title: Finn's Lute
description: Inge Six Fingers asks you to recover Finn's Lute, a unique eight-course lute stolen from the Bards College by thieves now holed up in Stony Creek Cave. Return it for a one-point increase to all Stealth skills.

base_facts: I am the Dean of Lute at the Bards College in Solitude.
I am still grieving the theft of Finn's Lute over a year ago.

LEARN_ABOUT_LUTE: Thieves broke into the College and stole Finn's Lute, the very first eight-course lute ever created.
I recently learned the thieves are hiding out in Stony Creek Cave in southeastern Eastmarch.
RETURN_LUTE: The player has returned Finn's Lute to me. I taught them a few stealth tricks as thanks.
QUEST_COMPLETE: Finn's Lute has been returned to me at last. I am overwhelmed with joy to have it back after over a year of grieving its loss.
I taught the player stealth tricks I've picked up over the yearsâ€”raising each Stealth skill by one pointâ€”as I could not pay what the lute is truly worth.
My disposition toward the player has improved for recovering the College's most precious instrument.

beats.comment: Player learns about the stolen lute from Inge.
Player agrees to recover Finn's Lute. Sets stage 20 and displays the find objective.
Player has found Finn's Lute in Stony Creek Cave. Observational gate for stage 40.
Player returns Finn's Lute to Inge and receives the Stealth skill reward. Sets stage 200 to finish.
Quest is finished. Observational gate for the completion stage.

title: Take Up Arms
description: Prove yourself worthy to join the Companions by speaking with Kodlak Whitemane, training with Vilkas, and running errands for the guild members in Jorrvaskr.

base_facts: I am the Harbinger of the Companions.
I lead the Companions from Jorrvaskr in Whiterun.

SPEAK_WITH_KODLAK: I have agreed to consider this newcomer for membership.
I asked Vilkas to test their combat skills in the yard.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The newcomer has completed their initiation and joined the Companions as a whelp.
Kodlak's instinct about their potential appears to have been well-founded.
They must now prove themselves through the guild's tasks before earning greater trust.

base_facts: I am a senior member of the Companions.
I train new recruits at Jorrvaskr.

TRAIN_WITH_VILKAS: I tested the newcomer in the yard.
They show some promise as a warrior.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The newcomer has earned their place as a whelp, though they still have much to prove.
They will need to complete jobs for the guild before earning the full respect of senior members.

base_facts: I am the smith at the Skyforge above Jorrvaskr.
I craft and maintain weapons and armor for the Companions.

DELIVER_SWORD_TO_EORLUND: The newcomer brought Vilkas's sword for sharpening.
I asked them to deliver Aela's shield to her.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The newcomer completed their errands and is now a whelp of the Companions.
Like all newcomers, they must work their way up through service to the guild.

base_facts: I am a member of the Companions.
I can often be found in Jorrvaskr's living quarters.

BRING_AELA_SHIELD: I asked Farkas to show them to their quarters.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The newcomer has joined the Companions as a whelp.
They will need to take on jobs from guild members to advance beyond their current rank.

base_facts: I am a member of the Companions.
I help new recruits settle into Jorrvaskr.

FOLLOW_FARKAS_TO_QUARTERS: I showed the newcomer to their quarters.
They are now a whelp of the Companions.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The newcomer is now a whelp with a bed in Jorrvaskr's living quarters.
Farkas offered them a job to help prove themselves to the Companions.
They must complete at least one task for the guild before receiving a more significant assignment.

beats.comment: Player speaks with Kodlak about joining the Companions.
Player spars with Vilkas in the yard to prove their worth.
Player takes Vilkas's sword to Eorlund at the Skyforge for sharpening.
Player delivers Aela's shield to her in the living quarters.
Player follows Farkas to their new quarters in Jorrvaskr.
Quest completes; player has officially joined the Companions.

title: Proving Honor
description: The Companions give the player a final trial before induction: retrieve a fragment of Wuuthrad from Dustman's Cairn with Farkas as Shield-Brother, where the Silver Hand and a startling werewolf revelation await.

base_facts: I am a senior member of the Companions and one of the Circle.
A scholar has discovered another fragment of Wuuthrad.
I assign new recruits their final trial before induction.

SPEAK_TO_SKJOR: I have sent the whelp to retrieve a Wuuthrad fragment with Farkas as their Shield-Brother.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The whelp passed the trial and has been inducted into the Companions by Kodlak.
The Wuuthrad fragment from Dustman's Cairn has been successfully recovered.
The new member will need to complete more work before I consider them for the next steps.

base_facts: I am a member of the Companions.
I will serve as Shield-Brother for the trial at Dustman's Cairn to judge the recruit's valor.

SPEAK_TO_FARKAS: I am accompanying the new recruit to Dustman's Cairn.
RETRIEVE_FRAGMENT: I revealed my werewolf form to fight off the Silver Hand.
The recruit proved honorable in retrieving the Wuuthrad fragment.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I swore eternal loyalty to the new Companion at their initiation ceremony.
The whelp proved honorable at Dustman's Cairn and retrieved the Wuuthrad fragment.
I revealed my beast blood to the recruit when the Silver Hand ambushed us in the cairn.

beats.comment: Player speaks to Skjor about the next steps and is given the trial to retrieve a Wuuthrad fragment.
Player speaks to Farkas who becomes their Shield-Brother for the Dustman's Cairn expedition.
Player fights through Dustman's Cairn, witnesses Farkas transform, and retrieves the Wuuthrad fragment.
Player returns to Jorrvaskr with the fragment for the initiation ceremony.
Quest complete. Player is inducted into the Companions as an official member by Kodlak.

title: The Silver Hand
description: After proving themselves to the Companions, the player is summoned by Skjor for a secret blood ritual in the Underforge, granting lycanthropy and membership in the Circle. Aela then leads an assault on the Silver Hand stronghold at Gallows Rock, where Skjor is found dead.

base_facts: I am a senior member of the Companions and part of the Circle.
I am a werewolf, sharing the blood of the beast with the Circle.
I have a special assignment for the newest member of the Companions.

TALK_TO_SKJOR: I have summoned the new member for a special mission.
They must meet me at the Underforge tonight.
MEET_SKJOR_AT_NIGHT: The Underforge is a secret crypt beneath Eorlund Gray-Mane's smithy.
The Harbinger Kodlak Whitemane must not know about this.
I will grant the new member the power of the beast through a blood ritual.
UNDERFORGE_RITUAL: The blood ritual is complete. The new member is now a werewolf and one of the Circle.

base_facts: I am a member of the Companions and part of the Circle.
I am a werewolf.
Skjor and I have planned something special for the newest member.

UNDERFORGE_RITUAL: I served as the forebear for the blood ritual, offering my blood to grant lycanthropy.
TALK_TO_AELA: The new member has survived the initiation and is now one of the Circle.
The Silver Hand at Gallows Rock must be slaughtered.
Skjor went ahead into the fort.
GALLOWS_ROCK_CLEARED: The Silver Hand at Gallows Rock have been killed.
QUEST_COMPLETE: Skjor is dead, killed by the Silver Hand.
I will have my revenge on the Silver Hand.
The new member has proven themselves in battle alongside me.

base_facts: I am the Harbinger of the Companions.
I disapprove of the Circle's lycanthropy and wish to find a cure for our blood.

beats.comment: Player is directed to Skjor for a special mission after completing radiant quests.
Player meets Skjor at night near the secret entrance to the Underforge.
Player enters the Underforge and participates in the blood ritual, becoming a werewolf.
After the rampage as a werewolf, player wakes and talks to Aela, who directs them to Gallows Rock.
Player clears Gallows Rock of Silver Hand members. Game sets stage 30 when enemies are killed.
Aela discovers Skjor's body at Gallows Rock. Quest finishes at stage 200.

title: Blood's Honor
description: Kodlak Whitemane, Harbinger of the Companions, reveals the true cost of the Companions' lycanthropy and sends the player to slay the Glenmoril Witches for their heads. Upon returning, the player discovers the Silver Hand has attacked Jorrvaskr and killed Kodlak.

base_facts: I am the Harbinger of the Companions.
I carry the beast blood and seek a cure for my lycanthropy so my spirit may reach Sovngarde.
The Companions' lycanthropy came from a pact my predecessor made with the Glenmoril Witches.

SPEAK_TO_KODLAK: I have asked to speak with the warrior about their secret missions against the Silver Hand.
I wish to explain the true nature of our condition and my desire for a cure.
HUNT_WITCHES: I have sent the warrior to slay the Glenmoril Witches and bring back their heads for the cure.

base_facts: I am a member of the Companions and a werewolf.
I have been sending the new warrior on missions against the Silver Hand.

KODLAK_SLAIN: Kodlak has been killed by the Silver Hand.
The Silver Hand attacked Jorrvaskr while the warrior was away at the coven.

base_facts: I am a member of the Companions and a werewolf.

KODLAK_SLAIN: Kodlak is dead. The Silver Hand attacked Jorrvaskr and stole the fragments of Wuuthrad.

beats.comment: Kodlak summons the player to discuss the secret missions and reveal the truth about lycanthropy.
Kodlak sends the player to kill the Glenmoril Witches and collect their heads for the cure.
Player has collected a Glenmoril Witch head and must return to Kodlak.
The Silver Hand attacked Jorrvaskr and killed Kodlak; quest completes and Purity of Revenge begins.

title: Purity of Revenge
description: After Kodlak Whitemane's death, Vilkas seeks revenge against the Silver Hand who attacked Jorrvaskr and stole the fragments of Wuuthrad. Accompany Vilkas to Driftshade Refuge, retrieve the fragments, and avenge Kodlak.

base_facts: Vilkas is a Companion seeking revenge for Kodlak Whitemane's death.
The Silver Hand attacked Jorrvaskr and stole the fragments of Wuuthrad.
Vilkas will accompany you to Driftshade Refuge as a shield-brother.

ACCEPT_QUEST: Vilkas is going with you to Driftshade Refuge to wipe out the Silver Hand.
DRIFTSHADE_COMPLETED: The Silver Hand at Driftshade Refuge have been defeated and the Wuuthrad fragments recovered.
QUEST_COMPLETE: Vilkas considers Kodlak's death avenged after the Silver Hand at Driftshade Refuge were wiped out.
The fragments of Wuuthrad have been recovered and returned to Jorrvaskr.
Vilkas directs the player to meet at the Skyforge to pay respects to the now-avenged Kodlak Whitemane.
Kodlak's funeral at the Skyforge begins immediately, starting the next quest Glory of the Dead.

beats.comment: Player learns Vilkas wants revenge for Kodlak's death.
Player agrees to accompany Vilkas to Driftshade Refuge.
Player has cleared Driftshade Refuge and retrieved Wuuthrad fragments.
Quest completes; Vilkas directs player to the Skyforge for Kodlak's funeral.

title: Glory of the Dead
description: After Kodlak Whitemane's death, the Companions hold his funeral at the Skyforge. Eorlund reforges Wuuthrad from its fragments, and the Circle travels to Ysgramor's Tomb to cleanse Kodlak's soul of lycanthropy using a Glenmoril Witch head so he may reach Sovngarde. The player is named the new Harbinger.

base_facts: I am a member of the Circle and Kodlak's shield-brother.
I grieve deeply for Kodlak and wanted him cleansed of the beast blood.
I will not enter the deeper tomb; my grief is too heavy.

FUNERAL: I attended Kodlak's funeral at the Skyforge.
CIRCLE_MEETING: I spoke of Kodlak's wish to be cleansed and the way through Ysgramor's Tomb.
CURE_KODLAK: Kodlak's soul is finally at peace in Sovngarde.
HARBINGER: A new Harbinger has been named to lead the Companions.

base_facts: I am a member of the Circle and a werewolf.
I do not see lycanthropy as a curse the way Kodlak did.
I lit the funeral pyre for Kodlak.

FUNERAL: I lit the flame at Kodlak's funeral.
TOMB_EXPEDITION: I accompanied the new Harbinger into Ysgramor's Tomb.
CURE_KODLAK: Kodlak's wolf spirit has been defeated and his soul is free.
HARBINGER: I acknowledge the new Harbinger and will stay in the tomb a while longer.

base_facts: I am a member of the Circle and a werewolf.
I am terrified of large spiders since Dustman's Cairn.
I cared for Kodlak and wanted to honor his wishes.

TOMB_EXPEDITION: I could not go past the spiders in the tomb and turned back.
HARBINGER: I accept the new Harbinger of the Companions.

base_facts: I was the Harbinger of the Companions.
I wished to be cleansed of my werewolf curse so I could enter Sovngarde.
I knew of a way to cleanse my soul even in death through the Tomb of Ysgramor.

BURIAL_CHAMBER: My ghost appeared near the Flame of the Harbinger and asked for the witch head.
CURE_KODLAK: My wolf spirit was defeated and my soul is finally free to go to Sovngarde.
HARBINGER: I named my successor as the new Harbinger before departing to Sovngarde.

base_facts: I am the smith of the Companions and work at the Skyforge.
I repaired Wuuthrad from its fragments.
Kodlak's funeral flame fueled the rebirth of Wuuthrad.

WUUTHRAD_REFORGED: I have reforged Wuuthrad from all its fragments including Kodlak's secret piece.
CIRCLE_MEETING: I brought the reforged Wuuthrad to the Circle in the Underforge.

beats.comment: Kodlak's funeral at the Skyforge; Aela lights the pyre.
All Wuuthrad fragments collected and given to Eorlund for reforging.
Circle gathers in the Underforge; Eorlund brings reforged Wuuthrad.
Travel to Ysgramor's Tomb; place Wuuthrad on Ysgramor's statue to open the way.
Reach the burial chamber and speak to Kodlak's ghost near the Flame of the Harbinger.
Throw witch head into fire, defeat Kodlak's wolf spirit, and speak to Kodlak one last time.
Kodlak names the player as the new Harbinger and departs to Sovngarde; quest complete.

title: Totems of Hircine
description: Aela the Huntress asks the player to retrieve a Totem of Hircine from a dungeon and return it to the Underforge in Whiterun, where it grants a new Beast Form power.

base_facts: Aela is a Companion and a werewolf who reveres Hircine.
She seeks the Totems of Hircine to restore the Companions' ancient traditions.
She accompanies the player as a Shield-Sister to retrieve each totem.

QUEST_ACCEPTED: Aela has asked the player to retrieve a Totem of Hircine from a dungeon.
TOTEM_RETRIEVED: The totem has been recovered from the dungeon and must be brought to the Underforge.
TOTEM_PLACED: The totem has been placed in the Underforge, granting a new Beast Form power.
QUEST_COMPLETED: Aela prays at the newly placed totem in the Underforge upon quest completion and will remain there for some time.
Aela awarded the player a leveled amount of gold for recovering the totem.
While praying at the totem, Aela initially only offers Animal Extermination work; she may offer the next totem quest after the player leaves and returns to the Underforge.
Aela can offer this quest up to three times total, one for each of the three Totems of Hircine still to be recovered.

beats.comment: Aela offers the totem quest when asked about work.
Player retrieves the totem from the dungeon.
Player places the totem in the Underforge.
Quest completion observed.

title: Purity
description: Farkas or Vilkas seeks to be cured of lycanthropy and asks the player to help retrieve a Glenmoril witch head and perform the purification ritual at Ysgramor's Tomb.

base_facts: I am a Companion and a werewolf.
I want to be cured of lycanthropy like Kodlak was.

AGREE_TO_HELP: I have asked someone to help me cure my lycanthropy.
PURITY_COMPLETE: I am cured of my beast blood.

base_facts: I am a Companion and a werewolf.
I want to be cured of lycanthropy like Kodlak was.

AGREE_TO_HELP: I have asked someone to help me cure my lycanthropy.
PURITY_COMPLETE: I am cured of my beast blood.

beats.comment: Player agrees to help Farkas or Vilkas cure their lycanthropy.
Player has a Glenmoril witch head and the cleansing at Ysgramor's Tomb begins.
The wolf spirit of the questgiver has been defeated in Ysgramor's Tomb.
Player speaks to the questgiver after the wolf spirit is slain.
Quest complete; the questgiver is cured of lycanthropy.

title: Joining the Legion
description: Prove your worth to the Imperial Legion by clearing Fort Hraggstad of bandits, then take the oath before General Tullius to become an Auxiliary.

base_facts: I am Legate Rikke, the commanding officer overseeing Imperial Legion recruitment in Skyrim.
I serve under General Tullius at Castle Dour in Solitude.
I test potential recruits before allowing them to join the Legion.

HEAR_ABOUT_LEGION: A survivor from Helgen is seeking to join the Imperial Legion.
SPEAK_TO_LEADERS: I have sent the recruit to clear Fort Hraggstad of bandits as a test of their usefulness.
CLEAR_FORT_HRAGGSTAD: The recruit has cleared Fort Hraggstad. I will send men to garrison it.
REPORT_TO_RIKKE: The recruit has proven themselves. It is time for them to take the Imperial oath.
TAKE_OATH: The recruit has taken the oath and is now an Auxiliary of the Imperial Legion.
QUEST_COMPLETE: Our new Auxiliary has been inducted and sent to Beirand for equipment.

base_facts: I am General Tullius, military governor of Skyrim and commander of the Imperial Legion forces here.
I am stationed at Castle Dour in Solitude, managing the war against the Stormcloaks.
I rely on Legate Rikke to evaluate new recruits.

SPEAK_TO_LEADERS: I directed a resourceful survivor from Helgen to Legate Rikke for recruitment.
TAKE_OATH: I administered the Imperial oath to the new recruit.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The new Auxiliary has been welcomed into the Legion and sent to get outfitted.

base_facts: I am Hadvar, a soldier of the Imperial Legion stationed in Riverwood.
I survived the dragon attack at Helgen alongside the player.

HEAR_ABOUT_LEGION: I encouraged the survivor from Helgen to travel to Solitude and join the Imperial Legion.

beats.comment: Player hears about joining the Imperial Legion from someone with Legion ties.
Player speaks to Legate Rikke and General Tullius at Castle Dour.
Player clears bandits from Fort Hraggstad to prove their usefulness.
Player returns to Legate Rikke after clearing Fort Hraggstad.
Player takes the Imperial oath before General Tullius.
Quest completes; player is now an Auxiliary of the Imperial Legion.

title: Get Outfitted
description: After joining the Imperial Legion and clearing Fort Hraggstad, General Tullius directs the new recruit to Beirand, the smith at Castle Dour, to receive a free set of Imperial armor.

base_facts: I command the Imperial Legion in Skyrim from Castle Dour.
New recruits must look the part and be properly outfitted.

TULLIUS_ORDERS: I've sent the new recruit to Beirand for Imperial armor.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The new recruit has been properly outfitted as an Imperial soldier.
The recruit is now equipped and ready to serve the Empire.

base_facts: I am the blacksmith at Castle Dour in Solitude.
I outfit Imperial soldiers with their armor.
Each soldier gets one free outfit; after that they must pay.

GET_IMPERIAL_GEAR: I've given the new recruit their Imperial armor set.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I've finished outfitting the new recruit with their Imperial armor.
I am no longer under special protection now that this outfitting duty is done.
My shop inventory carries fewer items now that the assignment is complete.
The recruit has received their one free outfit; any replacements must be paid for.

beats.comment: Observational gate when Tullius directs the player to Beirand after joining the Legion.
Player talks to Beirand and chooses light, medium, or heavy Imperial armor to complete the outfitting.
Observational gate when the quest finishes and the player is fully outfitted.

title: Joining the Stormcloaks
description: Prove your worth to join the Stormcloaks by killing an Ice Wraith at Serpentstone Isle, then return to Galmar Stone-Fist in Windhelm to take the Stormcloak oath.

base_facts: I am Jarl of Windhelm and leader of the Stormcloak rebellion.
I recognize this recruit from Helgen.
Those who wish to join the Stormcloaks must speak with Galmar Stone-Fist.

JOIN_STORMCLOAKS_INITIATED: I have directed this recruit to Galmar for testing.
OATH_TAKEN: This recruit has proven worthy and joined the Stormcloaks.

base_facts: I am Ulfric Stormcloak's lieutenant and I handle recruitment for the Stormcloaks.
New recruits must prove themselves by killing an Ice Wraith at Serpentstone Isle.
I can provide an Elixir of Resist Cold and Ice Wraith Banes to help recruits who need them.

JOIN_STORMCLOAKS_INITIATED: I have sent this recruit to kill an Ice Wraith at Serpentstone Isle.
ICE_WRAITH_KILLED: The recruit has returned from Serpentstone Isle alive.
RETURN_TO_GALMAR: The recruit has proven their mettle and is ready to take the oath.
OATH_TAKEN: This recruit has taken the Stormcloak oath and is now one of us, an Unblooded.

beats.comment: Player speaks with Ulfric who directs to Galmar; Galmar sends player to kill an Ice Wraith at Serpentstone Isle.
Player has killed the Ice Wraith; stage 100 fires and the return objective appears.
Player returns to Galmar after killing the Ice Wraith; stage 160 fires for taking the oath.
Player takes the Stormcloak oath; quest completes at stage 200.

title: The Jagged Crown (Imperial)
description: After joining the Imperial Legion, Legate Rikke sends the player to recover the Jagged Crown from the ruins of Korvanjund before the Stormcloaks can claim it, then deliver it to General Tullius in Solitude.

base_facts: I am a Legate in the Imperial Legion serving under General Tullius.
The Jagged Crown is an ancient symbol of Skyrim's rulers hidden in Korvanjund.
Recovering the crown before the Stormcloaks would strike a blow to Ulfric's claim.

TALK_TO_RIKKE: I have assigned the new recruit to help recover the Jagged Crown from Korvanjund.
MEET_AT_KORVANJUND: The Imperial force has arrived at Korvanjund and Stormcloaks are already here.
RETRIEVE_CROWN: The recruit has retrieved the Jagged Crown from the depths of Korvanjund.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The recruit successfully delivered the Jagged Crown to General Tullius as ordered.
The Korvanjund operation was completed despite Stormcloak interference inside the ruins.
The Empire's strategic position in the civil war is strengthened by securing the ancient crown.

base_facts: I am the military governor of Skyrim and commander of the Imperial Legion here.
The Jagged Crown is a symbol of legitimacy for whoever claims the throne of Skyrim.

DELIVER_CROWN: The Jagged Crown has been delivered. This strengthens the Empire's claim in Skyrim.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The Jagged Crown is now in Imperial custody, strengthening the Empire's claim to Skyrim's throne.
He commended the recruit for successfully recovering the crown from Korvanjund.
He immediately issued new orders directing the recruit to the next mission: Message to Whiterun.
With the crown secured, Ulfric Stormcloak's claim to rulership lacks its most potent symbol of legitimacy.

base_facts: I am an Imperial soldier who escaped Helgen alongside the recruit.
I have concerns about what lurks inside ancient Nordic ruins.

MEET_AT_KORVANJUND: The Stormcloaks are a threat, but the ruins themselves may be worse.

beats.comment: Player receives assignment from Legate Rikke to recover the Jagged Crown.
Player meets Rikke outside Korvanjund where Imperial forces gather before the assault.

keywords: I need to speak with them

triggers.intent: Player explicitly agrees to proceed with this quest handoff: Player meets Rikke outside Korvanjund where Imperial forces gather before the assault.
examples_yes: Tell me what needs to happen next.
examples_no: What are you asking me to do?
No, I do not want to do that.

beats.intent_summary: Player agrees to proceed with this quest handoff: Player meets Rikke outside Korvanjund where Imperial forces gather before the assault.

beats.comment: Player fights through Korvanjund ruins and retrieves the Jagged Crown from the draugr overlord.
Player delivers the Jagged Crown to General Tullius in Solitude.
Quest completes after delivering the crown. Tullius gives next assignment leading to Message to Whiterun.

title: The Jagged Crown (Stormcloaks)
description: After joining the Stormcloaks, Galmar Stone-Fist sends the player to retrieve the Jagged Crown from the ruins of Korvanjund. The player fights through Imperial soldiers and draugr, solves a puzzle door, and retrieves the crown from a boss-level draugr before delivering it to Ulfric Stormcloak in Windhelm.

base_facts: I am Galmar Stone-Fist, second-in-command of the Stormcloak Rebellion.
I know the Jagged Crown lies in the ruins of Korvanjund.
I lead Stormcloak forces on expeditions to reclaim important artifacts.

TALK_TO_GALMAR: I have given the recruit the mission to retrieve the Jagged Crown from Korvanjund.
MEET_GALMAR_KORVANJUND: I am leading the assault on Korvanjund to retrieve the Jagged Crown.
RETRIEVE_CROWN: The Jagged Crown has been found. I told the recruit to take it straight to Ulfric.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I remained behind at Korvanjund to search the ruins for anything else of use while the recruit delivered the Jagged Crown.
The Jagged Crown has been successfully retrieved from Korvanjund and delivered to Ulfric.

base_facts: I am Ulfric Stormcloak, Jarl of Windhelm and leader of the Stormcloak Rebellion.
The Jagged Crown is a symbol of legitimacy for the High King of Skyrim.

DELIVER_CROWN: The Jagged Crown has been delivered to me. This strengthens our claim to rule Skyrim.
GET_NEW_ORDERS: I have given new orders for the next phase of the campaign.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I have received the Jagged Crown from the recruit, securing a powerful symbol of legitimacy for the Stormcloak Rebellion.
I am immediately tasking the recruit with delivering a message to Balgruuf in Whiterun for the next phase of the campaign.

base_facts: I am a Stormcloak soldier loyal to Ulfric's cause.
I joined the expedition to Korvanjund.

MEET_GALMAR_KORVANJUND: I am at Korvanjund with Galmar and the other Stormcloaks, ready to fight.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I fought alongside the recruit and Galmar through the ruins of Korvanjund to retrieve the Jagged Crown.
The Jagged Crown has been delivered to Ulfric, marking a significant victory for the Stormcloaks.

beats.comment: Player talks to Galmar and receives the mission to retrieve the Jagged Crown from Korvanjund.
Player meets Galmar outside Korvanjund and the assault on the ruins begins.

keywords: I need to speak with them

triggers.intent: Player explicitly agrees to proceed with this quest handoff: Player meets Galmar outside Korvanjund and the assault on the ruins begins.
examples_yes: Tell me what needs to happen next.
examples_no: What are you asking me to do?
No, I do not want to do that.

beats.intent_summary: Player agrees to proceed with this quest handoff: Player meets Galmar outside Korvanjund and the assault on the ruins begins.

beats.comment: Player retrieves the Jagged Crown from the boss draugr in Korvanjund Crypt.
Player delivers the Jagged Crown to Ulfric Stormcloak in the Palace of Kings.
Player receives new orders from Ulfric after delivering the crown.

triggers.intent: Player explicitly agrees to proceed with this quest handoff: Player receives new orders from Ulfric after delivering the crown.
examples_yes: Tell me what needs to happen next.
examples_no: What are you asking me to do?
No, I do not want to do that.

beats.intent_summary: Player agrees to proceed with this quest handoff: Player receives new orders from Ulfric after delivering the crown.

beats.comment: The Jagged Crown quest is complete. The next quest Message to Whiterun begins.

title: Message to Whiterun (Imperial)
description: General Tullius sends the player to deliver a message to Jarl Balgruuf of Whiterun, offering Imperial military support against a potential Stormcloak attack. Balgruuf sends his war axe to Ulfric Stormcloak as a traditional Nord peace offering, but Ulfric rejects it, signaling war. The player must warn Balgruuf and report to Legate Quentin Cipius as the Battle for Whiterun begins.

base_facts: I am the military governor of Skyrim and commander of the Imperial Legion stationed in Solitude.
I am concerned about a potential Stormcloak attack on Whiterun and want the Legion to be part of its defense.

QUEST_BEGUN: I have sent the player to deliver my message to Jarl Balgruuf, offering Imperial military support in exchange for Whiterun's allegiance to the Empire.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I have received Balgruuf's letter confirming Whiterun's allegiance to the Empire and the terms for Legionnaires in the hold.
My Imperial forces are now actively defending Whiterun against the Stormcloak invasion.

base_facts: I am the Jarl of Whiterun, trying to keep my hold neutral in the Civil War.
I will not commit to the Empire until the dragon threat at Whiterun is dealt with.

MESSAGE_DELIVERED: I have received General Tullius's message but am reluctant to pick a side.
I am sending my war axe to Ulfric Stormcloak as a traditional Nord peace offering.
JARL_WARNED: Ulfric has rejected my axe, meaning war is coming to Whiterun.
I have accepted Imperial military support to defend the city.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I have taken back my rejected war axe and abandoned Whiterun's neutrality to side with the Empire.
