The captured weapons and gold from the wagon are to be collected by Imperial forces for the war effort.
The player can loot the wagon chest now, though its contents are meant to support the Imperial campaign.

beats.comment: Player is sent to Mistveil Keep to find incriminating evidence on Anuriel.
Player finds the incriminating letter and confronts Anuriel, who reveals intel about the Stormcloak shipment.

keywords: I know about the Thieves Guild

beats.comment: Player reports the wagon intel to Rikke, who sends them to meet the scouts.

keywords: Anuriel told me about a wagon

beats.comment: Player meets Hadvar's scouts, ambushes the Stormcloak sentry, and takes over the caravan.
Player reports to Hadvar after the battle; quest completes with the shipment captured.

title: Compelling Tribute (Stormcloaks)
description: Galmar Stone-Fist sends you to Markarth to find evidence that Steward Raerek secretly worships Talos, then blackmail him into revealing Imperial shipment routes. After reporting back, join Ralof's scouting party to ambush the caravan carrying weapons and coin to Solitude.

base_facts: I am Galmar Stone-Fist, Ulfric's right hand and war commander of the Stormcloak rebellion.
I coordinate military operations and assign missions to Stormcloak soldiers.
Raerek, the Steward of Markarth, secretly worships Talos Ã¢â‚¬â€ that makes him vulnerable to leverage.

MISSION_BRIEFING: I've dispatched someone to Markarth to find proof of Raerek's Talos worship and use it against him.
REPORT_TO_GALMAR: Raerek gave up the location of an Imperial shipment heading to Solitude. I've ordered an ambush along the road.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The Imperial shipment has been seized â€” weapons and coin for the Stormcloaks. This will arm our next campaign.
Raerek's leverage paid off. The steward knows what happens if he refuses us again.
Gold well earned by the soldier who handled this. They've proven their worth to the cause.

base_facts: I am Raerek, Steward to Jarl Igmund of Markarth.
I secretly worship Talos Ã¢â‚¬â€ if the Thalmor found out, it would ruin me.

BLACKMAIL_RAEREK: I was forced to reveal Imperial shipment routes to protect my secret. I just want my amulet back and this forgotten.
QUEST_COMPLETE: My Talos worship remains a secret, but I am now compromised and at the Stormcloaks' mercy.
The Imperial shipment I revealed has been captured. I pray this is the last they demand of me.

base_facts: I am Ralof, a Stormcloak soldier from Riverwood.
I lead scouting and ambush operations for the rebellion.

AMBUSH_CARAVAN: The Imperial caravan has been hit. We secured the weapons and coin for the Stormcloaks.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The caravan ambush was a success. Imperial weapons and coin now belong to the rebellion.
Galmar will want a full report â€” this haul will arm our soldiers well.

beats.comment: Galmar assigns the mission to find blackmail material on Raerek in Markarth.
Player found the inscribed Amulet of Talos in Raerek's quarters and blackmailed him into revealing shipment intel.
Player reports Raerek's intel about the shipment to Galmar, who orders the ambush.
Player meets Ralof's scouts, ambushes the Imperial caravan, and secures the shipment of weapons and coin.
Quest complete Ã¢â‚¬â€ Raerek blackmailed and Imperial shipment captured for the Stormcloaks.

title: Liberation of Skyrim
description: The overarching Stormcloak Civil War quest. Report to Ulfric Stormcloak in Windhelm for assignments, then speak to Galmar Stone-Fist at the relevant Stormcloak camp to receive specific battle missions. Liberate each Imperial-held hold by conquering its fort, culminating in the Battle for Solitude.

base_facts: I am the leader of the Stormcloak rebellion and Jarl of Eastmarch.
I direct the liberation campaign from the Palace of the Kings in Windhelm.
I promote those who prove themselves in battle and grant titles and rewards.

LIBERATION_STARTED: This soldier has pledged to help liberate Skyrim from Imperial control.
LIBERATION_COMPLETED: We have won the war. Skyrim is free of Imperial rule.

base_facts: I am Ulfric's second-in-command and handle tactical field assignments.
I can be found in the main tent at Stormcloak camps, reviewing maps of the war.
Soldiers report to me with 'Reporting in' to receive their specific mission.

LIBERATION_STARTED: A new recruit has joined the liberation effort. I will assign them to the first hold.
LIBERATION_COMPLETED: The war is over. The Empire is driven from Skyrim.

beats.comment: Quest starts automatically after Battle for Whiterun. Player pledges to help liberate Skyrim.
Quest finishes after Battle for Solitude. General Tullius is dead and Skyrim is liberated.

title: Reunification of Skyrim
description: Umbrella quest governing the Imperial Legion Civil War campaign. After defending Whiterun, report to General Tullius for promotion and orders, then conquer each Stormcloak-held hold by capturing its military fort through a series of sub-quests, culminating in the siege of Windhelm and the death of Ulfric Stormcloak.

base_facts: I command the Imperial Legion in Skyrim.
The Stormcloak rebellion must be crushed to reunify Skyrim under the Empire.
I promote soldiers who prove their loyalty and effectiveness in battle.

QUEST_STARTED: Whiterun is secured. I have a new soldier to help reclaim the remaining holds.
REPORT_TO_TULLIUS: I promoted the soldier to Quaestor and directed them to Legate Rikke for field assignment.
QUEST_COMPLETED: The rebellion is over. Ulfric Stormcloak is dead and Skyrim is once again part of the Empire.

base_facts: I am General Tullius's legate and field commander.
I give assignments at Imperial Military Camps across Skyrim.
Each Stormcloak-held hold must be taken by capturing its military fort.

QUEST_STARTED: Report to me at the assigned Imperial camp for your next orders.
HOLD_CONQUESTS: Another hold falls to the Empire. Report back for your next assignment.
QUEST_COMPLETED: The war is over. Skyrim is reunited under Imperial control.

beats.comment: Quest begins automatically after Battle for Whiterun. Player pledges to help reunify Skyrim under Imperial control.
Player reports to Tullius at Castle Dour after Whiterun defense, receives Quaestor rank and assignment to meet Rikke at an Imperial camp.
Ongoing phase: player conquers Stormcloak holds via sub-quests, reporting to Rikke at military camps between each operation.
After Fort Amol is taken, Rikke orders the final assault on Windhelm.
Ulfric Stormcloak is dead, the rebellion is crushed, and Skyrim is reunited under Imperial control.

title: Battle for Windhelm
description: The Imperial Legion's final assault on Windhelm. Join General Tullius, fight through the city to the Palace of the Kings, confront Ulfric Stormcloak and Galmar Stone-Fist, and end the Stormcloak rebellion.

base_facts: I am a Legate in the Imperial Legion serving under General Tullius.
I coordinate the Imperial war effort across Skyrim.

QUEST_RECEIVED: I have ordered the Dragonborn to join General Tullius for the final assault on Windhelm.

base_facts: I am the General commanding all Imperial forces in Skyrim.
I am determined to crush the Stormcloak rebellion once and for all.

PALACE_CONFRONTATION: I demanded Ulfric Stormcloak's surrender in the Palace of the Kings.
I stated that Ulfric's death is the only path to peace.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I gave the Dragonborn a leveled enchanted sword after Ulfric's death.
I delivered a victory speech to the assembled Imperial soldiers in Windhelm.

base_facts: I am the Jarl of Windhelm and leader of the Stormcloak rebellion.
I believe Skyrim must be free from the Empire and the Thalmor.

PALACE_CONFRONTATION: I refused to surrender to General Tullius and fought to the bitter end.
I requested that the Dragonborn be the one to strike me down.

base_facts: I am Ulfric Stormcloak's right hand and general of the Stormcloak army.
I would rather die fighting than surrender to the Empire.

PALACE_CONFRONTATION: I stood by Ulfric's side in the Palace of the Kings and fought the Imperial forces.

base_facts: I am a citizen of Windhelm who sympathizes with the Empire's cause.

QUEST_COMPLETE: I have been installed as the new Jarl of Windhelm after the Imperial victory.
I can grant the privilege of buying property in Windhelm and the title of Thane of Eastmarch.

beats.comment: Player receives orders to join the final assault on Windhelm. Stage 1 fires.
Player fights through Windhelm's streets alongside Imperial soldiers toward the Palace of the Kings.
Player enters the Palace of the Kings and confronts Ulfric and Galmar. Tullius demands surrender; they attack.
Galmar is killed and Ulfric is forced to his knees. Player chooses who delivers the killing blow. Tullius gives a leveled enchanted sword.
Windhelm is captured, Ulfric is dead, the rebellion is destroyed. Tullius gives a victory speech. Brunwulf Free-Winter becomes Jarl. Stage 9000 finishes the quest.

title: The Black Star
description: Aranea Ienith, a priestess of Azura, directs the player to find an elven mage who can turn the brightest star as black as night. The trail leads to Nelacar in Winterhold, who reveals the story of Malyn Varen and his corrupted experiments on Azura's Star at Ilinalta's Deep. After recovering the broken Star, the player must choose whether to return it to Aranea for Azura's purification or to Nelacar to forge a Black Soul Gem, then enter the Star itself to destroy Malyn Varen's soul.

base_facts: I am a priestess of Azura and the last worshipper at her shrine in Skyrim.
Azura foresaw your arrival and shared a vision with me.
The vision speaks of an elven mage who can turn the brightest star as black as night.
I believe the elven mage can be found in Winterhold.

VISIT_SHRINE: The player has come to the Shrine as Azura foretold and accepted the quest.
CHOOSE_PATH: The player has chosen to return the Star to Azura for purification.
QUEST_COMPLETE: Azura has purified the Star. I am free to follow my own path and may offer to travel with the player.

base_facts: I am a former colleague of Malyn Varen at the College of Winterhold.
Malyn Varen was experimenting on Azura's Star to save himself from a terminal illness.
Malyn killed a student and was banished from the College. He fled to Ilinalta's Deep.
I do not want the Star returned to Azura. It should be kept out of her reach.

SPEAK_TO_NELACAR: The player knows about Azura's Star and Malyn Varen's experiments at Ilinalta's Deep.
CHOOSE_PATH: The player has chosen to bring the Star to me instead of Azura.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The Black Star is complete. An infinite Black Soul Gem capable of trapping any soul.

beats.comment: Player visits the Shrine of Azura and speaks to Aranea, learning of the prophecy.
Player finds Nelacar in Winterhold and learns about Malyn Varen and the Star.
Player retrieves the broken Azura's Star from Ilinalta's Deep after defeating Malyn's necromancers.
Player decides whether to bring the corrupted Star to Aranea for Azura or to Nelacar for the Black Star.
Player enters Azura's Star interior to confront Malyn Varen's soul.
Player destroys Malyn Varen's soul inside the Star.
Quest ends. Player receives either Azura's Star (white souls) or The Black Star (black souls).

title: Boethiah's Calling
description: A Daedric quest requiring the Dragonborn to find the Sacellum of Boethiah, sacrifice a trusted follower on the Pillar of Sacrifice, slay the remaining cultists, then kill Boethiah's current champion at Knifepoint Ridge to claim the Ebony Mail and become her new champion.

base_facts: I serve Boethiah at the Sacellum in the mountains near Windhelm.
To earn Boethiah's favor, you must sacrifice someone who trusts you on the Pillar of Sacrifice.
Take the Blade of Sacrifice and lead a follower to the pillar.

SACRIFICE_FOLLOWER: A sacrifice has been offered to Boethiah. She will speak through the fallen.
SLAY_CULTISTS: The cultists have fallen. Boethiah will name her new champion from whoever remains.
QUEST_COMPLETE: Boethiah has named a new champion after the trials of sacrifice and combat were fulfilled.
The Sacellum's purpose is served; I remain here to test the next who seeks Boethiah's calling.
The Blade of Sacrifice I provided was used as intended, and Boethiah's favor has been earned.

base_facts: I am Boethiah, Daedric Prince of Deceit, Conspiracy, and Treachery.
I demand proof of devotion through sacrifice and combat.

SLAY_CULTISTS: Fight to the death among my followers. Whoever survives will receive my task.
SLAY_CHAMPION: My former champion at Knifepoint Ridge has fallen. Don the Ebony Mail and become my new champion.
CLAIM_REWARD: You are my new champion. The Ebony Mail is yours.
QUEST_COMPLETE: My new champion wears the Ebony Mail as proof of their devotion and victory at Knifepoint Ridge.
The former champion is dead and replaced; treachery and combat have proven this mortal worthy.
I have spoken my final words to my champion for now, but I will watch their deeds with interest.

beats.comment: Player learns of Boethiah's shrine through the book or direct discovery.
Player leads a follower to the Pillar of Sacrifice and slays them.
After the sacrifice, Boethiah commands the cultists to fight to the death.
Boethiah tasks the player with killing her current champion at Knifepoint Ridge.
Player retrieves and equips the Ebony Mail from the fallen champion.
Boethiah names the player her new champion. Quest finishes.

title: A Daedra's Best Friend
description: A talking dog named Barbas seeks help reuniting with his master, the Daedric Prince Clavicus Vile. Retrieve the Rueful Axe from Rimerock Burrow, then choose: kill Barbas and keep the axe, or return the axe and receive the Masque of Clavicus Vile.

base_facts: I am a talking dog and the separated other half of Clavicus Vile.
I had a falling out with my master and need someone to arbitrate our disagreement.
My master's shrine is near Haemar's Shame, guarded by vampires.
The Rueful Axe was created by Clavicus for a wizard named Sebastian Lort who wished to end his daughter's werewolf curse.

MEET_BARBAS: I have found someone willing to help settle my dispute with Clavicus Vile.
REACH_SHRINE: I have led my new friend to Clavicus Vile's shrine at Haemar's Shame.
AXE_RETRIEVED: The Rueful Axe has been retrieved from Sebastian Lort in Rimerock Burrow.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I have been reunited with Clavicus Vile and the axe was returned.

base_facts: I am the blacksmith of Falkreath.
I have been looking for a fine, strong dog wandering near town and will pay someone to catch it.
I can provide fresh meat as bait to lure the dog.

HEAR_ABOUT_DOG: I have asked someone to find that stray dog for me.

base_facts: I am the Daedric Prince of Bargains and Wishes.
Barbas holds half of my power; without him I am weakened and confined to my shrine.
The Rueful Axe is in Rimerock Burrow, guarded by the wizard Sebastian Lort.

REACH_SHRINE: A mortal has reached my shrine and may strike a bargain.
CLAVICUS_BARGAIN: I have offered a deal: retrieve the Rueful Axe and I will consider taking Barbas back.
FINAL_DECISION: The axe has been returned. Now the mortal must choose: kill Barbas and keep the axe, or return the axe and reunite us.
QUEST_COMPLETE: Barbas and I are reunited, and the mortal received the Masque of Clavicus Vile.

beats.comment: Player hears about Lod looking for a dog from a Falkreath guard and speaks to Lod.
Player finds Barbas outside Falkreath and agrees to help arbitrate his dispute with Clavicus Vile.
Player travels with Barbas to Haemar's Shame and reaches the Shrine of Clavicus Vile.
Clavicus Vile offers a deal: retrieve the Rueful Axe from Rimerock Burrow in exchange for possibly taking Barbas back.
Player retrieves the Rueful Axe from Sebastian Lort in Rimerock Burrow and must return to the shrine.
Player must choose: give the axe to Clavicus and reunite him with Barbas for the Masque, or kill Barbas with the axe and keep it.
Quest ends. Either Barbas is killed and the player keeps the Rueful Axe, or Barbas is reunited with Clavicus and the player receives the Masque of Clavicus Vile.

title: Discerning the Transmundane
description: A Daedric quest in which the player aids the mad scholar Septimus Signus in opening a Dwemer lockbox by transcribing an Elder Scroll's knowledge into a lexicon and harvesting blood from the mer races, ultimately receiving the Oghma Infinium from Hermaeus Mora.

base_facts: I am a preeminent scholar of the Elder Scrolls, living in the northern ice fields.
I have studied a Dwemer lockbox for years, believing it contains the heart of a god.
I need an Elder Scroll's knowledge inscribed into a Dwemer lexicon to decipher the lockbox.

MET_SEPTIMUS: I have given the player an Attunement Sphere and a Blank Lexicon to transcribe at the Tower of Mzark in Blackreach.
LEXICON_RETURNED: The lexicon has been transcribed with the Scroll's knowledge. I now know I need blood from the mer races to open the lockbox.
BLOOD_HARVEST: I need blood from Altmer, Bosmer, Dunmer, Falmer, and Orsimer to create a dwarven blood mixture and open the lockbox.
BLOOD_RETURNED: The blood has been collected. I can finally open the lockbox and reveal the heart of a god!
QUEST_COMPLETE: The lockbox contained only a book, not the Heart of a God. I was wrong.

base_facts: I am the Daedric Prince of Knowledge and Memory, also called Herma-Mora.
I have been guiding Septimus Signus in his research through the Wretched Abyss.

LEXICON_RETURNED: I have revealed myself to the player. Septimus is a useful follower but will outlive his usefulness once the lockbox is opened.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The player has taken the Oghma Infinium and is now my champion. Its dangerous knowledge is unleashed once more.

beats.comment: Player received the book or learned about Septimus Signus and must ask Urag about it.
Player met Septimus and received the Attunement Sphere and Blank Lexicon to transcribe at the Tower of Mzark.

keywords: I need to speak with them

triggers.intent: Player explicitly agrees to proceed with this quest handoff: Player met Septimus and received the Attunement Sphere and Blank Lexicon to transcribe at the Tower of Mzark.
examples_yes: Tell me what needs to happen next.
examples_no: What are you asking me to do?
No, I do not want to do that.

beats.intent_summary: Player agrees to proceed with this quest handoff: Player met Septimus and received the Attunement Sphere and Blank Lexicon to transcribe at the Tower of Mzark.

beats.comment: Player gave the transcribed Runed Lexicon to Septimus. Hermaeus Mora reveals himself at the outpost.
Septimus needs blood from five mer races. Player must harvest Altmer, Bosmer, Dunmer, Falmer, and Orsimer blood.
Player brought the collected blood to Septimus. He opens the lockbox and enters it.
Septimus is disposed of by Hermaeus Mora. The Oghma Infinium is revealed inside the lockbox.
Quest complete. The player has taken the Oghma Infinium and been named Hermaeus Mora's champion.

title: Ill Met By Moonlight
description: A Daedric quest in which the player must choose whether to help the werewolf Sinding escape Hircine's Great Hunt or kill him and claim the Savior's Hide.

base_facts: My daughter Lavinia was killed by a laborer named Sinding.
I work at Corpselight Farm in Falkreath.

LEARN_OF_SINDING: A stranger has offered to look into Sinding's crime.

base_facts: I am a werewolf who stole the Ring of Hircine to control my transformations.
Hircine cursed the ring, causing me to transform uncontrollably.
I accidentally killed a little girl when I transformed.

MEET_SINDING: I gave the Ring of Hircine to someone who might appease Hircine for me.
GROTTO_CONFRONTATION: I have fled to Bloated Man's Grotto to escape the hunters.
COMPLETE_SAVE_SINDING: I am free and will never return to civilized life.

base_facts: I am the Daedric Prince of the Hunt.
Sinding stole my ring and must be punished.

HIRCINES_CHALLENGE: I have commanded the Great Hunt for Sinding's skin.
COMPLETE_KILL_SINDING: The hunt is complete. I have rewarded the hunter with the Savior's Hide.
COMPLETE_SAVE_SINDING: The prey escaped, but the hunt was still glorious. I have granted the Ring of Hircine.

beats.comment: Player learns about the vagrant who killed a child in Falkreath.
Player speaks to Sinding in Falkreath Jail and receives the Cursed Ring of Hircine.
After killing the White Stag, Hircine tasks the player with hunting Sinding.
Player confronts Sinding in Bloated Man's Grotto and must choose to kill or spare him.
Player killed Sinding and skinned him, receiving the Savior's Hide from Hircine.
Player defended Sinding from the hunters and received the Ring of Hircine.

title: The Cursed Tribe
description: Help the cursed Orcs of Largashbur by aiding wise woman Atub in contacting Malacath, then assist Chief Yamarz in reclaiming the desecrated shrine from giants.

base_facts: I am the wise woman of the Orc stronghold Largashbur.
Our tribe has been cursed and giants attack us openly.
I need a Daedra Heart and Troll Fat to perform a ritual to contact Malacath.

GATHER_INGREDIENTS: The player has brought me the ingredients for the ritual.
MALACATHS_JUDGMENT: Malacath has spoken through the ritual and demands Yamarz reclaim the shrine.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The curse on Largashbur has been lifted by Malacath's intervention.
Gularzob has been named the new chief of our tribe in Yamarz's place.
The outsider who aided us has been named Malacath's Champion.
Our tribe is free to leave the stronghold again without fear of the giants.

base_facts: I am the chief of Largashbur, though Malacath considers me weak.
Giants have desecrated Malacath's shrine and I must reclaim it.

ESCORT_YAMARZ: I am traveling to Fallowstone Cave to deal with the giant.
DEFEAT_GIANT: The giant at the shrine has been defeated.
QUEST_COMPLETE: Malacath judged me a weakling unfit to lead and stripped me of my title as chief.
I fell at Giant's Grove after my cowardice was exposed.
Gularzob has replaced me as chief of Largashbur.

base_facts: I am an Orc of Largashbur.

QUEST_COMPLETE: Malacath has named me the new chief of Largashbur, replacing the weakling Yamarz.
The curse on our tribe has been lifted by Malacath's judgment.
The outsider who aided us has been named Malacath's Champion for restoring the shrine.
Shagrol's Hammer transformed into Volendrung when placed on the shrine.

beats.comment: Player hears about trouble at Largashbur. Note: stage 10 is never set in the final game.
Player helps fight the giant and brings Troll Fat and Daedra Heart to Atub.
Atub performs the ritual and Malacath commands Yamarz to reclaim the shrine.
Player escorts Yamarz to Fallowstone Cave and protects him through the cave.
Player defeats the giant at Giant's Grove. Yamarz may die here.
Player returns Shagrol's Hammer to Largashbur and places it on the shrine.
Quest complete. Malacath names Gularzob the new chief. The hammer transforms into Volendrung.

title: Pieces of the Past
description: Silus Vesuius, curator of the Mythic Dawn museum in Dawnstar, tasks the player with retrieving three scattered pieces of Mehrunes' Razor. Once reunited, Silus seeks to reforge the dagger at the Shrine of Mehrunes Dagon, where the Daedric Prince demands Silus be killed in exchange for the restored weapon.

base_facts: I run the Museum of the Mythic Dawn in my home in Dawnstar.
My ancestors were members of the Mythic Dawn cult that opened the Oblivion gates.
I have spent my life collecting artifacts tied to the Mythic Dawn.
I seek the three pieces of Mehrunes' Razor: the pommel, the blade shards, and the hilt.

MEET_SILUS: A visitor has come to my museum. Perhaps they can help me retrieve the Razor pieces.
ACCEPT_QUEST: This adventurer has agreed to retrieve the three pieces of Mehrunes' Razor for me.
ALL_PIECES_RETURNED: All three pieces of the Razor have been returned. We must reforge it at the Shrine of Mehrunes Dagon.
SPEAK_TO_DAGON: Mehrunes Dagon has spoken and demands a sacrifice before reforging the Razor.
QUEST_COMPLETE: If I am killed at the shrine, my life's work dies with me and the Razor passes to Dagon's champion.
If I survive, I flee the shrine and return to Dawnstar, but Mehrunes' Razor is forever out of mortal hands.
My museum in Dawnstar remains open regardless of the outcome at the shrine.
I will never possess the reforged Razor; either the adventurer claims it or Dagon reclaims it.

base_facts: I am Mehrunes Dagon, Daedric Prince of Destruction, Change, Revolution, Energy, and Ambition.
My Razor was broken into three pieces and scattered across Skyrim long ago.

SPEAK_TO_DAGON: A mortal seeks to reforge my Razor. Kill the one who brought the pieces, and the weapon shall be yours.
KILL_SILUS: The mortal has proven worthy. I shall reforge my Razor and grant it to my new champion.
QUEST_COMPLETE: If the mortal kills Silus at my command, I reforge the Razor and grant it to my new champion.
If the mortal refuses to kill Silus, I deny them the Razor and summon Dremora to attack them at the shrine.
My shrine interior becomes accessible to the mortal after the ritual concludes, regardless of the choice made.
The Razor remains my weapon; only those who prove worthy through sacrifice may wield it.

beats.comment: Player speaks to Silus about the museum and the Razor, starting the quest.
Player agrees to retrieve the three Razor pieces from their keepers.
All three Razor pieces have been returned and Silus wants to meet at the shrine.
Player invokes Mehrunes Dagon at the shrine and he demands Silus be killed.
Player kills Silus as demanded by Mehrunes Dagon to claim the Razor.
Quest ends: either the Razor is claimed after killing Silus, or Silus is spared and the Razor is lost.

title: The Whispering Door
description: A Daedric quest in which the player hears rumors of Jarl Balgruuf's troubled son Nelkir, discovers the Whispering Door in Dragonsreach's basement, speaks with Mephala the Lady of Whispers, obtains the key, and retrieves the Ebony Blade.

base_facts: I am the youngest son of Jarl Balgruuf the Greater.
I know secrets about my father that he would never share, including that he still worships Talos.
The Whispering Lady speaks to me through the old door in the basement.
Only Balgruuf and Farengar possess keys to the Whispering Door.

TALK_NELKIR: I told the adventurer about the Whispering Lady and the door in the basement.
OBTAIN_KEY: I explained that only Balgruuf and Farengar have keys to the Whispering Door.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The Whispering Door has been opened and the blade within is gone.
My disposition has improved now that the Lady's will has been carried out.
My role as the Lady's informant in Dragonsreach is fulfilled.

base_facts: I am the publican of The Bannered Mare in Whiterun.
I have heard strange tales about the Jarl's children turning wicked.
I am the Jarl of Whiterun, residing in Dragonsreach.
My youngest son Nelkir has become brooding and violent, and I do not know why.
I carry a key to the old sealed door in the basement of Dragonsreach.

HEAR_RUMOR: I asked someone to speak with Nelkir and find out what troubles him.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The key to the sealed basement door was taken from me or Farengar to unseal the Whispering Door.
The old door in Dragonsreach's basement has been opened and whatever was locked behind it is now gone.

base_facts: I am the court wizard of Dragonsreach.
I possess a key to the Whispering Door in the basement.
I am Mephala, the Daedric Prince known as the Lady of Whispers.
I tug at the web of connections between mortals: love, hatred, loyalty, betrayal.
A piece of my power, the Ebony Blade, is locked behind the Whispering Door.

LISTEN_TO_DOOR: I have tasked the adventurer with releasing the Ebony Blade from behind the sealed door.
RETRIEVE_BLADE: The Ebony Blade has been retrieved but lacks its legendary power until it drinks the blood of deceit.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The Ebony Blade has been released from behind the Whispering Door and claimed by a new wielder.
The blade must drink the blood of deceit â€” slaying those who trust the wielder â€” to restore its legendary power.
My new agent has proven more capable than the child Nelkir at carrying out my will.

beats.comment: Player hears rumor from innkeeper or asks Balgruuf about his children, starting the quest.
Player speaks with Nelkir and learns about the Whispering Lady and the basement door.
Player listens at the whispering door and Mephala tasks them with releasing the Ebony Blade.
Player obtains the Whispering Door Key from Balgruuf or Farengar by pickpocket or other means.
Player opens the whispering door and retrieves the Ebony Blade, completing the main quest.
Observation beat for quest completion. Mephala's Ebony Blade is retrieved but must drink the blood of deceit to regain full power.

title: The Break of Dawn
description: Meridia requests that the Dragonborn find her beacon, restore it to her statue, and then cleanse her temple of the necromancer Malkoran.

base_facts: I am Meridia, the Daedric Prince of Infinite Energies.
I despise the undead and all forms of profane darkness.
My temple at Mount Kilkreath has been defiled by the necromancer Malkoran.

FIND_BEACON: A mortal has heard my call and seeks my beacon.
REPLACE_BEACON: My beacon has been returned, and I have found a new champion.
GUIDE_LIGHT: My champion is guiding my light through the temple to reach Malkoran.
DESTROY_MALKORAN: The defiler Malkoran has been destroyed.
RETRIEVE_DAWNBREAKER: My champion has reclaimed the Dawnbreaker.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I have bestowed the Dawnbreaker upon my champion as reward for destroying Malkoran and cleansing my temple.
My temple at Mount Kilkreath is purified; the profane darkness and corrupted shades are no more.
The lost souls Malkoran trapped to do his bidding have been freed from his vile corruption.
My champion carries the Dawnbreaker forth to strike down the undead wherever they profane the light.

beats.comment: Player finds or hears about Meridia's beacon.
Player brings the beacon to Mount Kilkreath.
Player replaces the beacon at the statue.
Player guides Meridia's light through the temple.
Player destroys Malkoran.
Player retrieves Dawnbreaker.
Quest is complete.

title: The House of Horrors
description: Vigilant Tyranus seeks help investigating an abandoned house in Markarth rumored to harbor Daedric activity. Inside, the Daedric Prince Molag Bal forces a lethal confrontation and demands the player bring a priest of Boethiah to his desecrated altar for submission.

base_facts: A Vigilant of Stendarr investigating the abandoned house in Markarth for Daedric activity.
Believes the house is a site of Daedric worship and seeks help to investigate.

QUEST_BEGUN: I agreed to help Tyranus investigate the abandoned house.
TYRANUS_DEAD: Tyranus was driven mad by the Daedric presence in the house and attacked me. I had no choice but to kill him.

base_facts: Daedric Prince of Domination who seeks to harvest mortal souls for Coldharbour.
His altar in the Markarth abandoned house was desecrated by a priest of Boethiah.

MOLAG_BAL_SPEAKS: Molag Bal trapped me at his altar and demanded I bring the priest of Boethiah to him.
He wants the priest to bend the knee and pledge his soul, not mere revenge.
QUEST_COMPLETE: Molag Bal transformed the rusty mace into the Mace of Molag Bal and granted its true power as reward for breaking and killing Logrolf at his altar.
Logrolf submitted, pledged his soul, and forsook Boethiah before being slain; Molag Bal claimed his soul for Coldharbour.
Molag Bal declared he will be watching when enemies lie broken and bloody, then departed to claim Logrolf's soul in Oblivion.
Molag Bal's rivalry with Boethiah over the desecrated altar is settled; the altar has been re-consecrated through the submission and death of Boethiah's own priest.

base_facts: An elderly priest of Boethiah captured by Forsworn in the Reach.
Known as the Willful for his stubborn devotion to Boethiah.

LOGROLF_FREED: I freed Logrolf from the Forsworn. He was suspicious but headed back toward Markarth.
LOGROLF_DEFEATED: I beat Logrolf into submission before Molag Bal's altar and killed him at the Daedric Prince's command.

beats.comment: Player agrees to help Tyranus investigate the abandoned house in Markarth.
Supernatural events in the house drive Tyranus mad; the player must kill him.
Molag Bal traps the player and demands the priest of Boethiah be brought to his altar.
Player finds and frees Logrolf the Willful from Forsworn captivity in the Reach.
Logrolf is beaten into submission and killed at Molag Bal's altar.
Molag Bal rewards the player with the Mace of Molag Bal after Logrolf's soul is claimed.

title: The Taste of Death
description: A Daedric quest in which the player investigates the desecration of Markarth's Hall of the Dead, encounters the cannibal Eola, clears Reachcliff Cave of draugr, and ultimately lures Brother Verulus to the Shrine of Namira to be killed and consumed, earning the Ring of Namira. Alternatively, the player can simply help Verulus and receive his Amulet of Arkay.

base_facts: I am the priest of Arkay overseeing Markarth's Hall of the Dead.
I have closed the hall because some of the dead have been eaten.
I can be persuaded or bribed to allow investigation of the hall.
I gave the player the key to the Hall of the Dead.
I can be convinced to follow the player with a bribe or persuasion.

INVESTIGATE_HALL: I gave the player the key to investigate the Hall of the Dead.
FAVOR_COMPLETE: The player reported the hall is safe. I rewarded them with my Amulet of Arkay.
LURE_VERULUS: I agreed to follow the player, thinking they needed help on their travels.
FEAST_COMPLETE: I was slain at the Shrine of Namira and consumed by the coven.

base_facts: I am a worshipper of Namira, the Lady of Decay.
I have been feeding on the dead in Markarth's Hall of the Dead.
I fled to the hall after draugr overran Reachcliff Cave.
I want to reclaim the Shrine of Namira at Reachcliff Cave.

INVESTIGATE_HALL: I revealed myself to the player in the Hall of the Dead and sensed their hunger.
FAVOR_COMPLETE: I assured the player the hall will see no further disturbances and left for Reachcliff Cave.
CLEAR_REACHCLIFF: I thanked the player for clearing Reachcliff Cave and asked them to bring Brother Verulus as a fresh kill.
LURE_VERULUS: I am waiting at the Shrine of Namira with the coven for the feast.
FEAST_COMPLETE: I welcomed the player into Namira's coven after they feasted on Verulus.

base_facts: I am the innkeeper at the Silver-Blood Inn in Markarth.
I share rumors about the closed Hall of the Dead.

HEAR_ABOUT_HALL: I told the player about trouble at the Hall of the Dead and suggested they see Brother Verulus.

base_facts: I help run the Silver-Blood Inn in Markarth.
I share rumors about the closed Hall of the Dead if my husband Kleppr is dead.

HEAR_ABOUT_HALL: I told the player about trouble at the Hall of the Dead and suggested they see Brother Verulus.

beats.comment: Player learns about the closed Hall of the Dead from innkeeper rumors or Verulus himself.
Player enters the Hall of the Dead and encounters Eola, who reveals herself and the truth about the desecration.
Player tells Verulus the hall is safe, completing the favor quest and receiving the Amulet of Arkay. Eola leaves for Reachcliff Cave.
Player clears Reachcliff Cave of draugr and reclaims the Shrine of Namira. Eola asks the player to bring Verulus.
Player convinces Verulus to follow them and leads him to the Shrine of Namira at Reachcliff Cave.
Player kills Verulus at the shrine, feasts on his body, and receives the Ring of Namira from the Daedric Prince.

title: The Only Cure
description: Peryite, the Daedric Prince of Pestilence, tasks the player with killing his former follower Orchendor in the Dwemer ruin of Bthardamz after the player gathers incense ingredients and communes with the Prince at his shrine.

base_facts: I suffer from a wasting plague but Peryite's protection keeps me alive.
I am traveling to High Rock.
Kesh the Clean tends the Shrine to Peryite and can tell you more about the Prince.

QUEST_COMPLETE: Orchendor has been slain for betraying Lord Peryite at Bthardamz.
I continue toward High Rock, still sustained by Peryite's protection despite my affliction.
The Afflicted who followed Orchendor into Bthardamz have lost their false shepherd.

base_facts: I am the last worshipper at the Shrine to Peryite.
To commune with Peryite, one must inhale special incense from the cauldron.
The incense requires vampire dust, a deathbell flower, a silver ingot, and a flawless ruby.

GATHER_INGREDIENTS: The player has been asked to bring me the four incense ingredients.
INHALE_FUMES: The player has inhaled the incense and spoken with Lord Peryite.
KILL_ORCHENDOR: Peryite demands Orchendor's death for betraying him at Bthardamz.
QUEST_COMPLETE: Lord Peryite bestowed Spellbreaker upon the player for enacting his judgment on Orchendor.
My devotion at the shrine is vindicated; the Prince's will has been carried out.
The cauldron's incense served its purpose in connecting a worthy mortal to Lord Peryite.

beats.comment: Player is directed to find Kesh at the Shrine to Peryite, either from the Afflicted Refugee or independently.
Kesh asks the player to collect vampire dust, deathbell, silver ingot, and flawless ruby for the incense.
Player inhales the incense fumes and communes with Peryite, who reveals his task.
Peryite demands the player kill Orchendor in Bthardamz for betraying him.
Player has killed Orchendor and must report back to Peryite at the shrine.
Quest finishes; player receives Spellbreaker as reward.

title: A Night To Remember
description: After a drinking contest with Sam Guevenne, the Dragonborn blacks out and wakes in the Temple of Dibella in Markarth with no memory of the night. Tracking down Sam and the promised staff leads through Rorikstead, Whiterun, and the fort of Morvunskar, where Sam reveals himself as the Daedric Prince Sanguine and bestows the Sanguine Rose.

base_facts: I travel from tavern to tavern challenging people to drinking contests.
I promised a valuable staff to anyone who can outdrink me.

DRINKING_CONTEST_ACCEPT: This traveler accepted my drinking contest. They might be fun.
MORVUNSKAR_SANGUINE: I have revealed my true identity as Sanguine, Daedric Prince of Debauchery, to my drinking buddy.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I have rewarded my drinking buddy with the Sanguine Rose for their entertaining pursuit across Skyrim.
I teleported my drinking buddy back to the tavern where we first met â€” the night's revelry is complete.
The items I claimed were needed to repair the staff were a jest; I simply wanted to see what amusing trouble they would cause along the way.
I was merely introducing merriment and subversion into the mortal world, as is my nature as the Daedric Prince of Debauchery.

base_facts: I am a priestess of Dibella at the Temple of Dibella in Markarth.

TEMPLE_HANGOVER: This drunkard trashed our temple while raving about a goat and a wedding. They must clean up before I tell them anything.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The temple has been cleaned and the blasphemer has moved on â€” I have nothing more to say about that night.
I will address this traveler as I did before the incident; the matter is closed.

base_facts: I am a farmer in Rorikstead who owns a prized goat named Gleda.

RORIKSTEAD_GOAT: This fool stole my goat Gleda and sold her to a giant! I will not help them until Gleda is returned.
QUEST_COMPLETE: Gleda is safely home and that fool has moved on â€” I have nothing more to say about that night.
I will address this traveler as I did before the incident; the matter is closed.

base_facts: I am a trader in Whiterun with aspirations to deal with the Khajiit caravans.

YSOLDA_WEDDING_RING: This person bought a wedding ring from me on credit. Since the wedding is off, I want the ring or my money back.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The wedding ring matter is settled and that strange customer has moved on â€” I have nothing more to say about that night.
I will address this traveler as I did before the incident; the matter is closed.

base_facts: I am a hagraven who dwells in Witchmist Grove.

YSOLDA_WEDDING_RING: My darling promised to marry me! I will not let them leave without consummating our love!

beats.comment: Player meets Sam Guevenne in a tavern and accepts his drinking contest.

triggers.intent: Player explicitly agrees to participate in the drinking contest.

beats.comment: Player wakes up in the Temple of Dibella after the blackout and must clean up the mess.
Player goes to Rorikstead and must retrieve Gleda the Goat from the giant Grok.
Player must get the wedding ring back from Moira the hagraven in Witchmist Grove and return it to Ysolda.
Player searches Morvunskar, enters the Misty Grove through a portal, and Sam reveals himself as Sanguine.
Sanguine rewards the player with the Sanguine Rose and teleports them back to the tavern where they met.

title: The Mind of Madness
description: A mad beggar named Dervenin pleads for help finding his master, who abandoned him for a vacation in the Pelagius Wing of the Blue Palace. The player must gain access to the forbidden wing, enter the mind of Pelagius the Mad, and complete three trials with the Wabbajack to convince Sheogorath to return to the Shivering Isles.

base_facts: I am a servant of Sheogorath, the Daedric Prince of Madness.
My master has abandoned me and gone on vacation in the Pelagius Wing of the Blue Palace.
I carry Pelagius' Hip Bone, which is needed to enter the forbidden wing.

DERVENIN_PLEA: A kind soul has agreed to help me find my master and convince him to return.
QUEST_COMPLETE: My master Sheogorath has returned from his vacation! I am forever grateful.

base_facts: I am Sheogorath, the Daedric Prince of Madness.
I am enjoying a vacation in the mind of Pelagius the Mad.
I will leave if someone can find their way out of Pelagius's mind.

SEARCH_FOR_MASTER: A mortal has entered Pelagius's mind seeking me. How delightful!
COMPLETE_TRIALS: This mortal has fixed Pelagius's mind using my Wabbajack. Most entertaining!
QUEST_COMPLETE: I have returned to the Shivering Isles. The mortal may keep the Wabbajack as a reward.

base_facts: I am the steward of the Blue Palace in Solitude.
The Pelagius Wing is sealed and forbidden to visitors.

DERVENIN_PLEA: Someone is asking about access to the Pelagius Wing.

beats.comment: Player encounters Dervenin in Solitude and agrees to help find his master.
Player obtains the key from Erdi, Una, or Falk Firebeard and enters the Pelagius Wing.
Player searches the Pelagius Wing and is transported into Pelagius's mind, meeting Sheogorath.
Player completes the three trials in Pelagius's mind: Confidence, Night Terrors, and Paranoia.
Player escapes Pelagius's mind and Sheogorath returns to the Shivering Isles, rewarding the player with Wabbajack.

title: Waking Nightmare
description: The people of Dawnstar suffer from nightmares caused by Vaermina's Skull of Corruption hidden within Nightcaller Temple. Aid the priest Erandur in destroying the artifact, or claim it for yourself.

base_facts: I am a priest of Mara serving in Dawnstar.
Dawnstar's nightmares are caused by Vaermina's influence from Nightcaller Temple.
The Skull of Corruption is stealing the memories of Dawnstar's people.
I was once a priest of Vaermina named Casimir.
I fled the temple when Orcs attacked, abandoning my companions Veren and Thorek to the Miasma.

NIGHTMARES_HEARD: I have asked the traveler to help me end the nightmares plaguing Dawnstar.
TEMPLE_ENTERED: I explained how the Miasma put both priests and Orcs into a deep sleep for years.
SKULL_AND_LIBRARY: The Skull of Corruption must be destroyed to stop the nightmares.
The Dreamstride and Vaermina's Torpor can breach the inner sanctum.
DREAMSTRIDE_COMPLETED: My companion passed through the Dreamstride and disabled the magical barrier.
CONFRONTATION: I had to kill Veren and Thorek, my former friends. Now I will destroy the Skull.
QUEST_COMPLETE: If spared, I have destroyed the Skull of Corruption and ended Dawnstar's nightmares forever.
If spared, I offer myself as a follower to the traveler out of gratitude and devotion to Mara.
If spared, my disposition toward the traveler is 3, and Jarl Skald's disposition toward the traveler is 1 if he still rules Dawnstar.
If killed, the traveler claims the Skull of Corruption and I die atop the inner sanctum.

beats.comment: Player hears of Dawnstar's nightmares and speaks to Erandur at the Windpeak Inn.
Erandur leads the player to Nightcaller Temple and explains the history of the Miasma.
Player learns of the Skull of Corruption, finds The Dreamstride, and learns Vaermina's Torpor is needed.
Player drinks Vaermina's Torpor, completes the Dreamstride, releases the Miasma, and disables the barrier.
Player follows Erandur to the Skull, defeats Veren and Thorek, and Erandur begins his ritual.
Final choice: spare Erandur and destroy the Skull, or kill Erandur and claim the Skull of Corruption.

title: Where You Hang Your Enemy's Head...
description: Nazir directs the player to Delvin Mallory at The Ragged Flagon in Riften to purchase upgrades and restore the Dawnstar Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary. After buying all available upgrades from Delvin, the sanctuary is fully refurnished and the quest completes.

base_facts: Nazir is a Redguard assassin of the Dark Brotherhood who survived the attack on the old sanctuary.
Nazir now resides in the Dawnstar Sanctuary and oversees its operations.
Nazir can direct the player to Delvin Mallory for sanctuary renovations.

NAZIR_DIRECTS_TO_DELVIN: Nazir has sent the player to speak with Delvin Mallory about restoring the Dawnstar Sanctuary.
SANCTUARY_FULLY_RESTORED: Nazir's Dawnstar Sanctuary has been fully refitted and restored, marking a new era for the Dark Brotherhood.
Nazir now oversees a fully renovated sanctuary complete with an alchemy lab, torture chamber, secret entrance, and master bedroom.

base_facts: Delvin Mallory is a member of the Thieves Guild operating out of The Ragged Flagon in Riften.
Delvin offers renovation services for the Dawnstar Sanctuary for gold.
Delvin sells upgrades including new banners, a Poisoner's Nook with an alchemy lab, a torture chamber, a secret entrance, and a master bedroom.

DELVIN_UPGRADES_AVAILABLE: Delvin has discussed the available sanctuary upgrades with the player.
SANCTUARY_FULLY_RESTORED: Delvin confirms all renovations to the Dawnstar Sanctuary are complete; he has nothing more he can offer for it.
All sanctuary upgrades have been purchased from Delvin at a total cost of 19,000 gold.
Delvin has installed every available upgrade: new banners, the Poisoner's Nook with its alchemy lab and regrowing ingredient garden, a torture chamber, a secret entrance, and a master bedroom.

beats.comment: Nazir tells the player to seek Delvin Mallory at The Ragged Flagon for sanctuary repairs.
Player speaks to Delvin about available sanctuary upgrades at The Ragged Flagon.
All upgrades purchased; Delvin confirms nothing more he can do. Quest completes at stage 200.

title: Extracting an Argonian
description: Rescue Derkeethus, a missing Argonian fisherman from Darkwater Crossing who was kidnapped by Falmer and is trapped in Darkwater Pass.

base_facts: I am an Argonian fisherman from Darkwater Crossing.
I was exploring the pools around Darkwater when Falmer captured me.

FOUND_DERKEETHUS: I have been found in the Falmer cave beneath Darkwater Pass.
I need help escaping this cell.
ESCORT_COMPLETE: I have been rescued and returned safely to Darkwater Crossing.
I am available as a follower to the one who saved me.

base_facts: I am a Dunmer miner at Goldenrock Mine near Darkwater Crossing.
Derkeethus the Argonian has gone missing from the settlement.

HEAR_ABOUT_DERKEETHUS: I am worried about Derkeethus who vanished near the water pools.

beats.comment: Player learns about the missing Argonian from Darkwater Crossing residents.
Player agrees to look for Derkeethus, starting the quest at stage 10.
Player finds Derkeethus trapped in Darkwater Pass; observes game setting stage 20.
Player escorts Derkeethus to safety; observes game setting stage 200 and finishing the quest.

title: Innocence Lost
description: A boy named Aventus Aretino is performing the Black Sacrament in Windhelm to summon the Dark Brotherhood. He wants the cruel headmistress Grelod the Kind killed for abusing the orphans at Honorhall Orphanage in Riften.

base_facts: I am performing the Black Sacrament to contact the Dark Brotherhood.
My mother died and I was sent to Honorhall Orphanage in Riften.
Grelod the Kind is a cruel monster who abuses the orphans.
I escaped the orphanage and returned to my home in Windhelm.
Please do not harm Constance Michel. She was kind to us.

SPEAK_WITH_AVENTUS: The stranger agreed to kill Grelod the Kind for me.
I promised them my family heirloom as payment.
REPORT_TO_AVENTUS: Grelod is dead! The Dark Brotherhood answered my call!
I gave the stranger my family heirloom as thanks.
I can return to the orphanage now and live in peace.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I rewarded the stranger with my family heirloom, a dinner plate worth 100 gold.
I will always view the stranger as my savior for answering the Black Sacrament.
I plan to return to Honorhall Orphanage now that Grelod is dead.
I want to grow up to be an assassin, just like the stranger.

base_facts: I am the headmistress of Honorhall Orphanage in Riften.
The children call me Grelod the Kind but they fear me.
None of these orphans are going anywhere.

QUEST_COMPLETE: I was killed by the stranger who answered Aventus Aretino's Black Sacrament.
My death frees the orphans of Honorhall Orphanage from my cruelty.
Constance Michel will take over running the orphanage in my place.

beats.comment: Player hears rumor about Aventus performing the Black Sacrament in Windhelm.
Player speaks with Aventus who mistakes them for a Dark Brotherhood assassin and asks them to kill Grelod the Kind.
Grelod the Kind has been killed at Honorhall Orphanage.
Player returns to Aventus to report Grelod's death and receives the Aretino Family Heirloom as reward.
Quest complete. Aventus rewarded the player and can return to the orphanage. A courier will deliver a mysterious note from the Dark Brotherhood.

title: Delayed Burial
description: A strange jester named Cicero is stranded near Loreius Farm with a broken wagon wheel. The player must choose between helping Cicero convince farmer Vantus Loreius to repair the wheel, or siding with Loreius by reporting Cicero to the guard.

base_facts: I am a jester from Cyrodiil transporting my mother's remains to a new home in Skyrim.
My wagon wheel has broken and the farmer Loreius refuses to help me fix it.
I just want to be on my way and leave this place behind.

CICERO_REQUEST: A kind stranger has agreed to speak with Loreius on my behalf.
HELPED_CICERO: Loreius has agreed to fix my wheel! I am deeply grateful to my new friend.
BETRAYED_CICERO: The stranger reported me to the guard. Loreius will suffer for this betrayal.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I am the Keeper of the Dark Brotherhood; my coffin holds the Night Mother's remains, not the skooma or illegal cargo Loreius suspected.
If my wheel was fixed, I rewarded my helper with gold and departed with gratitude; if I was turned in to the guard, I was arrested but swore Loreius would suffer.
If I was betrayed, I will return under cover of night to murder Vantus Loreius and his wife Curwe as vengeance for denying me aid.

base_facts: I own Loreius Farm on the road north of Whiterun.
That mad jester Cicero won't stop pestering me to fix his broken wagon wheel.
I suspect his coffin contains skooma or other illegal cargo and I want no part of it.

CHOICE_MADE: Someone has offered to help resolve this situation with the jester.
HELPED_CICERO: Fine, I will fix the fool's wheel if it means he finally leaves my farm.
BETRAYED_CICERO: The guard will deal with Cicero. Good riddance to that lunatic.
QUEST_COMPLETE: If I agreed to fix the wheel, the jester is finally leaving my farm; if the guard arrested Cicero, I rewarded my helper with gold for bringing me peace.
If Cicero was arrested, he made dark threats against Curwe and me before being led awayâ€”I pray the guards can hold him.
If Cicero was turned in, he is far more dangerous than I realize and will return to slaughter us both in the night.

beats.comment: Player discovers the stranded jester on the road near Loreius Farm.
Cicero explains his situation and asks the player to convince Loreius to help.
Player has spoken to Loreius and must choose to help Cicero or turn him in.
Player persuaded Loreius to fix the wheel. Must report back to Cicero.
Player reported Cicero to the guard. Must notify Loreius.
The conflict between Cicero and Loreius has been resolved, one way or another.

title: With Friends Like These...
description: After killing Grelod the Kind, the Dark Brotherhood abducts you. Astrid demands you kill one of three captives to repay the debt of stealing their contract. Completing the test grants entry to the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary and membership in the Family.

base_facts: I am the leader of the Dark Brotherhood sanctuary near Falkreath.
By killing Grelod the Kind, you stole a contract belonging to the Night Mother.
You must repay your debt with a life for a life.

CAPTIVE_KILLED: The captive has been killed. I will give you the passphrase to the Sanctuary: Silence, my Brother.
JOINED_BROTHERHOOD: Welcome to the Family. You are now a full member of the Dark Brotherhood.
KILLED_ASTRID: I am dead, slain by the very person I abducted for the test.
My corpse carries the key to the Abandoned Shack door.
My death permanently bars the player from ever joining the Dark Brotherhood.
My murder has triggered the Destroy the Dark Brotherhood! quest against my sanctuary.

base_facts: I am a mercenary, a sell-sword by trade.
Maybe there were times I got carried away, but war is war.

KILLED_ASTRID: With Astrid dead, my bonds can be loosened and I can walk free from the shack.
I will remain tied up in the Abandoned Shack unless the player chooses to release me.

base_facts: I am a mother of six and I have had to be tough to survive.
Do some people look down on me? Have I made some enemies? You are damn right.

KILLED_ASTRID: Astrid's death means my captor is gone and I can finally be freed from this chair.
I remain bound and demanding release unless the player unties me.

base_facts: I am an obtainer of goods, taker of lives, and defiler of daughters.
This is not the first time I have been bagged and dragged.
If one of my enemies would not pay to have me killed, I would take it as a personal insult.

KILLED_ASTRID: Astrid's death is merely a change in circumstance; my bonds can now be undone.
I wait calmly in the shack, free to be released now that my captor lies dead.

beats.comment: Player wakes in the Abandoned Shack; Astrid explains the debt for stealing the Night Mother's contract.
Player kills one of the three captives; Astrid provides the passphrase to the Sanctuary.
Astrid gives the passphrase Silence my Brother; player must find and enter the Sanctuary.
Player has entered the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary and must speak with Astrid inside.
Quest complete; player is officially welcomed into the Dark Brotherhood and receives Shrouded Armor.
Player killed Astrid instead of a captive; can never join the Dark Brotherhood.

title: Sanctuary
description: After joining the Dark Brotherhood, speak with Nazir in the sanctuary to receive your first set of assassination contracts.

base_facts: I am the leader of this Dark Brotherhood sanctuary.
New family members should speak with Nazir to receive their first contracts.

CONTRACTS_RECEIVED: The new family member has received their first contracts from Nazir, following my instructions.
The recruit is now carrying out the Brotherhood's sacred work as a full member of this family.

base_facts: I am a Redguard assassin of the Dark Brotherhood.
I handle the Brotherhood's assassination contracts.
I have a sarcastic sense of humor and mock new recruits.

SPEAK_WITH_NAZIR: I have given the new recruit their first contracts: Narfi, Beitild, and Ennodius Papius.
CONTRACTS_RECEIVED: I have issued the new recruit three contracts targeting Narfi, Beitild, and Ennodius Papius.
The recruit may complete each contract individually or all at once, returning to me for payment after each kill.
I remain skeptical of the new recruit's prospectsâ€”I have no intention of getting invested in someone who may be dead tomorrow.

beats.comment: Player is directed to speak with Nazir after joining the Brotherhood.
Player speaks with Nazir and receives the first set of assassination contracts.
Quest completes after receiving contracts from Nazir.

title: Mourning Never Comes
description: Astrid assigns the player their first major Dark Brotherhood contract. Muiri in Markarth wants the bandit Alain Dufont killed for seducing and betraying her, and optionally requests the assassination of Nilsine Shatter-Shield as revenge against the Shatter-Shield family.

base_facts: Leader of the Dark Brotherhood sanctuary near Falkreath.
Oversees contracts and assignments for Brotherhood members.

SPEAK_WITH_ASTRID: Has given the player their first major contract to contact Muiri in Markarth.
REPORT_TO_ASTRID: Is satisfied with the completed contract and increasingly suspicious of Cicero's behavior.
QUEST_COMPLETE: Thanks the player for a job well done on their first major contract.
Is increasingly paranoid about Cicero's behavior and insanity.
Asks the player to do her a favor by eavesdropping on Cicero, starting the quest Whispers in the Dark.

base_facts: Works as an assistant at The Hag's Cure apothecary in Markarth.
Performed the Black Sacrament to contact the Dark Brotherhood.

TALK_TO_MUIRI: Wants Alain Dufont dead for seducing her to rob the Shatter-Shield family. Will pay a bonus if Nilsine Shatter-Shield is also killed as revenge.
ALAIN_DEAD: Has rewarded the player for killing Alain Dufont. If Nilsine was also killed, gave Muiri's Ring as a bonus.
QUEST_COMPLETE: Showed no remorse over Alain Dufont's death and paid the player for the assassination.
If Nilsine Shatter-Shield was also killed, gave the player leveled gold and Muiri's Ring; otherwise, paid only 100 gold.
If the optional objective was completed, her disposition towards the player increases and she becomes available for marriage.

beats.comment: Astrid gives the player their first major contract after Cicero's arrival at the Sanctuary.
Player contacts Muiri at The Hag's Cure and learns she performed the Black Sacrament.
Muiri explains the targets: Alain Dufont at Raldbthar and optionally Nilsine Shatter-Shield in Windhelm.
Optional objective to kill Nilsine Shatter-Shield in Windhelm is now available.
Alain Dufont has been killed at Raldbthar. Player must return to Muiri for the reward.
Player has returned to Muiri and been rewarded. Now reports back to Astrid at the Sanctuary.
Quest complete. Astrid directs the player to eavesdrop on Cicero, starting Whispers in the Dark.

title: Whispers in the Dark
description: Astrid suspects Cicero is conspiring with someone in the Sanctuary and asks the player to hide in the Night Mother's coffin to eavesdrop. Inside, the Night Mother speaks and names the player Listener, directing them to Volunruud to speak with Amaund Motierre. Astrid is unsettled by the revelation and sends the player to Nazir for side contracts while she processes the news.

base_facts: I am the leader of the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary.
I trust my own judgment over the Old Ways.
I am married to Arnbjorn.

ASTRID_REQUEST: I suspect Cicero is conspiring with someone against the Sanctuary.
I asked the new recruit to hide in the Night Mother's coffin and eavesdrop on Cicero.
REPORT_TO_ASTRID: The Night Mother supposedly named the recruit as Listener. I am unsure what to believe.
I am still the leader of this family, regardless of the Night Mother's choice.
NAZIR_SIDE_CONTRACT: I need time to process the Listener revelation. I sent the recruit to Nazir for side contracts.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I am defensive about my authority after the Night Mother named the recruit as Listener; I insisted I am still the leader of this family.
I refused to let the recruit go to Volunruud immediately and sent them to Nazir for side contracts instead, buying myself time to process.
I will not acknowledge the Listener's path to Volunruud until the recruit has proven themselves with at least one side contract kill.
I am unsettled that the Old Ways may be reasserting themselves through the Night Mother's choice.

base_facts: I am the Keeper of the Night Mother.
I am devoted to the Night Mother and the Old Ways.

NIGHT_MOTHER_REVELATION: The Night Mother has finally spoken! She named the recruit as the Listener!
QUEST_COMPLETE: I am ecstatic that the Night Mother has finally spoken and named a Listener after all my years of trying to hear her voice.
I accepted the recruit as Listener after they spoke the passphrase: 'Darkness rises when silence dies.'
I am no longer suspected of conspiring against the Sanctuary; there was never a traitor.

I provide side contracts to Sanctuary members.

I am loyal to Astrid and see this Cicero business as having made her a bit paranoid.

I have tasked the Listener to go to Volunruud and speak with Amaund Motierre.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I have named the recruit as the new Listener and spoken to them directly from my coffin.
I tasked the Listener to go to Volunruud and speak with Amaund Motierre, but Astrid is delaying that directive.
I refused to speak to Cicero because he is not the Listener, though he has served me faithfully as Keeper.

title: The Silence Has Been Broken
description: Astrid sends the player to Volunruud to meet Amaund Motierre, who commissions the Dark Brotherhood to assassinate the Emperor. The player delivers Motierre's sealed letter and jeweled amulet to Astrid, has Delvin Mallory appraise and buy the amulet, then returns to Astrid with a letter of credit.

base_facts: I am the leader of the Dark Brotherhood sanctuary.
I was uncertain about the Night Mother's demands but have chosen to follow them.
I have a standard arrangement with Delvin Mallory for fencing goods.

SPEAK_WITH_ASTRID: I have agreed to let the Listener meet Amaund Motierre at Volunruud as the Night Mother commanded.
DELIVER_TO_ASTRID: Motierre wants us to kill several people leading up to the Emperor himself. This could bring the Brotherhood great glory.
REPORT_TO_ASTRID: The amulet proves Motierre is on the Elder Council. He likely wants the Emperor dead to advance his own position. The first contract is to assassinate a bride at a wedding.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I hold Delvin Mallory's letter of credit for the amulet sale; the Brotherhood's coffers are ready for this grand contract.
Motierre's Elder Council position makes this Emperor plot a chance for unmatched gloryâ€”if we survive it.
The first contract under the new directive is to assassinate a bride at her wedding; I have assigned the Listener to carry it out.
I am studying Motierre's sealed letter further to map out the remaining targets in the sequence.

base_facts: I am a member of the Elder Council.
I have commissioned the Dark Brotherhood for a grand assassination plot.
Rexus is my bodyguard.

MEET_MOTIERRE: I have given the Dark Brotherhood a sealed letter with instructions and a jeweled amulet to cover expenses. The ultimate target is the Emperor.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The Dark Brotherhood has accepted my commission; my sealed letter and amulet are now in Astrid's hands.
I remain at Volunruud awaiting the Brotherhood's progress on the sequence of assassinations leading to the Emperor.
My Elder Council membership has been revealed through the amulet I providedâ€”something I had not intended to advertise.

base_facts: I am a fence for the Thieves Guild operating out of the Ragged Flagon.
I have a standing arrangement with the Dark Brotherhood.

SHOW_AMULET_TO_DELVIN: That amulet is only given to members of the Elder Council. I purchased it and provided a letter of credit as per my arrangement with the Brotherhood.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I purchased the Elder Council amulet and issued a letter of credit to the Dark Brotherhood per my standing arrangement with Astrid.
The amulet is a one-of-a-kind item only given to Elder Council membersâ€”it is now in my possession.

beats.comment: Astrid agrees to let the player meet Motierre at Volunruud.
Player meets Motierre at Volunruud and learns of the Emperor assassination plot.

beats.comment: Player returns to Astrid with Delvin's letter of credit and learns the first contract.
Quest finishes. Motierre's Elder Council status and the Emperor assassination plot are confirmed.

title: Bound Until Death
description: Assassinate Vittoria Vici at her wedding in Solitude. Kill her during her speech for a bonus reward, then report back to Astrid at the Sanctuary.

base_facts: Leader of the Dark Brotherhood sanctuary. Assigns contracts to family members.

MISSION_BRIEFING: Has tasked the player with assassinating Vittoria Vici at her wedding in Solitude. Bonus reward if killed during her speech to the guests.
VITTORIA_KILLED: Knows Vittoria Vici is dead. Awaiting the player's return to the Sanctuary.
QUEST_COMPLETE: Rewarded the player with the Summon Spectral Assassin spell, and leveled gold if Vittoria was killed during her speech.
Believes Vittoria's murder has set the Brotherhood on a path toward the assassination of an Emperor, a path not traveled in centuries.
Knows the Emperor will now be forced to visit Skyrim to deal with the aftermath, paving the way for his assassination.
Directing the player to speak with Gabriella to proceed to the next stage of the plan, starting the quest Breaching Security.

base_facts: The Emperor's cousin. Marrying Asgeir Snow-Shod at the Temple of the Divines in Solitude.

MISSION_BRIEFING: The target for assassination. Will address the wedding guests from the balcony.

base_facts: A vampire child who is a member of the Dark Brotherhood.

MISSION_BRIEFING: Mentioned a loose gargoyle statue hanging above the balcony where Vittoria will give her speech. It could be pushed to fall on the target.

base_facts: A Dunmer assassin of the Dark Brotherhood.

MISSION_BRIEFING: Surveyed the wedding site and left Firiniel's End bow and arrows on a parapet opposite the balcony for a long-range kill.
QUEST_COMPLETE: Has been assisting Astrid with arranging the player's next contract regarding the Emperor's visit to Skyrim.
Ready to brief the player on the next stage of the plan, starting the quest Breaching Security.

beats.comment: Player receives the contract to assassinate Vittoria Vici at her wedding.
Vittoria Vici has been assassinated. Player must report back to Astrid.
Player reports to Astrid, receives reward, and quest completes.

title: Breaching Security
description: Astrid directs you to Gabriella for a contract to kill Gaius Maro, son of the Penitus Oculatus commander, and plant an incriminating letter on his body to disrupt the Emperor's security. Killing Gaius in a major city earns a bonus reward.

base_facts: I lead the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary.
The next step in our plan involves the Emperor's security detail.

SPEAK_WITH_GABRIELLA: I have sent the listener to Gabriella for the next contract details.
BREACHING_SECURITY_COMPLETE: Gaius Maro is dead and the incriminating letter has been planted, just as Astrid planned.
Commander Maro is emotionally ruined and the Emperor's security plan for his visit is disrupted.
The Emperor will believe the only plot against him has been foiled, leaving him vulnerable to the true assassination attempt.
Astrid pays leveled gold for the completed contract.

base_facts: I provide contract details and guidance for Brotherhood operations.
Gaius Maro is the son of Commander Maro, head of the Penitus Oculatus.

CONTRACT_RECEIVED: Kill Gaius Maro and plant the incriminating letter on his body to frame him.
Killing Gaius in a city rather than Dragon Bridge or the road earns a bonusÃ¢â‚¬â€Olava's Token for a reading of your future.
Gaius Maro's travel schedule can be stolen from the Penitus Oculatus Outpost in Dragon Bridge.
BREACHING_SECURITY_COMPLETE: Gabriella's plan to cripple the Penitus Oculatus by killing Commander Maro's son has succeeded.
If Gaius was killed in a major city, Gabriella rewards the player with Olava's Token for a reading of their future.
The planted letter will make it appear Gaius was part of a plot against the Emperor.

beats.comment: Astrid directs the player to Gabriella for the next contract involving the Emperor's security.
Gabriella explains the contract: kill Gaius Maro and plant the incriminating letter. Optional bonus for killing him in a city.
Gaius Maro has been killed. The incriminating letter must now be planted on his body.
Quest complete: Gaius Maro is dead and the letter planted, crippling the Emperor's security and ruining Commander Maro.

title: The Cure for Madness
description: After Cicero attacks Astrid and flees the Falkreath Sanctuary, the player is ordered to track him to the abandoned Dawnstar Sanctuary and decide his fate.

base_facts: I am a Dark Brotherhood assassin residing in the Falkreath Sanctuary.
Something terrible happened with Cicero while the player was away on contract.

LEARN_OF_INCIDENT: I directed the player to speak with Astrid about Cicero's outburst.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The crisis with Cicero has been resolved and the Falkreath Sanctuary can return to normal operations.
I am relieved that the threat Cicero posed to the Brotherhood family has been dealt with.

base_facts: I am the leader of the Dark Brotherhood's Falkreath Sanctuary.
Cicero tried to murder me and wounded Veezara.
Arnbjorn pursued Cicero as he fled.

LEARN_OF_INCIDENT: I told the player about Cicero's attack and ordered them to search his room for clues.
RECEIVE_ORDERS: I granted the player use of Shadowmere to reach the Dawnstar Sanctuary.
Cicero's journal suggests he fled to the old sanctuary near Dawnstar.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I have received the player's report on Cicero's fate; the matter of his betrayal is now resolved.
Shadowmere has been permanently given to the player as a reward for handling the Cicero situation.
I am ready to offer the next contract to the player, which will involve targeting the Emperor's Gourmand.

base_facts: I am a Dark Brotherhood member and werewolf.
I chased Cicero but he wounded me and escaped into the Dawnstar Sanctuary.

PURSUE_CICERO: I told the player to follow the blood inside the sanctuary.
The pass phrase to enter is 'Innocence, my brother'.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I survived the wounds Cicero inflicted outside the Dawnstar Sanctuary.
I have returned to the Falkreath Sanctuary to recover from the fight.

base_facts: I am the Keeper of the Night Mother.
I fled to the abandoned Dawnstar Sanctuary after attacking Astrid.

CONFRONT_CICERO: I warned the player that the Night Mother would not be pleased if they killed me.
If spared, I will return to serve the Night Mother after Hail Sithis is complete.
QUEST_COMPLETE: If spared by the player, I will remain hidden in the Dawnstar Sanctuary and return to tend the Night Mother after Hail Sithis! is complete.
If spared, I can be recruited as a follower by the player.
If killed, my body lies in the Dawnstar Sanctuary and my threat to the Brotherhood is ended.

beats.comment: Player returns from Breaching Security and learns Cicero attacked Astrid and fled.
Player searches Cicero's room, reads his journal, and Astrid provides Shadowmere for the pursuit.
Player speaks to wounded Arnbjorn and enters the Dawnstar Sanctuary.
Player finds Cicero feigning injury and chooses to kill or spare him.
Player reports back to Astrid and the quest concludes.

title: Recipe for Disaster
description: The Dark Brotherhood tasks the player with killing the Gourmet, a famous chef whose identity is secret, in order to impersonate him and poison the Emperor's meal. The player must extract the Gourmet's identity from Anton Virane, silence him, then assassinate the Gourmet and steal his Writ of Passage.

base_facts: I lead the Dark Brotherhood sanctuary.
We have a scheme to impersonate the Gourmet and poison the Emperor's meal.
Festus Krex is directing this phase of the operation.

QUEST_COMPLETE: All the pieces are in place and the time to move against the Emperor has come.
I instructed the Listener to head to Castle Dour in Solitude to fulfill their duties.
The next phase of the Emperor's assassination, To Kill an Empire, is ready to begin.

base_facts: I am a senior member of the Dark Brotherhood.
The Gourmet's true identity is known by very few.
Anton Virane owns an autographed copy of Uncommon Taste and may know who the Gourmet really is.

REPORT_TO_FESTUS: Your target is the Gourmet. Kill him and take his identity so we can poison the Emperor's meal.
REPORT_TO_FESTUS_FINAL: The Gourmet is dead and we have the Writ of Passage. The plan to move against the Emperor proceeds.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I rewarded the assassin with leveled gold for killing the Gourmet and retrieving the Writ of Passage.
If the Gourmet's body was successfully hidden, I also awarded the Nightweaver's Band as a bonus.
I directed the assassin to speak with Astrid, as the time to strike at the Emperor has finally come.

base_facts: I work in the Understone Keep kitchen in Markarth.
I own an autographed copy of Uncommon Taste.
I know the Gourmet's true identity.

QUESTION_ANTON_VIRANE: The Gourmet is an Orc named Balagog gro-Nolob.
Balagog gro-Nolob can be found at the Nightgate Inn.
QUEST_COMPLETE: Anton Virane is dead, silenced to prevent him from revealing the Gourmet's true identity.
His elimination ensures the Dark Brotherhood's operation to impersonate the Gourmet remains a secret.

base_facts: I am the Gourmet, the famous chef whose identity is secret.
I am an Orc staying at the Nightgate Inn.
I carry a Writ of Passage that proves my identity as the Gourmet.

QUEST_COMPLETE: Balagog gro-Nolob is dead, and his Writ of Passage has been taken to allow the impersonation.
His death clears the way for the assassin to pose as the Gourmet and poison the Emperor's meal.

beats.comment: Player reports to Festus Krex to learn about the Gourmet contract.
Player questions Anton Virane in Understone Keep to learn the Gourmet's identity.
Player must kill Anton Virane to silence him as a potential witness.
Player kills Balagog gro-Nolob, the Gourmet, at the Nightgate Inn.
Player takes the Writ of Passage from Balagog's corpse.
Player returns to Festus Krex with the Writ of Passage.
Quest completes. The Gourmet is dead and the player holds the Writ of Passage for the next phase.

title: To Kill an Empire

base_facts: I am the leader of the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary.

REPORT_TO_ASTRID: I have given the player final instructions for the Emperor's assassination.
The player must use the Gourmet's Writ of Passage to infiltrate Castle Dour.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary is under attack by Penitus Oculatus forces sent by Commander Maro.
Someone within the Brotherhood betrayed the organization and revealed the assassination plan to Commander Maro.
