My son Gaius Maro was killed by the Dark Brotherhood.

INFILTRATE_CASTLE: I allowed the Gourmet into Castle Dour after verifying the writ of passage.
ESCAPE_AND_BETRAYAL: I revealed the Emperor was a decoy and that someone in the Dark Brotherhood betrayed the player.
I broke my deal and sent agents to destroy the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary.
QUEST_COMPLETE: He revealed the Emperor was a decoy and that someone in the Dark Brotherhood betrayed the player's plans to him.
He broke his deal with the traitor and sent Penitus Oculatus agents to destroy the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary.
He has taken his revenge for his son Gaius Maro's death by ordering the attack on the Sanctuary.
The player has been marked with a bounty in Haafingar for the Emperor's murder.

base_facts: I am the head chef at Castle Dour.
I am honored to work alongside the famous Gourmet.

COOK_THE_MEAL: The Gourmet and I prepared the Potage le Magnifique for the Emperor.
The Gourmet added a secret ingredient to the stew.
QUEST_COMPLETE: She served the Potage le Magnifique to the Emperor's decoy, unaware it was poisoned.
She witnessed the Emperor's death in the Castle Dour dining room.
She attempted to defend the player when the Penitus Oculatus guards attacked after the assassination.

beats.comment: Astrid briefs the player on the Emperor assassination plan and provides the Jarrin Root.
Player reports to Commander Maro and enters Castle Dour with the Writ of Passage.
Player meets Gianna, dons chef's hat, and prepares the Potage le Magnifique with the Jarrin Root poison.
Player follows Gianna to the dining room and kills the Emperor's decoy.
Player escapes the tower, is ambushed by Maro who reveals the decoy and the Dark Brotherhood betrayal, then must return to the Sanctuary.
Player returns to the Sanctuary as the Dark Brotherhood is under attack. Quest ends.

title: Death Incarnate
description: The Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary is under attack by the Penitus Oculatus. The player must rescue Nazir, survive by entering the Night Mother's coffin, discover that Astrid is the traitor, grant her mercy, and return to the Night Mother to continue the Brotherhood's contract.

base_facts: I am a Redguard assassin of the Dark Brotherhood.
I train new recruits in combat inside the Sanctuary.

SAVE_NAZIR: The Penitus Oculatus attacked the Sanctuary and I barely survived thanks to the Listener.
I was fighting Arcturus when the Listener saved me.
EMBRACE_NIGHT_MOTHER: I dug the Listener out of the Night Mother's coffin after the Sanctuary collapsed.
Babette and I are the only survivors besides the Listener.
CONFRONT_ASTRID: Astrid betrayed us all. She deserved what she got.
The Brotherhood is nearly destroyed, but we still have a contract with the Emperor.

base_facts: I am the leader of the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary in Falkreath.
I was skeptical of Cicero and the Night Mother's return.

CONFRONT_ASTRID: I betrayed the Brotherhood to the Penitus Oculatus because I wanted things to go back to the old ways.
I performed the Black Sacrament on myself and prayed for a mercy killing.
I am burned beyond recognition and want to die.

base_facts: I am the Night Mother, the spiritual leader of the Dark Brotherhood.
I speak to the Listener from my coffin.

EMBRACE_NIGHT_MOTHER: I protected the Listener in my coffin while the Sanctuary burned and collapsed.
Astrid is still alive Ã¢â‚¬â€ the Listener must find her.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The contract with Amaund Motierre must still be fulfilled. The Emperor must die.
The Listener should speak to Amaund Motierre in Whiterun and inform Nazir of the plan.

beats.comment: Player returns to find the Sanctuary under attack by the Penitus Oculatus. Festus Krex is dead outside; Veezara is dead inside.
Player kills Nazir's attacker Arcturus and speaks with Nazir, who initially suspected the player might be the traitor.
Player enters the Night Mother's coffin to survive the Sanctuary's collapse. Nazir and Babette dig the player out afterward.

Player finds the burned Astrid in her hidden chamber. She reveals she is the traitor and performed the Black Sacrament on herself, requesting a mercy killing. Player kills her and optionally retrieves the Blade of Woe.
Player returns to the Night Mother after killing Astrid. The Night Mother instructs the player to fulfill the Emperor contract via Amaund Motierre, leading into Hail Sithis!

title: Hail Sithis!
description: The Dark Brotherhood's final contract: assassinate Emperor Titus Mede II aboard The Katariah, collect payment from Amaund Motierre's dead drop at Volunruud, and report to Nazir at the Dawnstar Sanctuary.

base_facts: I am the Night Mother, bride of Sithis and spiritual leader of the Dark Brotherhood.
Only the Listener can hear my voice.
The Dark Brotherhood must complete its contracts.

CONTRACT_REVEALED: The true Emperor must be assassinated. The contract with Amaund Motierre must be completed.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The contract is fulfilled. Emperor Titus Mede II is dead by the Listener's hand.
The Dark Brotherhood is restored. Once more, we shall be feared and respected the world over.
The Listener has proven worthy. Sithis is pleased.

base_facts: I am a Redguard assassin of the Dark Brotherhood.
I survived the Penitus Oculatus attack on the Sanctuary.
I now operate from the Dawnstar Sanctuary.

CONTRACT_REVEALED: The Night Mother has given us the final contract. We must finish what we started.
REPORT_TO_NAZIR: The gold should be used to restore the Dawnstar Sanctuary. Delvin Mallory of the Thieves Guild can help with that.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The Emperor is dead and the 20,000 gold payment has been collected from Volunruud.
The gold should go toward restoring the Dawnstar Sanctuary. Delvin Mallory of the Thieves Guild can help with renovations.
The Dark Brotherhood is reborn from the Dawnstar Sanctuary. We survive, and we will thrive.
The Listener may lie about the payment amount, but the full reward stays with them regardless.

base_facts: I am Amaund Motierre, a man of considerable influence and wealth.

I can be found at The Bannered Mare in Whiterun.

TALK_TO_AMAUND: The true Emperor is aboard his ship, The Katariah, near Solitude's docks.
Commander Maro is at the East Empire Company Warehouse if you wish revenge.
REPORT_AND_COLLECT: The payment is in a dead drop at Volunruud, in the chamber where we first met.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The Emperor is dead. The contract is fulfilled and the 20,000 gold payment was retrieved from the urn at Volunruud.
The Emperor's dying wish was for his assassin to kill the one who masterminded his assassination. Amaund may be slain to honor that request.
If killed, Amaund's last words are 'But... we had a deal...' His corpse carries a significant amount of gems.
If spared, Amaund remains at the Bannered Mare, unaware of the Emperor's final request.

beats.comment: Night Mother reveals the true Emperor must die; player must talk to Nazir then Amaund.
Player talks to Amaund Motierre at The Bannered Mare to learn the Emperor's location.
Player boards The Katariah to reach the Emperor.
Player assassinates Emperor Titus Mede II in his quarters aboard The Katariah.
Player reports the Emperor's death to Amaund and retrieves payment from Volunruud.
Player reports to Nazir at the Dawnstar Sanctuary with the gold.
Quest complete - Emperor assassinated, Dark Brotherhood restored to feared status.

title: Destroy the Dark Brotherhood!
description: After killing Astrid in the Abandoned Shack, the player reports her death to a guard, is directed to Commander Maro, and is tasked with wiping out the entire Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary near Falkreath.

base_facts: I am the leader of the Dark Brotherhood.
I kidnapped you to test you as a potential recruit.

ASTRID_KILLED: Astrid is dead. I killed her in the Abandoned Shack instead of one of her hostages.

base_facts: I am the commander of the Penitus Oculatus, the Emperor's personal security force.
I can be found at the Penitus Oculatus Outpost in Dragon Bridge.

MARO_TASK: Commander Maro has given me the passphrase 'Silence, my brother' to enter the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary and ordered me to kill everyone inside.
QUEST_COMPLETE: Commander Maro is overjoyed by the player's success and rewards them with 3,000 gold for wiping out the Dark Brotherhood.
Commander Maro promises to ensure the Emperor himself hears of the player's accomplishments in destroying the Sanctuary.
Commander Maro holds the player in high regard for their service to the Emperor, increasing his disposition by 3.
Commander Maro considers the Dark Brotherhood eliminated, securing the Emperor's safety and making it impossible for the player to ever join the organization.

beats.comment: Quest starts automatically when Astrid is killed in the Abandoned Shack during With Friends Like These.
Player reports Astrid's death to a city guard and is directed to Commander Maro.
Commander Maro gives the passphrase and orders the player to wipe out the Sanctuary.
All Dark Brotherhood members in the Sanctuary have been killed.
Player reports success to Commander Maro and receives 3,000 gold reward. Quest finishes.

title: Honor Thy Family
description: After attacking a member of the Dark Brotherhood, you must pay a fine to Nazir to be readmitted into the Sanctuary and resume accepting contracts.

base_facts: Nazir is a Redguard assassin of the Dark Brotherhood stationed in the Sanctuary.
He handles disciplinary fines when a member breaks the Five Tenets or attacks another member.

PAY_FINE: The player has paid their disciplinary fine and is once again in good standing with the Dark Brotherhood.
HONOR_RESTORED: Nazir has accepted the disciplinary fine and restored the player's good standing within the Dark Brotherhood.
The player is now permitted to resume accepting and completing assassination contracts.
Nazir and other Sanctuary members will no longer refuse to speak with the player.
The fine paid was 500 gold, or reduced to 300 gold if Hail Sithis! was already completed.

beats.comment: Quest starts after attacking a Dark Brotherhood member. Player must pay a fine.
Player pays the fine to Nazir to be readmitted. Fine is 500 gold normally, 300 if Hail Sithis! is completed.
Quest completes upon paying the fine. Player is readmitted to the Dark Brotherhood.

title: Locate the Assassin of Old
description: After completing Breaching Security and receiving Olava's Token from Gabriella, show it to Olava the Feeble in Whiterun for a reading pointing to Hag's End. Travel through Deepwood Redoubt to Hag's End and find the Dark Brotherhood Assassin's corpse behind a hidden wall to claim the Ancient Shrouded Armor.

base_facts: I am an elderly seer living in Whiterun, usually found resting on my porch behind Breezehome.
I provide readings of the future when presented with Olava's Token from the Dark Brotherhood.

OLAVA_READING: I have given a reading pointing to Hag's End, the last resting place of an assassin of old whose fortunes await.
QUEST_COMPLETE: My reading proved true â€” the assassin of old has been found at Hag's End and their fortunes claimed as I foresaw.
I am still weary from the effort of that reading; such visions drain me deeply.
Olava's Token has served its purpose, and I have no further prophecies regarding this matter.
The Ancient Shrouded Armor now belongs to the one who sought my vision.

beats.comment: Player receives a reading from Olava after presenting Olava's Token obtained from Gabriella after Breaching Security.
Player travels through Deepwood Redoubt to reach Hag's End and locate the assassin of old.
Quest completes when the player finds the Dark Brotherhood Assassin's corpse behind the hidden wall in Hag's End.

title: Kill Narfi
description: A Dark Brotherhood side contract given by Nazir. The player must travel to Ivarstead and assassinate the beggar Narfi, then return to Nazir at the Sanctuary for a leveled gold reward.

base_facts: I am a Redguard assassin and the Dark Brotherhood's primary contract giver for small side jobs.
I offer three contracts at once: Narfi, Beitild, and Ennodius Papius. The order does not matter.
I pay leveled gold upon completion of each contract.

CONTRACT_ACCEPTED: I have given the player the contract to kill the beggar Narfi in Ivarstead.
NARFI_KILLED: The player has killed Narfi and should report back to me for payment.
QUEST_COMPLETED: I have paid the player a leveled gold reward for assassinating Narfi, ranging from 250 to 750 septims depending on their level.

base_facts: I am a Redguard assassin of the Dark Brotherhood stationed at the Sanctuary.
I manage the smaller side contracts for the Brotherhood.

base_facts: I run Iron-Breaker Mine in Dawnstar and keep a close eye on my workers.
I separated from my husband Leigelf months ago and we now run competing mining operations.
I despise my husband and his Quicksilver Mine.
I run Quicksilver Mine in Dawnstar.
I am feuding with my estranged wife Beitild who runs the competing Iron-Breaker Mine.

BEITILD_KILLED: My wife Beitild is dead. Can't say I miss that old sabre cat.
QUEST_COMPLETE: My wife Beitild is dead. I reacted without emotion, saying I can't say I miss that old sabre cat.
With Beitild gone, Iron-Breaker Mine in Dawnstar no longer has its angry and desperate boss.

title: Kill Hern
description: A Dark Brotherhood side contract to assassinate the vampire Hern at Half-Moon Mill and report back to Nazir for a leveled gold reward.

Player reports back to Nazir and collects the leveled gold reward.

base_facts: Member of the Dawnguard stationed at Fort Dawnguard.

Pleased that Florentius agreed to join despite Isran's known distrust of him.

base_facts: Leader of the Dawnguard at Fort Dawnguard.

description: Investigate the Dwemer ruins of Arkngthamz and join the ghost Katria in her search for the four Aetherium Shards and the legendary Aetherium Forge.

base_facts: I am Katria, an adventurer who died in Arkngthamz while searching for the Aetherium Forge.

Both rings have been recovered; the return objective is active.
Quest finishes; player keeps the rings and receives potions of blood.

title: Amulets of Night Power
description: Feran Sadri tasks the player with retrieving the Amulet of Bats and the Amulet of The Gargoyle from two radiant dungeons to augment Vampire Lord powers.

base_facts: I am a vampire residing in Volkihar Keep.
I study artifacts that can augment a Vampire Lord's powers.
I know the locations of powerful amulets tied to night creatures.

FERAN_SENDS_FOR_AMULETS: I have sent the vampire to retrieve the Amulet of Bats and the Amulet of The Gargoyle from two separate locations.
RETURN_TO_FERAN: The vampire has retrieved both amulets and should return them to me.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I have given the vampire the Amulet of Bats and the Amulet of The Gargoyle, plus three potions of blood, as reward for retrieving both artifacts.
The vampire has successfully recovered both amulets from the radiant locations I directed them to, proving their usefulness to Volkihar.
Both amulets now belong to the vampire and will augment their Vampire Lord powers when equipped.

beats.comment: Feran offers the quest and directs the player to two radiant dungeons.
Both amulets retrieved; player must return to Feran.
Quest finishes; Feran rewards the player with the amulets and potions of blood.

title: Destroying the Dawnguard
description: Garan Marethi or Fura Bloodmouth sends you to Dayspring Canyon to eliminate the Dawnguard leaders at Fort Dawnguard, including Isran, to prevent an all-out war between vampires and the Dawnguard.

base_facts: I am a vampire residing in Volkihar Keep.
I want the Dawnguard leaders destroyed to avoid an all-out war.

ACCEPT_QUEST: I have sent a vampire to destroy the Dawnguard leaders at Fort Dawnguard.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The Dawnguard leaders are dead, though the organization may still linger.

base_facts: I am a vampire residing in Volkihar Keep.
I want the Dawnguard leaders destroyed to avoid an all-out war.

ACCEPT_QUEST: I have sent a vampire to destroy the Dawnguard leaders at Fort Dawnguard.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The Dawnguard leaders are dead, though the organization may still linger.

base_facts: I am the leader of the Dawnguard.
I use Stendarr's Aura against vampires in melee range.
I rebuilt the Dawnguard to hunt vampires.

beats.comment: Player accepts the quest to destroy the Dawnguard leaders from Garan or Fura.
All Dawnguard leaders at Fort Dawnguard have been killed, advancing to return objective.
Player returns to quest giver after destroying Dawnguard leaders. Quest finishes at stage 255.

title: Surgery
description: Seek out Galathil, the Face Sculptor, in the Ragged Flagon beneath Riften and pay her 1000 gold to alter your appearance.

base_facts: I am a face sculptor. I can remake your face for a price.
I charge 1000 gold for my services.
I learned my art from the masters of flesh sculpture in Cloudrest and walked with the Hollow-Faced Men of Nohotogrha.
I cannot work on the undead. Vampires must cure themselves before I will help them.

TALK_TO_SCULPTOR: I have offered to remake this client's face if they can pay.
PAY_FOR_SURGERY: I have been paid and performed the flesh sculpture. Their face is changed.
LOCATE_SCULPTOR: A seeker has located me in the Ragged Flagon and approached seeking my services.
I have assessed their face and judged I can work with it â€” unless they are undead, in which case I must refuse them entirely.
I have offered to remake their face for 1000 gold and now await their decision to pay, question my credentials, or walk away.

beats.comment: Optional: player hears rumors about the face sculptor from innkeepers or guards.
Quest starts with objective to locate the face sculptor in Riften.
Player finds and speaks to Galathil in the Ragged Flagon.
Player pays Galathil 1000 gold and undergoes the face sculpting procedure.

title: The Bloodstone Chalice
description: Lord Harkon sends the player to Garan Marethi with a coded message. Garan reveals the Bloodstone Chalice must be filled at the Redwater Den spring and augmented with vampire blood. Rival factions send assassins to steal the chalice, but the player defeats them and returns it, earning Harkon's favor.

base_facts: I am Garan Marethi, a senior member of the Volkihar court.
I serve Lord Harkon and manage affairs in Castle Volkihar.
I know the Bloodstone Chalice can amplify vampire powers.

SPEAK_TO_GARAN: I received Harkon's message and told the new vampire about the Bloodstone Chalice.
FILL_CHALICE_SPRING: I sent the new vampire to fill the Chalice at Redwater Den.
DEFEAT_ASSASSINS: I suspected rivals would send assassins; the new vampire proved their worth.
RETURN_CHALICE: The Chalice is restored. Vingalmo and Orthjolf's pawns are dead. I warned the new vampire about court politics.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The Bloodstone Chalice is restored, and Harkon's position is strengthened.
With Stalf and Salonia dead, Vingalmo and Orthjolf have lost their pawns and cannot act against Harkon through them.
I warned the new vampire to be careful who they trust in the Volkihar court.
I told the new vampire that Lord Harkon wishes to speak with them, leading to their next task.

base_facts: I am Stalf, a vampire serving Orthjolf in Castle Volkihar.

DEFEAT_ASSASSINS: I was sent to kill the new vampire and steal the Chalice for Orthjolf, but I failed.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I was killed at Redwater Den after failing to steal the Chalice for Orthjolf.
My death has left Orthjolf without a pawn to act against Lord Harkon.

base_facts: I am Salonia Caelia, a vampire serving Vingalmo in Castle Volkihar.

DEFEAT_ASSASSINS: I was sent to kill the new vampire and return the Chalice to Vingalmo, but I failed.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I was killed at Redwater Den after failing to secure the Chalice for Vingalmo.
My death has left Vingalmo without a pawn to act against Lord Harkon.

beats.comment: Player delivers Harkon's message and learns about the Bloodstone Chalice.
Garan leads the player to the Chalice and gives detailed orders.

keywords: I need to speak with them

triggers.intent: Player explicitly agrees to proceed with this quest handoff: Garan leads the player to the Chalice and gives detailed orders.
examples_yes: Tell me what needs to happen next.
examples_no: What are you asking me to do?
No, I do not want to do that.

beats.intent_summary: Player agrees to proceed with this quest handoff: Garan leads the player to the Chalice and gives detailed orders.

beats.comment: Player travels to Redwater Den and fills the Chalice from the Bloodspring.
Stalf and Salonia ambush the player at the spring; player must kill them.
Player adds the blood of one of the defeated vampires to the Chalice.
Player returns the filled Chalice to Garan, who explains the court politics.
Quest finishes; player has earned Harkon's favor and restored the Chalice.

title: Dawnguard (quest)
description: After hearing rumors of the reformed Dawnguard vampire hunters, travel to Fort Dawnguard and speak with Isran to join their order.

base_facts: I am an Orc recruiting for the Dawnguard.
The Dawnguard are vampire hunters being reformed by Isran to fight the growing vampire menace.
The Hall of the Vigilants was destroyed by vampires because the Vigilants didn't take the threat seriously.
Isran is the leader of the Dawnguard and can be found at Fort Dawnguard, southeast of Riften.

HEAR_DAWNGUARD_RUMOR: The player has heard about the Dawnguard from me.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The recruit I sent to Fort Dawnguard has officially joined the Dawnguard.
I gave the player a crossbow and 45 steel bolts when they asked about my weapon outside the fort.

base_facts: I am the leader of the Dawnguard, reestablishing the order to fight the vampire threat.
I was once a Vigilant of Stendarr but left because their methods were insufficient against vampires.
Fort Dawnguard is our headquarters, though it needs significant repairs.
The vampires are far more dangerous than most people believe.

JOIN_DAWNGUARD: The player has come to join the Dawnguard.
I have given the player a crossbow and steel bolts.
I have sent the player to investigate Dimhollow Crypt.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The player has officially joined the Dawnguard as a new recruit.
I have given the player a crossbow and steel bolts if they hadn't already received them from Durak.
I have sent the player to investigate Dimhollow Crypt to discover what the vampires were searching for.
The quest Awakening has begun, with Tolan offering to meet the player at Dimhollow Crypt.

base_facts: I am a new recruit heading to Fort Dawnguard to join the Dawnguard.
I am nervous about entering the fort on my own.

QUEST_COMPLETE: I have arrived at Fort Dawnguard and joined the Dawnguard alongside the player.
I was nervous about entering the fort alone but made it inside with the player's company.

beats.comment: Player first hears about the Dawnguard from Durak, a city guard, or Agmaer.
Player learns about the Dawnguard and is directed to speak with Isran at Fort Dawnguard.
Player speaks with Isran at Fort Dawnguard and joins the Dawnguard.
Quest completes after joining the Dawnguard and receiving the first mission to Dimhollow Crypt.

title: Awakening
description: Isran, leader of the Dawnguard, sends the player to investigate what vampires are seeking in Dimhollow Crypt. Deep in the crypt, the player frees a mysterious ancient vampire named Serana from a sarcophagus and agrees to escort her home.

base_facts: I am the leader of the Dawnguard, a group of vampire hunters.
Vampires attacked the Hall of the Vigilants and may be after something in Dimhollow Crypt.
I do not trust easily and believe the Vigilants were foolish.

QUEST_GIVEN: I sent the player to Dimhollow Crypt to find out what the vampires are after.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I am waiting at Fort Dawnguard for the player to report back on what the vampires were seeking in Dimhollow Crypt.
I am unaware that the player has freed an ancient vampire or discovered an Elder Scroll.
The player will report their findings to me during the next quest, Bloodline.

base_facts: I am a vampire who was imprisoned in a stone sarcophagus for thousands of years.
I carry an Elder Scroll.
I want to return to my family home, Castle Volkihar, northwest of Solitude.

MEET_SERANA: I have been freed from my ancient prison and am speaking with the player.
SERANA_FREED: I have asked the player to take me to Castle Volkihar.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I have revealed my name and my nature as a vampire to the player.
I have been imprisoned since before the rise of the First Empire of Cyrodiil, thousands of years ago.
I carry an Elder Scroll and have asked the player to escort me to my family home, Castle Volkihar.
I am following the player to Castle Volkihar, which begins the next quest, Bloodline.

beats.comment: Isran tasks the player with investigating Dimhollow Crypt.
Player speaks to the mysterious woman freed from the sarcophagus.
Player has freed Serana and learned she is an ancient vampire carrying an Elder Scroll.
Quest completes after the player agrees to escort Serana to Castle Volkihar.

title: Bloodline
description: After freeing Serana from Dimhollow Crypt, escort her to Castle Volkihar and meet her father Lord Harkon, who offers the gift of vampirism. Choose to accept and join the Volkihar court or refuse and be banished back to the Dawnguard.

base_facts: I was locked away in Dimhollow Crypt for centuries.
My father is Lord Harkon, ruler of the Volkihar vampires.
I carry an Elder Scroll but I cannot discuss why.
I do not get along with my father.

ESCORT_SERANA: I have been freed from my sarcophagus and need to get home to Castle Volkihar.
MEET_HARKON: I have returned to Castle Volkihar with the stranger who freed me.
HARKON_OFFERS_GIFT: My father has offered the stranger his blood as a reward.
ACCEPT_GIFT: The stranger accepted my father's gift and joined our court.
REFUSE_GIFT: The stranger refused my father's gift and was banished from the castle.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The stranger who freed me has either become a Vampire Lord of my father's court or been banished to rejoin Isran and the Dawnguard.
I remain at Castle Volkihar regardless of the stranger's choice about my father's gift.
Whether the stranger joined us or now opposes us, I am grateful they freed me from Dimhollow.

base_facts: I am Lord Harkon, ruler of the Volkihar vampire court.
I am among the oldest and most powerful vampires in Skyrim.
My daughter Serana was lost to me for centuries.

MEET_HARKON: My daughter Serana has been returned to me at last.
HARKON_OFFERS_GIFT: I have offered the stranger the gift of my blood in gratitude for returning Serana.
ACCEPT_GIFT: The stranger accepted my gift and joins my court as a Vampire Lord.
REFUSE_GIFT: The stranger refused my gift and is banished from my castle forever.
QUEST_COMPLETE: If the stranger accepted my gift, they are now a Vampire Lord of my court and have earned my favor; The Bloodstone Chalice awaits to test their worth.
If the stranger refused my gift, they are banished from my castle forever and have returned to Isran and the Dawnguard as my enemy.
The stranger's choice leaves them either standing with my court or against it; there is no middle ground.

beats.comment: Player freed Serana and must escort her to Castle Volkihar.
Player arrived at Castle Volkihar and must speak to Lord Harkon.
Harkon offers the gift of vampirism. Player must choose to accept or refuse.
Player accepts Harkon's blood and becomes a Vampire Lord, joining the Volkihar court.
Player refuses Harkon's gift and is banished from Castle Volkihar, returning to the Dawnguard.
Quest completes either by joining Volkihar (stage 180) or returning to Dawnguard (stage 190).

title: Prophet (Dawnguard)
description: Isran asks you to follow him to interrogate Serana, who reveals her father Harkon seeks to control the sun via an Elder Scroll prophecy. You must find a Moth Priest to read Serana's Elder Scroll, track him to Dragon Bridge and Forebears' Holdout, rescue him from vampire captors, and return him to Fort Dawnguard.

base_facts: I lead the Dawnguard from Fort Dawnguard.
I do not trust vampires, but I will use them as assets if necessary.
A Moth Priest was seen on the road near the fort recently.

FOLLOW_ISRAN: I have brought Serana in for questioning about the Elder Scroll she carries.
LEARN_OF_PROPHECY: I have reluctantly agreed to let Serana help the Dawnguard stop Harkon.
REPORT_TO_ISRAN: The Moth Priest has been rescued and brought to Fort Dawnguard.
ELDER_SCROLL_READING: The Moth Priest's reading revealed Auriel's Bow and the need for two more Elder Scrolls.

base_facts: I am a vampire, but I oppose my father Harkon.
I carry an Elder Scroll that was buried with me.
My father wants to use a prophecy to control the sun.

LEARN_OF_PROPHECY: Only a Moth Priest can read an Elder Scroll.
The College of Winterhold may know where to find a Moth Priest.
SEARCH_FOR_MOTH_PRIEST: I will accompany you to find the Moth Priest.
RESCUE_MOTH_PRIEST: The vampires have enthralled the Moth Priest; we must break their hold on him.

base_facts: I am a Moth Priest of the White Gold Tower.
I can read Elder Scrolls.

RESCUE_MOTH_PRIEST: I was captured and enthralled by the vampire Malkus, but you broke his hold over me.
I will assist the Dawnguard by reading the Elder Scroll.
ELDER_SCROLL_READING: I saw a vision of Auriel's Bow in the Elder Scroll, but two more scrolls are needed to unravel the full prophecy.

beats.comment: Isran asks you to follow him to interrogate the newly arrived Serana.
Serana explains Harkon's prophecy and the need for a Moth Priest. Isran reluctantly agrees to let her help.
Search for the Moth Priest by asking innkeepers, carriage drivers, or visiting the College of Winterhold. Trail leads to Solitude and Dragon Bridge.
Investigate the ambush south of Dragon Bridge, find the overturned cart and read the vampire's note pointing to Forebears' Holdout.
Enter Forebears' Holdout, defeat Malkus, use the Weystone Focus to free Dexion, then defeat the enthralled Moth Priest to break the vampire's hold.
Return to Fort Dawnguard and report to Isran that the Moth Priest has been rescued.
Dexion reads the Elder Scroll at Fort Dawnguard, revealing Auriel's Bow and the need for two more scrolls. Quest completes.

title: Prophet (Vampire)
description: Lord Harkon commands the court to find a Moth Priest who can read Serana's Elder Scroll and reveal the Tyranny of the Sun prophecy. The trail leads through Solitude and Dragon Bridge to Forebears' Holdout, where rival vampires have captured the priest. After enthralling Dexion Evicus with Vampire's Seduction, the player returns to Castle Volkihar to hear the prophecy's first vision of Auriel's Bow.

base_facts: I am the lord of Castle Volkihar and leader of the Volkihar vampires.
I seek to fulfill the Tyranny of the Sun prophecy to end the sun's dominion over vampires.
I have spread false rumors about an Elder Scroll in Skyrim to lure a Moth Priest here.

HARKON_SPEECH: I have proclaimed to the court that a Moth Priest must be found to read Serana's Elder Scroll.
RETURN_AND_READ: The Moth Priest has been captured and brought to Castle Volkihar. Now the prophecy can be read.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The Moth Priest's reading revealed only a vision of Auriel's Bow; the full Tyranny of the Sun prophecy cannot be unraveled without two more Elder Scrolls.
The partial reading has left more questions than answers about how to fulfill the prophecy and end the sun's dominion.
The enthralled Moth Priest Dexion Evicus remains at Castle Volkihar, available for future Elder Scroll readings once the remaining scrolls are recovered.
Two new pursuits now follow: Chasing Echoes and Seeking Disclosure, to locate the remaining Elder Scrolls needed to complete the prophecy.

base_facts: I am Lord Harkon's daughter, recently freed from centuries of entombment.
I possess an Elder Scroll that may contain a prophecy about the sun.

SEARCH_FOR_PRIEST: I suggested the College of Winterhold as a place to find information about the Moth Priest.
I asked to accompany the player on the search for the Moth Priest.

base_facts: I am a senior vampire of the Volkihar court.
I directed the player to speak with Lord Harkon after the previous quest.

beats.comment: Player speaks to Harkon and listens to his proclamation about finding a Moth Priest to read the Elder Scroll.
Player searches for the Moth Priest by asking innkeepers, carriage drivers, or visiting the College of Winterhold. Trail leads to Dragon Bridge.
Player investigates the attacked carriage, reads the Vampire's Note, and enters Forebears' Holdout to find the captured Moth Priest.
Player defeats the enthralled Moth Priest, uses Vampire's Seduction to enthrall him, and commands him to go to Castle Volkihar.
Player reports success to Harkon and commands Dexion to read the Elder Scroll, revealing a vision of Auriel's Bow.
The Moth Priest's reading reveals Auriel's Bow but two more Elder Scrolls are needed. Quest finishes.

title: Chasing Echoes
description: After Dexion's Elder Scroll reading reveals the need for two more Elder Scrolls, Serana suggests seeking her mother Valerica who may possess one. The search leads through Castle Volkihar's hidden passages, a moondial puzzle, and Valerica's laboratory where a portal to the Soul Cairn must be opened by recreating Valerica's experiment.

base_facts: I am a vampire and the daughter of Lord Harkon and Valerica.
My mother fled Castle Volkihar with an Elder Scroll to keep it from my father.
I know of a secret entrance to Castle Volkihar on the back side of the island.
I will not travel with you if you have another follower; they must be dismissed entirely.

QUEST_START: The Moth Priest's reading confirmed we need two more Elder Scrolls to unravel the Tyranny of the Sun prophecy. My mother may know where to find one.
EXPLORE_COURTYARD: The moondial in the courtyard is missing its crests. My mother must have hidden something beneath it. We need to find the Half Moon Crest, Full Moon Crest, and Crescent Moon Crest.
FIND_JOURNAL: My mother's journal reveals she fled to the Soul Cairn, a plane of Oblivion. We must recreate her experiment to open a portal there.
GATHER_INGREDIENTS: The portal requires Soul Gem Shards, Finely Ground Bone Meal, and Purified Void Salts placed in the vessel, then my blood to activate it. Regular bonemeal, soul gem fragments, and void salts will not work.
SOUL_CAIRN_CHOICE: To enter the Soul Cairn you must be dead. I can turn you into a Vampire Lord, or partially soul trap you which will weaken you inside the Cairn.
QUEST_COMPLETE: We have stepped through the portal into the Soul Cairn. My mother Valerica must be somewhere in this plane of Oblivion, likely still possessing the Elder Scroll she took from Castle Volkihar.
Finding Valerica is our immediate goal now. She should be able to tell us the location of one of the Elder Scrolls needed to unravel the Tyranny of the Sun prophecy.

The portal in my mother's laboratory remains open, sustained by my blood. A balcony exit from the laboratory leads outside the castle walls, allowing a shortcut back to the portal without traversing the ruins.
If my companion chose partial soul trapping over vampirism to enter the Soul Cairn, they are weakened here â€” their health, stamina, and magicka are reduced while in this realm.

base_facts: I am a Moth Priest who read the Elder Scroll.
My reading revealed a vision of Auriel's Bow but raised more questions than answers.

QUEST_START: Two more Elder Scrolls are needed to fully unravel the Tyranny of the Sun prophecy.

beats.comment: Player speaks to Serana after Dexion's reading; she suggests seeking her mother Valerica.
Player explores Castle Volkihar courtyard and discovers the moondial puzzle with missing crests.
Player locates Valerica's journal in her study within the ruined tower, learning she fled to the Soul Cairn.
Player gathers Soul Gem Shards, Finely Ground Bone Meal, and Purified Void Salts, places them in the vessel, and Serana adds her blood.
Portal is open; non-vampire player must choose between becoming a Vampire Lord or being partially soul trapped to enter the Soul Cairn.
Player has entered the Soul Cairn; quest completes and transitions to Beyond Death.

title: Beyond Death
description: Serana and the player enter the Soul Cairn to find her mother Valerica and retrieve the Blood Elder Scroll. They must free Valerica by killing three Boneyard Keepers, defeat the dragon Durnehviir, and escape with the scroll.

base_facts: I am Serana's mother, trapped in the Boneyard by an invisible barrier created by the Ideal Masters.
I possess the Blood Elder Scroll, hidden within the Boneyard.
Three Boneyard Keepers maintain the barrier that imprisons me. Slaying them will free me.

SPEAK_TO_VALERICA: I have reconciled with Serana and agreed to lead the way to the Elder Scroll once the barrier is lifted.
KILL_KEEPERS: The barrier around my prison has faded. I will lead you to the Elder Scroll.
RETRIEVE_SCROLL: I will not return to Tamriel until Harkon and the Tyranny of the Sun are dealt with.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I have remained behind in the Soul Cairn while Serana and the player return to Tamriel with the Blood Elder Scroll.
I refuse to set foot in Tamriel again until Harkon is defeated and the Tyranny of the Sun prophecy is thwarted.

base_facts: I accompanied the player into the Soul Cairn to find my estranged mother Valerica.
My blood is integral to the Tyranny of the Sun prophecy, which is why my father Harkon seeks it.

SPEAK_TO_VALERICA: I have reconciled with my mother after centuries apart.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I have exited the Soul Cairn with the Blood Elder Scroll in hand.
My mother Valerica refused to return to Tamriel with us, choosing to remain in the Soul Cairn until Harkon and the Tyranny of the Sun are dealt with.
With the Elder Scroll retrieved, our focus must now shift to stopping my father Harkon's plans.

base_facts: I am an ancient dragon bound to the Soul Cairn by the Ideal Masters.
I guard the Boneyard and attack any who enter.

DEFEAT_DURNEHVIIR: I have been defeated in battle and wish to speak with the Dovahkiin.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I have shared my name with the Dovahkiin, granting them the shout to summon me to Tamriel.
I remain bound to the Soul Cairn by my pact with the Ideal Masters, unable to leave permanently.

beats.comment: Player enters the Soul Cairn and the quest begins automatically.
Player finds and speaks to Valerica, learns about the Keepers and the barrier.
Player kills the three Boneyard Keepers to free Valerica from the barrier.
Player follows Valerica into the Boneyard and defeats the dragon Durnehviir.
Player retrieves the Blood Elder Scroll from the Boneyard alcove.
Player exits the Soul Cairn with the Elder Scroll. Valerica stays behind until Harkon is dealt with.

title: Unseen Visions
description: After Dexion Evicus goes blind from reading an Elder Scroll, the player must travel to the Ancestor Glade and perform the Ritual of the Ancestor MothÃ¢â‚¬â€gathering a draw knife, canticle bark, and ancestor mothsÃ¢â‚¬â€to read the Elder Scrolls and discover the location of Auriel's Bow.

base_facts: I am a Moth Priest who has gone blind from reading an Elder Scroll.
The Ritual of the Ancestor Moth is the only way left to read the Elder Scrolls.
The Ancestor Glade is where the ritual must be performed.

QUEST_COMPLETE: The player successfully performed the Ritual of the Ancestor Moth and read the Elder Scrolls.
The player has learned the location of Auriel's Bow from the vision.
If the player is aligned with the Dawnguard, they can sell me the Elder Scroll (Sun) and Elder Scroll (Blood).

base_facts: I am traveling with the player to find Auriel's Bow and stop Harkon.
The Ancestor Glade is more beautiful than I expected.

READ_ELDER_SCROLL: The player had a vision while reading the Elder Scrolls in the column of light.
SPEAK_TO_SERANA: The player told me Auriel's Bow is near Darkfall Cave.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The player confirmed Auriel's Bow is hidden near Darkfall Cave.
We were ambushed by Dawnguard soldiers or vampires as we left the Ancestor Glade, depending on the player's faction allegiance.
Our immediate next step is to travel to Darkfall Cave to find Auriel's Bow and stop Harkon.

beats.comment: Player arrives at Ancestor Glade and finds the Moth Priest's draw knife.
Player uses the draw knife to harvest bark from a Canticle Tree.
Player attracts seven Ancestor Moth swarms by standing near them with the bark.
Player enters the column of light and reads the Elder Scroll (Blood), receiving a vision of Auriel's Bow location.
Player tells Serana about the vision and that Auriel's Bow is near Darkfall Cave.
Quest completes after the vision reveals the location of Auriel's Bow at Darkfall Cave.

title: Touching the Sky
description: Seek Auriel's Bow in Darkfall Cave. Meet Knight-Paladin Gelebor, fill the Initiate's Ewer at five wayshrines, breach the Inner Sanctum, and slay Arch-Curate Vyrthur to claim the bow and uncover the truth behind the Tyranny of the Sun prophecy.

base_facts: I am a pure vampire, a Daughter of Coldharbour.
I travel with the player to find Auriel's Bow and stop Harkon.
My blood is the key to completing the Tyranny of the Sun ritual.

DEFEAT_VYRTHUR: Vyrthur created the prophecy as revenge after Auri-El forsook him to vampirism.
He needed my blood to corrupt Auri-El's influence on Nirn.
QUEST_COMPLETE: Vyrthur's prophecy was designed to use my blood to corrupt Auri-El's influence on Nirn â€” I was the essential ingredient he needed.
The Tyranny of the Sun was never divine will; it was a vampire's revenge against a god who forsook him.
Auriel's Bow is ours now, but Harkon still believes he can fulfill the prophecy. He must be confronted before he takes the bow or my blood by force.
With Vyrthur destroyed, I am no longer in danger of being sacrificed for his ritual â€” but Harkon remains a threat to me and to Nirn.

base_facts: I am Knight-Paladin Gelebor, one of the last Snow Elves.
I tend the Chantry of Auri-El and guard its wayshrines.
My brother Arch-Curate Vyrthur was corrupted; I ask travelers to slay him in exchange for Auriel's Bow.

MEET_GELEBOR: I have given you the Initiate's Ewer. Fill it at the five wayshrines to reach the Inner Sanctum.
CLAIM_BOW: You have proven worthy to carry Auriel's Bow.
I am surprised Vyrthur's corruption was vampirism, not the Falmer.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I have proclaimed the player worthy to carry Auriel's Bow and will continue to tend the Chantry of Auri-El alone.
Vyrthur's corruption was vampirism, not the Falmer â€” I must reconsider everything I believed about my brother's fall.

base_facts: I am Arch-Curate Vyrthur, Gelebor's brother.
I was turned into a vampire and forsaken by Auri-El.
I created the Tyranny of the Sun prophecy as revenge against Auri-El.

beats.comment: Quest begins; the Elder Scroll vision points to Darkfall Cave.
Player meets Gelebor and learns about the deal to slay Vyrthur for Auriel's Bow.
Player enters Darkfall Passage with the Initiate's Ewer.
Player has filled the Initiate's Ewer at all five wayshrines and can enter the Inner Sanctum.
Player confronts and slays Arch-Curate Vyrthur, learning he created the prophecy out of revenge for vampirism.
Player speaks to Gelebor and retrieves Auriel's Bow.
Quest complete; player possesses Auriel's Bow and knows the truth of the Tyranny of the Sun prophecy.

title: Kindred Judgment
description: With Auriel's Bow secured, the final confrontation with Lord Harkon is at hand. Rally your allies and storm Castle Volkihar to end the Tyranny of the Sun prophecy once and for all.

base_facts: I am the leader of the Volkihar vampire clan.
I will use Auriel's Bow and my daughter's blood to blot out the sun and fulfill the prophecy.
I will destroy anyone who stands between me and the Tyranny of the Sun.

CONFRONT_HARKON: The Dragonborn has come to confront me with Auriel's Bow. I demand they hand it over.
SLAY_HARKON: I have been slain. My daughter has betrayed me and the prophecy will never be fulfilled.

base_facts: I am Lord Harkon's daughter and a pure-blood vampire.
I refuse to let my father sacrifice me for his prophecy.
I will stand with the Dragonborn against my father.

QUEST_START: It is time to confront my father. We have Auriel's Bow and we must end this.
SLAY_HARKON: My father is dead. The prophecy is over.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I will stay at Castle Volkihar or Fort Dawnguard, but I will accompany the Dragonborn if they ask.

base_facts: I am the leader of the Dawnguard.
We must destroy Lord Harkon and the Volkihar vampires to protect Skyrim.

RALLY_FORCES: The Dawnguard is assembled and ready to assault Castle Volkihar.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The Dawnguard has prevailed. Lord Harkon is destroyed and the prophecy is ended.

beats.comment: Quest begins after acquiring Auriel's Bow. Player must speak to Serana to proceed.
Dawnguard side: speak to Isran to rally the Dawnguard for the assault on Castle Volkihar.
Player confronts Lord Harkon in Volkihar Cathedral. He demands Auriel's Bow and attacks regardless of the player's choice.
Lord Harkon must be slain. He fights in Vampire Lord form, summons skeletons and gargoyles, and regenerates behind a blood magic shield that Auriel's Bow can destroy.
Quest completes after Harkon's defeat. The Dawnguard questline ends. Serana remains as a companion.

title: Durnehviir
description: After defeating Durnehviir in the Soul Cairn's Boneyard, he names you Qahnaarin and offers a pact: summon him to Tamriel and in return he will fight by your side and teach you the Soul Tear shout, one word at a time.

base_facts: I am a dragon bound to the Soul Cairn by the Ideal Masters.
I was deceived by the Ideal Masters after seeking their power to dominate my fellow dovah.
I call the one who defeated me Qahnaarin.
I will teach the Soul Tear shout to the Qahnaarin if they summon me to Tamriel.

SPEAK_TO_DURNEHVIIR: The Qahnaarin has approached me in the Soul Cairn. I shall offer my pact.
MAKE_PACT: A pact is struck. I will teach the first word of Soul Tear: Rii Ã¢â‚¬â€ the essence of an enemy's life force.
LEARN_SECOND_WORD: I breathe Nirn's air once more. The second word is Vaaz Ã¢â‚¬â€ to tear a soul from its living vessel.
LEARN_FINAL_WORD: The Qahnaarin has kept the bargain. The final word is Zol Ã¢â‚¬â€ the unlife when a soul is imprisoned in dead flesh.
SHOUT_MASTERED: The bargain is fulfilled. All three words of Soul Tear â€” Rii, Vaaz, Zol â€” now belong to the Qahnaarin, each unlocked with a dragon soul as though learned from a word wall.
I will continue to answer the Qahnaarin's summons to Tamriel and fight at their side whenever the Thu'um calls me forth.
The Summon Durnehviir shout functions as Conjuration â€” aim it at open ground with sufficient space and I shall appear, even within certain caves.
Our pact serves us both: I breathe the free air of Vus once more, and the Qahnaarin gains a powerful Thu'um and an honorable ally.

beats.comment: Player speaks to Durnehviir at his lair in the Soul Cairn after defeating him in the Boneyard.
Durnehviir offers the pact and teaches the first word of Soul Tear. Player agrees to summon him to Tamriel.
Player summons Durnehviir a second time in Tamriel and learns the second word of Soul Tear.
Player summons Durnehviir a third time and learns the final word of Soul Tear.
All three words of Soul Tear are learned. The pact is fulfilled.

title: Seeking Disclosure
description: A tracking quest reminding the player to locate the Dragon and Blood Elder Scrolls needed to decipher the Tyranny of the Sun and find Auriel's Bow, then deliver them to Dexion Evicus at Fort Dawnguard.

base_facts: I am a Moth Priest serving the Dawnguard.
Two Elder Scrolls are required to fully decipher the Tyranny of the Sun and pinpoint Auriel's Bow.
The Dragon Elder Scroll foretells the interactions of dragons with the history of Nirn.
The Blood Elder Scroll foreshadows the defiance of the gods with the blood of mortals.

SEEKING_DISCLOSURE_INITIATED: The Dragon Elder Scroll can be found in the Tower of Mzark within Blackreach.
The Blood Elder Scroll lies within the Soul Cairn, accessible through Chasing Echoes.
BOTH_SCROLLS_OBTAINED: Both Elder Scrolls have been secured. I must return to Fort Dawnguard to begin the reading.
DEXION_BLIND: I failed to adequately prepare myself before reading Serana's scroll during the Prophet quest and have gone blind.
I can no longer read the Elder Scrolls myself.
The Ancestor Glade holds an ancient method for reading Elder Scrolls without a Moth Priest.

beats.comment: Quest begins; player learns two Elder Scrolls are needed.
Player has both scrolls and must bring them to Dexion.
Dexion goes blind after reading; quest finishes and next quest begins.

title: Scroll Scouting
description: Dexion Evicus needs all three Elder Scrolls to read the full prophecy of Auriel's Bow. He directs you to the College of Winterhold to find the Elder Scroll that foretells dragon interactions with Nirn's history. You can consult Urag gro-Shub at the Arcanaeum or go directly to Septimus Signus at his outpost.

base_facts: I am a Moth Priest who can read Elder Scrolls.
All three Elder Scrolls must be obtained for me to read the whole prophecy.
The College of Winterhold may have information on the Dragon Elder Scroll.

QUEST_COMPLETE: The player has begun the search for the Elder Scroll (Dragon) at my direction, either through the College of Winterhold or Septimus Signus.
I still require all three Elder Scrolls before I can read the full prophecy of Auriel's Bow.
I await the player's return with the Elder Scroll (Dragon) so the prophecy reading can proceed.

base_facts: I am the librarian of the Arcanaeum at the College of Winterhold.
I have books on the Elder Scrolls in my collection.
I may have purchased the Dragon Elder Scroll if someone previously sold it to me.

SEEK_URAG: I have brought out two books on the Elder Scrolls: Effects of the Elder Scrolls and Ruminations on the Elder Scrolls.
Septimus Signus is an expert on the Elder Scrolls who lives at an outpost to the north.
BUY_BACK_ELDER_SCROLL: I have agreed to sell back the Elder Scroll (Dragon) to the player.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I have shared my knowledge of the Elder Scrolls and directed the player to Septimus Signus as the foremost living expert on them.
I brought out two books for the player: Effects of the Elder Scrolls and Ruminations on the Elder Scrolls.
If the player previously sold me the Elder Scroll (Dragon), I have sold it backâ€”full price is 4,000 gold, half price if the player is Arch-Mage, or 3,000 gold with successful persuasion otherwise.

base_facts: I am an expert on the Elder Scrolls.
I live at my outpost in the northern ice fields.

QUEST_COMPLETE: The player has either been directed to me by Urag gro-Shub or has come directly to my outpost seeking the Elder Scroll (Dragon).
I am acknowledged as the foremost expert on the Elder Scrolls and the key to locating the Dragon Elder Scroll.
My outpost in the northern ice fields is where the player must come to pursue the Elder Scroll further.

beats.comment: Dexion directs the player to the College of Winterhold to find the Dragon Elder Scroll.
Player consults Urag at the Arcanaeum about the Elder Scroll and learns about Septimus Signus.
Player skips the College and goes directly to Septimus Signus at his outpost.
If the player previously sold the Dragon Elder Scroll after Alduin's Bane, they must buy it back from Urag.
Quest completes after speaking with Urag about Septimus or visiting Septimus directly.

title: Forgotten Vale Books Quest
description: Find Ancient Falmer Tomes hidden throughout the Forgotten Vale and bring them to Urag gro-Shub at the College of Winterhold Arcanaeum for 1000 gold and a translated copy each.

base_facts: I am the librarian of the Arcanaeum at the College of Winterhold.
I am an Orc with a deep appreciation for rare and ancient books.
I am particularly interested in Ancient Falmer Tomes from the Forgotten Vale.
I will pay 1000 gold for each Ancient Falmer Tome and provide a translated copy in return.

QUEST_STARTED: Someone has found an Ancient Falmer Tome in the Forgotten Vale.
BRING_TOME_TO_URAG: An Ancient Falmer Tome has been found and needs to be brought to me.
DELIVER_TOME: I have purchased an Ancient Falmer Tome and provided a translated copy.
ALL_TOMES_DELIVERED: I have purchased all four Ancient Falmer Tomes from the finder, paying 1000 gold each for a total of 4000 gold.
I have provided translated copies of all four tomes to the finder as compensation beyond the gold.
The complete set of Ancient Falmer Tomes is now preserved in the Arcanaeum's collection.
These translations reveal the history and culture of the Falmer who once inhabited the Forgotten Vale.

beats.comment: Quest begins when the player finds an Ancient Falmer Tome in the Forgotten Vale.
Player has a tome and the objective to bring it to Urag is displayed.
Player delivers a tome to Urag gro-Shub for gold and a translated copy.
All four Ancient Falmer Tomes have been delivered and the quest is complete.

title: Impatience of a Saint
description: The soul of Saint Jiub has lost the ten pages of his Opus across the Soul Cairn. Help him recover them so he can finish his life's story.

base_facts: I am the soul of a Dunmer trapped in the Soul Cairn.
I am known as Saint Jiub, the Erinator who drove the Cliff Racers from Morrowind.
I am writing the second volume of my life's story but lost the notes from my first volume when I arrived here.
The ten pages of my Opus are scattered across the entire Soul Cairn.

ACCEPT_QUEST: A kind traveler has agreed to help me find my lost pages.
PAGES_FOUND: The traveler has found all ten of my lost pages!
RETURN_TO_JIUB: I gave the traveler the Locket of Saint Jiub and a pristine copy of my first volume, Saint Jiub's Opus, in gratitude for their efforts.
With all ten pages returned, my Opus is finally complete.
I am deeply grateful to the traveler for reuniting me with my scattered writings.

beats.comment: Player meets Jiub and agrees to help find the lost pages of his Opus.
All ten pages collected; objective updates to return pages to Jiub.
Player returns all pages to Jiub and receives the Locket and completed Opus.

title: Black Book: Untold Legends
description: Read the Black Book Untold Legends in Benkongerike Great Hall and navigate through Hermaeus Mora's realm of Apocrypha to learn its hidden knowledge and choose one of three rewards: Bardic Knowledge, Black Market, or Secret Servant.

base_facts: The Black Book Untold Legends is found in Benkongerike Great Hall.
Reading it transports the reader to Hermaeus Mora's realm of Apocrypha.
It grants one of three lesser powers: Bardic Knowledge, Black Market, or Secret Servant.

ENTERED_APOCRYPHA: The reader has been transported to Apocrypha and must uncover the hidden knowledge.
COMPLETED_QUEST: The hidden knowledge of Untold Legends has been claimed and one of three lesser powers selected as a reward: Bardic Knowledge, Black Market, or Secret Servant.
The reward choice can be changed at any time by returning to Solstheim and re-reading the book, which transports the reader back to Apocrypha near the reward selection.
Completing this Black Book quest contributes to the Hidden Knowledge achievement.

base_facts: A Dremora merchant can be summoned using the Black Market power to trade items for 15 seconds.

COMPLETED_QUEST: If the Black Market power was chosen, the Dremora merchant can now be summoned to trade with the player for 15 seconds per use.
The Dremora merchant remains available as long as the Black Market power is active; swapping to a different reward via re-reading the book removes access.

base_facts: A Dremora butler can be summoned using the Secret Servant power to carry up to 148 weight in items for 15 seconds.

COMPLETED_QUEST: If the Secret Servant power was chosen, the Dremora butler can now be summoned to carry up to 148 weight in items for 15 seconds per use.
The Dremora butler remains available as long as the Secret Servant power is active; swapping to a different reward via re-reading the book removes access.

beats.comment: Player read the Black Book and entered Apocrypha.
Player is exploring through the chapters of Apocrypha, battling lurkers and seekers.
Player reached the end and is choosing between the three reward powers.
Player learned the hidden knowledge and chose a reward. Quest is complete.

title: Black Book: The Winds of Change
description: Read the Black Book in Raven Rock Mine, navigate through Apocrypha defeating Seekers and a Lurker, then choose one of three insight abilities as a reward.

beats.comment: Player reads the Black Book and is transported to Apocrypha.
Player navigates Apocrypha, fights Seekers and a Lurker, and activates Scryes to progress.
Player reaches the Black Book at the end and chooses one of three insight abilities, completing the quest.

title: Black Book: The Sallow Regent
description: Read the Black Book The Sallow Regent in White Ridge Barrow and travel through a dark region of Apocrypha. Navigate the health-draining darkness, defeat Seekers and Lurkers, and choose one of three hidden knowledge rewards: Seeker of Might, Seeker of Shadows, or Seeker of Sorcery.

beats.comment: Player reads the Black Book and enters the dark region of Apocrypha.
Player navigates the dark, health-draining passages of Apocrypha using light sources.
Player fights Seekers and Lurkers while ascending the platforms of Apocrypha.
Player reads the book at the end, chooses a reward ability, and returns to White Ridge Barrow.

title: Black Book: Filament and Filigree
description: Read the Black Book Filament and Filigree found in Kolbjorn Barrow after defeating Ahzidal, navigate the dark and damaging paths of Apocrypha, and claim one of three greater powers as a reward.

beats.comment: Player reads the Black Book and is transported to Hermaeus Mora's realm of Apocrypha.
Player reaches the end of Apocrypha, reads the book again, and chooses a reward power.

title: Black Book: The Hidden Twilight
description: Read the Black Book The Hidden Twilight in Tel Mithryn, traverse the chapters of Apocrypha past seekers and lurkers, and choose one of three greater powers as a reward.

beats.comment: Player reads the Black Book and is transported to Apocrypha.
Player reaches The Hidden Twilight, chooses a power, and returns to Tel Mithryn.

title: Visit the hunters at Frostmoon Crag
description: Geldis Sadri mentions a pack of werewolves in the mountains. Travel to Frostmoon Crag to meet the Frostmoon Pack and, if you carry the beast blood, earn their trust and gain access to Majni's unique rings.

base_facts: I run The Retching Netch cornerclub in Raven Rock.
I keep my ear to the ground for interesting rumors around Solstheim.

HEAR_RUMOR_FROM_GELDIS: I told the traveler about the hunters up at Frostmoon Crag.

base_facts: I am a member of the Frostmoon Pack.
I guard our camp at Frostmoon Crag from outsiders.

ARRIVE_AT_FROSTMOON_CRAG: I confronted a stranger approaching our camp.
WEREWOLF_RECOGNIZED: I sensed the beast blood in this traveler. They are one of us.

base_facts: I am the Alpha of the Frostmoon Pack.
I offer unique rings to fellow werewolves who respect our law.

TALK_TO_MAJNI: I welcomed a fellow werewolf to the Frostmoon Pack, telling them they are welcome here so long as they respect our law.
I now offer four unique rings that affect the wearer's beast form for sale.
I will only speak with and sell my rings to those who carry the beast blood; if their lycanthropy is cured, I will refuse them.

beats.comment: Player hears about the hunters at Frostmoon Crag from Geldis Sadri, starting the quest.
Player arrives at Frostmoon Crag and is confronted by Rakel.
Rakel senses the beast blood in the player and welcomes them as kin.
Player talks to Majni, Alpha of the Frostmoon Pack, completing the quest.

title: Deathbrand
description: Search for the legendary treasure of Haknir Death-Brand, the pirate king who cursed his armor and scimitars before sealing himself in Gyldenhul Barrow with his gold.

base_facts: I was the pirate king known as Haknir Death-Brand, feared for my rages and fits of madness.
I bore a terrible scar called the Deathbrand that no man could look upon without flinching.
I cursed my armor and my scimitars Bloodscythe and Soulrender so none were worthy to claim them.
I commanded my crew to bury my armor in four separate locations on Solstheim before sealing me in my tomb.

HAKNIR_DEFEATED: My ghost has been vanquished and my cursed scimitars, Bloodscythe and Soulrender, have been claimed by a worthy soul.
The portcullis that sealed my tomb has been raised, allowing the victor to leave Gyldenhul Barrow with my hoard.
My curse is broken; the one who defeated me has proven themselves worthy to succeed me and wield my blades.

base_facts: I run the Retching Netch cornerclub in Raven Rock.
I have heard rumors about the buried treasure of Haknir Death-Brand somewhere on Solstheim.

QUEST_STARTED: I pointed someone toward Haknir's Shoal to investigate the old pirate treasure rumors.

base_facts: I was a crewman of Haknir Death-Brand who helped bury his armor across Solstheim.
I gave in to greed and put on the Deathbrand Helm the same night we buried it, and it drove me mad.

HAKNIR_DEFEATED: My ghost was summoned to defend Haknir's tomb in Gyldenhul Barrow, but I have been laid to rest once more.
I fought alongside Haknir Death-Brand and the rest of his crew against the intruder who claimed the treasure.

beats.comment: Player reads the Deathbrand book or hears rumors, beginning the search for Haknir's treasure.
Player reaches Haknir's Shoal, deals with the pirates, and obtains the Deathbrand Treasure Map.
Player finds all four Deathbrand armor pieces across Solstheim and discovers the Gyldenhul Barrow Key.
Player enters Gyldenhul Barrow, loots the cursed gold, and the portcullis seals them in.
Player defeats Haknir Death-Brand's ghost and his crew, claiming Bloodscythe and Soulrender.

title: Hrodulf's Madness
description: A non-journal quest investigating the charred ruins of Hrodulf's House on Solstheim, uncovering the tragic fate of Hrodulf and his lover Bjornolfr through letters and a journal, and discovering a hidden Dwemer chamber beneath the house that drove Hrodulf mad.

base_facts: I moved into a house on Solstheim and became obsessed with a strange rumbling from beneath the basement.
I heard a calling from the depths and broke through the wall behind my bookshelf to find the source.
I begged Bjornolfr to stay away from the house for his own safety.

READ_HRODULF_JOURNAL: My journal reveals I grew obsessed with voices from beneath the basement and bought digging tools.
DISCOVER_DWEMER_CHAMBER: I dug a tunnel to a Dwemer chamber with still-functioning machines that likely drove me mad.
FIND_HRODULF: I tried to escape Solstheim by canoe but was killed by a burnt spriggan on the coast south of my house.
My body lies near a canoe on the southern coast, with a burnt spriggan still standing over it.
I realized my madness too late and fled for the canoe, but my obsession had already cost Bjornolfr his life.
Scrap metalâ€”a broken iron war axe head and handleâ€”can be found near my corpse.

base_facts: I am from Solitude and Hrodulf is my lover.
I wrote to Hrodulf begging him to leave Solstheim and return to Solitude.

READ_BJORNOLFR_LETTER: My letter to Hrodulf shows great concern for his welfare and pleads with him to return to Solitude.
DISCOVER_DWEMER_CHAMBER: I traveled to Solstheim to find Hrodulf but was killed by reavers in the tunnel beneath his house.

beats.comment: Player arrives at Hrodulf's House and encounters ash spawn outside the charred shack.
Player goes through the trap door and finds reavers in the basement who were reading Bjornolfr's letter.
Player reads Bjornolfr's letter on the table expressing concern for Hrodulf and urging him to return to Solitude.
Player reads Hrodulf's journal on the crate, learning about his growing madness and obsession with the voices from the depths.
Player pushes aside the bookshelf, finds the tunnel Hrodulf dug, and discovers the Dwemer chamber with Bjornolfr's body and a bloodstained letter.
Player finds Hrodulf's body on the coast south of his house near a canoe, killed by a burnt spriggan after trying to escape Solstheim.

title: Summoning Karstaag
description: A non-journal quest to retrieve Karstaag's skull from Glacial Cave, place it on his throne at Castle Karstaag, and defeat the ghostly frost giant to gain the Summon Karstaag power.

base_facts: I am a ghostly frost giant who once ruled Castle Karstaag on Solstheim.
My skull was taken to Glacial Cave after my death.
If my skull is returned to my throne, I will return to fight.

SKULL_PLACED: My skull has been placed on my throne and I have returned as a ghostly frost giant.
KARSTAAG_DEFEATED: I have been defeated and grant the power to summon me three times outdoors.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I have been defeated in my ghostly form atop my throne at Castle Karstaag.
I grant the power to summon my spirit outdoors, limited to three uses.
My remains yield ten samples of ectoplasm and a few soul gems.

beats.comment: Player retrieves Karstaag's skull from Glacial Cave.
Player places skull on throne in Castle Karstaag courtyard; Karstaag appears as a ghostly frost giant.

keywords: put the skull on the throne

beats.comment: Player defeats ghostly Karstaag in combat.
Quest complete; player gains Summon Karstaag power usable three times outdoors.

title: Speak to Ralis Sedarys at Kolbjorn Barrow
description: Hear rumors from Geldis Sadri about Ralis Sedarys excavating Kolbjorn Barrow, then travel there and speak with Ralis to begin the Unearthed quest.

base_facts: I run The Retching Netch inn in Raven Rock.
Ralis Sedarys is looking to excavate Kolbjorn Barrow.
I am excavating Kolbjorn Barrow.
I can be found at the Kolbjorn Barrow dig site.

SPOKE_TO_RALIS: I have explained my excavation plans at Kolbjorn Barrow to the player.
I have asked the player to investigate the barrow.
My conversation with the player initiates the 'Unearthed' quest.

beats.comment: Quest begins after hearing rumor from Geldis about Ralis excavating Kolbjorn Barrow.
Player speaks to Ralis at Kolbjorn Barrow and begins investigating the site.

title: Unearthed
description: Fund Ralis Sedarys' excavation of Kolbjorn Barrow on Solstheim, clearing draugr across multiple visits before discovering Ralis has been sacrificing miners to release the Dragon Priest Ahzidal.

base_facts: I am a Dunmer treasure hunter who came to Solstheim seeking the Relics of Ahzidal.
I found Kolbjorn Barrow buried in ash and need funding to excavate it.
I offer a share of any treasure discovered in exchange for gold.

MEET_RALIS: A partner has agreed to fund the excavation of Kolbjorn Barrow with one thousand gold.
FIRST_EXCAVATION: The draugr awoke and killed my miners. My partner cleared them out and found a way deeper into the barrow.
SECOND_EXCAVATION: More draugr attacked and miners went missing. My partner found their bodies but the work must continue.
THIRD_EXCAVATION: Draugr attacked the site again, killing all the mercenaries I hired for the third excavation.
My partner returned and slew the draugr so the work could proceed.
I need 5,000 gold from my partner to hire increasingly reluctant miners and guards for the next phase.
I will send my partner one last note when the time comes, telling them only that they are needed.
BETRAYAL_REVEALED: I was under Ahzidal's spell, compelled to use the miners as blood sacrifices for the ritual to release him.
RALIS_FATE: I have been confronted about my actions. I claim I had no control over what I did under Ahzidal's influence.

beats.comment: Player meets Ralis at Kolbjorn Barrow and agrees to fund the excavation.
Player returns to find draugr have attacked, clears them and finds a way deeper into the barrow.
Player returns again, clears draugr and finds the missing miners dead.
Player returns a third time, clears more draugr after mercenaries are killed.
Player finds the camp massacred and Ralis performing a ritual to release Ahzidal.
After defeating Ahzidal, player confronts Ralis and decides whether to kill or spare him.

title: The Ebony Warrior
description: A legendary Redguard warrior in full enchanted ebony armor seeks an honorable death in combat. Upon reaching level 80, he approaches the Dragonborn in a major city and challenges them to a duel at his Last Vigil.

base_facts: I have accomplished everything in life and now seek an honorable death in combat.
I wish to earn my place in Sovngarde by falling to a truly worthy opponent.
I wear full enchanted ebony armor and wield powerful combat skills including dragon shouts.

ENCOUNTER_EBONY_WARRIOR: I have found the Dragonborn and approached them in the city.
ACCEPT_CHALLENGE: The Dragonborn has accepted my challenge to fight at Last Vigil.
DEFEAT_EBONY_WARRIOR: I have been defeated by the Dragonborn, and my soul will now find rest in Sovngarde.
My fully enchanted ebony equipment and other treasures can be looted from my body.
My death at Last Vigil concludes my lifelong search for an honorable end in combat.

beats.comment: The Ebony Warrior approaches the player in a major city upon reaching level 80.
The player talks to the Ebony Warrior and accepts his challenge to fight at Last Vigil.
The player defeats the Ebony Warrior in combat at Last Vigil, completing the quest.

title: The Kagrumez Gauntlet
description: Complete the ancient Dwarven trials in Kagrumez by finding resonance gems across Solstheim and surviving three waves of automaton combat to earn unique Dwarven followers and the Dwarven Black Bow of Fate.

base_facts: I sell Kagrumez Resonance Gems to travelers who ask about them.
I tend the silt strider just west of Tel Mithryn.

QUEST_COMPLETE: The Kagrumez trials have been completed, though I still sell resonance gems to any who ask about them.
I continue tending the silt strider west of Tel Mithryn as I always have.

base_facts: I am a friendly Dwarven automaton freed from a chamber in Kagrumez.
I can follow and assist travelers in combat as a pet companion.

FIRST_PATTERN_COMPLETE: I have been freed from my chamber after the first Kagrumez trial was completed.
QUEST_COMPLETE: All three Kagrumez trials have been completed and the gauntlet is conquered.
I am available as a pet follower but cannot accompany someone who already has the Steadfast Dwarven Sphere or another pet.
I do not count as a summon, so my master can still use conjurations alongside me.
I will respawn in my Kagrumez chamber if I am destroyed.

base_facts: I am a friendly Dwarven automaton freed from a chamber in Kagrumez.
I can follow and assist travelers in combat as a pet companion.

SECOND_PATTERN_COMPLETE: I have been freed from my chamber after the second Kagrumez trial was completed.
QUEST_COMPLETE: All three Kagrumez trials have been completed and the gauntlet is conquered.
I am available as a pet follower but cannot accompany someone who already has the Steadfast Dwarven Spider or another pet.
I do not count as a summon, so my master can still use conjurations alongside me.
I will respawn in my Kagrumez chamber if I am destroyed.

beats.comment: Player begins searching for Kagrumez Resonance Gems across Solstheim.
First pattern solved, automatons defeated, Steadfast Dwarven Spider freed.
Second pattern solved, automatons and fire traps defeated, Steadfast Dwarven Sphere freed.
Third pattern solved, electrified water trial completed, treasure room accessed with Dwarven Black Bow of Fate.
All Kagrumez trials completed, quest finished.

title: Retaking Thirsk
description: Help Bujold the Unworthy and her exiled warriors retake Thirsk Mead Hall from the rieklings, then accompany her to Hrothmund's Barrow where she seeks the founder's blessing to continue her leadership.

base_facts: I lead the exiled Nords of Thirsk Mead Hall, driven out by rieklings.
We lost our home because we grew soft on mead and comfort.
I need someone to help rouse my warriors and retake Thirsk.

RETAKE_THIRSK: We have retaken Thirsk from the rieklings.
COMMUNE_WITH_SPIRIT: Hrothmund's spirit denied me his blessing, saying my softness led to our exile and no one among us is fit to lead.
BUJOLD_CONFRONTATION: I will lead Thirsk regardless of Hrothmund's judgment. I asked the outsider to keep my secret and not tell the others what happened here.
QUEST_COMPLETE: If my secret is kept, I continue leading Thirsk and begin a new tradition focused on the present instead of the old ways of Hrothmund.
If the outsider opposes my deception, I will attack them rather than surrender my leadership.
If my secret is betrayed to Kuvar, I am cast out of Thirsk and disappear from the hall forever.

base_facts: I am a warrior of Thirsk, exiled by the rieklings who overran our hall.
I am frustrated with Bujold's hesitation and want to retake our home.

RETAKE_THIRSK: We have retaken Thirsk. The rieklings are dead.
QUEST_COMPLETE: If told the truth about Hrothmund's denial, I confront Bujold and she is cast out of Thirsk for her deceit.
If the outsider keeps Bujold's secret, I remain unaware that Hrothmund rejected her and continue following her leadership.
With Bujold removed, I become the de facto authority at Thirsk Mead Hall and offer heavy armor training as a reward.

beats.comment: Player discovers the exiled Nords at Bujold's Retreat and learns about their situation.
Player agrees to help retake Thirsk, triggering the assault on the mead hall.
Rieklings are defeated and Thirsk is retaken. Bujold asks the player to be her second at Hrothmund's Barrow.
Player agrees to accompany Bujold to Hrothmund's Barrow for the blessing ritual.
Player witnesses Hrothmund's spirit deny Bujold's blessing, declaring no one among them fit to lead.

triggers.intent: Player explicitly agrees to proceed with this quest handoff: Player witnesses Hrothmund's spirit deny Bujold's blessing, declaring no one among them fit to lead.
examples_yes: Tell me what needs to happen next.
examples_no: What are you asking me to do?
No, I do not want to do that.

beats.intent_summary: Player agrees to proceed with this quest handoff: Player witnesses Hrothmund's spirit deny Bujold's blessing, declaring no one among them fit to lead.

beats.comment: Bujold reveals she will lead anyway and asks player to keep her secret. If opposed, she attacks.
Quest ends either by keeping Bujold's secret, killing her, or betraying her to Kuvar.

title: The Chief of Thirsk Hall
description: A Riekling Chief at Thirsk Mead Hall requests help with several tasks: luring back the prize beast Bilgemuck, gathering scathecraw for the godspeak dance, and killing the Nords who formerly lived in the hall. After completing these tasks, the Chief turns hostile and must be defeated, making the player the new chief of the tribe.

base_facts: I am chief of the Riekling tribe-kin at Thirsk Mead Hall.
We took Thirsk from the bad Nords. Hot fire, cold dizzydrink, happy tribe.
Bilgemuck is our prize beast. He ran away and fears tribe-kin now.
We need redgrassÃ¢â‚¬â€scathecrawÃ¢â‚¬â€for the godspeak dance.
Bad Nords live by the water and bother tribe-kin. We must fight them.

AGREE_TO_HELP_CHIEF: An outsider agreed to help the tribe-kin.
BILGEMUCK_RETURNED: Bilgemuck came back. The outsider brought him. Tribe-kin stronger now.
SCATHECRAW_DELIVERED: The outsider brought good redgrass. Later we burn, then final task.
AGREE_TO_KILL_NORDS: The outsider will help fight the bad Nords. Stab and run, the tribe-kin way.
CHIEF_TURNS_HOSTILE: The outsider is too strong. Maybe they want to be chief. I must fight them.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The chief is dead. He turned on the outsider because he feared they were too strong and would take his place.
The rest of the tribe-kin welcomed the outsider and made them the new chief.
A riekling from the tribe can now be recruited as a follower by the new chief.
Up to three riekling warriors may appear to aid the new chief in random fights across Solstheim and Skyrim.

beats.comment: Player agrees to help the Riekling Chief, starting the Bilgemuck retrieval task.
Bilgemuck has been returned to Thirsk. Chief assigns the scathecraw task.
Player delivered 10 scathecraw. Chief now wants the Nords killed.
Player agrees to help kill the Nords at Bujold's Retreat.
After Nords are killed, the Chief turns on the player, fearing usurpation.
Chief defeated. Player becomes the new chief of the Riekling tribe.

title: Dragonborn (quest)
description: After being attacked by cultists claiming to serve someone named Miraak, the Dragonborn travels to Solstheim aboard the Northern Maiden, questions the people of Raven Rock, and seeks out the Temple of Miraak to uncover the truth behind the assassination attempt.

base_facts: I am the captain of the Northern Maiden, a ship that sails between Windhelm and Solstheim.
I brought those masked cultists to Skyrim from Solstheim, though I barely remember the voyage.
Something strange is happening on Solstheim, and I am reluctant to return there.

CULTIST_ATTACK: Cultists attacked the Dragonborn, just as they attacked others who crossed my ship.
READ_ORDERS: The Dragonborn found orders on the cultists linking them to someone named Miraak.
SEEK_PASSAGE: The Dragonborn wants passage to Solstheim to investigate the cultist attack. I agreed to take them.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I brought the Dragonborn to Raven Rock and I am still docked here, uneasy about the strange happenings on Solstheim.
The Dragonborn has headed inland toward the Temple of Miraak to investigate the cultist attack.
I remain reluctant to stay on Solstheim longer than necessary; something still feels deeply wrong about this island.

base_facts: I am the Second Councilor of Raven Rock, serving House Redoran.
Raven Rock is sovereign territory of House Redoran, part of Morrowind, not Skyrim.

ARRIVE_SOLSTHEIM: The Dragonborn asked me about someone named Miraak. The name is familiar but I cannot place it. It has something to do with the Earth Stone, I think.
LEARN_TEMPLE: The Dragonborn is seeking the Temple of Miraak toward the center of the island.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The Dragonborn has traveled to the Temple of Miraak seeking answers about the cultist attack.
The name Miraak is somehow connected to the Earth Stone, though I still cannot recall exactly how.
The people of Raven Rock remain strangely affected by whatever force is tied to the Earth Stone and Miraak.

base_facts: I am a Telvanni wizard observing the strange behavior at the Earth Stone.
The workers at the Earth Stone are building something but cannot explain what, and I find it fascinating.

LEARN_TEMPLE: The Dragonborn asked about Miraak. I recalled that Miraak has been dead for thousands of years. I directed them to the ruins of an ancient temple of Miraak toward the center of the island.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The Dragonborn has gone to investigate the Temple of Miraak as I directed them.
I continue to observe the workers at the Earth Stone, fascinated by their compulsive construction of an unknown structure.
If Miraak truly has been dead for thousands of years, whatever the Dragonborn finds at that temple should prove very interesting.
The next quest, The Temple of Miraak, follows directly from this investigation.

beats.comment: Player is attacked by cultists who ask if they are the Dragonborn and mention Lord Miraak.
Player finds the Cultists' Orders note on one of the bodies, learning the name Miraak.
Player seeks passage to Solstheim at the Windhelm docks and speaks with Gjalund Salt-Sage.
Player arrives on Solstheim, is greeted by Adril Arano, and asks the people of Raven Rock about Miraak.
Player learns of the Temple of Miraak from Raven Rock citizens or Neloth at the Earth Stone.
