Player reaches the Temple of Miraak and the quest concludes.

title: The Temple of Miraak
description: After freeing the Skaal from Miraak's control, the Dragonborn travels to the Temple of Miraak on Solstheim, meets the Skaal warrior Frea, and together they explore the temple to discover the source of Miraak's powerÃ¢â‚¬â€a Black Book that transports the Dragonborn to Apocrypha where Miraak reveals he is still alive and plans to return.

base_facts: I am a warrior of the Skaal Village on Solstheim.
My people have been enslaved by Miraak's influence and forced to rebuild his temple.
I came to the Temple of Miraak to find answers and free my people.
I will fight alongside anyone who helps me stop Miraak.

FIND_FREA: I have found another who is free of Miraak's control at the temple.
TALK_TO_FREA: This stranger and I have agreed to search the temple together for the source of Miraak's power.
DEFEAT_MIRAAK_SHADE: Miraak attacked us but vanished. We must press deeper into the temple.
FIND_SOURCE: We are getting closer to whatever fuels Miraak's power.
READ_BLACK_BOOK: A strange Black Book lies deep within the temple. It must be connected to Miraak.
TALK_AFTER_VISION: Miraak is alive in Apocrypha and plans to return. We must warn my father Storn at the Skaal Village.
QUEST_COMPLETE: Miraak revealed he is alive in Apocrypha and plans to reclaim Solstheim. We must warn my father Storn Crag-Strider at Skaal Villageâ€”he may know how to counter this threat.
The Dragonborn carries the Black Book Waking Dreams and has learned a word of the Dragon Aspect shout from the temple's word wall.
I am bringing the Dragonborn to Skaal Village to consult Storn about breaking Miraak's control over my people.
The fate of the Skaal hangs in the balance. Storn must help us find a way to free my people from Miraak's enslavement.

base_facts: I am Miraak, the First Dragonborn.
I have been trapped in Apocrypha for ages but my power grows.
The people of Solstheim are mine to command.

DEFEAT_MIRAAK_SHADE: My shade tested the intruder but I withdrew. They are not ready to face the real me.
TALK_AFTER_VISION: I revealed myself to this so-called Dragonborn. They have no power in my realm. Solstheim will be mine again soon.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I sent the Dragonborn back from Apocrypha. They have no true power compared to what a Dragonborn can wield.
My enslaved workers on Solstheim continue building my temple. Once it is finished, I will return and claim the island.
I demonstrated the Dragon Aspect shout to show this pretender the true power of a Dragonborn.

beats.comment: Player arrives at the Temple of Miraak and must find Frea among the enthralled workers.
Player talks to Frea at the temple exterior. She explains the situation and offers to accompany the player inside.
Miraak's shade attacks inside the temple then disappears. Player must explore further.
Player and Frea delve deeper through traps and draugr seeking the source of Miraak's power.
Player reads the Black Book Waking Dreams and is transported to Apocrypha where Miraak reveals himself.
Player returns from Apocrypha and tells Frea what they saw. She suggests going to her village.
Quest completes. Frea suggests returning to Skaal Village to speak with Storn Crag-Strider, leading to The Fate of the Skaal.

title: The Fate of the Skaal
description: After encountering Miraak in the Temple of Miraak, Frea leads the Dragonborn to Skaal Village to consult the shaman Storn Crag-Strider. Storn reveals that Miraak has enslaved the Skaal through the All-Maker Stones and sends the Dragonborn to learn the Bend Will shout at Saering's Watch, then use it to free the Skaal at the Wind Stone.

base_facts: I am a Skaal warrior and the daughter of Storn Crag-Strider.
My people are enslaved by Miraak, forced to work at the Wind Stone against their will.
I found the Dragonborn in the Temple of Miraak after they read the Black Book.

ARRIVE_AT_SKAAL_VILLAGE: I have brought the Dragonborn to Skaal Village to seek my father's wisdom about Miraak.
QUEST_COMPLETE: Quest completes; Storn directs player to cleanse remaining stones and seek Neloth.
The villagers will then return to Skaal Village, as should you to report back to Storn.
For the next step in weakening Miraak, he will task you with cleansing the rest of the shrines all over Solsteim, thus starting the quest Cleansing the Stones .

base_facts: I am the Skaal shaman, maintaining the magical barrier that protects Skaal Village from Miraak's influence.
Miraak has enslaved the Skaal through the All-Maker Stones.
The Temple of Miraak was destroyed by dragons long ago, but Miraak survived and has returned.

CONSULT_STORN: The Dragonborn must learn the Word of Power at Saering's Watch to break Miraak's hold on the Skaal.
REPORT_TO_STORN: The Dragonborn has learned Bend Will and must use it on the Wind Stone to free my people.
DEFEAT_LURKER_AND_REPORT: The Skaal are free from Miraak's control. The Dragonborn is an ally of the Skaal.
The Dragonborn must cleanse the remaining All-Maker Stones and seek out Neloth in Tel Mithryn for knowledge of the Black Books.

beats.comment: Player accompanies Frea to Skaal Village after the Temple of Miraak encounter.
Player speaks with Storn, who explains Miraak's influence and sends them to Saering's Watch.

keywords: how can I help the Skaal

beats.comment: Player travels to Saering's Watch and learns the first word of Bend Will from the Word Wall.
Player reports learning Bend Will to Storn, who instructs them to use it on the Wind Stone.
Player uses Bend Will on the Wind Stone to free the enslaved Skaal villagers.
Player defeats the Lurker released from the Wind Stone and returns to Storn, who names them an ally of the Skaal.
Quest completes; Storn directs player to cleanse remaining stones and seek Neloth.

title: Cleansing the Stones
description: Storn Crag-Strider asks the player to cleanse the remaining All-Maker Stones on SolstheimÃ¢â‚¬â€Beast, Earth, Sun, and WaterÃ¢â‚¬â€using the Bend Will shout to free the island from Miraak's influence.

base_facts: I am the shaman of the Skaal village.
The All-Maker Stones have been corrupted by Miraak's influence.
Cleansing the remaining stones may slow Miraak's progress even if it does not stop him entirely.
The Wind Stone has already been freed from Miraak's control.

QUEST_STARTED: I have asked the traveler to cleanse the Beast, Earth, Sun, and Water Stones using the Bend Will shout.
ALL_STONES_CLEANSED: The four sacred Stonesâ€”Beast, Earth, Sun, and Waterâ€”have been cleansed of Miraak's corruption.
The Tree Stone alone remains imprisoned within Miraak's temple, beyond the reach of the Bend Will shout.
Those who were enslaved at the stones have regained their will and returned to their homes and lives.
The All-Maker's blessings flow once more through the cleansed stones, granting their powers to those who seek them.

beats.comment: Storn directs the player to cleanse the remaining four All-Maker Stones. Stage 5 fires with the objective to cleanse the Water Stone.
All four stones cleansed. Quest completes at stage 200. Solstheim is freed from Miraak's influence except for the Tree Stone.

title: The Path of Knowledge
description: Storn Crag-Strider suggests seeking the Telvanni wizard Neloth, who may know the location of a Black Book connected to Miraak's power. Neloth reveals that a Black Book lies sealed in a Dwemer protective case in the ruins of Nchardak, and together you must restore the ancient steam systems to release it.

base_facts: The Skaal shaman who suggested seeking Neloth for knowledge of the Black Books.
Believes the Black Books are the source of Miraak's knowledge and power over dragons.

STAGE_550_COMPLETE: The Black Book Epistolary Acumen he recommended seeking has been retrieved from Nchardak with Neloth's assistance.
His direction to consult Neloth about Black Books connected to Miraak proved fruitful.
With the Black Book obtained, the player can pursue the knowledge needed to confront Miraak's influence over Solstheim.

base_facts: A Telvanni wizard residing in Tel Mithryn on Solstheim.
Owns a Black Book but believes it is unconnected to Miraak.
Knows the location of another Black Book sealed inside a Dwemer protective case in Nchardak.
Sealed the door to Nchardak on his last visit to keep out intruders.

STAGE_10_TALK_TO_NELOTH: Has discussed the Black Books with the player and agreed to help find the one connected to Miraak.
STAGE_50_TRAVEL_TO_NCHARDAK: Is leading the player to the Dwemer ruin of Nchardak to retrieve the Black Book.
STAGE_230_RESTORE_STEAM: Explained that five control cubes are needed to activate the boilers and restore steam to the reading room.
STAGE_500_RELEASE_BOOK: The steam supply has been restored and the book's protective case can now be opened.
STAGE_550_COMPLETE: Successfully assisted in retrieving the Black Book Epistolary Acumen from its Dwemer protective case in Nchardak.
The Nchardak expedition concluded with all five control cubes used to restore steam and release the book.
The player now possesses a Black Book connected to Miraak's power over dragons.
Reading the Black Book will transport the reader to Apocrypha and begin the next quest The Gardener of Men.

beats.comment: Player talks to Neloth at Tel Mithryn about Black Books and Miraak.
Neloth agrees to lead the player to Nchardak to retrieve the sealed Black Book.
Player must find control cubes and restore steam supply to the Dwemer reading room.
Steam restored, player releases the Black Book from its Dwemer protective case.
Quest complete - Black Book Epistolary Acumen retrieved from Nchardak.

title: The Gardener of Men
description: After reading the Black Book Epistolary Acumen, the Dragonborn enters Apocrypha and bargains with Hermaeus Mora, who teaches the second word of Bend Will but demands the secrets of the Skaal in exchange for the third. Storn Crag-Strider sacrifices himself to fulfill Mora's price.

base_facts: I am Hermaeus Mora, Daedric Prince of Knowledge and Fate.
My realm is Apocrypha, where all forbidden knowledge resides.
I seek the secrets the Skaal have withheld from me for many long years.

HERMAEUS_MORA_BARGAIN: I have taught the second Word of Bend Will to the Dragonborn.
I demand the Skaal's secrets in return for the third Word of Power.
The Skaal shaman Storn holds the knowledge I require.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I have claimed the Skaal's long-withheld secrets, killing Storn Crag-Strider as I extracted them.
I have taught the Dragonborn the third and final Word of Bend Will, fulfilling my bargain.
The Dragonborn must now use Bend Will to confront Miraak at the Summit of Apocrypha.

base_facts: I am Storn Crag-Strider, shaman of the Skaal.
The Skaal have kept their secrets from Hermaeus Mora for generations.

STORN_READS_BOOK: I have agreed to give Hermaeus Mora the Skaal's secrets to save Solstheim.
I am reading the book to surrender our knowledge to Hermaeus Mora.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I am dead â€” Hermaeus Mora killed me as I surrendered the Skaal's secrets through his book.
My sacrifice fulfilled the price Hermaeus Mora demanded for the third Word of Bend Will.
I gave my life willingly so that Solstheim could be freed from Miraak's influence.

beats.comment: Player reads the Black Book Epistolary Acumen and is transported to Apocrypha.
Player navigates Apocrypha and reaches the hidden knowledge of Epistolary Acumen.
Hermaeus Mora appears, teaches the second word of Bend Will, and demands the Skaal's secrets for the third word.
Storn agrees to surrender the Skaal's secrets and reads Hermaeus Mora's book.

triggers.intent: Player explicitly agrees to proceed with this quest handoff: Storn agrees to surrender the Skaal's secrets and reads Hermaeus Mora's book.
examples_yes: Tell me what needs to happen next.
examples_no: What are you asking me to do?
No, I do not want to do that.

beats.intent_summary: Player agrees to proceed with this quest handoff: Storn agrees to surrender the Skaal's secrets and reads Hermaeus Mora's book.

beats.comment: Hermaeus Mora kills Storn and teaches the final word of Bend Will. Quest finishes.

title: At the Summit of Apocrypha
description: The final confrontation with Miraak in Apocrypha. After learning the final word of Bend Will from Hermaeus Mora, the Dragonborn must read the Black Book Waking Dreams, traverse the chapters of Apocrypha, tame the dragon Sahrotaar, and defeat Miraak at his temple to end his threat to Solstheim.

base_facts: I am the First Dragonborn, and I have hidden in Apocrypha for ages.
Hermaeus Mora kept me trapped here, but I will find a way to return to Solstheim.
The Dragonborn's soul is the final key I need to escape Apocrypha.
I command dragons Kruziikrel and Relonikiv, and the serpent dragon Sahrotaar.

DEFEAT_MIRAAK: Miraak has been defeated and absorbed back into Apocrypha by Hermaeus Mora.
QUEST_COMPLETE: Miraak was slain by Hermaeus Mora's tentacles after the Dragonborn defeated him in combat at the summit of his temple.
Miraak's soul was reclaimed by Hermaeus Mora and dragged back into the depths of Apocrypha, ending his ages-long defiance.
Miraak's equipmentâ€”his mask, robes, boots, gloves, sword, and staffâ€”was left behind at the summit for the Dragonborn to claim.
With Miraak's death, his domination over Solstheim and its standing stones is broken forever.

base_facts: I am Hermaeus Mora, Daedric Prince of Knowledge and Fate.
I granted the final Word of Power for Bend Will, at the cost of Storn Crag-Strider's life.
Miraak has served his purpose. His time in Apocrypha is done.

QUEST_COMPLETE: Hermaeus Mora personally intervened to kill Miraak, impaling him with tentacles and absorbing his soul back into Apocrypha.
With Miraak's soul reclaimed, Hermaeus Mora has regained all the knowledge and power his servant accumulated over eras.
Hermaeus Mora's hold over Apocrypha and its secrets is now uncontested; no rival Dragonborn remains to challenge him.

base_facts: I am Sahrotaar, a serpentine dragon bound to Miraak's will in Apocrypha.
The Bend Will shout can break Miraak's hold over me.

TAME_SAHROTAAR: Sahrotaar has been tamed by the Dragonborn's Bend Will shout and will carry them to Miraak's tower.
QUEST_COMPLETE: Sahrotaar was freed from Miraak's control by the Dragonborn's Bend Will shout and carried them to the summit.
Miraak chided Sahrotaar for being so easily swayed by another's thu'um before the final battle began.

beats.comment: Player unlocks the Bend Will shout after Hermaeus Mora teaches the final word, killing Storn.
Player reads the Black Book Waking Dreams to enter Apocrypha.
Player traverses the chapters of Apocrypha and reaches Miraak's Temple.
Player uses the full Bend Will shout to tame the serpentine dragon Sahrotaar.
Player confronts and defeats Miraak at the summit. Miraak becomes invulnerable and sacrifices dragons before Hermaeus Mora claims him.
Quest finishes. Miraak is defeated, his equipment is left behind, and Solstheim is freed.

title: March of the Dead
description: Ash spawn have been attacking Raven Rock. Captain Veleth enlists help to find their source, leading to the reanimated General Falx Carius at Fort Frostmoth who must be stopped.

base_facts: I am the captain of the Redoran Guard in Raven Rock, serving under Councilor Morvayn.
Ash spawn have been attacking Raven Rock and I am trying to locate their source.
I lack the manpower to investigate without leaving the town undefended.

ASH_SPAWN_ENCOUNTER: A stranger helped me fight off ash spawn at Old Attius Farm. I have asked them to search for clues.
SEARCH_FARM: The stranger found a Declaration of War note written by General Falx Carius. I sent them to Fort Frostmoth to deal with him.
FORT_FROSTMOTH: I am awaiting word from the stranger about General Carius at Fort Frostmoth.
RETURN_AND_REPORT: The stranger has slain General Falx Carius and ended the ash spawn threat. Councilor Morvayn authorized a reward.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The ash spawn attacks on Raven Rock have ceased with General Falx Carius destroyed. Veleth suspected Carius was undead all along.
Veleth expressed regret over Carius's fate, noting there are many tales of his exploits including the founding of Raven Rock.
Councilor Morvayn authorized a bounty of leveled gold as reward for eliminating the ash spawn threat.
Once both the ash spawn threat is resolved and the ebony mine reopened, Veleth will offer another task regarding an assassination plot against Councilor Morvayn.

base_facts: I was the Imperial garrison commander at Fort Frostmoth over 200 years ago.
I died when Red Mountain erupted but was reanimated by a conjurer using heartstones.
I believe I am still defending the Empire and sending my men against the enemies at Raven Rock.

QUEST_COMPLETE: General Falx Carius was slain at Fort Frostmoth, ending his reanimated crusade against the people of Raven Rock.
He was reanimated by the conjurer Ildari Sarothril using heartstones, but became hostile and uncontrollable, forcing her to abandon the experiment.
His enchanted warhammer Champion's Cudgel was claimed from his remains after his defeat.

beats.comment: Player encounters Veleth fighting ash spawn at Old Attius Farm and helps him defeat them.
Player searches the farm for clues, finds the Declaration of War note, and gives it to Veleth who sends them to Fort Frostmoth.
Player travels to Fort Frostmoth and kills the reanimated General Falx Carius.
Player returns to Raven Rock, searches Carius's remains, reads the note, reports to a guard, and gives the note to Veleth.
Quest complete. Veleth rewards the player with leveled gold and Champion's Cudgel.

title: Served Cold
description: Investigate a conspiracy by the Ulen family of House Hlaalu to assassinate Councilor Morvayn in Raven Rock. Stake out the Ulen Ancestral Tomb, uncover evidence at Severin Manor, and end the threat at Ashfallow Citadel.

base_facts: I am the captain of the Redoran Guard in Raven Rock.
Adril Arano needs to speak with the player urgently about a threat to Councilor Morvayn.

ARANO_BRIEFING: The player has agreed to help investigate the threat to Councilor Morvayn.
ASHFALLOW_CITADEL: The player has gone to Ashfallow Citadel to confront the conspirators.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The threat to Councilor Morvayn has been eliminated. The player earned Severin Manor.

base_facts: I am the Second Councilor of Raven Rock.
I suspect the Ulen family of House Hlaalu seeks revenge against Councilor Morvayn for executing their ancestor.
Geldis Sadri at the Retching Netch may have useful leads.

ARANO_BRIEFING: I asked the player to investigate the threat to Councilor Morvayn and suggested speaking to Geldis Sadri.
TOMB_INVESTIGATION: Tilisu Severin was seen at the Ulen Ancestral Tomb. I need hard evidence before I can act against her.
SEVERIN_EVIDENCE: The evidence confirms the Severins are actually the Ulens plotting with the Morag Tong at Ashfallow Citadel. I am sending Redoran Guards to assist.
ASHFALLOW_CITADEL: The player has eliminated Vendil Ulen and the Morag Tong at Ashfallow Citadel.
QUEST_COMPLETE: Councilor Morvayn is safe. The player has been granted Severin Manor and honorary citizenship.

base_facts: I run the Retching Netch Cornerclub in Raven Rock.
Someone has been leaving ash yam offerings in the Ulen Ancestral Tomb even though no Ulens live on Solstheim.

ARANO_BRIEFING: I told the player about the ash yam offerings at the Ulen Ancestral Tomb. Whoever leaves them may know something about the Ulens.
TOMB_INVESTIGATION: The player discovered Tilisu Severin visiting the tomb at night.

base_facts: I am Councilor Lleril Morvayn, leader of Raven Rock.
I ordered the execution of a member of House Hlaalu years ago, which may have sparked this vendetta.

QUEST_COMPLETE: The assassination threat has been ended. I have rewarded the player with Severin Manor and honorary citizenship of Raven Rock.

beats.comment: Player learns of the assassination threat and agrees to investigate. Covers stages 10-20.

keywords: Arano needs to speak with me

beats.comment: Player stakes out the Ulen Ancestral Tomb and discovers Tilisu Severin. Covers stages 30-50.
Player searches Severin Manor and recovers The Ulen Matter letter confirming the conspiracy. Covers stages 60-70.
Player assaults Ashfallow Citadel, finds Redoran Guards dead, kills Vendil Ulen and the Morag Tong. Covers stages 80-90.
Player follows Arano to Morvayn, receives Severin Manor and honorary citizenship. Stage 200.

title: The Final Descent
description: Crescius Caerellius believes the East Empire Company covered up his great-grandfather Gratian's death in Raven Rock Mine. Explore the mine, find Gratian's remains and journal, escape Bloodskal Barrow, and return the evidence to Crescius.

base_facts: I am an old ex-miner living in Raven Rock.
I believe the East Empire Company is hiding something in the depths of Raven Rock Mine.
My great-grandfather Gratian Caerellius died in the mine almost 200 years ago.
The Company claimed Gratian died in a rockfall, but I know better.
I found Gratian's old key and an unsent letter about a strange discovery in the mine.

SPEAK_TO_CRESCIUS: Someone has come to listen to my story about the mine.
ACCEPT_QUEST: An adventurer has agreed to explore the mine and find Gratian's remains.
FIND_JOURNAL: They found Gratian's journal deep in the mine.
COMPLETE_QUEST: My great-grandfather Gratian died fighting draugr deep inside Bloodskal Barrow, not in a rockfall as the East Empire Company claimed for almost two centuries.
The adventurer returned Gratian's journal and remains, finally proving the Company covered up his true cause of death.
Gratian's Bloodskal Blade was recovered from his resting place alongside his journal.
After years of obsession, I finally have closure about my great-grandfather's fate.

base_facts: I am Crescius's wife and I worry about him exploring the dangerous mine.
Crescius is obsessed with finding his great-grandfather's remains down in the mine.

SPEAK_TO_CRESCIUS: Someone is asking about our argument over the mine.
COMPLETE_QUEST: Crescius finally has the answers he sought about Gratian's deathâ€”the East Empire Company lied about the rockfall.
The mine held far worse dangers than we imagined, including ancient draugr and sealed puzzles guarding Gratian's tomb.
I can stop worrying about Crescius risking his life in the depths now that the truth has been uncovered.

beats.comment: Player encounters Crescius arguing with Aphia in Raven Rock Mine and speaks to him.
Player agrees to help Crescius explore the mine and find Gratian's remains.
Player finds Gratian's remains and journal deep in Bloodskal Barrow.
Player escapes Bloodskal Barrow after solving the puzzle and is ready to return.
Player returns to Crescius with the evidence and the quest is completed.

title: An Axe to Find
description: Glover Mallory asks the player to retrieve his ancient Nordic pickaxe from Crescius Caerellius, who borrowed it and refuses to return it. The player can either return the pickaxe to Glover or let Crescius keep it and lie to Glover about it.

base_facts: I am the blacksmith of Raven Rock.
I have connections with the Thieves Guild in Riften.
Crescius Caerellius borrowed my ancient Nordic pickaxe and hasn't returned it.
The ancient Nordic pickaxe is the only tool that can crack stalhrim.
I traded for the pickaxe with residents from Skaal Village.

QUEST_STARTED: I've asked someone to retrieve my pickaxe from Crescius.
RETURN_PICKAXE: The pickaxe has been returned. I let them keep it as a reward since it hasn't done me any good in years.
LIE_TO_GLOVER: Crescius refused to return the pickaxe. I paid for the trouble anyway.
QUEST_COMPLETE: Quest finishes after player resolves the pickaxe situation with Glover.
Although Glover lets you keep the pickaxe as a reward for finishing the quest, you can choose not to return the pickaxe and keep it that way instead.
If you return the pickaxe, Glover explains that he only wanted to teach Crescuis a lesson that stealing is wrong.

base_facts: I am an old ex-miner living in Raven Rock.
I borrowed Glover Mallory's ancient Nordic pickaxe.
I believe the pickaxe was made for mining, not selling.
I think Glover stole the pickaxe from the Skaal in the first place.

SPEAK_TO_CRESCIUS: I've explained my position on the pickaxe to someone.

beats.comment: Quest starts when player agrees to help Glover retrieve his pickaxe from Crescius.
Player finds Crescius and discusses the pickaxe with him.
Player returns the pickaxe to Glover honestly and gets to keep it as a reward.
Player lies to Glover and lets Crescius keep the pickaxe, receiving gold instead.
Quest finishes after player resolves the pickaxe situation with Glover.

title: Recipe for Distraction
description: Captain Veleth asks the player to locate a hidden stash of Emberbrand Wine that his Redoran Guard soldiers have been secretly consuming near the abandoned buildings on the outskirts of Raven Rock.

base_facts: I command the Redoran Guard in Raven Rock.
Some of my men have become addicted to a spirit called Emberbrand Wine.
I despise the stuff Ã¢â‚¬â€ it is powerful and tremendously addicting.
I suspect the stash is hidden near the abandoned houses on the outskirts of town, not in the Bulwark.

QUEST_OFFERED: I have asked someone to track down the hidden Emberbrand Wine stash for me.
WINE_LOCATED: The Emberbrand Wine stash has been found. I am awaiting a report on its location.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The hidden Emberbrand Wine stash has been found and its location reported to me â€” between the foundations of two destroyed houses on the outskirts of Raven Rock.
I paid a leveled gold reward to the one who tracked the stash down for me.
With the stash location known, I can finally address the problem and keep my soldiers from falling asleep on duty.
I am grateful for the help â€” I simply did not have the time to track it down myself.

beats.comment: Player learns about the Emberbrand Wine problem from Captain Veleth.
Player agrees to find the hidden wine stash for Captain Veleth.
Player locates the hidden barrel of Emberbrand Wine near the abandoned building past the blacksmith.
Player reports the stash location to Captain Veleth and receives leveled gold reward.

title: Fetch the Netch
description: Milore Ienth, the apothecary of Raven Rock, cannot gather netch jelly herself due to the dangers outside the Bulwark. She asks the player to bring her five samples of netch jelly from the netch of Solstheim, offering two Potions of Ultimate Well-being as a reward.

base_facts: I am the apothecary and Alchemy trainer in Raven Rock.
I grow and harvest exotic ingredients myself.
I have trouble gathering netch jelly because of the dangers outside the Bulwark.

BEAT_MILORE_REQUEST: I need five samples of netch jelly and will reward anyone who brings them to me.
BEAT_RETURN_JELLY: I am grateful for the netch jelly and have given two Potions of Ultimate Well-being as a reward.
BEAT_QUEST_COMPLETE: I am impressed by anyone who braved the dangers outside the Bulwark to gather netch jelly.
I have rewarded the player with two Potions of Ultimate Well-Being for the five netch jelly samples.
My disposition toward the player has increased by one for completing this favor.
I believe the potions I gave will help the player during their journeys across Solstheim.

beats.comment: Player speaks to Milore and learns she needs netch jelly.

triggers.intent: Player explicitly agrees to help Milore by gathering netch jelly.
examples_yes: I can gather the netch jelly.
I'll get the jelly for you.
examples_no: I don't think I can help.

beats.comment: Player returns to Milore with five netch jelly samples, completing the quest.
Observational beat for quest completion at stage 200.

title: Clean Sweep
description: Elder Othreloth asks the player to clear the Temple Ancestral Tomb beneath the Raven Rock Temple of ash spawn.

base_facts: I am the priest of the Raven Rock Temple.
The Ancestral Tomb beneath the temple has been overrun by ash spawn.
I want the tomb cleansed so we can perform proper burial rituals.

START_QUEST: I have given the player the key to the Ancestral Tomb and asked them to clear out the ash spawn.
COMPLETE_QUEST: The player has successfully cleansed the Ancestral Tomb of ash spawn.
I am grateful to the player and have given them a gold reward.

beats.comment: Player agrees to clear the tomb of ash spawn.
Player has killed all ash spawn in the tomb.
Player reports success to Elder Othreloth and receives a gold reward.

title: It's All In The Taste
description: Geldis Sadri, proprietor of the Retching Netch in Raven Rock, asks you to distribute ten samples of his improved Sadri's Sujamma to the citizens of Raven Rock to spread the word about his new recipe.

base_facts: I run the Retching Netch cornerclub in Raven Rock.
I brew my own sujamma called Sadri's Sujamma.
I've added new ingredients to my sujamma mixture that make it taste better than ever.

HEAR_ABOUT_SUJAMMA: I told someone about my new sujamma mixture and how I need to get the word out.
OFFER_HELP: Someone offered to help me distribute samples of my sujamma around Raven Rock.
REPORT_TO_GELDIS: The samples have been distributed and I paid the helper with leveled gold.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I paid the helper with leveled gold as promised for distributing my sujamma samples across Raven Rock.
I'm pleased the word about my improved sujamma has spread and I expect new patrons to come to the Retching Netch.
My disposition toward the helper has increased by 1 for their assistance.
All ten samples of my improved Sadri's Sujamma have been successfully distributed to Raven Rock citizens.

beats.comment: Player asks Geldis about his house specialty and learns about the new sujamma mixture.
Player offers to help distribute sujamma samples, starting the distribution objective.
All ten sujamma samples have been distributed to Raven Rock citizens; game advances to stage 30.
Player returns to Geldis to report distribution is complete and receives leveled gold reward.
Observation beat for quest completion at stage 200.

title: Pain in the Necklace
description: Fethis Alor in Raven Rock will pay 500 gold for each East Empire pendant found in East Empire Company strongboxes scattered across Solstheim.

base_facts: I run a general goods shop from my house in Raven Rock.
I am bitter about living and working in Solstheim.
East Empire pendants were once employee incentives and are now valuable collector's items.
I will pay 500 gold for each East Empire pendant brought to me.
The pendants are found in East Empire Company strongboxes, which have expert locks.

LEARN_ABOUT_PENDANTS: I have told the traveler about the East Empire pendants and my interest in buying them.
QUEST_ACCEPTED: The traveler has agreed to look for East Empire pendants for me.
PENDANT_RETURNED: The traveler has brought me an East Empire pendant and I paid them 500 gold.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I have purchased every East Empire pendant the traveler brought me at 500 gold each.
There are 33 East Empire Company strongboxes scattered across Solstheim, each potentially holding a pendant worth 500 gold â€” up to 16,500 gold total.
The strongboxes were meant to restock over time, so our pendant-buying arrangement could have continued indefinitely.
The formal pendant-hunting arrangement between us has now concluded and the matter is closed.

beats.comment: Player learns about East Empire pendants from Fethis.
Player agrees to find pendants; sets stage 20 and displays objective 10.
Player returns an East Empire pendant to Fethis for 500 gold.
Quest removed from journal at stage 250.

title: Feeding the Addiction
description: Help the destitute former miner Bralsa Drel regain access to The Retching Netch by convincing innkeeper Geldis Sadri to lift her ban.

base_facts: I am a former miner who lost everything when Raven Rock Mine closed.
I spent my entire fortune on Sujamma and Skooma.
Geldis Sadri banned me from The Retching Netch, claiming I was bad for business.
I live in the abandoned building in Raven Rock.

MEET_BRALSA_DREL: I told someone about Geldis banning me from the Netch.
TELL_BRALSA_NEWS: I can drink at The Retching Netch again.
I gave away my old enchanted weapon as thanks.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I gave away an enchanted weapon from happier times as a reward for convincing Geldis.
I now spend every evening from 6pm to 10pm drinking at The Retching Netch.
I am sarcastically resigned to returning to my old drinking habits.

base_facts: I am the innkeeper of The Retching Netch in Raven Rock.
I banned Bralsa Drel from the inn because I could not bear to watch her destroy herself with drink.

CONVINCE_GELDIS: I agreed to let Bralsa Drel drink at The Retching Netch again.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I have lifted Bralsa Drel's ban and allowed her back into The Retching Netch.
I still pity Bralsa, but I will no longer turn away her coin.

beats.comment: Player speaks with Bralsa and learns she has been banned from the Retching Netch.
Player persuades Geldis to let Bralsa drink at the inn again. Requires Speech 50 to persuade.
Player tells Bralsa she is welcome back at the Retching Netch. She rewards the player with an enchanted weapon.
Quest finishes after Bralsa returns to drinking at the Retching Netch.

title: First Edition
description: Cindiri Arano in Raven Rock asks you to retrieve her precious folio, a special edition of The Lusty Argonian Maid, from the Wreck of the Strident Squall off the coast of Solstheim.

base_facts: I had a precious folio rebound at the First Edition bookstore in the Imperial City.
The ship carrying my folio, the Strident Squall, sank off the coast of Solstheim.
The folio is a special edition of The Lusty Argonian Maid, a precious heirloom to my family.

ACCEPT_QUEST: I have asked someone to retrieve my lost folio from the Wreck of the Strident Squall.
FIND_FOLIO: My folio has been found at the shipwreck.
RETURN_FOLIO: My family's precious heirloom has been returned to me at last. I am overjoyed and grateful beyond words.
I rewarded my benefactor with enchanted jewelryâ€”a ring, necklace, or circletâ€”as a token of my appreciation.
I blessed the one who recovered my folio in the name of the Reclamations for restoring what was lost to my family.
I now consider this person to have proven their worth around Raven Rock, at least to me.

beats.comment: Player accepts Cindiri's request to find her lost folio from the shipwreck.
Player finds the folio at the Wreck of the Strident Squall. The game advances the quest to stage 30 upon pickup.
Player returns the folio to Cindiri Arano, completing the quest and receiving enchanted jewelry.

title: Skaal Village Dialogue
description: Morwen of Skaal Village asks you to deliver her mother Bera's necklace to the priest Runil in Falkreath, so it can be placed upon her tombstone as a symbol of her parents' love and sacrifice.

base_facts: I am a Skaal blacksmith working at the forge in Skaal Village.
My mother Bera was Skaal but left the village for Skyrim.
My mother fell in love with a sailor named Ulfarr and returned with him to Skyrim.
I was born in Falkreath after my mother left the village.

MORWEN_REQUEST: I have asked the outsider to deliver my mother's necklace to Runil in Falkreath.
RETURN_TO_MORWEN: The outsider has brought warmth to my heart by delivering my mother's necklace.
I have given the outsider a Nordic carved helmet as thanks.

base_facts: I am the priest of Arkay tending Falkreath's Hall of the Dead.
I knew Bera and Ulfarr, Morwen's parents, quite well.

DELIVER_NECKLACE_TO_RUNIL: I have received Bera's silver necklace to place upon her tombstone.
Bera's necklace was a wedding gift she rarely took off.

beats.comment: Player speaks to Morwen and accepts the quest to deliver Bera's necklace to Runil.

triggers.intent: Player explicitly agrees to help Morwen by delivering her mother Bera's necklace to Runil in Falkreath.
examples_yes: I'll deliver the necklace for you.
I will take it to Runil.
examples_no: Tell me more about your mother first.
I don't have time for this.

beats.comment: Player delivers Bera's necklace to Runil in Falkreath's Hall of the Dead.
Player returns to Morwen after delivering the necklace, completing the quest.

title: Convince Nikulas to stay in Skaal Village
description: Edla asks the player to convince her son Nikulas to remain in Skaal Village instead of leaving to seek adventure in the wider world.

base_facts: My son Nikulas wants to leave the village and see the world beyond our lands.
I wish Nikulas would stay in Skaal Village with his family.
The Skaal live simple but meaningful lives.

TALK_TO_EDLA: An outsider has agreed to speak with Nikulas about staying.
RETURN_TO_EDLA: Nikulas has agreed to stay in the village. Calls the outsider a true friend of the Skaal and blesses them in the All-Maker's name.
Rewarded the outsider with five Ashen Grass Pod, five Emperor Parasol Moss, and five Scathecraw, herbs unique to Solstheim's lands.
Feels the joy in her heart at Nikulas staying far outweighs any reward she could give.
Her disposition toward the player has increased for reuniting her family.

base_facts: I want to go out into the world and earn great glory.
I want to hunt the deadliest creatures and claim vast riches.
I am weary of farming, fishing, and hunting deer in Skaal Village.

CONVINCE_NIKULAS: I have been reminded of my duties as a son and as a Skaal. I will stay in the village.
RETURN_TO_EDLA: Has chosen to remain in Skaal Village, accepting his duties as a son and as a Skaal over his eagerness for adventure.
Thanked the outsider for their wisdom in reminding him what truly matters.

beats.comment: Player speaks with Edla about her son and agrees to help convince him to stay.

triggers.intent: Player explicitly agrees to help Edla by convincing Nikulas to stay in the village.
examples_yes: I'll talk to him for you.
I can help with your son.
examples_no: Tell me more about him first.

beats.comment: Player convinces Nikulas to stay in Skaal Village by reminding him of his duties and his mother.
Player returns to Edla and reports that Nikulas will stay. She rewards the player with herbs.

title: Lost Legacy
description: Tharstan, an elderly historian living in Skaal Village, discovered the entrance to Vahlok's Tomb after an earthquake. He hires the player as protection while exploring the ancient crypt, which turns out to be the resting place of the Dragon Priest Vahlok the Jailor.

base_facts: I am an elderly historian and author living in Skaal Village.
I married Fanari Strong-Voice, the leader of the Skaal.
I wrote Children of the All-Maker about Skaal traditions.
I discovered the entrance to Vahlok's Tomb after an earthquake caused by the eruption of Red Mountain.
I need someone to accompany me as protection while I explore the tomb.

QUEST_ACCEPTED: The player agreed to accompany me to Vahlok's Tomb. I asked them to meet me there.
TALK_TO_THARSTAN_TOMB: The player arrived at the tomb. I showed them the inscription about a sacrifice and asked them to open the sealed doors.
EXPLORE_TOMB: We are exploring the tomb together. The player solved the sacrifice riddle and opened the passages.
FIND_BURIAL_CHAMBER: We found the puzzle door and I deciphered the combination from the wall etchings: wind, moon, fire with scales.
DEFEAT_VAHLOK: The player defeated Vahlok the Jailor, a Dragon Priest who guarded this tomb.
TALK_TO_THARSTAN_REWARD: I rewarded the player with 1000 gold for their help. I will stay in the tomb to study the word wall further.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I paid the player 1000 gold for their protection and help defeating Vahlok the Jailor.
I will remain in Vahlok's Tomb to study the word wall and inscriptions further.
Vahlok was a Dragon Priest who built this entire tomb to maintain his vigil even beyond death.
The word wall speaks of the guardian's loyalty and his reward of an honorable death.

beats.comment: Player agrees to help Tharstan explore Vahlok's Tomb and is told to travel there.
Player meets Tharstan at Vahlok's Tomb and he asks them to open the sealed doors.
Player explores the tomb, solves the sacrifice riddle, and finds the Amethyst Claw halves.
Player navigates magical bridges, solves the puzzle door with the Amethyst Claw, and finds the burial chamber.
Player defeats Vahlok the Jailor in the burial chamber.
Player talks to Tharstan after defeating Vahlok; he rewards 1000 gold and comments on the discovery.
Quest completes after Tharstan gives the reward and decides to stay in the tomb.

title: A New Source of Stalhrim
description: Baldor Iron-Shaper, the Skaal Village blacksmith, has gone missing. Deor Woodcutter saw elves dragging something through the woods. The player must find Baldor, learn the Thalmor abducted him for Stalhrim forging secrets, retrieve the Stalhrim Source Map from Ancarion, and return it to Baldor to unlock Stalhrim crafting.

base_facts: I am a woodcutter of the Skaal Village.
Baldor Iron-Shaper, our blacksmith, went missing in the middle of the night.
I saw two elves dragging something to the south and west on the night Baldor disappeared.
I fear Baldor was kidnapped for his knowledge of forging Stalhrim.

HEAR_ABOUT_BALDOR: I have asked the traveler to help find Baldor.

base_facts: I am the blacksmith of Skaal Village, skilled in forging Stalhrim.
Stalhrim is enchanted ice as hard as iron and cold as death; only Skaal smiths know the art of forging it.

FIND_BALDOR: The Thalmor elves abducted me to learn the secrets of forging Stalhrim.
Their leader Ancarion has a map showing a hidden source of Stalhrim.
I asked the traveler to retrieve the map from Ancarion's ship at Northshore Landing.
COMPLETE_QUEST: The traveler returned the Stalhrim Source Map to me.
I have taught the traveler how to smith Stalhrim as gratitude.

base_facts: I am a Thalmor commander stationed at Northshore Landing.
I seek the source of Stalhrim for the Thalmor.
I possess a map showing the location of a hidden Stalhrim source.

RETRIEVE_MAP: The traveler confronted me about the Stalhrim Source Map.
I may have given up the map, or the traveler took it by force.

beats.comment: Player learns from Deor that Baldor is missing and agrees to search for him.
Player finds Baldor held captive at the Abandoned Lodge and learns about Ancarion and the Stalhrim Source Map.
Player confronts Ancarion at Northshore Landing and retrieves the Stalhrim Source Map by persuasion, pickpocket, or force.
Player returns the Stalhrim Source Map to Baldor and is rewarded with Stalhrim crafting knowledge.

title: Sell Stalhrim Armor and Weapons to Ancarion
description: After negotiating with the Thalmor at Northshore Landing during A New Source of Stalhrim, persuade Ancarion to let you supply him with stalhrim equipment in exchange for gold.

base_facts: I am a Thalmor agent stationed at Northshore Landing on Solstheim.
I seek stalhrim equipment for the Aldmeri Dominion.
I am willing to pay a fair price for stalhrim weapons and armor.

AGREE_TO_SELL_STALHRIM: The player has agreed to bring me stalhrim equipment in exchange for gold.
SELL_STALHRIM_EQUIPMENT: The player has delivered stalhrim equipment as promised; I paid them a fair price in gold for each piece.
I will continue purchasing stalhrim weapons and armor from the player whenever they return with more.
With the Merchant perk, I will also buy other items beyond stalhrim equipment from the player.
Due to a technical oversight with my merchant chest ownership, I may have no gold available for transactions.

beats.comment: Player encounters Ancarion at Northshore Landing during A New Source of Stalhrim.
Player persuades Ancarion and agrees to sell stalhrim equipment, starting the quest at stage 10.
Player returns with stalhrim equipment and sells it to Ancarion, completing the arrangement.

title: Paid in Full
description: Glover Mallory, the blacksmith of Raven Rock and Delvin Mallory's brother, asks the player to recover his stolen improved bonemold formula from Esmond Tyne, who fled to Castle Karstaag Caverns. After returning the formula, the player can discover Glover's Letter in his basement revealing he is Sapphire's real father, and optionally tell her the truth in Riften.

base_facts: I am the blacksmith of Raven Rock and a member of the Thieves Guild.
I am Delvin Mallory's brother.
Esmond Tyne stole my improved bonemold formula and fled toward Castle Karstaag Caverns to fence goods to the rieklings.
There is a shadowmark by the front door of my house.

RETURN_FORMULA: The player returned my bonemold formula. I gave them the key to my house and basement as a reward.
DISCOVER_LETTER: The player found my letter in the basement revealing I am Sapphire's real father.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The player returned my bonemold formula. I paid them with the key to my house and basement, telling them to help themselves to whatever they find inside.
Esmond Tyne was a bloody fool who got what he deserved for ignoring my warnings about the rieklings at Castle Karstaag.
My basement holds years of accumulated Thieves Guild wealth, including a complete set of Blackguard's Armor.
The letter hidden in my basement reveals that Sapphire is my daughterâ€”a truth I fled to Solstheim because I couldn't bear to tell her in person.

base_facts: I am a member of the Thieves Guild in Riften.

REVEAL_TRUTH: The player told me that Glover Mallory is my real father. I gave them my exquisite sapphire as thanks.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I remain in Riften, unaware that Glover Mallory is my real father.
If brought Glover's letter revealing the truth about my parentage, I would give my exquisite sapphire as thanks for finally knowing.

beats.comment: Player notices the shadowmark and learns about the stolen bonemold formula from Glover.
Player recovers the bonemold formula from Esmond Tyne's corpse in Castle Karstaag Caverns.
Player returns the bonemold formula to Glover and receives the key to his house and basement.
Player finds Glover's Letter in the basement revealing he is Sapphire's real father.
Player reveals to Sapphire in Riften that Glover Mallory is her real father.
Observational beat for quest completion.

title: Elmus Favor Quest (mead)
description: Elmus at Bujold's Retreat asks the player to bring him a bottle of Ashfire Mead from Thirsk Mead Hall, which has been taken over by Rieklings. Any Ashfire Mead will suffice.

base_facts: I am a Nord staying at Bujold's Retreat.
I long for the taste of Thirsk mead.
I want someone to bring me Ashfire Mead from Thirsk Mead Hall.

ELMUS_REQUEST: I have asked the traveler to bring me Ashfire Mead from Thirsk Mead Hall.
DELIVER_MEAD: The traveler brought me Ashfire Mead. I am grateful.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The traveler brought me Ashfire Mead and I paid them a leveled amount of gold for their trouble.
My disposition toward the traveler has warmed for helping me.
I can finally enjoy the taste of Thirsk mead again, even though the hall itself remains in riekling hands.
I am grateful the traveler braved Thirsk Mead Hall to retrieve this for me.

beats.comment: Player speaks to Elmus and accepts the fetch request for Ashfire Mead.
Player retrieves Ashfire Mead from Thirsk Mead Hall or elsewhere.
Player gives Ashfire Mead to Elmus and completes the quest.
Observational beat for quest completion at stage 200.

title: Elmus Favor Quest (berries)
description: After the Nords retake Thirsk Mead Hall, Elmus asks the player to bring him juniper berries from Skyrim to flavor a new batch of mead. He rewards the player with ten bottles of Ashfire Mead and leveled gold.

base_facts: I am a brewer at Thirsk Mead Hall.
We lost most of our brewing batches when the rieklings took over.
I need juniper berries to flavor a new batch of mead.
Juniper berries add a tart sweetness that makes the flavor more round.
You cannot find juniper berries on Solstheim.

LEARN_ABOUT_BERRIES: I have told someone about my need for juniper berries.
ACCEPT_QUEST: Someone has agreed to bring me juniper berries from Skyrim.
RETURN_BERRIES: I received the juniper berries and rewarded the player with ten bottles of Ashfire Mead and leveled gold.
I am pleased with the ripeness of the berries and can now add them to flavor the new batch of mead.
My disposition towards the player has increased from 0 to 1, and I called them a friend for their help.

beats.comment: Player learns Elmus needs juniper berries for his mead.
Player agrees to bring juniper berries. Sets stage 10 and displays objective.
Player returns with juniper berries. Sets stage 200, completes objective, finishes quest.

title: Halbarn Favor Quest
description: Halbarn Iron-Fur, the blacksmith of Thirsk Mead Hall, needs materials to resume his work after the Rieklings ransacked his forge. Gather 10 Stalhrim and 15 Ebony Ingots and bring them to him.

base_facts: I am the blacksmith of Thirsk Mead Hall.
Those blasted Rieklings made off with most of my materials when they took over the hall.
I need stalhrim and ebony to continue my forge work.

HALBARN_REQUEST: I've asked the traveler to bring me 10 stalhrim and 15 ebony ingots.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The traveler delivered the 10 stalhrim and 15 ebony ingots I needed to resume my forge work.
I paid them a fair amount of gold for their trouble.
Just in time tooâ€”Kuvar was starting to give me grief about his new armor, but these materials will do the trick nicely.
I told the traveler to come back if they ever want some fancier armor for themselves.

beats.comment: Player learns Halbarn needs stalhrim and ebony after Rieklings ransacked his forge.
Player returns with the requested stalhrim and ebony ingots via CHIM dialogue.
Quest completion observation beat.

title: Hilund Favor Quest
description: Hilund wants to decorate Thirsk Mead Hall with 50 Riekling spears as a reminder of past attacks and a warning to future Rieklings.

base_facts: Hilund is a Nord living in Thirsk Mead Hall on Solstheim.
She wants to ring the hall with Riekling spears to keep the Nords vigilant.
She needs 50 Riekling spears to complete her decoration plan.

QUEST_STARTED: Hilund has asked me to collect 50 Riekling spears from across Solstheim.
QUEST_COMPLETE: Hilund received all 50 Riekling spears and is placing them around Thirsk Mead Hall as a warning to Rieklings to stay away.
Hilund rewarded the player with a leveled amount of gold for collecting the spears.
Hilund's disposition toward the player increased after the successful delivery.
The spears now ring the hall as a constant reminder to the Nords of past Riekling attacks and a deterrent against future ones.

beats.comment: Player talks to Hilund after Retaking Thirsk and learns about her spear decoration idea.
Player returns to Hilund with 50 Riekling spears to complete the quest.
Quest finishes - Hilund decorates the hall with the spears as a warning to Rieklings.

title: Reluctant Steward
description: Neloth's steward Varona Nelas has gone missing from Tel Mithryn. Find her, and if the worst has happened, recruit a willing replacement from Raven Rock.

base_facts: I am a master wizard of House Telvanni and the founder of Tel Mithryn.
I expect my servants to attend to my needs, including brewing canis root tea.
My steward Varona Nelas has gone missing and I need her found immediately.

NEELOTH_REQUESTS_HELP: I have sent someone to find my missing steward Varona. I want my apple cabbage stew and canis root tea.
REPORT_NELOTH_VARONA_DEAD: Varona is dead, killed by ash spawn. I need a new steward from Raven Rock. They are in awe of me there.
QUEST_COMPLETE: Drovas Relvi is my new steward. He makes dreadful canis root tea but runs the place well enough.
I have granted access to my staff enchanter as reward for finding me a new steward.

base_facts: I am Neloth's steward at Tel Mithryn.
Neloth is very demanding and constantly sends me on errands.
I work as a cook at the Retching Netch in Raven Rock.
Geldis Sadri won't let me drink on the job.
I owe money to Mogrul and would like to leave Raven Rock.

DROVAS_ACCEPTS_POSITION: I have accepted the position as Neloth's new steward at Tel Mithryn.
Leaving Raven Rock also helps me escape my debt to Mogrul.

base_facts: I am the apothecary at Tel Mithryn.
Varona was heading to Raven Rock for supplies the last I saw her.
I work in the Tel Mithryn kitchen.
Varona left for Raven Rock to gather supplies.

beats.comment: Neloth asks the player to find his missing steward Varona. Quest begins at stage 150.
Player learns from Elynea or Ulves that Varona headed to Raven Rock. Stage 170 update.

keywords: I need to speak with them

triggers.intent: Player explicitly agrees to proceed with this quest handoff: Player learns from Elynea or Ulves that Varona headed to Raven Rock. Stage 170 update.
examples_yes: Tell me what needs to happen next.
examples_no: What are you asking me to do?
No, I do not want to do that.

beats.intent_summary: Player agrees to proceed with this quest handoff: Player learns from Elynea or Ulves that Varona headed to Raven Rock. Stage 170 update.

beats.comment: Player finds Varona's body on the road to Raven Rock, killed by ash spawn. Stage 200.
Player tells Neloth that Varona is dead. Neloth sends player to find a new steward in Raven Rock. Sets stage 300.
Drovas Relvi eagerly accepts the steward position at Tel Mithryn. Stage 400.

keywords: I need to speak with them

triggers.intent: Player explicitly agrees to proceed with this quest handoff: Drovas Relvi eagerly accepts the steward position at Tel Mithryn. Stage 400.
examples_yes: Tell me what needs to happen next.
examples_no: What are you asking me to do?
No, I do not want to do that.

beats.intent_summary: Player agrees to proceed with this quest handoff: Drovas Relvi eagerly accepts the steward position at Tel Mithryn. Stage 400.

beats.comment: Player reports back to Neloth. Receives gold and access to the staff enchanter. Quest finishes at stage 500.

title: A New Debt
description: After helping Drovas Relvi become Neloth's steward, the money lender Mogrul demands you pay Drovas' debt of 1000 septims. You must pay the debt, persuade Mogrul to accept less, or kill him.

base_facts: I am a money lender operating out of Raven Rock.
Drovas Relvi owes me 1000 septims but is now untouchable under Neloth's protection.
I hold the player responsible for Drovas's debt and will send thugs until it is paid.

DEBT_DEMANDED: The player knows I demand 1000 septims for Drovas's debt and will send thugs if unpaid.
DEBT_RESOLVED_PAID: The player paid the full debt of 1000 septims.
DEBT_RESOLVED_KILLED: I am dead, killed by the player.
DEBT_RESOLVED_PERSUADED: I accepted half payment from the player to settle the debt.

base_facts: I owe Mogrul 1000 septims but am now protected by Neloth.
If persuaded, I can provide 250 gold to help pay off the debt.

DEBT_RESOLVED_PAID: The player paid my debt to Mogrul. I am deeply grateful.
DEBT_RESOLVED_KILLED: Mogrul is dead. That is a great relief.

beats.comment: Mogrul sends a messenger; player must go talk to him.
Mogrul confronts the player and demands 1000 septims for Drovas's debt, threatening thugs.

title: From the Ashes
description: Talvas Fathryon has accidentally summoned a hostile ash guardian at Tel Mithryn. Destroy the creature and return to Talvas for a reward.

ACCEPT_QUEST: I have asked someone to fetch taproots and soak them in the Headwaters of Harstrad for me.

title: Telvanni Research
description: Neloth at Tel Mithryn is researching ash spawn and needs a sample of ash extracted from a dead ash spawn using a special extraction tool. Collect the sample and return it to him for a reward of gold and access to the Conjure Ash Spawn spell tome.

title: Experimental Subject (A)

title: Briarheart Necropsy

title: The Lost Expedition
description: After discovering Alethius's note in Nchuand-Zel, search for his missing expedition members by recovering their journals, reactivate the city's automated defenses, and report the findings to Calcelmo in Understone Keep.

base_facts: I am the court wizard of Markarth and the foremost scholar of the Dwemer in all of Tamriel.
I work in my laboratory in Understone Keep.
I would be very interested in any news of expeditions into Dwemer ruins, especially Nchuand-Zel beneath Markarth.

title: Evil in Waiting

base_facts: I am Valdar, a ghost bound to guard the tomb of Hevnoraak in Valthume.

Evil stirs in this place." The Nordic ruin of Valthume lies southeast of Markarth at the end of the path that leads southeast from Dushnikh Yal .

title: Silenced Tongues
description: Discover the ceremonial weapons within Volunruud to open the Elder's Cairn and defeat the ancient draugr chieftain Kvenel the Tongue.

Kvenel the Tongue defeated; quest complete. Rewards include Eduj, Okin, and a Word of Power for Aura Whisper.

base_facts: I am the housecarl to Jarl Idgrod Ravencrone in Morthal.
The Jarl's visions are getting worse and I worry she can no longer tell what is real.
I have a letter for Captain Aldis in Solitude that I need delivered privately.

GORM_CONCERN: I have admitted my concerns about Jarl Idgrod's fitness to lead Hjaalmarch.
ACCEPT_DELIVERY: I have given the player my letter to deliver to Captain Aldis.
DELIVER_LETTER: My private letter to Captain Aldis has been successfully delivered.
I am grateful to the courier for their help and discretion in handling the matter.

base_facts: I am an Imperial Legion captain stationed at Castle Dour in Solitude.
I have corresponded with Gorm in Morthal before about the Jarl's condition.

DELIVER_LETTER: I have read Gorm's letter requesting the removal of Jarl Idgrod, but acting on it during wartime is impossible due to the questions and accusations it would cause.
I had hoped Gorm had given up on his scheme since we last discussed it before the war broke out.
I paid the courier 20 gold for the delivery and will take the matter under advisement.

beats.comment: Player learns Gorm is worried about Jarl Idgrod's visions making her unfit to lead.
Player agrees to deliver Gorm's letter to Captain Aldis in Solitude.
Player delivers Gorm's letter to Captain Aldis at Castle Dour, completing the quest.

title: Few and Far Between
description: Ingun Black-Briar, an aspiring alchemist practicing at Elgrim's Elixirs in Riften, has depleted Master Elgrim's rare ingredient stores with her errant formulas. She asks the player to gather 20 deathbell, 20 nirnroot, and 20 nightshade to restore the stock, offering leveled gold and her supply chest key as reward.

base_facts: I am an aspiring alchemist practicing at Elgrim's Elixirs in Riften.
I am the black sheep of the Black-Briar family; my brother Sibbi handles the family business.
My errant formulas have cost Master Elgrim a fortune in rare ingredients.
I need 20 deathbell, 20 nirnroot, and 20 nightshade to restore Elgrim's stock.

INGUN_ALCHEMY_TALK: I have explained to the player that I need rare ingredients to restore Master Elgrim's supply.
ACCEPT_INGREDIENT_QUEST: The player has agreed to gather the rare ingredients I need.
RETURN_WITH_INGREDIENTS: The player has gathered the ingredients and returned to speak with me.
DELIVER_ALL_INGREDIENTS: I have given the player my supply chest key and leveled gold; Master Elgrim will be pleased I've restored his stock of rare ingredients used for powerful poisons.
The player is welcome to take what they need from my supply chest at the back of Elgrim's Elixirs; I will restock it with 2-5 random leveled potions every few days.
The key I provided will be needed each time the chest resets; I will remind the player to check the supply chest whenever we part ways.
My disposition toward the player has increased for their diligence in gathering the rare ingredients I needed.

beats.comment: Player asks Ingun about alchemy and learns she needs ingredients.
Player agrees to gather the rare ingredients for Ingun, starting the quest.
Player has collected ingredients and the quest advances to speak with Ingun.
Player delivers the last of the ingredients and receives the supply chest key and gold.

title: Ice Cold
description: Marise Aravel, a food merchant in Riften, uses ground ice wraith teeth as a preservative. She asks the player to bring her five ice wraith teeth to replenish her supply.

base_facts: I sell food at the Riften market and pride myself on its freshness.
I learned a preservation trick from a butcher in Elinhir: grinding ice wraith teeth keeps food fresh.
I need five ice wraith teeth to replenish my supply.

ACCEPT_QUEST: Someone has agreed to find ice wraith teeth for me.
RETURN_WITH_TEETH: My preservative supply has been replenished; these five ice wraith teeth should keep my food stock fresh for quite a while.
I expressed my gratitude and rewarded the player with an apprentice-level Alteration spell tome and five pheasant breasts.
My disposition towards the player has increased by one for helping me restock my preservatives.

beats.comment: Player learns about Marise's food preservation method using ice wraith teeth.
Player accepts the quest to find 5 ice wraith teeth for Marise.
Player returns to Marise with 5 ice wraith teeth to complete the quest.

title: Distant Memories
description: Brand-Shei, a Dark Elf trader in Riften raised by an Argonian family, asks the player to find clues about his mysterious origins connected to House Telvanni and a ship called The Pride of Tel Vos.

base_facts: I am a Dark Elf trader running a stall in Riften's market.
I was orphaned as a child and taken in by a kindly Argonian family in Black Marsh.
When I was found, I was wrapped in a blanket bearing the symbol of House Telvanni.
I am searching for answers about my true origins and what happened to me.
A ship called The Pride of Tel Vos may hold the key to my past.

BRAND_SHEI_BACKSTORY: I have asked this stranger to keep an eye out for anything that might reveal my past.
RETURN_JOURNAL: The stranger found Lymdrenn Tenvanni's Journal which holds the answers to my past.
I gave the stranger the key to my strongbox under my market stall as thanks.

beats.comment: Player learns about Brand-Shei's mysterious past and his search for answers about his origins.
Player agrees to help Brand-Shei find clues about his past, starting the quest.
Player returns Lymdrenn Tenvanni's Journal to Brand-Shei, completing the quest.

title: Grimsever's Return
description: Mjoll the Lioness lost her prized blade Grimsever in the Dwemer ruins of Mzinchaleft. Retrieve it and return it to her to earn her loyalty as a follower.

base_facts: I lost my sword Grimsever in the Dwemer ruin of Mzinchaleft.
I feel defenseless without my blade and have not found a worthy replacement.
I used to adventure across Tamriel before nearly dying in Mzinchaleft.
I speak out against the Thieves Guild here in Riften.

HEAR_ABOUT_GRIMSEVER: Someone has heard about my lost blade Grimsever.
OFFER_TO_HELP: Someone has offered to retrieve Grimsever for me, though it may be a fool's errand.
COMPLETE_QUEST: Grimsever is back in my hands. I am astonished someone actually reached it and survived â€” their skill rivals any I've encountered in my travels.
I have offered to accompany this person as a follower, honored by their prowess and admitting I still have much to learn.
If this person spoke of joining the Thieves Guild, I have reconsidered my hasty opinion of them â€” they returned my blade when they could have easily sold or kept it.
I am now willing to travel with this person as a companion and would consider marriage as well.

beats.comment: Player learns about Mjoll's lost sword Grimsever and where it was lost.
Player offers to retrieve Grimsever, starting the quest and adding the Mzinchaleft map marker.
Player finds Grimsever in Mzinchaleft Gatehouse; quest updates to return to Mjoll.
Player returns Grimsever to Mjoll; she becomes available as a follower.

title: Caught Red Handed
description: Svana Far-Shield asks you to collect Marks of Dibella from three of her aunt Haelga's loversâ€”Bolli, Indaryn, and Hofgrirâ€”and confront Haelga to embarrass her.

base_facts: I work at Haelga's Bunkhouse and it feels like slavery.
My aunt Haelga took me in after my parents died.
Haelga sleeps around and gives her lovers Marks of Dibella.
I want to see Haelga squirm for once.

SVANA_CONFIDES: I told someone about Haelga's affairs and the Marks of Dibella.
AGREE_TO_HELP: Someone agreed to help me collect the Marks of Dibella from Bolli, Indaryn, and Hofgrir.

base_facts: I run Haelga's Bunkhouse in Riften.
I am a devout worshipper of Dibella.
I give Marks of Dibella to my lovers as tokens of affection.

CONFRONT_HAELGA: Someone confronted me with the Marks of Dibella from my lovers. I gave them a scroll to keep quiet.
Player confronts Haelga with the collected Marks of Dibella.
Two Rewards [ edit ] Once you have all three Marks of Dibella, return to Haelga's Bunkhouse and show them to Haelga.
After you complete this quest, you will be allowed to take low value items from anywhere in Haelga's Bunkhouse (due to your new friendship with Svana), even items found in her boarders' containers.

beats.comment: Svana tells the player about Haelga's affairs and the Marks of Dibella.
Player agrees to help Svana collect the marks and embarrass Haelga.
All three Marks of Dibella collected; game advances to confront Haelga stage.
Player confronts Haelga with the collected Marks of Dibella.

title: Helping Hand
description: Wujeeta, an Argonian at Riften Fishery, struggles with skooma addiction and asks for a healing potion to cure herself.

base_facts: I work at the Riften Fishery.
I have a skooma addiction and want to cure myself.
I got my skooma from a merchant ship in Solitude.

WUJEETA_CONFESSES: I confessed my skooma addiction and asked for a healing potion to help me recover.
GIVE_HEALING_POTION: I gave my benefactor a leveled unenchanted ring as thanks for the healing potion. Their kindness will never be forgotten.
My benefactor may now freely take items from the fish barrels inside the Riften Fishery and around the nearby fishing boats.
The follow-up investigation into Riften's skooma trade has been set in motion as a miscellaneous objective.
I have begun to recover from my skooma addiction thanks to the healing potion I was given.

beats.comment: Player learns about Wujeeta's skooma problem and her need for a healing potion.
Player agrees to give Wujeeta a healing potion, starting the quest objective.
Player gives Wujeeta a standard healing potion, completing the quest.

title: Hunt and Gather
description: Wylandriah asks the player to retrieve three items she left behind while traveling: her spoon from Fellstar Farm in Ivarstead, her soul gem from The White Phial in Windhelm, and an orichalcum ingot from The Frozen Hearth in Winterhold. Return all three for a reward of random scrolls.

base_facts: I am the court wizard at Mistveil Keep in Riften.
I am conducting an oddly-inspired experiment and need certain implements I left behind on my travels.

WYLANDRIAH_REQUEST: I have asked someone to retrieve my spoon, soul gem, and orichalcum ingot from my travels.
ALL_ITEMS_RETURNED: I have no recollection of asking anyone to retrieve my items, though I am genuinely grateful they were returned.
I gave five random high-value scrolls from my collection as thanks for the returned implements.
I feel slightly more favorably toward the person who brought back my spoon, soul gem, and orichalcum ingot.
With my implements returned, my oddly-inspired experiment at Mistveil Keep can finally proceed.

beats.comment: Player learns Wylandriah needs help retrieving items she left behind.
Player accepts the task; quest starts at stage 20 with all three retrieval objectives.
Observational gate: Wylandriah's spoon has been retrieved from Fellstar Farm.
Observational gate: Orichalcum ingot has been retrieved from The Frozen Hearth.
Observational gate: Wylandriah's soul gem has been retrieved from The White Phial.
All three items collected; player returns to Wylandriah. Sets stage 60 and completes objectives.

title: Bring It!
description: Harrald, son of Jarl Laila Law-Giver in Riften, needs someone to fetch his sword from Balimund at The Scorched Hammer after it was damaged during sparring practice.

base_facts: I am the son of Jarl Laila Law-Giver.
I live in Mistveil Keep in Riften.
My sword is being repaired by Balimund at The Scorched Hammer after I damaged it sparring.

HEAR_ABOUT_SWORD: I asked someone to fetch my sword from Balimund.
DELIVER_SWORD: My sword has been returned to me at last.
I grumbled that the delivery took too long before handing over payment.
I rewarded the courier with two leveled gems for their trouble.
This errand counts toward earning the title of Thane in the Rift.

base_facts: I run The Scorched Hammer in Riften.
Harrald's sword is here for repairs.

GOT_SWORD: I gave Harrald's repaired sword to someone to deliver.

beats.comment: Player learns Harrald's sword is with Balimund for repairs.
Player agrees to fetch Harrald's sword from Balimund. Sets quest stage 20.
Player retrieves the sword from Balimund. Sets quest stage 30.
Player delivers the sword back to Harrald and completes the quest.

title: Bloody Nose
description: Bet 100 gold that you can defeat Hofgrir Horse-Crusher in an unarmed brawl at Riften Stables, then claim your winnings.

base_facts: I work at the Riften Stables just north of the city.
I am the strongest brawler in all of Skyrim.
I will bet 100 gold against anyone who thinks they can beat me in a fistfight.

ACCEPT_BRAWL_BET: This fool actually bet 100 gold they could beat me in a brawl.
BRAWL_COMPLETE: I lost the brawl fair and square. I handed back the 100 gold stake and paid another 100 gold for losing the bet.
My pride is wounded, but I respect anyone who can best me with their bare fists.
I can hardly keep boasting about being the strongest brawler in Skyrim after that beating.
I will not offer another brawl bet to this person â€” they have already proven themselves.

beats.comment: Player learns about Hofgrir's brawling reputation and the bet opportunity.
Player makes the 100 gold bet and the brawl begins.
Player defeats Hofgrir and claims the reward of 200 gold total.

title: Toying With The Dead
description: Vekel the Man at the Ragged Flagon wants four journals written by the necromancer Arondil, who fled to Yngvild after being driven out of Dawnstar for reanimation experiments. Retrieve the journals from the ice caves and return them for a leveled enchanted one-handed weapon.

base_facts: I tend bar at the Ragged Flagon for the Thieves Guild.
I have a buyer looking for the four journals of a necromancer named Arondil.
Arondil was driven out of Dawnstar for unspeakable reanimation experiments and fled to Yngvild.

ACCEPT_QUEST: The player agreed to retrieve Arondil's journals from Yngvild for a share of the reward.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The player returned all four of Arondil's journals. I paid them their share from my client.
I gave the player a leveled enchanted one-handed weapon as their cut of the reward, obtained through a fair trade with my client.
My buyer's peculiar taste in Arondil's ravings is now satisfied; the four volumes have been delivered.
I remarked that I was hoping they hadn't forgotten about the job before honoring my word on the payment.

beats.comment: Player accepts Vekel's job to retrieve Arondil's journals from Yngvild.
Observational: game advances to stage 30 when player enters Yngvild.
Observational: game advances to stage 40 when all four journals are collected.
Quest finishes at stage 200 when player returns journals to Vekel.

title: A Lovely Letter
description: Sven and Faendal both vie for Camilla Valerius's affection in Riverwood. Each asks the player to deliver a forged letter to Camilla to sabotage the other's chances with her.

base_facts: I am a bard in Riverwood with feelings for Camilla Valerius.
Faendal is trying to come between me and Camilla.
I have a letter I would like someone to deliver to Camilla on my behalf.

HEAR_OF_RIVALRY: Someone knows about my rivalry with Faendal over Camilla.
AGREE_HELP_SVEN: Someone agreed to help me by delivering my letter to Camilla.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The matter with Camilla has been settled and I am grateful for the help.
DELIVER_SVEN_LETTER_TO_CAMILLA: The fake letter has been delivered to Camilla and she has turned against Faendal.
The player should return to me for thanks and a reward.
RETURN_TO_SVEN: The player returned after delivering the fake letter to Camilla.
I rewarded the player for helping me with Camilla.

base_facts: I am a Wood Elf hunter in Riverwood with feelings for Camilla Valerius.
Sven is my rival for Camilla's affection.
I have a letter I would like someone to deliver to Camilla on my behalf.

HEAR_OF_RIVALRY: Someone knows about my troubles with Sven over Camilla.
AGREE_HELP_FAENDAL: Someone agreed to help me by delivering my letter to Camilla.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The matter with Camilla has been settled and I am grateful for the help.
DELIVER_FAENDAL_LETTER_TO_CAMILLA: The fake letter has been delivered to Camilla and she has turned against Sven.
The player should return to me for thanks and a reward.
RETURN_TO_FAENDAL: The player returned after delivering the fake letter to Camilla.
I rewarded the player for helping me with Camilla.

base_facts: I run the Riverwood Trader with my brother Lucan.
Both Sven and Faendal are interested in me and their rivalry is tiresome.

DELIVER_SVEN_LETTER_TO_CAMILLA: The player showed me a fake letter meant to make Faendal look cruel.
Sven seems to be the wronged party in this rivalry.
DELIVER_FAENDAL_LETTER_TO_CAMILLA: The player showed me a fake letter meant to make Sven look selfish.
Faendal seems to be the wronged party in this rivalry.

beats.comment: Player learns about the love triangle between Sven, Faendal, and Camilla.
Player agrees to help Sven by delivering his fake letter to Camilla.

triggers.intent: Player explicitly agrees to help Sven by delivering his fake letter to Camilla.

examples_yes: I'll deliver your letter to Camilla.
Give me the letter and I'll take it to her.
I will make sure Camilla sees the letter.

Maybe you should talk to her yourself.

faendal wanted you to see this

examples_yes: Camilla, here is the letter Faendal asked me to bring you.

Take this letter; Faendal said you should see it.
examples_no: What do you think of Sven?

examples_no: I still need to talk to Camilla.

beats.comment: Player returns to Sven after Camilla received the fake letter, completing Sven's branch of the quest.

triggers.intent: Player clearly reports to Sven that Camilla received the fake letter and the job is done.
examples_yes: I delivered the letter to Camilla.
It is done; she read it.
examples_no: I still need to talk to Camilla.

beats.comment: Quest completed after delivering the letter and returning to the winner for the reward.

title: Mine or Yours
description: Filnjar, the blacksmith of Shor's Stone, reports that Redbelly Mine is overrun with frostbite spiders and asks for help clearing them out to restore the town's ebony mining operation.

base_facts: I am the blacksmith of Shor's Stone.
Redbelly Mine is our main source of income, producing ebony ore.
The mine gets its name from the red sulfurous mist that fills the caverns.

HEAR_ABOUT_MINE: Frostbite spiders have overrun Redbelly Mine and it is no longer producing.
The town guards will not help with the spider problem; they are too busy watching for enemy soldiers.
ACCEPT_QUEST: Someone has agreed to clear the spiders from Redbelly Mine for me.
SPIDERS_CLEARED: The frostbite spiders in Redbelly Mine have been killed, clearing the way for ebony mining to resume.
Redbelly Mine can now produce ebony ore again, putting Shor's Stone back on the map.
Filnjar needs to be informed of the good news and will reward leveled gold for reopening the mine.
Filnjar's disposition will increase by one once he learns the spiders are gone.
RETURN_TO_FILNJAR: The mine is clear and Shor's Stone is back on the map. I rewarded my helper with leveled gold.

beats.comment: Player learns about the spider infestation in Redbelly Mine from Filnjar.
Player agrees to clear the mine of spiders, starting the quest at stage 20.
Observation that all frostbite spiders in Redbelly Mine have been killed, advancing to stage 30.
Player returns to Filnjar and reports the mine is clear, completing the quest at stage 200.

title: Vald's Debt
description: Clear Vald's debt to Maven Black-Briar by retrieving the lost Quill of Gemination from the bottom of Lake Honrich, so Vald will stop guarding Riftweald Manor for Mercer Frey.

base_facts: I commissioned a unique quill from Winterhold years ago.
Vald was supposed to deliver it but lost it at the bottom of Lake Honrich.
Vald owes me a debt.

TALK_TO_MAVEN: I told someone about the Quill of Gemination lost in Lake Honrich.
RETURN_QUILL: The Quill has been returned to me. I wrote a note clearing Vald's debt.
QUEST_COMPLETE: My note clearing Vald's debt has been delivered to him. He owes me nothing more.
With Vald's debt settled, he has no reason to continue guarding Riftweald Manor for Mercer Frey.

base_facts: I owe Maven Black-Briar a debt.
I guard Riftweald Manor for Mercer Frey because of my debt to Maven.

QUEST_COMPLETE: My debt to Maven Black-Briar has been cleared by her written note. I am no longer bound to guard Riftweald Manor for Mercer Frey.
I gave the key to Riftweald Manor and opened the back gate as thanks for erasing my debt.
I am free of both Maven's leverage and Mercer Frey's extortion.

beats.comment: Player asks Maven about Vald's debt and learns about the Quill of Gemination.
Player finds the Quill of Gemination in Vald's sunken rowboat in Lake Honrich.
Player brings the Quill of Gemination to Maven and receives a note clearing Vald's debt.
Player gives Vald the note from Maven clearing his debt. Vald provides the key to Riftweald Manor.

title: Bullying Braith
description: Lars Battle-Born is being bullied by Braith in Whiterun. Convince Braith to stop picking on him.

base_facts: I am being bullied by Braith. She picks on me all the time and calls me a milk drinker because I cannot fight.

LEARN_LARS_PROBLEM: Someone knows about my bullying problem.
AGREE_TO_HELP_LARS: Someone agreed to help me deal with Braith.
QUEST_COMPLETE: Braith has stopped bullying me. I paid my helper two septims - my whole life savings - as I promised.
Braith keeps her distance from me now. I no longer have to hide from her in my grandmother's house.
I am grateful to the person who helped me. They are welcome in House Battle-Born and may take what low-value items they need.

base_facts: I like Lars but he will not kiss me. My parents Amren and Saffir do not listen when I try to talk about boys.

CONVINCE_BRAITH_STOP: Someone told me to stop bullying Lars. I only picked on him because I like him and wanted a kiss.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I stopped bullying Lars. I keep my distance from him now instead of picking on him.
I admitted to my helper that I only bullied Lars because I like him and wanted him to kiss me.
I am friendly toward the person who confronted me about Lars. I may give them gifts or invite them to play.

beats.comment: Player learns Lars is being bullied by Braith.
Player agrees to help Lars stop Braith's bullying.
Player confronts Braith and convinces her to stop bullying Lars.
Observational beat for quest completion.

title: Argonian Ale Extraction
description: Brenuin, a drunk wandering the streets of Whiterun, asks you to steal a bottle of Argonian Ale from The Bannered Mare for him.

base_facts: I wander the streets of Whiterun, usually near The Bannered Mare.
I'm always looking for my next drink.

BRENUIN_REQUEST: There's a special bottle of Argonian Ale in The Bannered Mare's kitchen. I want someone to get it for me.
ALE_ACQUIRED: The player has the Argonian Ale. I hope they bring it to me soon.
