QUEST_COMPLETE: The player brought me the Argonian Ale, and I rewarded them with a Potion of Vigorous Healing I 'found' at the Temple of Kynareth.
My disposition towards the player improved for helping feed my drinking habit.
I am finally enjoying that special bottle of ale from the Bannered Mare.

beats.comment: Brenuin asks the player to steal Argonian Ale from The Bannered Mare.
Player has stolen the Argonian Ale from The Bannered Mare kitchen.
Player gave the Argonian Ale to Brenuin and received a Potion of Vigorous Healing.

title: Greatsword for a Great Man
description: Adrianne Avenicci forged a greatsword for Jarl Balgruuf and asks you to deliver it to her father Proventus Avenicci at Dragonsreach.

base_facts: I own Warmaiden's smithy in Whiterun.
I work my forge all day.

HEAR_ABOUT_SWORD: I forged a greatsword for Jarl Balgruuf to impress him.
I haven't had a chance to deliver it.
I'd like someone to deliver it to my father Proventus at Dragonsreach.
ACCEPT_QUEST: Someone agreed to deliver the greatsword to Father.
DELIVER_SWORD: My greatsword has been delivered to Father at Dragonsreach.
Father will present it to Jarl Balgruuf when the time is right.

base_facts: I am the steward of Dragonsreach in Whiterun.
Adrianne is my daughter.

DELIVER_SWORD: Adrianne's greatsword for Jarl Balgruuf has been delivered to me.
I will present the sword to Balgruuf when his mood is agreeable.
I rewarded the courier with twenty gold for making the delivery.
My daughter Adrianne is so eager to prove herself to the Jarl.

beats.comment: Player learns about the greatsword Adrianne forged for Balgruuf and her desire to have it delivered.
Player agrees to deliver the greatsword to Proventus.
Player delivers the greatsword to Proventus Avenicci at Dragonsreach.

title: Andurs' Arkay Amulet
description: Andurs, priest of Arkay in Whiterun's Hall of the Dead, lost his Amulet of Arkay in the catacombs and asks you to retrieve it from the restless dead.

base_facts: I am a priest of Arkay overseeing Whiterun's Hall of the Dead.
I lost my Amulet of Arkay somewhere in the catacombs beneath the Hall.
Strange noises come from the catacombs and I fear the restless dead.
I would retrieve my amulet myself but I am afraid of the skeletons down there.

ANDURS_MENTIONS_AMULET: I have asked the player to retrieve my Amulet of Arkay from the catacombs.
ACCEPT_QUEST: The player has agreed to help me retrieve my amulet from the catacombs.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The player has returned my Amulet of Arkay to me; I am very grateful for their bravery in facing the restless dead.
I rewarded the player with 15 gold for retrieving my amulet from the catacombs.
My disposition toward the player has increased by 3; I regard them more favorably for their service.
With my amulet restored, I can properly perform my duties as priest of Arkay in the Hall of the Dead once again.

beats.comment: Andurs tells the player about his lost Amulet of Arkay in the catacombs.
Player agrees to help Andurs retrieve his amulet from the catacombs.
Player has found Andurs' Amulet of Arkay in the catacombs.
Player returns the amulet to Andurs, completing the quest.

title: Delivery (Hillevi)
description: Hillevi Cruel-Sea asks the player to deliver a bottle of Nightshade Extract to Wuunferth the Unliving at the Palace of the Kings in Windhelm.

base_facts: I sell produce at my market stall in Windhelm's Stone Quarter.
My family owns Hollyfrost Farm outside the city.
Wuunferth the Unliving pays us for every portion of Nightshade we plant.
I have a bottle of Nightshade Extract that needs delivering to Wuunferth.

HILLEVI_EXPLAINS: I asked someone to deliver the Nightshade Extract to Wuunferth for me.
QUEST_STARTED: My delivery request has been accepted.
DELIVER_COMPLETE: My Nightshade Extract has been successfully delivered to Wuunferth.
I am grateful to the courier who made the delivery for me.
My family's Nightshade arrangement with Wuunferth continues as before.

base_facts: I am the court wizard in Windhelm, residing in the Palace of the Kings.
I pay the Cruel-Sea family for Nightshade they grow at Hollyfrost Farm.
Nightshade Extract is very poisonous but has its uses.

DELIVER_COMPLETE: I have received the Nightshade Extract from Hillevi's courier.
I paid the courier a leveled amount of gold for the delivery.
The extract is very poisonous, but I will not reveal what I need it for.

beats.comment: Player learns Hillevi needs someone to deliver Nightshade Extract to Wuunferth.
Player accepts the delivery task, quest stage 10 set.
Player delivers Nightshade Extract to Wuunferth, quest completes at stage 200.

title: Drowned Sorrows
description: After helping Ranmir pay his debts, Dagur asks you to find out what happened to Isabelle Rolaine, whose disappearance turned Ranmir into the town drunk. Follow the trail from Haran to Vex in the Thieves Guild, then to Hob's Fall Cave where Isabelle met her end, and return her letter to Ranmir.

base_facts: Runs the Frozen Hearth inn in Winterhold with his wife Haran.
Concerned about Ranmir's constant drinking and what it has done to him.
Knows Ranmir was once happy and in love with Isabelle Rolaine before she disappeared.

DAGUR_TELLS_ABOUT_ISABELLE: Told the player about Ranmir's past with Isabelle and how her disappearance broke him.

base_facts: Works at the Frozen Hearth inn in Winterhold.
Frustrated by Ranmir's drinking and the toll it takes on Birna.
Overheard Ranmir mention that Isabelle ran off with a thief named Vex.

HARAN_REVEALS_VEX: Revealed that Isabelle left with someone named Vex, connected to a dangerous crowd in Riften.

base_facts: The town drunk of Winterhold, drowning his sorrows at the Frozen Hearth.
Still heartbroken over Isabelle Rolaine's disappearance.
Gets angry if Isabelle's name is mentioned.

RETURN_TO_RANMIR_WITH_LETTER: Read Isabelle's letter and learned she went to Hob's Fall Cave to find treasure for him.
Left the Frozen Hearth to think about everything.

base_facts: A master infiltrator of the Thieves Guild, found in the Ragged Flagon in Riften.
Knew Isabelle Rolaine when she came looking for opportunities.
Warned Isabelle against seeking treasure but pointed her toward Hob's Fall Cave.

VEX_REVEALS_LOCATION: Told the player that Isabelle went to Hob's Fall Cave seeking valuables and never came back.

beats.comment: Dagur tells the player about Ranmir's past with Isabelle Rolaine after Ranmir's debts are settled.
Haran reveals that Isabelle ran off with a thief named Vex after Ranmir refuses to discuss her.
Vex in the Ragged Flagon reveals Isabelle went to Hob's Fall Cave and never returned.
Player finds Isabelle's body and letter in Hob's Fall Cave, then returns to Ranmir with the letter.

title: First Lessons
description: The player seeks to join the College of Winterhold. Faralda tests them with a spell at the bridge, Mirabelle Ervine gives them a tour of the grounds, and Tolfdir teaches them about ward spells before announcing an expedition to Saarthal.

base_facts: I guard the bridge to the College of Winterhold and test anyone who wishes to enter.
I require applicants to demonstrate magical ability by casting a spell before I let them cross.

ENTRANCE_EXAM: The applicant passed my spell test and was allowed to cross the bridge.
ADMITTED_TO_COLLEGE: I directed the new member to speak with Mirabelle Ervine inside the College.

base_facts: I am the Master-Wizard of the College of Winterhold and handle new arrivals.
I give tours of the College grounds to new members.

TOUR_WITH_MIRABELLE: I gave the new apprentice a tour of the College and provided them with novice robes and quarters in the Hall of Attainment.
TOLFDIR_LECTURE: I directed the new apprentice to attend Tolfdir's lecture in the Hall of the Elements.

base_facts: I am an elderly professor at the College of Winterhold who teaches the apprentices.
I believe in the importance of safety and mitigation when practicing magic.

TOLFDIR_LECTURE: I taught the new apprentice about ward spells and gave them Lesser Ward.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The apprentice successfully defended against my firebolt using a ward spell.
I have announced an upcoming expedition to Saarthal and the apprentice will be joining.
I now consider the apprentice a friend due to their successful participation in the lesson.
The introductory lecture and practical demonstration on the importance of safety and wards is complete.

beats.comment: Player discovers the College and must seek entry.
Faralda demands the player cast a spell to prove their ability.
Player is admitted and directed to Mirabelle Ervine.
Mirabelle gives the player a tour of the College facilities.
Player attends Tolfdir's lecture and learns about ward spells.
Player successfully defends with a ward; Tolfdir announces the Saarthal expedition.

title: College Objective Quest
description: A miscellaneous pointer quest directing you to visit the College of Winterhold after hearing about magic training from innkeepers or spell merchants. The quest completes once you reach the college bridge and speak with Faralda.

base_facts: I guard the bridge to the College of Winterhold and test those who wish to enter.
No one enters the College without passing my test.

QUEST_STARTED: Someone has been directed to the College and may approach soon.
MEET_FARALDA: I have met a prospective student at the bridge and will test them before granting entry.
QUEST_COMPLETE: A visitor directed to the College has reached my bridge and must now prove themselves worthy of entry.
I will begin the First Lessons trial to test this prospective student's magical ability before granting them passage into the College.
No one bypasses my judgment; this seeker will face the same test as all who wish to join the College.

base_facts: If someone asks about magic training, I direct them to the College of Winterhold.

beats.comment: Quest begins at stage 10 when the player is directed to visit the College.
Player hears about the College from innkeepers or spell merchants before the quest formally starts.
Player approaches the College bridge and is stopped by Faralda, who initiates First Lessons.
Quest finishes at stage 200 once the player has reached the College and spoken with Faralda.

title: Under Saarthal
description: Tolfdir leads the College apprentices to the ruins of Saarthal for an excavation. After assisting Arniel Gane with magical artifacts, the player discovers the Saarthal Amulet and triggers a hidden passage. A Psijic Order vision warns of danger within, and deeper exploration reveals a mysterious orb. The player must report the discovery to Arch-Mage Savos Aren.

base_facts: I am an elderly Alteration instructor at the College of Winterhold.
I believe practical field experience is essential for learning magic.
I am leading the expedition to Saarthal to study the ancient Nord ruins and their magical seals.

MEET_AT_SAARTHAL: I have arrived at Saarthal with the apprentices and am ready to begin the excavation.
ASSIST_ARNIEL: I have asked the student to help Arniel Gane find enchanted artifacts in the ruins.
AMULET_TRAP: The student found an ancient amulet that triggered a trap and revealed a sealed section of the ruins. This is highly unusual and very interesting.
PSIJIC_WARNING: The student received a vision from the Psijic Order warning of danger, but I wish to press on and investigate further.
DISCOVER_ORB: We have found a strange orb deep within Saarthal. The student must inform the Arch-Mage of this discovery.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I have remained at Saarthal to continue studying the mysterious orb and the sealed sections of the ruins.
The student has reported our discovery to the Arch-Mage and received a Staff of Magelight and a Word of Power for the Ice Form shout as rewards.
Our expedition revealed far more than expected, including Psijic Order involvement and a dangerous presence deep within Saarthal.

base_facts: I am a scholar at the College of Winterhold cataloging finds at the Saarthal excavation.
I prefer to work without interruptions and do not appreciate assistants making a mess of my work.

ASSIST_ARNIEL: A student has been sent to help me find additional magical artifacts in the nearby chambers.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I am continuing my cataloging work at the Saarthal excavation while Tolfdir studies the orb.
My focus remains on properly documenting the existing finds; the hidden chambers are outside my area of study.

base_facts: I am the Arch-Mage of the College of Winterhold.

DISCOVER_ORB: A student has reported an important discovery deep within Saarthal.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I have been informed of the strange orb discovered deep within Saarthal and am taking the matter seriously.
I rewarded the student with a Staff of Magelight and a Word of Power for the Ice Form shout for reporting the discovery promptly.
The discovery at Saarthal is significant and warrants further investigation by the College.

beats.comment: Player meets Tolfdir outside Saarthal and enters the ruins with the apprentices.
Player finds Arniel Gane and searches for magical artifacts in the excavation chambers.
Player picks up the Saarthal Amulet, triggering a trap that reveals a hidden sealed section of the ruins.
Player receives a Psijic Order vision warning of danger within Saarthal and follows Tolfdir deeper into the ruins.
Player and Tolfdir discover a mysterious orb deep in Saarthal. Player must report to the Arch-Mage.
Player has reported the Saarthal discovery to the Arch-Mage and the quest is complete.

title: Hitting the Books
description: After the discovery of a mysterious orb in Saarthal, the College of Winterhold seeks information about the artifact. Mirabelle Ervine directs the player to consult Urag gro-Shub, who reveals that relevant books were stolen by the former apprentice Orthorn and taken to Fellglow Keep.

base_facts: I am the Master Wizard of the College of Winterhold.
Tolfdir is still in Saarthal investigating the orb discovery.
The player should consult Urag gro-Shub in the Arcanaeum to research the Saarthal orb.

LEARN_FROM_MIRABELLE: I have directed the player to speak with Urag gro-Shub about the Saarthal discovery.

base_facts: I am the librarian of the Arcanaeum at the College of Winterhold.
Three books that may contain information about the Saarthal orb were stolen by Orthorn, a former Apprentice.
Orthorn joined renegade mages at Fellglow Keep and took the stolen books there.

CONSULT_URAG: I have told the player that Orthorn stole the books and took them to Fellglow Keep.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The book Night of Tears contains important information about Saarthal.
I have given the player skill books as a reward for returning the stolen books.

base_facts: I am a former Apprentice of the College of Winterhold.
I borrowed books from the Arcanaeum and brought them to Fellglow Keep.
The mages at Fellglow Keep imprisoned me as a test subject.

FREE_ORTHORN_OPTIONAL: I have been freed from my cage and offered to help find the books.
The books were taken by someone called The Caller.

beats.comment: Player speaks with Mirabelle about researching the Saarthal discovery.
Player consults Urag gro-Shub in the Arcanaeum about the stolen books.
Player travels to Fellglow Keep and retrieves the three stolen books.
Optional: Player frees Orthorn from his cage in Fellglow Keep Dungeons.
Player returns the books to Urag; Night of Tears reveals important information about Saarthal.

title: Good Intentions
description: After discovering the orb from Saarthal, the player must navigate growing concern around the Eye of Magnus. Ancano introduces a Psijic Order monk who warns of danger, leading the player to seek the Augur of Dunlain beneath the College and ultimately report the need for the Staff of Magnus to the Arch-Mage.

base_facts: I am a master wizard at the College of Winterhold.
I have been studying the orb recovered from Saarthal, which appears to be the Eye of Magnus.
The markings on the orb are unlike any Elven, Daedric, or Ayleid script I have seen.

LISTEN_TO_TOLFDIR: I shared my observations about the Eye of Magnus with the student before Ancano interrupted.
FIND_AUGUR: I told the student that the Augur of Dunlain is a former student who can be found in the Midden beneath the College.

base_facts: I am the Thalmor advisor to the College of Winterhold.
I am deeply interested in the Eye of Magnus and its potential.

FOLLOW_ANCANO: I insisted the student follow me to meet a visitor from the Psijic Order in the Arch-Mage's quarters.

base_facts: I am a monk of the Psijic Order.
I have come to warn that the Eye of Magnus is dangerous and must not be used.

SPEAK_WITH_QUARANIR: I froze time to speak privately and directed the student to seek the Augur of Dunlain within the College for guidance on dealing with the Eye of Magnus.

base_facts: I am a former student of the College of Winterhold, transformed by my own ambitions.
I reside in the Midden beneath the College.

FIND_AUGUR: I told the student that the Staff of Magnus is needed to deal with the Eye of Magnus and urged them to inform their superiors immediately.

base_facts: I am the Arch-Mage of the College of Winterhold.

REPORT_TO_SAVOS: I required some convincing before taking the Augur's warning about the Eye of Magnus seriously, but eventually accepted the student's report.
I directed the student to Mirabelle Ervine for more information on locating the Staff of Magnus.
I rewarded the student with the Mage's Circlet, impressed by their initiative and performance thus far.
The matter of the Eye of Magnus and the need for the Staff of Magnus now falls to Mirabelle Ervine for further investigation.

beats.comment: Player speaks with Tolfdir about the Night of Tears book and the Saarthal orb.
Tolfdir shares his thoughts on the Eye of Magnus before Ancano interrupts.
Ancano interrupts and insists the player follow him to the Arch-Mage's quarters.
Quaranir freezes time, warns about the Eye of Magnus, and directs player to the Augur of Dunlain.
Player finds the Augur of Dunlain in the Midden and learns about the Staff of Magnus.
Player reports the Augur's message about the Staff of Magnus to Arch-Mage Savos Aren and receives the Mage's Circlet.

title: Containment
description: After Ancano's manipulation of the Eye of Magnus causes a catastrophic energy surge that kills Arch-Mage Savos Aren, the player must protect Winterhold from magic anomalies and report to Mirabelle Ervine, who provides Savos Aren's Amulet and the Torc of Labyrinthian for the next quest.

base_facts: I am the Master Wizard of the College of Winterhold.
Ancano has done something with the Eye of Magnus.
The Arch-Mage went to confront Ancano and is now missing.

REPORT_MIRABELLE: I gave the player Savos Aren's amulet to aid them on their journey.
I gave the player the Torc of Labyrinthian.
The Staff of Magnus is needed to contain the Eye of Magnus.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I gave the player Savos Aren's Amulet, which enhances magicka, believing they will be better served by it than I.
Savos Aren had recently given me the Torc of Labyrinthian with cryptic instructions that I would know what to do with it when the time cameâ€”I believe it was meant for the player.
Tolfdir and I are struggling to contain the Eye of Magnus, which remains unreachable and continues to jeopardize the College.
I have directed the player to seek the Staff of Magnus in Labyrinthianâ€”it is our only hope of containing the Eye.

base_facts: I am a professor at the College of Winterhold.
The Arch-Mage has been killed by the energy from the Eye.

FIND_ARCH_MAGE: Whatever killed the Arch-Mage has also affected the town of Winterhold.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I am assisting Mirabelle in trying to contain the Eye of Magnus, but it remains unreachable and continues to threaten the College.
The town of Winterhold has been secured from the magic anomalies, but the danger from the Eye is far from over.

base_facts: I guard the bridge to the College of Winterhold.

PROTECT_WINTERHOLD: I went to Winterhold to help fight the magic anomalies alongside the player.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I fought alongside the player and Arniel to defeat the magic anomalies attacking Winterhold.
Arniel has chosen to remain in Winterhold after the fighting ended.

beats.comment: Player regains consciousness after the Eye's surge and is told to assess the damage.
Player finds the Arch-Mage's body in the courtyard; Tolfdir says Winterhold is in danger.
Player crosses the bridge to Winterhold; Faralda and Arniel join to help fight anomalies.
Player defeats ten magic anomalies infesting Winterhold with Faralda and Arniel's help.
Player reports to Mirabelle; she gives Savos Aren's Amulet and the Torc of Labyrinthian.
Winterhold is secured but the Eye of Magnus remains a threat; quest ends.

title: Revealing the Unseen
description: Search for the Synod researchers at Mzulft to learn the location of the Staff of Magnus, then report back to the College of Winterhold.

base_facts: I am the Master-Wizard of the College of Winterhold.
Members of the Synod recently visited the College asking about the Staff of Magnus.
The Synod was heading to the Dwemer ruin of Mzulft to search for the Staff.

SPEAK_WITH_MIRABELLE: I directed the student to seek the Synod at Mzulft.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I identified the barrier around the Eye of Magnus as some kind of ward.
I suspect Ancano created the barrier sealing the Hall of the Elements.
I attempted to break the barrier with Destruction spells alongside the Arch-Mage.
I warned Savos not to approach Ancano as he channeled magic into the Eye.

base_facts: I am a Synod researcher leading an expedition at Mzulft.
I need a focusing crystal to operate the Oculory.
The Falmer stole the focusing crystal from our expedition.

FIND_CRYSTAL: The student from the College returned my focusing crystal.
FOCUS_OCULORY: The Oculory is focused but there is interference from Winterhold.
Something powerful at the College is disrupting the Oculory's readings.
TALK_TO_PARATUS: The Oculory map reveals the Staff of Magnus is in Labyrinthian.
I will report this interference to the Synod Council.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The Oculory confirmed the Staff of Magnus is located in Labyrinthian.
I accused the College of Winterhold of deliberately interfering with the Synod's experiment.
I intend to report the College's interference and its powerful magical source to the Synod Council.
The Synod's goal was to scan the continent for powerful sources of magic for the good of the Empire.

base_facts: I am the Arch-Mage of the College of Winterhold.
The Eye of Magnus requires careful study and caution.

REPORT_TO_SAVOS: Ancano has sealed himself in the Hall of the Elements with the Eye of Magnus.
A magical barrier is blocking access to the Eye of Magnus.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I was informed the Staff of Magnus is located in Labyrinthian.
I am more immediately concerned with Ancano and the Eye of Magnus than the Staff's location.
I confronted Ancano and commanded him to stop channeling magic into the Eye.
I rushed toward Ancano despite Mirabelle's warning.

beats.comment: Player speaks with Mirabelle about the Staff of Magnus and learns the Synod headed to Mzulft.
Player reaches Mzulft, finds the dying Gavros Plinius, and learns about the Oculory.
Player meets Paratus, finds the focusing crystal stolen by Falmer, and returns it to him.
Player follows Paratus, places the crystal in the Oculory, and uses fire and frost spells to focus the beams of light.
Player talks to Paratus, learns the Staff of Magnus is in Labyrinthian and that something at the College is interfering with the Oculory.
Player returns to the College and finds Ancano has locked himself in the Hall of the Elements with the Eye of Magnus.
Quest completes after reporting the Staff of Magnus location to the Arch-Mage.

title: The Staff of Magnus
description: After the crisis at the College of Winterhold, Mirabelle Ervine sends you to Labyrinthian to retrieve the Staff of Magnus, the only artifact capable of containing Ancano's abuse of the Eye of Magnus. Navigate the ancient ruins, defeat the Dragon Priest Morokei, and return the Staff to Tolfdir.

base_facts: I sent the student to Labyrinthian to retrieve the Staff of Magnus.
I gave them the Torc of Labyrinthian and Savos Aren's Amulet to gain entry.
The Staff is the only way to contain Ancano's abuse of the Eye of Magnus.

MIRABELLE_BRIEFING: The student has departed for Labyrinthian with the Torc and Amulet.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I am holding the defensive line against Ancano inside the College.
The student has successfully recovered the Staff of Magnus from Labyrinthian.
With the Staff of Magnus recovered, we finally have a way to contain the Eye of Magnus.

base_facts: I am a Dragon Priest entombed deep within Labyrinthian.
I wield the Staff of Magnus.
I drain the magicka of any who dare enter my domain.
Savos Aren sealed me behind a magical barrier using the lives of his companions.

DEFEAT_MOROKEI: I have been defeated and the Staff of Magnus taken from me.

base_facts: I am at the College of Winterhold dealing with the magical crisis.
The student must return the Staff of Magnus to me so we can stop Ancano.

RETURN_TO_TOLFDIR: The student has returned with the Staff of Magnus.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The student has returned from Labyrinthian with the Staff of Magnus.
The student must use the Staff of Magnus on the Eye of Magnus to break Ancano's hold.
The magical crisis at the College is worsening, and we must act immediately.

base_facts: I once led an expedition into Labyrinthian with five companions from the College.
We were no match for Morokei.
I sealed Morokei behind a barrier, sacrificing my companions to maintain it.
I serve the Thalmor and Ancano.
I was sent to intercept the Staff of Magnus from anyone who retrieves it.
I am harnessing the power of the Eye of Magnus at the College.
The Staff of Magnus is the only thing that can counter my power.

QUEST_COMPLETE: The student has retrieved the Staff of Magnus, the only artifact capable of countering my power.
I remain in control of the Eye of Magnus, but the Staff threatens my plans.
My magical barrier protects me, but the Staff of Magnus can disrupt it.

beats.comment: Mirabelle sends the player to Labyrinthian after the Containment crisis.
Player has entered Labyrinthian and is searching for the Staff.
Player defeats Morokei and retrieves the Staff of Magnus.
Player returns to Tolfdir at the College with the Staff.
Quest finished - Staff of Magnus recovered.

title: The Eye of Magnus
description: The final quest of the College of Winterhold questline. After recovering the Staff of Magnus, the player must breach the magical barrier around the College, confront Ancano in the Hall of the Elements, and defeat him by using the Staff on the Eye of Magnus. With Ancano defeated, the Psijic Order removes the Eye and the player is named the new Arch-Mage.

base_facts: I am a professor at the College of Winterhold.
Mirabelle Ervine sacrificed herself so others could escape the College.
The Staff of Magnus can dissipate the Eye's barrier.
Using the Staff on the Eye when it is open will close it and sever Ancano's connection.

ENTER_COLLEGE: The magical barrier around the College has been breached using the Staff of Magnus.
DEFEAT_ANCANO: Ancano has been defeated but the Eye of Magnus is still dangerously active.
SPEAK_QUARANIR: The Psijic Order has taken the Eye of Magnus away. I have named the new Arch-Mage and given them the key and robes.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I have affirmed the new Arch-Mage and given them the key to the Arch-Mage's Quarters and the Archmage's Robes.
I have taken on the role of Master Wizard of the College following Mirabelle's death.
The Psijic Order has safely removed the Eye of Magnus from the College.
I will greet the new Arch-Mage with the respect their new position demands.

base_facts: I am an agent of the Thalmor embedded at the College of Winterhold.
I have merged my power with the Eye of Magnus and become nearly invincible.

REACH_HALL: I have harnessed the Eye's power. No one can stop me now.

base_facts: I am a monk of the Psijic Order.
The world is not ready for the power of the Eye of Magnus.

SPEAK_QUARANIR: The Psijic Order will safeguard the Eye. You have proven worthy and are now the Arch-Mage of the College.

beats.comment: Player uses the Staff of Magnus to breach the barrier around the College after learning of Mirabelle's death.
Player reaches the Hall of the Elements and confronts Ancano, who claims unstoppable power from the Eye.
Player defeats Ancano by using the Staff on the Eye to close it, making him vulnerable, then attacking. Tolfdir is paralyzed during the fight.

keywords: use the staff on the eye

beats.comment: After defeating Ancano, the Eye is still active. Player asks Tolfdir what to do next.
Quaranir of the Psijic Order appears, declares the player the new Arch-Mage, and the Order removes the Eye of Magnus.
Quest completes. Player is named Arch-Mage, receives the Archmage's Robes and key to the Arch-Mage's Quarters.

title: Tolfdir the Absent-Minded
description: Tolfdir has misplaced his alembic somewhere in the College of Winterhold. Find it and return it to him for a small reward of gold and a soul gem.

base_facts: I am a professor at the College of Winterhold.
I have a sentimental attachment to my particular alembic.
I tend to misplace my belongings from time to time.

TOLFDIR_NEEDS_HELP: I admitted to misplacing my alembic again.
ACCEPT_QUEST: Someone has offered to find my alembic for me.
RETURN_ALEMBIC: My alembic has been returned to me. I am grateful.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I rewarded the return of my alembic with thirty gold and an empty soul gem.
I am grateful for the help finding my misplaced alembic.
I am likely to misplace my alembic again somewhere in the Hall of Countenance.
I will offer the same reward if my alembic is found and returned to me again.

beats.comment: Player asks Tolfdir if he needs help; he admits misplacing his alembic.
Player offers to find Tolfdir's alembic; quest stage set to 10.
Player returns the alembic to Tolfdir; quest completes at stage 200.
Observational beat: quest has been completed.

title: Out of Balance
description: Drevis Neloren asks the player to cleanse the polluted magical focal points around the College of Winterhold using special Mystic Tuning Gloves, then return the gloves to him for a reward of soul gems.

base_facts: I am the Master of Illusion at the College of Winterhold.
The focal points for magical energy around the College have become polluted and need cleansing.
I have special Mystic Tuning Gloves that allow direct interaction with the focal points.

ACCEPT_QUEST: I have given the Mystic Tuning Gloves to the player to cleanse the focal points.
There may be side-effects to performing the cleansing task.
FOCAL_POINTS_CLEANSED: The focal points have been cleansed and the player should return the gloves to me.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The player has returned the Mystic Tuning Gloves after successfully cleansing all three focal points around the College.
I have rewarded the player with soul gems for their assistance with the purification.
My disposition toward the player has improved for their help with this task.
I can feel the difference in the magical energies alreadyâ€”the focal points in the courtyard, Hall of Countenance, and Hall of Attainment are purified.

beats.comment: Player agrees to help Drevis cleanse the focal points and receives the Mystic Tuning Gloves.
Player has cleansed all three focal points around the College. Stage 20 fires automatically.
Player returns to Drevis after cleansing the focal points and the quest completes at stage 200.

title: Brelyna's Practice
description: Brelyna Maryon, a Dunmer student at the College of Winterhold, asks the player to serve as a test subject for her experimental Alteration spells. Her first attempt turns the player green, and her second attempt transforms them into various animals before finally succeeding. She rewards the player with a Resist Magic necklace and becomes available as a follower.

base_facts: I am a Dunmer student at the College of Winterhold studying Alteration magic.
I have been developing new spells and need someone to practice casting them on.
I would rather not ask J'zargo to be my test subject.

FIRST_SPELL_EFFECT: My first spell turned the player green. That was not supposed to happen, but the effect is temporary.
GREEN_WORN_OFF: The green effect has worn off. I am confident I can fix the spell if the player lets me try again.
QUEST_COMPLETE: My second attempt turned the player into a horse, a cow, and a dog before I finally returned them to normal. I said "There, all better" when it worked.
I gave the player a Resist Magic necklace as thanks for their patience, and we agreed to never speak of this again.
Perhaps I should work on my spells more before trying anything else. I am grateful the player was willing to endure my mishaps.
I now trust the player enough to travel with them as a companion, and would consider marriage if asked.

beats.comment: Brelyna asks the player to be a test subject for her spells.

triggers.intent: Player explicitly agrees to help Brelyna by being her test subject.
examples_yes: I can be your test subject.
I'll assist you with your spells.
examples_no: I don't want to be a test subject.

beats.comment: Brelyna casts her first spell, turning the player green. The player must wait for the effect to wear off.
The green effect wears off and the player speaks to Brelyna, who asks to try again.
Brelyna's second attempt transforms the player into various animals before returning them to normal. She rewards the player with a Resist Magic necklace and the quest concludes.

title: J'zargo's Experiment
description: J'zargo asks the player to test his experimental Flame Cloak scrolls on undead creatures. The scrolls prove dangerously explosive, harming allies as well as enemies. After reporting results, J'zargo becomes available as a follower.

base_facts: J'zargo is a Khajiit student at the College of Winterhold.
J'zargo is ambitious and believes himself to be very skilled in magic.
J'zargo has been developing new Destruction spells.

BEAT_ACCEPT_EXPERIMENT: J'zargo has given the player ten Flame Cloak scrolls to test on the undead.
BEAT_UNDEAD_KILLED: The player has killed undead with J'zargo's Flame Cloak scrolls.
The scrolls cause a massive explosion that harms the wielder and nearby allies.
BEAT_REPORT_COMPLETE: J'zargo's experiment had an unfortunate side effect, but he is grateful for the help.
J'zargo is now available as a follower.
BEAT_QUEST_FAILED: J'zargo no longer wants the player's help after they exhausted all ten scrolls without killing enough undead.
The quest has failed; J'zargo does not become available as a follower through this experiment.
All ten Flame Cloak scrolls were used up without achieving the three required undead kills.
There is no way to obtain more copies of J'zargo's scrolls to retry the experiment.

beats.comment: Player agrees to help J'zargo test his Flame Cloak scrolls on undead.
Player has killed three undead with the scrolls and should report back.
Player reports the scroll results to J'zargo and the quest finishes.
Player ran out of scrolls without killing enough undead; quest fails.

title: Onmund's Request
description: Onmund regrets trading his family amulet to Enthir and asks for help getting it back. Enthir refuses to return it unless the Grand Staff of Charming is retrieved from a dangerous location. Returning the staff earns the amulet, and returning the amulet earns Onmund's friendship.

base_facts: I am a Nord student at the College of Winterhold.
I traded my family amulet to Enthir and deeply regret it.
I want my amulet back but Enthir will not budge.

ONMUND_ASKS_FOR_HELP: I have asked someone to help me get my amulet back from Enthir.
AMULET_RETURNED_TO_ONMUND: My family amulet has been returned to me. I am deeply grateful to the one who dealt with Enthir on my behalf.
I now consider my benefactor a true friend and am willing to follow them as a companion.
I am open to marriage should my benefactor express interest.

base_facts: I am a dealer at the College of Winterhold.
I do not go back on trades once they are made.
I might consider an exception for the right price.

ENTHIR_DEMANDS_STAFF: I have offered to trade Onmund's amulet for the Grand Staff of Charming.
STAFF_DELIVERED_TO_ENTHIR: I have traded Onmund's amulet for the Grand Staff of Charming.
AMULET_RETURNED_TO_ONMUND: The trade is fully concluded; I have the Grand Staff of Charming and Onmund has his amulet back.
I upheld my end of the bargain once the staff was delivered. The matter is settled.

beats.comment: Onmund asks the player to help recover his family amulet from Enthir.
Enthir refuses to return the amulet unless the Grand Staff of Charming is retrieved.
The player finds the Grand Staff of Charming at the radiant dungeon location.
Player delivers the Grand Staff of Charming to Enthir and receives Onmund's amulet.
Player returns the amulet to Onmund, completing the quest and earning his friendship.

title: Arniel's Endeavor
description: A multi-part College of Winterhold side quest in which Arniel Gane enlists the player's help researching the disappearance of the Dwemer, from gathering cogs to charging a warped soul gem and ultimately witnessing his fateful experiment with Keening.

base_facts: I am a researcher at the College of Winterhold studying the disappearance of the Dwemer.
I need help acquiring Dwemer artifacts for my secret project.
I am working with Enthir to obtain special items from Morrowind.

PART1_COGS_REQUEST: I have asked someone to bring me ten Dwemer cogs for my project.
PART1_COGS_DELIVERED: The Dwemer cogs have been delivered. My project is making progress.
PART2_ENTHIR_TRADE: I need a specific item from Enthir but he is refusing to hand it over.
PART2_TRADE_COMPLETE: I now have the warped soul gem I needed from Enthir.
PART3_SOUL_GEM_CHARGE: The warped soul gem must be charged in Dwemer convectors using Arniel's Convection.
PART3_CHARGE_COMPLETE: The warped soul gem has been fully charged and returned to me.
PART4_KEENING: I am waiting for a delivery from Morrowind Ã¢â‚¬â€ the dagger Keening Ã¢â‚¬â€ via Enthir's courier.
PART4_EXPERIMENT_COMPLETE: I struck the warped soul gem with Keening three times; the first two attempts produced no result, but on the third strike I vanished in a flash of light.
I was attempting to replicate Lord Kagrenac's work, using his tools on the charged soul gem to understand the disappearance of the Dwemer.
I have vanished completely and will never be seen again; whether I succeeded in my experiment or shared the Dwemer's fate remains unknown.
Keening was left behind on the floor after my disappearance, and the spell to summon my shade was granted to the one who observed the experiment.

base_facts: I am a merchant at the College of Winterhold dealing in rare and unusual goods.
I have business arrangements with Arniel Gane for certain items.

PART2_ENTHIR_TRADE: Arniel wants an item from me but has not paid. I will trade it for the Staff of Tandil.
PART2_TRADE_COMPLETE: The trade with Arniel is complete. I gave up the warped soul gem.
PART4_KEENING: I was supposed to arrange transport for an item from Morrowind but the courier never arrived.
PART4_EXPERIMENT_COMPLETE: Arniel has vanished after conducting his experiment with Keening and the warped soul gem; our business arrangement is effectively concluded.
I was only ever tasked with providing transport for Arniel's items from Morrowind and never knew the full nature of his project.

beats.comment: Arniel asks the player to bring him ten Dwemer cogs for his secret project.
Player delivers ten Dwemer cogs to Arniel; he rewards gold and hints at more work.
Arniel needs an item from Enthir who refuses unless the player retrieves the Staff of Tandil from a radiant dungeon.
Staff delivered to Enthir; warped soul gem obtained and given to Arniel. Part 2 complete.
Arniel reveals his project relates to the Dwemer disappearance. Player must charge the warped soul gem in Dwemer convectors using Arniel's Convection.
Warped soul gem fully charged and returned to Arniel. Part 3 complete.
Arniel waits for Keening from Morrowind. Enthir says the courier never arrived. Player must find the dead courier and retrieve Keening.
Arniel strikes the warped soul gem with Keening and vanishes. Player receives Keening and the spell Summon Arniel's Shade. Quest complete.

title: Rejoining the College
description: After committing a serious crime against a College of Winterhold member, the player is automatically suspended and must speak with Tolfdir to pay a fine and have their suspension lifted.

base_facts: I am a senior member of the College of Winterhold.
I handle disciplinary matters when members break the College's rules.
Murder is the only crime serious enough to warrant suspension from the College.

SUSPENSION_STARTED: A member of the College has been suspended for their actions and must speak with me.
FINE_ANNOUNCED: I have informed the suspended member of the fine they must pay to be reinstated. The amount depends on how many past incidents there have been.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I have lifted the suspension and reinstated the member into the College's ranks after they paid the required fine.
Any future incidents will demand a steeper fineâ€”500 gold for the second offense, 750 for the third, and 1000 for each thereafter.
I have lectured the member on appropriate conduct; the College will not tolerate further violence against its own.
The matter is settled for now, but I will not be so lenient if this happens again.

beats.comment: Player has been suspended from the College and must speak with Tolfdir about having it lifted.
Tolfdir has determined the fine amount based on the number of past incidents. Stage 10=250 gold, 20=500 gold, 30=1000 gold.
Player has paid the fine and their suspension from the College has been lifted.

title: Destruction Ritual Spell
description: After reaching mastery in Destruction, Faralda gives the Dragonborn the incomplete book Power of the Elements. Following its poetic clues, the player must activate three pedestals across Skyrim with flame, frost, and shock spells to complete the book and earn the Fire Storm spell.

base_facts: I am the Destruction magic trainer at the College of Winterhold.
Only those who have truly mastered Destruction magic can learn its deepest secrets.

FARALDA_OFFERS_BOOK: I have given the student the book Power of the Elements to test their mastery of Destruction.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The student has completed Power of the Elements and proven their mastery of Destruction magic.
I can now sell the student spell tomes for Lightning Storm and Blizzard, the remaining Master-level Destruction spells.
The student learned Fire Storm from the completed book, having followed Shalidor's clues across the three pedestals.

beats.comment: Player asks Faralda about further Destruction training; she offers the book Power of the Elements.
Faralda gives the book Power of the Elements; quest stage 10 starts.
Player visits Windward Ruins, places book on pedestal, and casts a flame spell to unlock the next page.
Player visits North Skybound Watch and casts a frost spell on the pedestal to unlock the final clue.
Player visits Four Skull Lookout and casts a shock spell on the pedestal to complete the book.
Player reads the completed book, learns Fire Storm, and finishes the quest at stage 200.

title: Illusion Ritual Spell
description: Drevis Neloren tasks the player with finding four hidden Master Illusion texts throughout the College of Winterhold using the Vision of the Tenth Eye spell, then returning them for a Master Illusion spell tome.

base_facts: I am the Master of Illusion at the College of Winterhold.
I can teach Master-level Illusion spells to those who have proven their mastery.
There are hidden texts containing powerful Illusion knowledge scattered throughout the College.

QUEST_STARTED: I have given the student Vision of the Tenth Eye to find the hidden Master Illusion texts.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The student has returned the four Master Illusion texts and I have rewarded them with the Hysteria spell tome.
The student has proven their mastery of Illusion magic and I can now offer them the remaining Master Illusion spell tomes for purchase: Call to Arms, Harmony, and Mayhem.
The hidden texts have been recovered from the Arcanaeum, Hall of Attainment, Hall of Countenance, and The Midden, and are back in my keeping.

beats.comment: Player accepts the quest from Drevis Neloren and receives Vision of the Tenth Eye to find the hidden texts.
Player returns the four Master Illusion texts to Drevis Neloren, completing the quest.
Quest completes after delivering the texts and receiving the Hysteria spell tome.

title: Conjuration Ritual Spell
description: Phinis Gestor requires a Sigil Stone from Oblivion to inscribe Master Conjuration spells. Summon and subdue an Unbound Dremora on the roof of the Hall of Attainment to retrieve one, then deliver it to Phinis for the Flame Thrall spell.

base_facts: Expert Conjuration instructor at the College of Winterhold.
Can teach Master-level Conjuration spells once given a Sigil Stone.

QUEST_STARTED: Has given the player the Summon Unbound Dremora spell to retrieve a Sigil Stone.
SIGIL_STONE_OBTAINED: Is waiting for the player to deliver the Sigil Stone.
QUEST_COMPLETE: Has used the delivered Sigil Stone to inscribe Master Conjuration spells.
Rewarded the player with the Flame Thrall spell tome as the first of the Master spells.
Now sells the Frost Thrall, Storm Thrall, and Dead Thrall spell tomes.
Recognizes the player as a true master of Conjuration for subduing the Unbound Dremora.

beats.comment: Quest begins when Phinis gives the Summon Unbound Dremora spell after reaching 90 Conjuration.
Player has subdued the Unbound Dremora multiple times and obtained the Sigil Stone.
Player delivers the Sigil Stone to Phinis to complete the quest.
Quest complete. Phinis has given the Flame Thrall spell and unlocked Master Conjuration spells for purchase.

title: Restoration Ritual Spell
description: After reaching Restoration skill 90 and completing Good Intentions, Colette Marence directs the player to the Augur of Dunlain in The Midden. The Augur tests the player by stripping their items and summoning ghosts; surviving using only Restoration magic earns the Bane of the Undead spell.

base_facts: I am the Restoration instructor at the College of Winterhold.
The Augur of Dunlain in The Midden holds knowledge of master Restoration spells.
Only those who gain the Augur's approval can learn the deepest Restoration magic.

COLETTE_DIRECTS_TO_AUGUR: I have sent this student to seek the Augur of Dunlain in The Midden for further training.
PASS_AUGUR_TEST: This student has passed the Augur's test and proven their mastery of Restoration.
This student may now purchase the Guardian Circle spell tome from me.

base_facts: I dwell in The Midden beneath the College of Winterhold.
I test those who seek mastery of Restoration magic.
My test requires surviving ghost attacks using only Restoration spells.

SPEAK_WITH_AUGUR: This mage has come seeking my test of Restoration mastery.
PASS_AUGUR_TEST: This mage has proven worthy and been granted the Bane of the Undead spell.
I have returned this mage's belongings now that the trial is concluded.
This mage has demonstrated true mastery of Restoration magic.

beats.comment: Player asks Colette about further Restoration training; she directs them to the Augur in The Midden.
Player finds and speaks with the Augur of Dunlain in The Midden and learns about the test.
Player survives the Augur's ghost test and receives Bane of the Undead. Quest completes at stage 200.

title: Alteration Ritual Spell
description: Tolfdir requests help completing his research on a new Master Alteration spell. He needs dragon heartscales, which can only be harvested using Kahvozein's FangÃ¢â‚¬â€a dagger found in a dragon priest dungeon. Retrieve the dagger, harvest heartscales from a dragon corpse, and return them to Tolfdir for the Dragonhide spell tome.

base_facts: I am a master of Alteration magic at the College of Winterhold.
I have been working on a new Master-level Alteration spell.

QUEST_ACCEPTED: I need dragon heartscales to complete my research on the Dragonhide spell.
Only Kahvozein's Fang can cut heartscales from a dragon's skeleton.
HEARTSCALES_COLLECTED: The Dragonborn has collected the dragon heartscales I need.
I am eager to see the heartscales and complete my research.
QUEST_COMPLETE: My research is complete thanks to the heartscales.
I have given the Dragonborn the Dragonhide spell tome as a reward.
I can now sell the Mass Paralysis spell tome.

beats.comment: Player speaks to Tolfdir with Alteration 90+ and agrees to help retrieve Kahvozein's Fang and harvest heartscales.
Player has used Kahvozein's Fang on a dragon corpse to harvest heartscales. Observed via quest stage.
Player returns dragon heartscales to Tolfdir and receives the Dragonhide spell tome.
Quest finishes at stage 200. Tolfdir rewards the Dragonhide spell tome and offers Mass Paralysis for purchase.

title: Unbound
description: The opening quest of Skyrim. The player is captured by the Empire and brought to Helgen for execution alongside Stormcloak rebels. Before the execution can be carried out, the dragon Alduin attacks the town. The player must escape through Helgen Keep, choosing to follow either Ralof or Hadvar, and flee to safety.

base_facts: I am a Stormcloak soldier captured near Darkwater Crossing.
I was on the cart with the player and Ulfric Stormcloak.
I guide the player through the tower during the dragon attack.

DRAGON_ATTACKS: I helped the player to their feet after Alduin's shout staggered them.
HEAD_TO_KEEP: I urged the player into the tower and then to jump through the hole Alduin blasted.
ESCAPE_THROUGH_KEEP: I led the player through Helgen Keep to escape the dragon.
FREEDOM: I escaped Helgen alongside the player after surviving Alduin's attack on the town.
I plan to head to Riverwood to find my sister Gerdur for shelter and supplies.
I urged the player to warn the Jarl of Whiterun about the dragon threat.
I told the player the Stormcloaks could use someone with their skills in Windhelm.

base_facts: I am an Imperial soldier stationed at Helgen.
I was reading the execution list and could not find the player's name.
I try to help citizens during the dragon attack.

DRAGON_ATTACKS: I tried to save the boy Haming from the dragon's attack.
HEAD_TO_KEEP: I told the player to follow me if they wanted to stay alive.
ESCAPE_THROUGH_KEEP: I led the player through Helgen Keep to escape the dragon.
FREEDOM: I escaped Helgen alongside the player after surviving Alduin's attack on the town.
I plan to head to Riverwood to find my uncle Alvor the blacksmith for shelter and supplies.
I urged the player to warn the Jarl of Whiterun about the dragon threat.
I told the player the Imperial Legion could use someone with their skills in Solitude.

beats.comment: Player is captured, brought to Helgen for execution, and Alduin attacks before the player can be executed.
Alduin's attack creates chaos. Player must make their way to Helgen Keep and choose to enter with either Ralof or Hadvar.
Player navigates Helgen Keep with their chosen companion, fights through spiders and a bear, and escapes the keep.
Player has escaped Helgen and the dragon attack. The quest is complete and the player is free to explore Skyrim.

title: Before the Storm
description: After escaping the dragon attack on Helgen, the player is directed to Riverwood to seek help from Alvor or Gerdur, who then asks them to inform Jarl Balgruuf in Whiterun about the dragon threat and request soldiers to protect Riverwood.

base_facts: Imperial soldier who escaped Helgen during the dragon attack.
His uncle Alvor is the blacksmith in Riverwood.

HEAD_TO_RIVERWOOD: Directed the player to seek out Alvor in Riverwood for shelter and supplies.

base_facts: Stormcloak soldier who escaped Helgen during the dragon attack.
His sister Gerdur lives in Riverwood.

HEAD_TO_RIVERWOOD: Directed the player to seek out Gerdur in Riverwood for shelter and supplies.

base_facts: Blacksmith in Riverwood, Hadvar's uncle.
Worried about the dragon threat to the defenseless village.

INFORM_JARL: Asked the player to inform Jarl Balgruuf about the dragon attack and request soldiers to protect Riverwood.

base_facts: Runs the lumber mill in Riverwood, Ralof's sister.
Worried about the dragon threat to the defenseless village.

INFORM_JARL: Asked the player to inform Jarl Balgruuf about the dragon attack and request soldiers to protect Riverwood.

base_facts: Jarl of Whiterun, rules from Dragonsreach.
Concerned about the security of his hold.

WARN_JARL: Learned of the dragon attack on Helgen from the player.
Agreed to send soldiers to protect Riverwood.
Rewarded the player with a piece of leveled armor.
QUEST_COMPLETE: Rewarded the player with a piece of leveled armor, choosing light or heavy based on their skill aptitude; grants heavy armor if both are equal.
Dispatched three Whiterun guards to Riverwood to defend the village against the dragon threat.
His disposition toward the player increased by one point.
Now seeks further help investigating the dragon threat, leading to a request involving Bleak Falls Barrow.

beats.comment: Player is directed to Riverwood after escaping Helgen. Stage 10/20.
Alvor or Gerdur tells the player to inform the Jarl about the dragon. Stage 30.
Player arrives in Whiterun. Stage 100.
Player tells Jarl Balgruuf about the dragon attack on Helgen. Stage 110.
Quest complete. Jarl rewards player with leveled armor and sends troops to Riverwood. Stage 160.

title: Bleak Falls Barrow
description: Jarl Balgruuf directs the player to his court wizard Farengar Secret-Fire, who requests the retrieval of the Dragonstone from Bleak Falls Barrow to map ancient dragon burial sites and understand why dragons are returning to Tamriel.

base_facts: I am the Jarl of Whiterun, ruling from Dragonsreach.
My court wizard Farengar is researching the dragon threat.
I sent the player to assist Farengar after they brought news of the dragon attack on Helgen.

BALGRUUF_DIRECTS: I directed the player to Farengar to help with his dragon research.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The player retrieved the Dragonstone for Farengar and has earned my gratitude and a reward.

base_facts: I am the court wizard serving Jarl Balgruuf in Dragonsreach.
I am researching dragons and why they are returning to Tamriel.
A Dragonstone in Bleak Falls Barrow may contain a map of ancient dragon burial sites.

FARENGAR_REQUESTS: I asked the player to retrieve the Dragonstone from Bleak Falls Barrow.
DRAGONSTONE_FOUND: The player has found the Dragonstone and should bring it to me at Dragonsreach.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The player delivered the Dragonstone. This will greatly aid my research into the dragon burial sites.

beats.comment: Balgruuf directs the player to Farengar after hearing about the dragon attack.
Farengar asks the player to retrieve the Dragonstone from Bleak Falls Barrow.
Player retrieved the Dragonstone from Bleak Falls Barrow and must deliver it to Farengar.
Player delivered the Dragonstone to Farengar and completed the quest.

title: Dragon Rising
description: After returning the Dragonstone to Farengar, a dragon is sighted near Whiterun. Jarl Balgruuf sends the player with Irileth to investigate the Western Watchtower, where they slay the dragon Mirmulnir and absorb its soul, revealing the player as Dragonborn. The Jarl rewards the player with the Thaneship of Whiterun and the housecarl Lydia.

base_facts: Court wizard of Whiterun residing in Dragonsreach.
Studies dragons and their lore.
Requested the Dragonstone from Bleak Falls Barrow.

REPORT_DRAGONSTONE: The Dragonstone has been recovered from Bleak Falls Barrow.
DRAGON_SIGHTED: A dragon has been sighted near the Western Watchtower outside Whiterun.

base_facts: Jarl of Whiterun Hold, rules from Dragonsreach.
Concerned about the dragon threat and the civil war's pressure on his hold.

REPORT_DRAGONSTONE: The Dragonstone has been returned; the hero deserves a reward.
DRAGON_SIGHTED: A dragon was sighted at the Western Watchtower; sending Irileth and the hero to investigate.
ABSORB_SOUL_REPORT: This person is Dragonborn; the Greybeards are summoning them to High Hrothgar.
THANE_OF_WHITERUN: Appointed the Dragonborn as Thane of Whiterun and granted Lydia as housecarl.

base_facts: Housecarl to Jarl Balgruuf, a fiercely loyal Dunmer warrior.
Commands the Whiterun Guard when directed by the Jarl.

DEPLOY_TO_WATCHTOWER: Leading the expedition to the Western Watchtower to confront the dragon.
KILL_DRAGON: The dragon Mirmulnir has been slain at the watchtower.
ABSORB_SOUL_REPORT: The hero absorbed the dragon's soul; some guards call them Dragonborn but Irileth dismisses it as myth.

base_facts: A warrior of Whiterun stationed at Dragonsreach.
Sworn to serve the Jarl and the Thane of Whiterun.

THANE_OF_WHITERUN: Sworn as housecarl to the new Thane of Whiterun, ready to follow and protect them.

beats.comment: Player returns the Dragonstone and speaks to Jarl Balgruuf about the reward.
Irileth reports a dragon sighting and brings the player to Jarl Balgruuf.
Jarl Balgruuf sends the player with Irileth and guards to the Western Watchtower.
The dragon Mirmulnir attacks and is slain by the player and the guards.
Player investigates the dragon corpse and absorbs its soul, unlocking a Shout word.
Player is called Dragonborn after absorbing the soul and is told to report to the Jarl. The Greybeards summon the Dragonborn.
Jarl Balgruuf names the player Thane of Whiterun, grants the Axe of Whiterun, and assigns Lydia as housecarl. Quest complete.

title: The Way of the Voice
description: After slaying a dragon outside Whiterun, the Greybeards summon the player to High Hrothgar. Arngeir recognizes the player as Dragonborn and offers training in the Way of the Voice, teaching words of Unrelenting Force and Whirlwind Sprint before sending the player to retrieve the Horn of Jurgen Windcaller.

base_facts: I am the speaking master of the Greybeards, acting as their voice in conversation.
High Hrothgar is our monastery on the Throat of the World.
The Dragonborn is especially gifted in the use of the Voice.

ARRIVE_HIGH_HROTHGAR: I have greeted the Dragonborn at High Hrothgar and asked them to prove their identity.
DEMONSTRATE_UNRELENTING_FORCE: The Dragonborn has proven they are Dragonborn by using Unrelenting Force.
LEARN_RO_FROM_EINARTH: I have directed the Dragonborn to learn the word 'Ro' from Master Einarth.
DEMONSTRATE_RO: The Dragonborn has demonstrated 'Ro' on the ethereal targets.
LEARN_WULD_FROM_BORRI: I have taken the Dragonborn outside to learn Whirlwind Sprint from Master Borri.
DEMONSTRATE_WHIRLWIND_SPRINT: The Dragonborn has demonstrated Whirlwind Sprint through the gate.
FINAL_TRAINING_TALK: I have sent the Dragonborn on their final trial to retrieve the legendary Horn of Jurgen Windcaller.
The Dragonborn has passed all tests of the Voice, demonstrating both Unrelenting Force and Whirlwind Sprint.
I have taught the Dragonborn all I can for now; they must prove their worth by completing this trial.
The quest 'The Horn of Jurgen Windcaller' begins as the Dragonborn sets out on this final trial.

base_facts: I am one of the Greybeard masters at High Hrothgar.
My voice is too powerful for normal conversation.

LEARN_WULD_FROM_BORRI: I have taught the Dragonborn a word of Whirlwind Sprint and opened the gate for their test.

base_facts: I am one of the Greybeard masters at High Hrothgar.
My voice is too powerful for normal conversation.

LEARN_RO_FROM_EINARTH: I have inscribed the word 'Ro' on the floor for the Dragonborn to learn.

beats.comment: Player arrives at High Hrothgar and speaks to Arngeir, who asks them to prove they are Dragonborn.
Player demonstrates Unrelenting Force to prove they are Dragonborn. Arngeir welcomes them and offers training.
Arngeir directs the player to learn the word 'Ro' from Einarth. Einarth inscribes it on the floor.
Player practices 'Ro' on ethereal targets three times. Arngeir comments on their quick learning.
Arngeir takes the player outside. Borri teaches a word of Whirlwind Sprint and opens the gate.
Player uses Whirlwind Sprint to pass through the gate before it closes.
Arngeir sends the player on the final trial to retrieve the Horn of Jurgen Windcaller. Quest completes at stage 160.

title: The Horn of Jurgen Windcaller
description: Arngeir sends the Dragonborn on a final trial to retrieve the Horn of Jurgen Windcaller from Ustengrav. Upon arrival the Horn is missing, replaced by a note from Delphine requesting a meeting at the Sleeping Giant Inn in Riverwood. After meeting Delphine and recovering the Horn, the Dragonborn returns to High Hrothgar, learns the final word of Unrelenting Force from Wulfgar, and receives the Greybeards' formal recognition as Dragonborn.

base_facts: I am the eldest of the Greybeards and speak for our order.
I have sent the Dragonborn to retrieve the Horn of Jurgen Windcaller from Ustengrav as a final trial.
The Horn is named after Jurgen Windcaller, the founder of the Greybeards.

RETURN_HORN: The Dragonborn has returned with the Horn and proven worthy of the trial.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The Dragonborn has returned the Horn of Jurgen Windcaller and completed the final trial I set for them.
The Greybeards have formally recognized the Dragonborn, speaking our greeting in the dragon language all at once.
High Hrothgar is now fully open to the Dragonborn; they may freely take what they need from within.
My disposition toward the Dragonborn has increased for their success in this trial.

base_facts: I am one of the Greybeards.
I will teach the final word of Unrelenting Force once the Dragonborn completes their trial.

GREYBEARDS_RECOGNITION: I have taught the Dragonborn the final word of Unrelenting Force.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I have taught the Dragonborn the final word of Unrelenting Force, completing their knowledge of the shout.
I joined my fellow Greybeards in speaking the formal recognition of the Dragonborn in the dragon language.

base_facts: I run the Sleeping Giant Inn in Riverwood.
I took the Horn of Jurgen Windcaller from Ustengrav to get the Dragonborn's attention.

MEET_DELPHINE: I have revealed myself to the Dragonborn and returned the Horn.
My organization has been looking for someone like the Dragonborn.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I returned the Horn to the Dragonborn and revealed my purpose; my organization has found the one we seek.
I await the Dragonborn in Riverwood to pursue the matter of A Blade in the Dark.

beats.comment: Arngeir assigns the final trial to retrieve the Horn of Jurgen Windcaller from Ustengrav.
Player discovers the Horn is missing and finds a mysterious note on the pedestal.
Player meets Delphine at the Sleeping Giant Inn in Riverwood and receives the Horn.
Player returns the Horn to Arngeir at High Hrothgar, completing the trial.
Wulfgar teaches the final word of Unrelenting Force and the Greybeards formally recognize the Dragonborn.
Quest complete. The Dragonborn is formally recognized and High Hrothgar is fully open.

title: A Blade in the Dark
description: Delphine, the Riverwood innkeeper, reveals she took the Horn of Jurgen Windcaller to attract the Dragonborn. She believes dragons are being resurrected from burial mounds and asks you to prove you are Dragonborn by slaying a dragon at Kynesgrove. After the kill, she reveals she is one of the last Blades and suspects the Thalmor are behind the dragon attacks.

base_facts: I am the innkeeper of the Sleeping Giant Inn in Riverwood.
I took the Horn of Jurgen Windcaller from Ustengrav to get the Dragonborn's attention.
I am one of the last members of the Blades, sworn to protect the Dragonborn.

TALK_TO_DELPHINE: The Dragonborn came to my inn asking about the attic room.
I returned the Horn of Jurgen Windcaller to them.
DELPHINE_REVEALS_PLAN: I told the Dragonborn that dragons are being resurrected from their burial mounds.
I need them to kill a dragon at Kynesgrove to prove they are truly Dragonborn.
SAHLOKNIR_SLAIN: The Dragonborn killed Sahloknir and absorbed its soul. They are Dragonborn.
BLADES_REVEALED: I revealed myself as one of the last Blades to the Dragonborn.
I suspect the Thalmor are responsible for the return of the dragons.
I plan to infiltrate the Thalmor Embassy to find evidence of their involvement.

base_facts: I am a dragon buried in a mound near Kynesgrove.
Alduin resurrected me from my burial mound using his Thu'um.

beats.comment: Player meets Delphine at the Sleeping Giant Inn and she returns the Horn, asking to talk privately.
Delphine reveals dragons are being resurrected and asks the player to accompany her to Kynesgrove to prove they are Dragonborn.

keywords: I need to speak with them

triggers.intent: Player explicitly agrees to proceed with this quest handoff: Delphine reveals dragons are being resurrected and asks the player to accompany her to Kynesgrove to prove they are Dragonborn.
examples_yes: Tell me what needs to happen next.
examples_no: What are you asking me to do?
No, I do not want to do that.

beats.intent_summary: Player agrees to proceed with this quest handoff: Delphine reveals dragons are being resurrected and asks the player to accompany her to Kynesgrove to prove they are Dragonborn.

beats.comment: Alduin resurrects Sahloknir at the burial mound. Player kills Sahloknir and absorbs its soul, proving they are Dragonborn.
After Sahloknir is slain, player talks to Delphine who acknowledges them as Dragonborn.
Delphine reveals she is one of the last Blades, suspects the Thalmor, and plans to infiltrate the Thalmor Embassy. Quest completes.

title: Diplomatic Immunity
description: Delphine suspects the Thalmor are behind the dragon resurrection and arranges for the player to infiltrate the Thalmor Embassy during Elenwen's reception, with help from her inside contact Malborn.

base_facts: I am Delphine, one of the last surviving Blades.
I suspect the Thalmor are responsible for the dragons returning.
I have a plan to infiltrate the Thalmor Embassy during Elenwen's party.

MEET_DELPHINE_RIVERWOOD: I explained my plan to infiltrate the Thalmor Embassy to the Dragonborn.
PREPARE_FOR_PARTY: I gave the Dragonborn an invitation and party clothes, and took their remaining equipment before they boarded the carriage.
DEBRIEF_AND_COMPLETE: The Dragonborn reported that the Thalmor are searching Riften for a Blade named Esbern.
The Thalmor are not behind the dragons returning - their own dossiers show they are as ignorant about the dragon resurgence as the Blades are.
Finding Esbern in Riften before the Thalmor do is now the priority, as he may know the meaning behind the dragons' return.
I will direct the Dragonborn to begin the search for Esbern in Riften immediately.

base_facts: I am Malborn, a Wood Elf who works inside the Thalmor Embassy.
The Thalmor killed my family in Valenwood, which is why I help Delphine.
I can smuggle equipment into the embassy for you.

MEET_MALBORN: I took the Dragonborn's equipment to smuggle into the embassy.
EMBASSY_PARTY: I unlocked the back door to the kitchen so the Dragonborn could slip away from the party.

base_facts: I am Elenwen, the Thalmor Ambassador to Skyrim.
I host parties for Skyrim's elite at the Thalmor Embassy.

beats.comment: Delphine reveals her plan to infiltrate the Thalmor Embassy.
Meet Malborn at the Winking Skeever and give him equipment to smuggle in.
Meet Delphine at Solitude Stables, receive invitation and party clothes, board carriage.
Enter the embassy party, talk to Malborn, create a distraction and slip away.
Search the ambassador's office and dungeon for intelligence on the dragons.
Escape the Thalmor Embassy after obtaining the intelligence.
Report findings to Delphine; the Thalmor are searching for Esbern in Riften.

title: Find the Thalmor Assassin
description: Malborn is hiding in Windhelm after escaping the Thalmor Embassy during Diplomatic Immunity. He believes a Khajiit assassin waits outside the city to kill him and asks for help eliminating the threat so he can flee to Morrowind.

base_facts: Malborn is hiding in the New Gnisis Cornerclub in Windhelm after escaping the Thalmor Embassy.
He believes a Thalmor assassin, a Khajiit, is waiting outside the city gates to kill him.
He wants to flee to Morrowind but is too afraid to leave Windhelm while the assassin lurks outside.
He still blames the player and Delphine for putting him in danger.

MALBORN_SITUATION: Malborn has asked for help dealing with a Thalmor assassin outside Windhelm.
ACCEPT_QUEST: Malborn's request for help has been accepted. The assassin is believed to be a Khajiit near the city gates.
TELL_MALBORN: Malborn is grateful the assassin is dead and rewards the player with leveled gold he stole from the Thalmor.
Malborn immediately leaves the New Gnisis Cornerclub and runs toward Refugees' Rest on his way to Morrowind, disappearing from the game once he reaches the podium.
If Brelas was present with Malborn in Windhelm, she flees alongside him toward Morrowind and also disappears from the game.
Malborn is a weak character and can be killed by animals or bandits on the road to Refugees' Rest; if he dies before being disabled, the quest will fail even after the reward has been given.

beats.comment: Player learns Malborn is hiding in Windhelm and fears a Thalmor assassin outside the city.
Player agrees to help Malborn by finding and dealing with the assassin.
Observational gate: the Thalmor assassin J'datharr has been killed and stage 100 reached.
Player tells Malborn the assassin is dead, completing the quest.

title: A Cornered Rat
description: After learning from Thalmor records that the Blade Esbern is still alive, Delphine sends the player to Riften to find the archivist before the Thalmor do. Esbern is hiding in the Ratway Warrens and must be convinced to trust the player before he will leave.

base_facts: I am one of the last Blades, posing as the innkeeper at the Sleeping Giant Inn in Riverwood.
Esbern was my old colleague and fellow Blade, an expert on ancient dragon lore.
I gave the player a secret phrase to gain Esbern's trust: 'Where were you on the 30th of Frostfall?'

QUEST_ACCEPTED: I sent the player to Riften to find Esbern before the Thalmor get to him.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The player found Esbern alive in the Ratway Warrens and is bringing him to me at the Sleeping Giant Inn.
With Esbern's expertise on dragon lore, we can finally make sense of the dragon threat and plan our next move.
I am eager to reunite with my old colleague after all these yearsâ€”he may be the key to stopping Alduin.

base_facts: I am a Blade and archivist, an expert on ancient dragon lore and the Prophecy of the Dragonborn.
I have been hiding in the Ratway Warrens beneath Riften from the Thalmor.
I am extremely cautious of anyone approaching my door, fearing Thalmor agents.

CONVINCE_ESBERN: The player convinced me to trust them. I agreed to follow them back to Delphine in Riverwood.
I warned the player about Alduin the World-Eater's return and its apocalyptic implications.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I agreed to follow the player to Delphine's base at the Sleeping Giant Inn in Riverwood.
I searched my room for any sensitive information the Thalmor could use before leaving the Warrens.
I gathered what supplies I could from the chest at the foot of my bed before departing.
The player's arrival gave me the first real hope I have felt since Alduin's return began.

base_facts: I am a member of the Thieves Guild operating out of the Ragged Flagon in Riften.

SEARCH_RATWAY: I told the player what I know about the old man hiding in the Ratway Warrens.

base_facts: I am the innkeeper at the Bee and Barb in Riften.

SEARCH_RATWAY: I told the player about the old man hiding down in the Ratway.

beats.comment: Delphine sends the player to Riften to find Esbern after learning from Thalmor records.
Player asks around Riften and enters the Ratway to search for Esbern's hideout.
Player locates Esbern's door in the Ratway Warrens but he refuses entry.
Player convinces Esbern to open his door using the secret phrase, Delphine's name, or Dragonborn identity.
Esbern agrees to follow the player back to Delphine. Quest ends and Alduin's Wall begins.

title: Alduin's Wall
description: After rescuing Esbern from the Thalmor in Riften's Ratway, escort him to Riverwood to reunite with Delphine. The Blades then travel to Sky Haven Temple to find Alduin's Wall, which may reveal how to defeat Alduin.

base_facts: I am the Blades loremaster, hiding from the Thalmor in the Ratway beneath Riften.
I have studied dragons and ancient Blades records for decades.
Alduin's Wall at Sky Haven Temple may hold the secret to defeating Alduin.

ESCORT_ESBERN_RIVERWOOD: I have escaped the Ratway and am traveling with the Dragonborn to meet Delphine in Riverwood.
TALK_TO_ESBERN: I have reunited with Delphine. We must find Sky Haven Temple and Alduin's Wall.
GAIN_ENTRANCE_SKY_HAVEN: The blood seal has been opened by the Dragonborn's blood. Sky Haven Temple is ours again.
LEARN_SECRET_WALL: Alduin's Wall reveals that the ancient Nords used a Shout to defeat Alduin. The Greybeards may know it.
QUEST_COMPLETE: Alduin's Wall confirms the ancient Nords used a Shout to defeat Alduin, and the final panel prophesies his return to contend with the last Dragonborn.
The Dragonborn must travel to High Hrothgar to ask the Greybeards if they know this Shout.
Sky Haven Temple is finally reclaimed as the new stronghold of the Blades.

base_facts: I am a Blade, operating in secret at the Sleeping Giant Inn in Riverwood.
I sent the Dragonborn to find Esbern in Riften.

TALK_TO_ESBERN: Esbern is alive. He speaks of Sky Haven Temple and Alduin's Wall. The Karthspire matches the location he described.
GAIN_ENTRANCE_SKY_HAVEN: Sky Haven Temple is real. The Blades have a home again.
LEARN_SECRET_WALL: The Greybeards may know the Shout that can defeat Alduin, though I distrust them.
QUEST_COMPLETE: Sky Haven Temple is ours again, and serves as the new headquarters for the Blades.
The Dragonborn must go to High Hrothgar and get the Greybeards to teach them this Shout.
I will remain at Sky Haven Temple with Esbern to study the temple and Alduin's Wall.

beats.comment: Player escorts Esbern from the Ratway to the Sleeping Giant Inn in Riverwood.
Esbern and Delphine reunite at the Sleeping Giant Inn and discuss finding Sky Haven Temple.
Player solves the Akaviri puzzles and opens the blood seal at Sky Haven Temple.

keywords: I need to speak with them

triggers.intent: Player explicitly agrees to proceed with this quest handoff: Player solves the Akaviri puzzles and opens the blood seal at Sky Haven Temple.
examples_yes: Tell me what needs to happen next.
examples_no: What are you asking me to do?
No, I do not want to do that.

beats.intent_summary: Player agrees to proceed with this quest handoff: Player solves the Akaviri puzzles and opens the blood seal at Sky Haven Temple.

beats.comment: Esbern reads Alduin's Wall and reveals the ancient Nords used a Shout to defeat Alduin.
Quest complete. Alduin's Wall revealed the ancient Shout. Next destination: High Hrothgar.

title: The Throat of the World
description: After deciphering Alduin's Wall, the Dragonborn learns that Alduin was defeated by a Shout called Dragonrend. Arngeir cannot teach it but directs the Dragonborn to Paarthurnax at the summit of the Throat of the World. After learning Clear Skies to bypass the magical winds, the Dragonborn meets PaarthurnaxÃ¢â‚¬â€who reveals he does not know Dragonrend either, but believes it can be learned from the ancient heroes through an Elder Scroll at the Time-Wound.

base_facts: I am the foremost of the Greybeards and speak for our order.
The Shout used to defeat Alduin is called Dragonrend, but I do not know it and its origins are lost to us.
Only Paarthurnax, our leader who dwells at the summit of the Throat of the World, may know Dragonrend.
I can teach you the Clear Skies Shout to clear the path through the magical winds blocking the way to the summit.

SEEK_ARNGEIR: The Dragonborn has come seeking knowledge of the Shout that defeated Alduin. I will help them reach Paarthurnax.
LEARN_CLEAR_SKIES: I have taught the Dragonborn all three words of Clear Skies so they may ascend to the Throat of the World.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The Dragonborn has returned from Paarthurnax seeking an Elder Scroll to look back through the Time-Wound and learn Dragonrend from the ancient Tongues.
I may be able to help the Dragonborn locate an Elder Scroll, or Esbern of the Blades may have knowledge of its whereabouts.

base_facts: I am Paarthurnax, leader of the Greybeards and a dragon who has chosen the Way of the Voice.
I have lived in seclusion at the summit of the Throat of the World for thousands of years.
I do not know the Dragonrend Shout, as it was created by mortals to defy dragons.

REACH_PAARTHURNAX: The Dragonborn has reached my mountain. We must observe the formalities of the dov before we speak.
LEARN_FIRE_BREATH: I have shared the Word YolÃ¢â‚¬â€FireÃ¢â‚¬â€with the Dragonborn as a gift of understanding between dov.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I do not know Dragonrend, but I believe it can be learned by looking back through the Tiid-Ahraanâ€”the Time-Woundâ€”here on the Throat of the World. An Elder Scroll, a Kel, is needed to open the way and witness the ancient.
I do not know where an Elder Scroll might be found. The Dragonborn must ask Arngeir or Esbern for that knowledge.
If the Dragonborn already possesses an Elder Scroll, they should bring it to the Time-Wound at once so we may look back to the moment Alduin was first defeated.

beats.comment: Player returns to High Hrothgar and asks Arngeir about the Shout used to defeat Alduin. Arngeir reveals Dragonrend and directs player to Paarthurnax.
Arngeir teaches all three words of Clear Skies in the courtyard so the player can ascend past the magical winds.
Player uses Clear Skies to pass the magical winds and reaches Paarthurnax at the summit. Paarthurnax initiates the formal greeting of the dov.
Paarthurnax shares the Word of Power for Fire Breath and asks the player to Shout at him as part of the formalities of the dov.

Paarthurnax explains Dragonrend is unknown to him but can be learned through the Time-Wound using an Elder Scroll. Quest finishes; player is directed to Arngeir or Esbern for the Elder Scroll's location.

title: Elder Knowledge
description: Paarthurnax reveals that the ancient Nords used an Elder Scroll to cast Alduin forward in time. The Dragonborn must recover that Elder Scroll to learn the Dragonrend Shout from the ancient heroes through the Time-Wound atop the Throat of the World.

base_facts: I am the master of the Greybeards.
The ancient Nords used an Elder Scroll to send Alduin forward in time, creating the Time-Wound.
The Dragonrend shout crippled Alduin but did not truly defeat him.
Recovering the Elder Scroll and using it on the Time-Wound may allow one to learn Dragonrend from the ancient heroes.

PAARTHURNAX_TASK: The Dragonborn has agreed to seek the Elder Scroll to learn Dragonrend.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The Dragonborn has recovered the Elder Scroll from the Tower of Mzark deep within Blackreach.
The Dragonborn must now return to the Throat of the World and use the Elder Scroll upon the Time-Wound to glimpse the ancient Nords and learn Dragonrend.
Paarthurnax awaits the Dragonborn's return atop the mountain to witness the opening of the Time-Wound.

base_facts: I am a Blade and scholar of dragon lore.
The College of Winterhold may have knowledge about the Elder Scrolls.
