QUEST_COMPLETE: The Dragonborn has recovered the Elder Scroll, following the lead Esbern provided about the College of Winterhold.
The next step is for the Dragonborn to return to Paarthurnax and use the Scroll at the Time-Wound atop the Throat of the World.

base_facts: I am the eldest and most vocal of the Greybeards.
The College of Winterhold may have knowledge about the Elder Scrolls.

QUEST_COMPLETE: The Dragonborn has recovered the Elder Scroll, following the guidance Arngeir provided about seeking knowledge at the College of Winterhold.
The Dragonborn must now return to the Throat of the World to use the Elder Scroll on the Time-Wound and learn Dragonrend.

base_facts: I am the librarian of the Arcanaeum at the College of Winterhold.
Elder Scrolls are instruments of immense knowledge and power; reading one risks madness and costs the reader's sight.
Septimus Signus is a specialist in Elder Scrolls lore who left the College to study Dwemer artifacts.
I have two rare books on the Elder Scrolls: Ruminations on the Elder Scrolls and Effects of the Elder Scrolls.

QUEST_COMPLETE: The Dragonborn recovered the Elder Scroll using the knowledge traced through the two rare books Urag provided.
Septimus Signus's Ruminations on the Elder Scrolls led the Dragonborn to Blackreach and the Scroll within the Tower of Mzark.

base_facts: I am a scholar obsessed with the Dwemer and Elder Scrolls.
The Elder Scroll lies deep within Blackreach, beneath the Tower of Mzark.
Alftand is the point of entry to reach Blackreach.
I possess the Blank Lexicon and Attunement Sphere needed to access Blackreach and the Elder Scroll.

SEPTIMUS_SIGNUS_FOUND: I have given the Dragonborn the Blank Lexicon and Attunement Sphere to access Blackreach.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The Dragonborn used the Blank Lexicon and Attunement Sphere Septimus provided to reach the Elder Scroll in Blackreach.
The concurrent quest Discerning the Transmundane remains ongoing; the Inscribed Lexicon must still be returned to Septimus at his outpost.
Septimus still needs the information from the Lexicon to unlock the Dwemer lockbox he obsesses over.

beats.comment: Paarthurnax reveals the Elder Scroll is needed to learn Dragonrend through the Time-Wound.
Optional: talk to Esbern for advice on finding the Elder Scroll.

keywords: I need to speak with them

triggers.intent: Player explicitly agrees to proceed with this quest handoff: Optional: talk to Esbern for advice on finding the Elder Scroll.
examples_yes: Tell me what needs to happen next.
examples_no: What are you asking me to do?
No, I do not want to do that.

beats.intent_summary: Player agrees to proceed with this quest handoff: Optional: talk to Esbern for advice on finding the Elder Scroll.

beats.comment: Optional: talk to Arngeir for advice on finding the Elder Scroll.
Esbern or Arngeir directs the player to the College of Winterhold for Elder Scroll knowledge.
Urag points to Septimus Signus, who provides the Blank Lexicon and Attunement Sphere for Blackreach.
Journey through Alftand and Blackreach to the Tower of Mzark to claim the Elder Scroll.
The Elder Scroll has been recovered; the quest is complete.

title: Alduin's Bane
description: After acquiring the Elder Scroll, the Dragonborn must read it at the Time-Wound on the Throat of the World to witness the ancient Nords using Dragonrend against Alduin, learn the shout, and then use it to defeat Alduin in the present.

base_facts: I have waited long at the Throat of the World for one who is doom-driven.
The Elder Scroll Ã¢â‚¬â€ the Kel Ã¢â‚¬â€ will allow you to see through the Time-Wound and learn Dragonrend.
Alduin will come when he senses the Elder Scroll. You must be ready.

READ_ELDER_SCROLL: The Dovahkiin has the Kel and stands at the Time-Wound. The vision will now unfold.
LEARN_DRAGONREND: The Dovahkiin has learned Dragonrend from the ancient Nord heroes. Now it must be used against Alduin.
DEFEAT_ALDUIN: Alduin has been forced to flee, but he is not truly slain. He will retreat to Sovngarde to feast on souls.
QUEST_COMPLETE: Alduin has been forced to flee the Throat of the World, but he is not truly slain; he has retreated to Sovngarde to feast on the souls of the dead.
The Dovahkiin has proven strong enough to wound Alduin with Dragonrend, but the World-Eater's threat persists beyond Mundus.
The Kel (Elder Scroll) remains with the Dovahkiin, still bound to their destiny and unable to be discarded.

base_facts: I am Alduin, Firstborn of Akatosh and World-Eater.
No mortal can truly slay me on Mundus.

DEFEAT_ALDUIN: I have been wounded by Dragonrend but I cannot be slain here. I will outlast the mortals and feast in Sovngarde.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I cannot be slain here on Mundus by any mortal, not even the Dovahkiin.
I will outlast the mortals and retreat to Sovngarde, where I will continue to grow in power by feasting on the souls of the dead.
The Dovahkiin has become strong, but I am Al-du-in, Firstborn of Akatosh, and my lordship will be restored.

beats.comment: Player reads the Elder Scroll at the Time-Wound and enters the vision of the past.
During the vision, the ancient Nord heroes use Dragonrend against Alduin and the player learns the shout.
Player uses Dragonrend to ground Alduin and defeats him in combat at the Throat of the World. Alduin flees to Sovngarde.
Alduin is driven off and the quest is complete. He cannot be slain here and retreats to Sovngarde.

title: The Fallen
description: After defeating Alduin at the Throat of the World, the World-Eater fled. The Dragonborn must trap one of Alduin's dragon allies at Dragonsreach to learn the location of his lair, navigating the civil war if necessary to gain the Jarl of Whiterun's cooperation.

base_facts: Dragonsreach was once used to imprison a dragon by the ancient Nords.
A dragon's name is a Word of Power that can be Shouted to summon it.
Odahviing is one of Alduin's allies who may be called.

SEEK_COUNCIL: The Dragonborn has asked how to find Alduin after he fled the Throat of the World.
LEARN_CALL_DRAGON: I have shared the name Odahviing so the Dragonborn can call him.

base_facts: Dragonsreach was once used to capture a dragon.
The Greybeards can host a peace council to negotiate a civil war truce.

SEEK_COUNCIL: The Dragonborn seeks a way to track Alduin after he fled.
NEGOTIATE_TRUCE: I have agreed to host the peace negotiations at High Hrothgar.

base_facts: The Blades' records contain the names of dragons.
A dragon's name can be used as a Shout to summon it.

SEEK_COUNCIL: The Dragonborn seeks a way to track Alduin.
LEARN_CALL_DRAGON: I have revealed the name Odahviing from the Blades' records.

base_facts: I am one of Alduin's allies.
I was curious to test the Dragonborn's power when called.

TRAP_ODAHVIING: I have been trapped in the Dragonsreach yoke.
INTERROGATE_ODAHVIING: Alduin's lair is at Skuldafn, an ancient Dragon Cult temple reachable only by air.
I will fly the Dragonborn to Skuldafn if released.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I have been released from the Dragonsreach yoke and am now free.
I honor my bargain to fly the Dragonborn to Skuldafn, having begun to question whether Alduin is fit to lead after his defeat at the Throat of the World.
The Dragonborn must speak with me on the Great Porch to begin the flight to Skuldafn.
The Dragonborn now possesses all three words of the Call Dragon shout and may summon me as an ally in future battles.

beats.comment: Player consults Paarthurnax, Arngeir, or Esbern after Alduin flees. Learns Dragonsreach was used to trap a dragon.
Player approaches the Jarl of Whiterun about using Dragonsreach to trap a dragon. Civil war status affects the Jarl's response.
If the civil war is unresolved, the Jarl requires a truce. The Greybeards host the peace council, starting Season Unending.
Esbern or Paarthurnax reveals the name Odahviing. The Dragonborn learns the Call Dragon Shout automatically.
Player prepares the trap at the Dragonsreach Great Porch with the Jarl's assistance.
Player calls Odahviing with the Shout, fights him, and draws him into the yoke trap at Dragonsreach.
Player interrogates the trapped Odahviing, who reveals Alduin's lair at Skuldafn and offers to fly the Dragonborn there.
Odahviing is released and flies the Dragonborn to Skuldafn. Quest finishes.

title: Season Unending
description: The Jarl of Whiterun refuses to help capture a dragon while the civil war rages. Convince the Greybeards to host a peace council at High Hrothgar and negotiate a truce between the Imperial Legion and the Stormcloaks so both sides can unite against Alduin.

base_facts: I am the Greybeards' spokesman and reside at High Hrothgar.
The Greybeards are the only group both sides of the civil war respect enough to broker a truce.

ARNGEIR_AGREES: I have agreed to host a peace council at High Hrothgar to help defeat Alduin.
COUNCIL_BEGINS: The delegations have arrived at High Hrothgar. The council is ready to begin.
TRUCE_SIGNED: I have reviewed and finalized the terms of the truce, which both delegations have agreed to.
I expressed my pessimism about the truce's lasting value, noting that 'season unending' is the ancient Nord term for war.
With the truce signed, the Jarl of Whiterun will now permit Dragonsreach to be used to capture a dragon, advancing the quest The Fallen.

base_facts: I command the Imperial Legion in Skyrim from Castle Dour in Solitude.

LEADERS_CONVINCED: I have agreed to attend the peace council at High Hrothgar.
TRUCE_SIGNED: I have signed the truce, agreeing to the negotiated exchange of holds with the Stormcloaks.
If the treaty favors the Imperials, I am pleased with the outcome and may offer a leveled enchanted weapon to an Imperial ally.
If the treaty disadvantages the Imperials, I will accuse the Dragonborn of betrayal, though it carries no permanent military repercussions.

base_facts: I lead the Stormcloak rebellion from the Palace of the Kings in Windhelm.

LEADERS_CONVINCED: I have agreed to attend the peace council at High Hrothgar.
TRUCE_SIGNED: I have signed the truce, agreeing to the negotiated exchange of holds with the Imperial Legion.
If the treaty favors the Stormcloaks, I am satisfied and may offer a leveled enchanted weapon to a Stormcloak ally.
If the treaty disadvantages the Stormcloaks, I will accuse the Dragonborn of betrayal, though there are no lasting consequences.

base_facts: I am one of the last Blades and a scholar of dragon lore.

NEGOTIATE_TRUCE: I reminded the council that Alduin threatens all of Skyrim, forcing both sides back to the table.
TRUCE_SIGNED: My speech reminding the council of Alduin's threat prevented the negotiations from collapsing when one side threatened to walk out.
With the truce signed, the civil war is temporarily halted, allowing both sides to focus on the dragon threat.
The Blades and the Greybeards managed to put aside their mutual dislike for the duration of the council.

beats.comment: Player talks to Arngeir at High Hrothgar about hosting a peace council.
Both General Tullius and Ulfric Stormcloak agree to attend the peace council.
Player returns to High Hrothgar and talks to Arngeir to begin the council.
Player takes their seat at the negotiating table.

keywords: I need to speak with them

triggers.intent: Player explicitly agrees to proceed with this quest handoff: Player takes their seat at the negotiating table.
examples_yes: Tell me what needs to happen next.
examples_no: What are you asking me to do?
No, I do not want to do that.

beats.intent_summary: Player agrees to proceed with this quest handoff: Player takes their seat at the negotiating table.

beats.comment: Player negotiates the truce terms between Imperials and Stormcloaks, deciding which holds are exchanged.
The peace treaty is signed and the quest is complete.

title: The World-Eater's Eyrie
description: Odahviing reveals that Alduin has fled to Sovngarde through a portal at Skuldafn. The Dragonborn must free Odahviing, be flown to Skuldafn, fight through the temple, defeat the dragon priest Nahkriin, and enter the portal to Sovngarde.

base_facts: I am a dragon captured by the Whiterun guards at Dragonsreach.
Alduin has fled to Sovngarde through a portal at the ancient temple of Skuldafn in the Jerall Mountains.
I will fly you to Skuldafn if you set me free.

FREE_ODAHVIING: The Dragonborn has set me free. I will honor our bargain and fly them to Skuldafn.
TRAVEL_TO_SKULDAFN: I have flown the Dragonborn to Skuldafn as promised. My debt is repaid.
QUEST_COMPLETE: My bargain with the Dragonborn is fulfilled; they have entered Alduin's portal to Sovngarde.
The Dragonborn has reached Sovngarde to hunt Alduin, the path I revealed to them.

base_facts: I am a dragon priest guarding Alduin's portal to Sovngarde at the summit of Skuldafn.
None shall pass through the portal while I live.

QUEST_COMPLETE: I was slain by the Dragonborn as they forced their way into Alduin's portal.
The Dragonborn claimed my staff and used it to activate the Dragon Seal, opening the way to Sovngarde.
The Dragonborn took my dragon priest mask from my remains.

beats.comment: Player frees Odahviing from Dragonsreach to gain passage to Skuldafn.
Player tells Odahviing they are ready to travel and he flies them to Skuldafn.
Player arrives at Skuldafn and must fight through the temple to reach Alduin's portal.
Player defeats Nahkriin and enters Alduin's portal to Sovngarde.
Quest completes after the Dragonborn enters Sovngarde.

title: Sovngarde (quest)
description: The Dragonborn enters Sovngarde through Alduin's portal, navigates the soul-snaring mist where Alduin devours trapped souls, proves their worth to the gate guardian Tsun to enter the Hall of Valor, and enlists three ancient Nord heroes to join the final battle against Alduin.

base_facts: I am the gate guardian of Shor's Hall, the Hall of Valor.
All who wish to enter must prove their worth in a warrior's duel.
I challenge visitors regardless of the right they claim to enter.

REACH_HALL_OF_VALOR: The Dragonborn has proven their worth in combat and earned the right to enter the Hall of Valor.
HEROES_JOIN_BATTLE: The Dragonborn and the three ancient heroes combine their Thu'um to clear the soul-snaring mist from the valley.
I have fulfilled my duty as gate guardian by allowing the Dragonborn to enter and join the battle.
The warriors now march out to the misty valley to confront Alduin, leading into the Dragonslayer conflict.

base_facts: I am the founder of the Companions and harbinger of men.
I welcome worthy warriors who have proven themselves to Tsun into the Hall of Valor.

HEROES_JOIN_BATTLE: I directed the Dragonborn to the three ancient heroes, and they have agreed to join the fight.
The heroes of old now leave the Hall of Valor and march out to the misty valley.
They will combine their Shouts with the Dragonborn to dispel Alduin's mist and face the World-Eater.

base_facts: I am one of the three ancient Nord heroes who defeated Alduin long ago using the Dragonrend shout.
I have waited in Sovngarde for the day Alduin would return.

TALK_TO_HEROES: The Dragonborn has come to Sovngarde to defeat Alduin. We will join our Shouts with theirs to clear the mist and face the World-Eater again.
HEROES_JOIN_BATTLE: I will join my Thu'um with the Dragonborn's and my fellow heroes' to clear the soul-snaring mist.
Shor has permitted us to leave the Hall of Valor and join the battle against Alduin.
We now march out to the misty valley to confront the World-Eater and free the trapped souls.

base_facts: I am one of the three ancient Nord heroes who defeated Alduin long ago.
I have waited in Sovngarde for the day Alduin would return.

TALK_TO_HEROES: The Dragonborn has come to Sovngarde to defeat Alduin. We will join our Shouts with theirs to clear the mist and face the World-Eater again.
HEROES_JOIN_BATTLE: I will combine my Shout with the Dragonborn and my companions to dispel Alduin's mist.
By Shor's leave, we are permitted to join the Dragonborn in the final battle against the World-Eater.
We head out to the valley to fight Alduin and put an end to his soul devouring.

base_facts: I am one of the three ancient Nord heroes who defeated Alduin long ago.
I have waited in Sovngarde for the day Alduin would return.

TALK_TO_HEROES: The Dragonborn has come to Sovngarde to defeat Alduin. We will join our Shouts with theirs to clear the mist and face the World-Eater again.
HEROES_JOIN_BATTLE: I will add my voice to the Dragonborn's and my fellow heroes' to clear the mist from Sovngarde.
Shor has granted us leave to join the Dragonborn in battle against Alduin.
We march to the misty valley to face the World-Eater and destroy him once and for all.

beats.comment: Player arrives in Sovngarde through Alduin's portal and must find a way to defeat Alduin.
Player navigates the soul-snaring mist and must defeat Tsun in combat to gain entry to the Hall of Valor.
Player speaks with the three ancient heroes inside the Hall of Valor who agree to help.
The three heroes join the Dragonborn to clear the mist and face Alduin. Quest completes and transitions to Dragonslayer.

title: Dragonslayer
description: The Dragonborn joins the three heroes of SovngardeÃ¢â‚¬â€Hakon One-Eye, Gormlaith Golden-Hilt, and Felldir the OldÃ¢â‚¬â€to dispel Alduin's mist with Clear Skies and defeat the World-Eater in final combat, freeing Sovngarde and Skyrim from his tyranny.

base_facts: I am Hakon One-Eye, one of the three Nord heroes who first fought Alduin long ago.
We used Dragonrend to force Alduin to the ground in our first battle.
I stand in Sovngarde ready to help the Dragonborn defeat Alduin once and for all.

HEROES_UNITE: The Dragonborn has joined us at the edge of the Shadowed Vale to face Alduin.
DISPEL_MIST: Together we used Clear Skies to blow away Alduin's mist. He must face us now.
ALDUIN_DEFEATED: Alduin is destroyed at last. Sovngarde and Skyrim are free from his shadow.

base_facts: I am Gormlaith Golden-Hilt, one of the three heroes of Sovngarde.
I fell in battle against Alduin long ago, but my spirit endures here.
We will use Clear Skies together to blow away Alduin's mist.

HEROES_UNITE: The Dragonborn stands beside us. Together we are strong enough.
DISPEL_MIST: Our combined Thu'um has cleared the mist. Alduin can no longer hide.
ALDUIN_DEFEATED: The World-Eater is vanquished. Our long watch is finally over.

base_facts: I am Felldir the Old, one of the three Nord heroes who fought Alduin.
We recorded Dragonrend on the Dragon Wall so future generations could use it against him.
I am ready to help the Dragonborn end Alduin's reign of terror.

HEROES_UNITE: The Dragonborn has come to Sovngarde to join our final stand.
DISPEL_MIST: We have dispelled Alduin's mist with our Shouts. Now he must fight us directly.
ALDUIN_DEFEATED: Alduin is no more. The prophecy is fulfilled and the World-Eater is gone.

beats.comment: The three heroes assemble with the Dragonborn at the edge of the Shadowed Vale to dispel Alduin's mist.
The heroes use Clear Skies three times to dispel Alduin's mist, forcing him into open battle.
Alduin is defeated in combat. Tsun teaches Call of Valor and returns the Dragonborn to Tamriel.

title: Paarthurnax (quest)
description: The Blades demand the Dragonborn kill Paarthurnax for his crimes during the Dragon War, refusing further aid until the deed is done. The Greybeards oppose this demand, forcing a choice between the two factions.

base_facts: I am the acting Grandmaster of the Blades.
Paarthurnax was Alduin's chief ally during the Dragon War and committed unforgivable atrocities.
Our oaths as Blades demand Paarthurnax's death before we can offer the Dragonborn further aid.

PAARTHURNAX_KILLED: The Dragonborn has killed Paarthurnax. I will speak with them again.
QUEST_COMPLETE: Paarthurnax is dead. The Blades welcome the Dragonborn back fully.

base_facts: Paarthurnax's war crimes during the Dragon War are still remembered thousands of years later.
The Blades cannot aid the Dragonborn while Paarthurnax lives.
Paarthurnax's betrayal of Alduin only proves he cannot be trusted.

QUEST_COMPLETE: Paarthurnax is dead. The Blades can once again support the Dragonborn against Alduin.

base_facts: Paarthurnax is the Master of the Greybeards.
All dragons served Alduin in the beginning; Paarthurnax could not help his nature.
Paarthurnax rebelled against Alduin and was instrumental in his first defeat.
Paarthurnax has overcome his violent nature through the Way of the Voice.

PAARTHURNAX_KILLED: The Dragonborn has murdered Paarthurnax. The Greybeards' hospitality is revoked.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I will never forgive the Dragonborn for Paarthurnax's murder. We have nothing to say to each other.

beats.comment: Quest starts; Blades demand Paarthurnax's death and refuse further aid.
Player consults Arngeir about the Blades' demand to kill Paarthurnax.
Player talks to Paarthurnax about his past and the Way of the Voice.
Paarthurnax has been killed; player must report back to the Blades.
Quest complete; Blades welcome Dragonborn back, Greybeards are outraged.

title: The Forsworn Conspiracy
description: Investigate the Forsworn conspiracy in Markarth after a woman named Margret is attacked in the marketplace. Eltrys asks you to uncover who is behind the Forsworn attacks and why the guards do nothing.

base_facts: I am a Breton living in Markarth.
My father was killed by the Forsworn.
I have spent my whole life trying to find out why the Forsworn attack and why the guards do nothing.
I meet contacts at the Shrine of Talos beneath the Temple of Dibella.

NOTE_AND_MEETING: I slipped a note to someone who witnessed the marketplace attack and asked them to meet me at the Shrine of Talos.
INVESTIGATION_BEGINS: I have hired someone to investigate the Forsworn conspiracy and will pay for any information they bring.
RETURN_TO_ELTRYS: I am compiling all the evidence my investigator has uncovered about the Forsworn conspiracy.
QUEST_COMPLETION: I was murdered at the Shrine of Talos after the player returned with the evidence.
Markarth guards are waiting at the shrine and frame the player for my murder to silence the investigation.
My death leads to the player's arrest and imprisonment in Cidhna Mine, starting the quest 'No One Escapes Cidhna Mine'.
The player must now locate Madanach, the King in Rags, inside Cidhna Mine to clear their name.

base_facts: I was attacked in the Markarth marketplace by a man named Weylin.
I rented a room at the Silver-Blood Inn.

MARGRET_EVIDENCE: I revealed that I am an Imperial spy working with General Tullius to investigate the Silver-Blood family and the Treasury House.
Thonar Silver-Blood arranged for my murder.

base_facts: I was a Breton who worked as a smelter at Cidhna Mine.
I lived in the Warrens in Markarth.
I shouted 'The Reach belongs to the Forsworn' when I attacked Margret.
I am Thonar Silver-Blood, head of the Treasury House.
The Silver-Blood family controls Markarth's wealth and Cidhna Mine.

THONAR_EVIDENCE: I admitted that I have been controlling the Forsworn by imprisoning their king Madanach in Cidhna Mine.
Madanach has become out of control and ordered the attack on my wife Betrid.

base_facts: I am Nepos the Nose, an old man living in Nepos's House in Markarth.
I am a Forsworn agent loyal to Madanach, the King in Rags.
I receive orders from Madanach, who is imprisoned in Cidhna Mine.

NEPOS_EVIDENCE: I confessed that I am the 'N' who directed Weylin to attack Margret on Madanach's orders.
I ordered Dryston to rough up anyone investigating the conspiracy.

beats.comment: Player receives Eltrys's note and meets him at the Shrine of Talos to begin the investigation.
Eltrys asks the player to find evidence about Margret and Weylin surrounding the Forsworn attack.
Player discovers Margret was an Imperial spy investigating the Silver-Bloods, either by reading her journal or persuading her.
Player finds Weylin's note revealing a puppet-master named 'N' and learns Nepos is behind it after Dryston's brawl.
Player confronts Thonar at the Treasury House and learns he has been controlling the Forsworn through Madanach.
Player confronts Nepos who confesses to being a Forsworn agent taking orders from Madanach and directing Weylin.
Player returns to Eltrys at the Shrine of Talos after both Thonar and Nepos have confessed their roles.
Eltrys is found dead and the player is framed for his murder, leading to imprisonment in Cidhna Mine.

title: No One Escapes Cidhna Mine
description: Imprisoned in Cidhna Mine after The Forsworn Conspiracy, the player must find Madanach the King in Rags to clear their name. Side with Madanach and escape with the Forsworn, or kill him and earn Thonar Silver-Blood's pardon.

base_facts: I am the King in Rags, leader of the Forsworn imprisoned in Cidhna Mine.
I control access through my bodyguard Borkul the Beast.
I want to escape and resume the war for the Reach.

MEET_MADANACH: The new prisoner seeks me out to clear their name.
PROVE_LOYALTY: This prisoner proved loyalty by killing Grisvar. They are now an honorary Forsworn.
ESCAPE_WITH_MADANACH: We escape through the tunnels. The Forsworn will reclaim the Reach.

base_facts: I am Madanach's bodyguard. No one sees him without paying a toll.
I accept a shiv, a brawl, intimidation, or persuasion as payment.

GET_PAST_BORKUL: The new prisoner found a way past me.

base_facts: I am a prisoner in Cidhna Mine who knows the ways of this place.
You must get past Borkul the Beast to reach Madanach.
I am a prisoner with a tragic story of what the Nords did to my family.
Madanach sends new prisoners to hear my tale so they understand our cause.

PROVE_LOYALTY: I shared my story of injustice with the new prisoner.

base_facts: I am a prisoner known as Grisvar the Unlucky.
I trade shivs for skooma.
I own Cidhna Mine and control the Silver-Blood family's interests in Markarth.
I will pardon any prisoner who kills Madanach.

THONAR_PARDON_COMPLETE: The prisoner killed Madanach as I demanded. I granted them a full pardon and their name is cleared in the Reach.
I returned their confiscated equipment and gave them the Silver-Blood Family Ring as reward for eliminating the King in Rags.
With Madanach dead, the Forsworn leadership inside Cidhna Mine is broken. My control over Markarth and its silver operations remains secure.

beats.comment: Player arrives in Cidhna Mine after The Forsworn Conspiracy and going to jail.
Player gets past Borkul to reach Madanach's area by brawl, bribe, shiv, or persuasion.
Player talks to Madanach, the King in Rags. Branching point for two paths.
Player hears Braig's story, kills Grisvar the Unlucky, and returns to Madanach proving loyalty.
Player follows Madanach and the Forsworn through the escape tunnels to Markarth Ruins.
Quest completes after escaping with Madanach. Forsworn clear the player's name in the Reach.
Player kills Madanach, searches his body, reads his note, and escapes Cidhna Mine alone.
Quest completes after killing Madanach. Thonar Silver-Blood grants a pardon and clears the player's name.

title: Promises to Keep
description: Louis Letrush asks the player to retrieve a horse named Frost from Sibbi Black-Briar, who is jailed in Riften. Sibbi reveals Frost belongs to Maven Black-Briar and offers payment to steal the horse from Black-Briar Lodge along with its lineage papers.

base_facts: I purchased a horse named Frost from Sibbi Black-Briar but the deal was never finalized before Sibbi was arrested.
I want someone to speak with Sibbi in Riften Jail and deliver Frost and the lineage papers to me.
I can be found at the Bee and Barb in Riften.

LISTEN_TO_OFFER: I have asked someone to help me get Frost from Sibbi Black-Briar.
RETURN_TO_LOUIS: This person has returned with Frost and the lineage papers.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I have paid leveled gold for the delivery of Frost and the lineage papers, and I intend to ride the horse to Whiterun Stables.
If I was persuaded or blackmailed with the threat of exposing the theft to Maven, I surrendered both the payment and the horse and fled.
If I was threatened with death, I may have fought or fled; either way I no longer consider the matter settled.
I may later send hired thugs after anyone who cheated me out of Frost.

base_facts: I am locked up in Riften Jail.
I sold a horse named Frost to Louis Letrush but the deal was not finished before I was arrested.
Frost actually belongs to the Black-Briar estate, not me personally.

SPEAK_TO_SIBBI: I have asked someone to steal Frost from Black-Briar Lodge and deliver him to Louis, and I will pay them for it.
The lineage papers are at Black-Briar Lodge.

base_facts: I own the Black-Briar Lodge and all its property, including the horse Frost.
I would not approve of anyone stealing from my estate.

beats.comment: Player hears Louis Letrush's offer about retrieving Frost from Sibbi.
Player speaks to Sibbi in Riften Jail and learns Frost belongs to Maven.
Player steals Frost's lineage papers from Black-Briar Lodge.
Player steals the horse Frost from Black-Briar Lodge stables.
Player returns to Louis Letrush with Frost and the lineage papers for reward.
Quest completes after Louis rewards the player. Player may keep Frost through persuasion or threats.

title: Unfathomable Depths
description: A disturbed Argonian named From-Deepest-Fathoms wanders the Riften docks, haunted by memories from a Dwemer Lexicon. She begs the player to take the Lexicon and return it to Avanchnzel, a Dwemer ruin in the Jerall Mountains. Inside, ghostly echoes of a doomed expedition reveal the fate of four adventurers who sought the Lexicon's knowledge. Returning the Lexicon to its receptacle grants the passive effect Ancient Knowledge.

base_facts: I am an Argonian wandering the Riften docks, tormented by memories that are not my own.
I carry a Dwemer Lexicon that fills my mind with unbearable visions of the past.
I must find someone to take the Lexicon back to Avanchnzel and free me of this burden.

ENCOUNTER_FROM_DEEPEST_FATHOMS: I have told the stranger about the Lexicon and begged them to take it from me.
The memories from the Lexicon are driving me mad; I cannot keep it any longer.
ACCEPT_THE_LEXICON: I have handed the Lexicon to the stranger. They must return it to Avanchnzel in the west.
I feel relief now that the Lexicon is no longer in my possession.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The stranger has returned the Lexicon to Avanchnzel, fulfilling my desperate plea.
I am finally free of the unbearable visions and memories that tormented me on the Riften docks.
My mind is my own again, no longer haunted by the doomed expedition's fate.
I can finally find peace now that the Dwemer artifact is back where it belongs.

beats.comment: Player meets From-Deepest-Fathoms on the Riften docks and learns about the Lexicon and Avanchnzel. Quest is at stage 10.
Player accepts the Lexicon from From-Deepest-Fathoms. Quest advances to stage 100 and the objective is displayed.
Player has traveled through Avanchnzel and placed the Lexicon on its receptacle. The game sets stage 900.
Quest finishes at stage 1000. Player receives the Ancient Knowledge passive effect.

title: Tending the Flames
description: Help the Bards College save the Burning of King Olaf festival by retrieving King Olaf's Verse from Dead Men's Respite, improvising missing parts for the Jarl's court, and preparing the festival effigy.

base_facts: I am the Headmaster of the Bards College in Solitude.
The Burning of King Olaf festival has been canceled by Jarl Elisif the Fair due to High King Torygg's death.
I need King Olaf's Verse from the Poetic Edda to convince the Jarl to allow the festival.

FIND_VERSE: The player has agreed to retrieve King Olaf's Verse from Dead Men's Respite.
RETURN_AND_RECONSTRUCT: The player returned with the Verse but parts are decayed. We must improvise the missing sections to save the festival.
COURT_PERFORMANCE: The court accepted our performance of King Olaf's Verse. The player should speak to me about joining the College.
COMPLETION: The Burning of King Olaf festival has been successfully restored and held in Solitude.
The player has been formally inducted into the Bards College as a new member.
Viarmo rewarded the player with leveled gold for their service to the College.
Viarmo's disposition toward the player has increased for saving the festival.

base_facts: I am preparing the effigy of King Olaf for the Burning of King Olaf festival at the Bards College.

FESTIVAL_PREP: I need General Tullius' coat to finish the effigy. The player must steal it for me.
FESTIVAL: The player brought the coat. The effigy is ready and the festival can begin after dusk.
COMPLETION: The effigy of King Olaf was successfully burned at the festival.
Jorn's disposition toward the player has increased for helping complete the effigy and restore the festival.

base_facts: I am the Dean of History at the Bards College.
I believe King Olaf's Verse can be found in Dead Men's Respite, which may also be King Olaf's burial tomb.

COMPLETION: Giraud's disposition toward the player has increased following the festival's success.
The player's retrieval of King Olaf's Verse from Dead Men's Respite vindicated Giraud's theory about the tomb.

beats.comment: Player accepts the task to find King Olaf's Verse at Dead Men's Respite.
Player returns with the Verse and helps Viarmo reconstruct the decayed parts through improvisation.
Player attends Viarmo's performance at the Blue Palace and speaks to him after the court accepts the Verse.
Player speaks to Jorn and must steal General Tullius' coat for the effigy.
Player places the coat on the effigy and attends the Burning of King Olaf.
Player is inducted into the Bards College after the festival.

title: The Wolf Queen Awakened
description: Potema the Wolf Queen has escaped her binding and is gathering power in her catacombs beneath Solitude. Falk Firebeard sends the player to Styrr for the key, then into Potema's Catacombs to defeat her and retrieve her remains for sanctification.

base_facts: I am the steward of the Blue Palace in Solitude.
Potema the Wolf Queen has escaped her binding ritual and must be stopped.
I sent a letter warning of the threat and requesting the adventurer's return.
Styrr the priest of Arkay can provide guidance and the key to Potema's Catacombs.

MS06_STAGE_50: I have sent the adventurer to speak with Styrr about how to stop Potema.
MS06_COMPLETE: Potema has been defeated and her remains sanctified. I spoke on behalf of the jarl to express our gratitude and rewarded the adventurer with gold and the Shield of Solitude.
The threat of the Wolf Queen's full resurrection has been ended for Solitude and Haafingar.
The Shield of Solitude carries a unique Resist Magic enchantment not found elsewhere, a worthy gift for one who saved the city.
A courier may deliver a follow-up letter concerning further Wolf Queen business if circumstances permit.

base_facts: I am a priest of Arkay at Solitude's Hall of the Dead.
Potema was a formidable necromancer and former Queen of Solitude who raised armies of the dead.
Potema's remains must be sanctified to prevent her full resurrection.
I hold the key to Potema's Catacombs beneath the Temple of the Divines.

MS06_STAGE_50: I gave the adventurer the key to Potema's Catacombs and the spell Turn Undead.
MS06_STAGE_150: I have received Potema's remains and will bless them to prevent her return.
MS06_COMPLETE: I have blessed Potema's remains to ensure the Wolf Queen can never return in corporeal form.
The adventurer who retrieved Potema's skull has earned my gratitude and that of Arkay's faithful.
By returning Potema's remains for sanctification, the adventurer has done a great service to the people of Haafingar.

beats.comment: Player sent to speak with Styrr about Potema and receive the catacombs key.
Player enters Potema's Catacombs to confront and defeat Potema.
Player retrieves Potema's skull from the throne in the sanctum.
Player returns Potema's remains to Styrr for blessing and must report to Falk.
Quest complete. Falk rewards the player with gold and the Shield of Solitude.

title: The Man Who Cried Wolf
description: Varnius Junius appeals to the Solitude court about strange occurrences near Wolfskull Cave. Falk Firebeard asks the player to investigate, leading to the discovery of necromancers attempting to summon Potema the Wolf Queen.

base_facts: I am the steward of Solitude, serving Jarl Elisif the Fair.
I have my hands full dealing with the murder of High King Torygg, the grieving Elisif, and the ongoing war.
Varnius Junius came from Dragon Bridge claiming strange occurrences near Wolfskull Cave, but I suspect he is overreacting.

HEAR_PLEA: Varnius Junius has appealed to the court about Wolfskull Cave. I need someone reliable to look into it.
ACCEPT_QUEST: I have asked the player to investigate Wolfskull Cave and clear out any threats.
CLEARED_CAVE: Necromancers tried to summon Potema in Wolfskull Cave! I must hear the player's report immediately.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I rewarded the player with a leveled amount of gold for stopping the necromancers.
I told the player they have done Solitude a larger service than they can imagine.
I am deeply concerned that Potema is far from defeated despite the interrupted ritual.
I will soon send a concerned letter via courier to the player, beginning the quest The Wolf Queen Awakened.

base_facts: I am a resident of Dragon Bridge. Unnatural magics are coming from Wolfskull Cave.
Strange noises, lights, and disappearances plague the area near the cave. We need someone to investigate.

HEAR_PLEA: I have appealed to Jarl Elisif for help. Falk Firebeard said he would send someone to deal with the cave.

beats.comment: Player witnesses Varnius Junius appealing to the court or hears about Wolfskull Cave, starting the quest at stage 15.
Player agrees to investigate Wolfskull Cave for Falk Firebeard, advancing to stage 50.
Player has cleared Wolfskull Cave and stopped the ritual to summon Potema, reaching stage 100.
Player reports back to Falk Firebeard about stopping the necromancers, completing the quest at stage 250.

title: Lights Out!
description: Jaree-Ra on the Solitude docks offers a scheme to extinguish the lighthouse fire and plunder a wrecked ship, but the Argonian siblings betray you and you must fight through the Blackblood Marauders to survive.

base_facts: I am an Argonian at the Solitude docks with a profitable offer.
I want someone to put out the Solitude Lighthouse fire so the Icerunner crashes on the rocks.
I promised the crew would not be harmed and there would be a share of the plunder.
I plan to betray my partner and keep all the loot at Broken Oar Grotto.

JAREE_RA_OFFER: I have recruited someone to extinguish the lighthouse beacon. I told them to meet me at the docks afterward.
RETURN_TO_JAREE_RA: The lighthouse fire is out and the Icerunner never made it to port. I sent my partner to find Deeja at the wreck.
HUNT_JAREE_RA: My sister Deeja is dead and my partner knows I betrayed them. I am at Broken Oar Grotto with the loot.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I have been killed at Broken Oar Grotto by the partner I betrayed.
My body and the nearby chest contain the gold and gems plundered from the Icerunner.
My Blackblood Marauders have been wiped out and the Icerunner's loot is lost to my partner.

base_facts: I am Jaree-Ra's sister and a Blackblood Marauder.
I am waiting at the Wreck of the Icerunner for Jaree-Ra's partner.
I have no intention of sharing the plunder. I will kill them once they arrive.

DEEJA_BETRAYAL_AND_DEFEAT: My partner has arrived at the wreck. The plunder has already been moved. Time to dispose of them.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I was killed at the Wreck of the Icerunner after revealing my betrayal.
The note looted from my body exposed Jaree-Ra's location and his orders to dispose of me.

beats.comment: Player hears Jaree-Ra's offer to extinguish the lighthouse fire for a share of plunder.
Player extinguishes the Solitude Lighthouse fire.
Player returns to Jaree-Ra at the docks after extinguishing the fire.
Player finds Deeja at the wreck; she betrays them and attacks. Player must defeat her and finds Jaree-Ra's note.
Player learns from Deeja's note that Jaree-Ra took the loot to Broken Oar Grotto and travels there.
Player confronts and defeats Jaree-Ra at Broken Oar Grotto.
Quest complete after defeating Jaree-Ra and his bandits.

title: In My Time Of Need
description: Alik'r Warriors search Whiterun for a Redguard woman. The player must choose between helping Saadia, who claims to be a fugitive noble hunted by Dominion assassins, or helping Kematu, who claims Saadia is a traitor who sold out Taneth to the Aldmeri Dominion.

base_facts: I work at The Bannered Mare in Whiterun under the name Saadia.
My real name is Iman, a noble of House Suda in Hammerfell.
I spoke out against the Aldmeri Dominion and now they have sent assassins after me.
The Alik'r warriors are those assassins, sent to deport me for execution.

MEET_SAADIA: The player knows I am being hunted by the Alik'r and I have asked for their help.
KILL_KEMATU: The player killed Kematu and I am safe for now. I rewarded them with gold.
DELIVER_SAADIA: The player betrayed me and led me into Kematu's trap at the stables.
QUEST_COMPLETE: If the player killed Kematu, I rewarded them with 500 gold and believe the remaining Alik'r will scatter, affording me some safety for now.
If the player betrayed me to Kematu, I was paralyzed at the Whiterun Stables and will be taken back to Hammerfell alive to face trial for treason.
I remain at the Bannered Mare if Kematu is dead; if handed over, I am gone from Whiterun entirely and no urn appears in the Hall of the Dead.

base_facts: I lead the Alik'r warriors searching for the Redguard woman in Whiterun.
We are not assassins. We serve the noble houses of Hammerfell.
Saadia is a traitor who sold the city of Taneth to the Aldmeri Dominion during the Great War.
We intend to bring her back to Hammerfell alive to face justice.

CONFRONT_KEMATU: The player found me in Swindler's Den and I explained the truth about Saadia.
DELIVER_SAADIA: The player delivered Saadia to me. I will take her back to Hammerfell alive.
QUEST_COMPLETE: If the player delivered Saadia to me, I paralyzed her at the Whiterun Stables and will escort her back to Hammerfell alive to face justice, though her fate after that is no longer in my hands.
I paid the player 500 gold for their assistance in capturing Saadia, and my disposition toward them increased.
If the player chose to fight, I am dead in Swindler's Den and my corpse carries 100 gold, two scimitars, and Hammerfell garb.

beats.comment: Player learns Alik'r warriors are searching Whiterun for a Redguard woman.
Player finds Saadia at The Bannered Mare and hears her claim of being hunted by Dominion assassins.
Player learns the Alik'r hideout is at Swindler's Den, either from the prisoner or prior knowledge.
Player enters Swindler's Den and confronts Kematu, who reveals Saadia is a traitor to Hammerfell.
Player kills Kematu and must return to Saadia for a reward.
Player lures Saadia to the Whiterun Stables where Kematu captures her with a paralysis spell.
Quest ends either by helping Saadia kill Kematu or delivering her to Kematu for justice.

title: Missing In Action
description: Fralia Gray-Mane believes her missing son Thorald is still alive and held captive. The player must find proof of his fate from the Battle-Born family, then rescue Thorald from Thalmor custody at Northwatch Keep and deliver his message to Fralia.

base_facts: I believe my son Thorald is still alive, not dead as the Battle-Borns claim.
I argued with Idolaf and Olfrid Battle-Born in the market about Thorald's fate.
It is not safe to discuss Thorald in the open; I asked the player to meet me at my home.

LEARN_OF_THORALD: The player has come to my home to discuss Thorald privately.
RETURN_TO_FRALIA: The player delivered Thorald's secret messageâ€”'Suffer the winter's cold wind, for it bears aloft next summer's seeds'â€”and I completed the phrase, confirming my son truly lives.
Thorald cannot come home to Whiterun, but knowing he is alive is enough for me. I called the player a dear friend for giving me back my son.
I rewarded the player with the enchanted weapon Eorlund forged for Thoraldâ€”or 200 gold if Eorlund has passed away.
My disposition toward the player has improved from gratitude for confirming Thorald's survival and delivering his message.

base_facts: I am hiding in House Gray-Mane because the Imperials would arrest me if found.
I know Thorald is not dead. The Battle-Borns have proof of what happened to him.
I need someone to search the Battle-Born house for evidence since I cannot leave.

DELIVER_PROOF: The player brought me proof that Thorald is alive at Northwatch Keep.
RESCUE_THORALD: The player has gone to Northwatch Keep to rescue Thorald.
RETURN_TO_FRALIA: If I accompanied the player to Northwatch Keep, I followed Thorald to join the Stormcloaks. If I stayed behind, Thorald urged me to leave Whiterunâ€”and I have already departed by the time the player returns.
My disposition toward the player has improved for helping rescue my brother from Thalmor custody.

base_facts: I am a Stormcloak supporter captured by the Thalmor and held at Northwatch Keep.
I cannot return to Whiterun; it is too dangerous for my family.

RESCUE_THORALD: The player freed me from Northwatch Keep. I asked them to tell my mother: 'Suffer the winter's cold wind, for it bears aloft next summer's seeds.'
RETURN_TO_FRALIA: I have departed to join the Stormcloaks; returning to Whiterun would endanger my family with the Thalmor hunting me.
I entrusted the player with my secret message to Mother before leaving Northwatch Keep, and the player has now delivered it.
My disposition toward the player has improved for freeing me and carrying my words home.

base_facts: Our families were once friends, but the civil war set the Gray-Manes and Battle-Borns against each other.
Thorald chose the Stormcloak side and that was his mistake.

beats.comment: Player overhears the feud and meets Fralia at her home to learn about Thorald.
Player searches the Battle-Born house for the imperial missive proving Thorald's fate.
Player delivers the missive to Avulstein, who proposes a rescue of Northwatch Keep.
Player assaults Northwatch Keep, kills the interrogator, frees Thorald, and leads him to safety.
Player returns to Fralia and delivers Thorald's secret message, completing the quest.

title: Rise in the East
description: Help the East Empire Company reopen its Windhelm office by eliminating the Blood Horker pirate base at Japhet's Folly.

base_facts: I work for the East Empire Company in Windhelm.
Pirate attacks have shut down our shipping operations.
I suspect the Shatter-Shield clan is connected to the pirates.
Suvaris Atheron keeps a logbook that may contain evidence of the connection.

RETURN_LOGBOOK: The logbook proves Suvaris met with Blood Horker pirates in Dawnstar.
INVESTIGATE_DAWNSTAR: Adelaisa Vendicci has arrived from the Company to oversee the operation.
COMPLETE_QUEST: The Blood Horker base at Japhet's Folly has been destroyed and the Windhelm office can finally reopen.
He paid the player leveled gold for eliminating the pirate threat to East Empire Company operations.
His disposition toward the player has improved from 0 to 1.
East Empire Company shipping can now resume from Windhelm without pirate interference.

base_facts: I am a superior in the East Empire Company.
I have come to Windhelm to deal with the pirate problem personally.

ASSAULT_JAPHET: We sail to Japhet's Folly to destroy the Blood Horker base.
Haldyn's battlemage magic creates the fog around the island.
KILL_HALDYN: With Haldyn dead the fog has lifted and our ships can attack.
COMPLETE_QUEST: She survived the assault on Japhet's Folly and returned safely to Windhelm.
She now offers to travel with and aid the player as a follower.
Her disposition toward the player has improved from 0 to 1.
She credits the player with destroying the Blood Horkers and saving the Company's Windhelm operations.

base_facts: I captain the Blood Horkers.
I drink at the Windpeak Inn in Dawnstar.
Haldyn is our secret weapon, a powerful battlemage.
Our base is at Japhet's Folly.

beats.comment: Player talks to Orthus and accepts the quest to help the East Empire Company.
Player steals Suvaris Atheron's logbook and gives it to Orthus.
Player talks to Stig Salt-Plank in Dawnstar and reports back to Orthus.
Player departs for Japhet's Folly with Adelaisa.
Player kills Haldyn the battlemage at Japhet's Folly.
Player reports to Adelaisa, returns to Windhelm, and speaks to Orthus to complete the quest.

title: Blood on the Ice
description: A serial killer known as the Butcher stalks Windhelm. Investigate the graveyard murder, follow the trail of blood to Hjerim, gather evidence, and uncover the true killer's identity before they strike again.

base_facts: I am the steward of Windhelm, serving under Ulfric Stormcloak in the Palace of the Kings.
A serial killer called the Butcher has been murdering citizens of Windhelm.

CRIME_SCENE: The Dragonborn has offered to help investigate the latest Butcher murder.
HJERIM_INVESTIGATION: The investigation has led to Hjerim, the abandoned house where Friga Shatter-Shield was killed.
CLUE_FOLLOWUP: The strange amulet and pamphlets from Hjerim may point toward the killer.
KILLER_CAUGHT: The Butcher has been caught and brought to justice.
WRONG_ACCUSATION: I ordered Wuunferth's arrest based on the evidence presented, believing him to be the Butcher.
If the killings resume, it will prove Wuunferth was innocent and the true killer still stalks Windhelm.

base_facts: I work in Windhelm's Hall of the Dead preparing bodies for burial.
I have life-long experience examining dead bodies.

CRIME_SCENE: Susanna's coin purse was intact, so robbery was not the motive.
The cuts on Susanna's body were made with a curved embalming blade.

base_facts: I am an Imperial living in Windhelm.
I wrote the 'Beware the Butcher!' pamphlets warning people about the killer.

CLUE_FOLLOWUP: The evidence from Hjerim points toward someone experimenting with Necromancy.
Wuunferth the Unliving, the court mage, may be involved.

base_facts: I run the House of Curiosities in Windhelm, a small museum of curios from my travels.
My sister and I opened the museum together before she passed away.

CLUE_FOLLOWUP: I identified the strange amulet as a Wheelstone, traditionally carried by court mages.
I offered to buy the amulet for 500 gold.
KILLER_CAUGHT: I was the Butcher all along, and have been brought to justice.

base_facts: I am the court mage of Windhelm, serving in the Palace of the Kings.

WRONG_ACCUSATION: I have been wrongly accused of being the Butcher and imprisoned in the Palace of the Kings.
The Wheelstone amulet and suspicions of necromancy were misinterpreted as proof of my guilt.
With me locked away, the real killer remains free and will murder again in Windhelm.
I will only be exonerated if the true Butcher is caught while I sit in the dungeons.
KILLER_CAUGHT: I was wrongly accused; the real killer has finally been caught.

beats.comment: Player discovers the murder scene in the graveyard and begins the investigation.
Player gains access to Hjerim and searches for clues in the abandoned house, finding pamphlets, journals, a strange amulet, and a hidden chamber.
Player follows up on clues from Hjerim by consulting Calixto about the amulet and Viola about the Butcher pamphlets.
Player accuses Wuunferth of being the Butcher based on the evidence, leading to his wrongful arrest. Premature quest finish; the real killer will strike again.
Player catches the real killer, Calixto Corrium, during the nighttime patrol and brings him to justice. True quest completion.

title: The White Phial
description: Nurelion, an elderly and dying alchemist in Windhelm, asks the player to retrieve the legendary White Phial from Forsaken Cave, where it is buried with its maker Curalmil. The Phial turns out to be cracked and useless, devastating Nurelion. His assistant Quintus Navale provides the true reward of 500 gold.

base_facts: I am an old and sick alchemist who owns The White Phial shop in Windhelm.
I have spent my entire life searching for the legendary White Phial.
The White Phial is buried with its maker Curalmil in Forsaken Cave to the west.
I have prepared a mixture to bypass Curalmil's alchemical protections in his tomb.

NURELION_REQUEST: I have sent an adventurer to retrieve the White Phial from Forsaken Cave.
RETURN_TO_NURELION: The White Phial was cracked and cannot hold liquid. I am devastated and have given up hope.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I am bedridden and dying; I will not wake or speak to anyone again.
The cracked Phial has broken my spirit completely and I have given up all hope.

base_facts: I am Nurelion's assistant at The White Phial shop in Windhelm.
My master is far too ill to undertake any journey himself.

QUEST_COMPLETE: I paid the adventurer 500 gold as proper compensation after my master gave them only 5 gold.
I am grateful the adventurer tried to help, even though my master was too heartbroken to be fair.
I have gone upstairs to watch over my master, who has taken to his bed and will not leave it again.
I may write to the adventurer in a few days if I find a way to repair the cracked Phial.

beats.comment: Nurelion asks the player to retrieve the White Phial from Forsaken Cave and gives them his mixture.
Player retrieves the Cracked White Phial from Forsaken Cave after defeating Curalmil and using Nurelion's mixture.
Player shows the cracked Phial to Nurelion, who is devastated and gives only 5 gold before retiring to bed.
Quintus thanks the player and pays 500 gold as proper compensation after Nurelion's meager reward.

title: Repairing the Phial
description: After the failed attempt to help Nurelion, his assistant Quintus Navale believes he can repair the White Phial using three rare ingredients: Unmelting Snow from the Throat of the World, Mammoth Tusk Powder from Stonehill Bluff, and a Briar Heart from a Forsworn Briarheart. The Phial is repaired in time for Nurelion to see it before he dies.

base_facts: I am Nurelion's assistant at The White Phial shop in Windhelm.
My master Nurelion is dying and bedridden.
I believe I have found a way to repair the White Phial.

SPEAK_TO_QUINTUS: I need three ingredients to repair the Phial: Unmelting Snow from the Throat of the World, Mammoth Tusk Powder from the giants at Stonehill Bluff, and a Briar Heart from a Forsworn Briarheart.
RETURN_TO_QUINTUS: With all three ingredients I can finally repair the White Phial.
I will use the alchemy lab to perform the repair.
QUEST_COMPLETE: Nurelion saw the repaired Phial before he died peacefully.
I gave the White Phial to the player. Keeping it would only remind me of Nurelion's obsession.
The Phial will regenerate its contents every 24 hours.

base_facts: I am an old alchemist dying in my bed at The White Phial shop.
The White Phial was my life's work and greatest obsession.

QUEST_COMPLETE: I saw the repaired White Phial before I died. Marvelous.

beats.comment: Player speaks to Quintus about repairing the White Phial and learns the three ingredients needed.
Player is tasked with retrieving Unmelting Snow, Mammoth Tusk Powder, and a Briar Heart.
Player returns with all three ingredients and Quintus repairs the Phial at the alchemy lab.
Nurelion sees the repaired Phial and dies peacefully. Quintus gives the player the White Phial and they choose its regenerating potion type.

title: The Golden Claw
description: Lucan Valerius's antique Golden Claw was stolen from the Riverwood Trader by bandits who fled to Bleak Falls Barrow. Retrieve the claw, discover the barrow's secret, and return the claw to Lucan or Camilla for a gold reward.

base_facts: My antique Golden Claw was stolen from the Riverwood Trader by bandits.
I am offering a gold reward for its return from Bleak Falls Barrow.

QUEST_ACCEPTED: Someone has agreed to help retrieve the Golden Claw from Bleak Falls Barrow.
CLAW_RETURNED: The Golden Claw has been returned! I rewarded the hero generously.
VALERIUS_DEAD: Lucan Valerius is dead; the gold reward he promised for the Golden Claw is permanently unavailable.
The Riverwood Trader has lost its proprietor; no one remains there to accept the claw's return.
With both Valerius siblings dead, the bounty for retrieving the Golden Claw can never be collected.

base_facts: Our shop was robbed. The golden claw was stolen by bandits.
I can guide you to Bleak Falls Barrow to find the claw.

QUEST_ACCEPTED: Someone is heading to Bleak Falls Barrow to retrieve the Golden Claw. I offered to show them the way.
CLAW_RETURNED: The Golden Claw has been returned! I gave them a reward for their effort.
VALERIUS_DEAD: Camilla Valerius is dead; she can no longer guide anyone toward Bleak Falls Barrow.
The Riverwood Trader has lost both its owners.
The gold reward for returning the Golden Claw cannot be claimed from either sibling.

base_facts: I stole the golden claw from the Riverwood Trader and fled to Bleak Falls Barrow.
I am trapped in a spider's web deeper in the barrow.

ARVEL_ENCOUNTERED: Someone found me trapped in the spider's web. I promised to give them the claw if they cut me free.

beats.comment: Player learns about the stolen Golden Claw and accepts the quest from Lucan or overhears bandits.
Player finds Arvel trapped in a spider web and must decide to free him for the claw.
Player obtains the Golden Claw from Arvel's body and learns it is also a key.
Player solves the puzzle door using the claw and learns a Word of Power from the Word Wall.
Player returns the Golden Claw to Lucan or Camilla and receives a leveled gold reward.
Both Lucan and Camilla are dead; the quest reward is no longer available.

title: Laid to Rest
description: Investigate a mysterious house fire in Morthal that killed Hroggar's wife and child, uncover a vampire plot led by Alva and her master Movarth, and defend the town from the vampire threat.

base_facts: I am the Jarl of Morthal.
A house fire recently killed Hroggar's wife and daughter.
I need someone trustworthy to investigate the fire.

QUEST_STARTED: I have asked someone to investigate the burned house.
JOURNAL_SHOWN: Alva is a vampire who enthralled Hroggar and killed his family.
Movarth plans to enslave the entire town of Morthal.
I have sent a group led by Thonnir to deal with Movarth.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The vampire threat has been eliminated.
Morthal is safe now.

base_facts: My wife Laelette disappeared. She said she was joining the Stormcloaks.
She was spending a lot of time with Alva before she left.

HELGI_AND_LAELETTE: Laelette was turned into a vampire by Alva.
I need proof that Alva is a vampire before I will believe it.
JOURNAL_SHOWN: Alva was behind everything that happened to Laelette.
I will lead the mob against Movarth.
MOVARTH_DEFEATED: Movarth is dead. Laelette can rest now.

base_facts: My wife and daughter died in a house fire.
Alva and I are together now.

ALVA_EVIDENCE: I was enthralled by Alva. She made me turn a blind eye to everything.

base_facts: I live in Morthal.
Hroggar and I are together.

ALVA_EVIDENCE: I am a vampire serving Movarth.
I enthralled Hroggar and had his family killed.
I planned to enslave the town for our blood.

beats.comment: Player hears about the burned house from townspeople or guards before the quest formally starts.
Jarl asks player to investigate the fire. Stage 20.
Player investigates the burned house and encounters Helgi's ghost. Stage 30.
Player finds Helgi after dark, defeats Laelette the vampire, and speaks to Thonnir about Alva. Stage 60.
Player investigates Alva's house and finds her journal revealing the vampire plot against Morthal. Stage 70.
Player shows Alva's journal to the Jarl, who sends a mob led by Thonnir to Movarth's Lair. Stage 95.
Player kills Movarth the master vampire in his lair. Stage 100.
Player returns to the Jarl for a gold reward. Quest finishes at stage 200.

title: A Return To Your Roots
description: Discover the significance of the Crimson Nirnroot in Blackreach, collect thirty samples, and deliver them to Avrusa Sarethi at Sarethi Farm to continue Sinderion's research.

base_facts: I am a former student of the alchemist Sinderion.
I tend Sarethi Farm between Riften and Ivarstead.
Sinderion traveled to Blackreach to study the Crimson Nirnroot and never returned.
I would be grateful to anyone who completes Sinderion's field work.

CRIMSON_NIRNROOT_DISCOVERED: The player has discovered a Crimson Nirnroot in Blackreach.
SINDERION_JOURNAL_READ: The player found Sinderion's remains and read his field journal requesting thirty Crimson Nirnroot samples.
NIRNROOT_COLLECTED: The player has collected thirty Crimson Nirnroot samples from Blackreach.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I received the thirty Crimson Nirnroot samples and was overjoyed that Sinderion's field work in Blackreach was finally completed.
I pledged to continue Sinderion's research into the Crimson Nirnroot in his memory.
I gave the player The Nirnroot Missive and granted them Sinderion's Serendipity, an ability that provides a twenty-five percent chance to mix two potions instead of one.
With the Crimson Nirnroot delivered, Sinderion's research can now continue at Sarethi Farm.

beats.comment: Player discovers a Crimson Nirnroot in Blackreach, beginning the quest.
Player finds Sinderion's remains and reads his field journal in Blackreach.
Player has collected thirty Crimson Nirnroot samples and is ready to deliver them.
Player delivers thirty Crimson Nirnroot to Avrusa Sarethi, completing the quest.

title: Erik the Slayer
description: Erik in Rorikstead dreams of becoming an adventurer, but his father Mralki refuses to let him go and cannot afford armor. Convince Mralki to change his mind so Erik can pursue his dream.

base_facts: I want to be an adventurer more than anything.
My father Mralki won't let me leave the farm.
We can't afford to buy armor even if he did let me go.
I work as a farmer for Lemkil in Rorikstead.
I stay at the Frostfruit Inn in the evening.

ERIK_REQUEST: A stranger has agreed to talk to my father about letting me become an adventurer.
QUEST_COMPLETE: My father changed his mind! I'm going to be an adventurer. I'll call myself Erik the Slayer.
I hope you'll come back to Rorikstead soon. Maybe we can swap stories about our adventures over a mug of ale at the inn!
My father and I will be visiting Whiterun soon to get me fitted for iron armor.
I'm ready to follow you as a companion if you'll have me.

base_facts: I am the innkeeper of the Frostfruit Inn in Rorikstead.
My son Erik is all the family I have left.
I worry about Erik and don't want him adventuring.
The farm needs Erik, and we couldn't afford armor anyway.

CONVINCE_MRALKI: I've changed my mind about Erik. He can become an adventurer if he wants.
QUEST_COMPLETE: Erik knows I've changed my mind. He's excited to finally become an adventurer.
We'll be heading to Whiterun soon to get Erik properly fitted for armor.

beats.comment: Erik tells the player about his dream of becoming an adventurer and asks them to talk to his father Mralki.
Player convinces Mralki to let Erik become an adventurer through persuasion, intimidation, or bribery.
Player returns to Erik with the good news that his father has agreed to let him become an adventurer.

title: Delivery (Sorex)
description: After Roggvir's execution in Solitude, Sorex Vinius asks you to deliver a bottle of Stros M'Kai Rum to Falk Firebeard at the Blue Palace.

base_facts: I work at the Winking Skeever in Solitude.
Roggvir was a friend of mine before his execution.
Falk Firebeard is one of the leaders of Solitude.

SOREX_DISCUSSES_LEADERS: I told the player about who runs Solitude.
SOREX_ASKS_DELIVERY: I asked the player to deliver Stros M'Kai Rum to Falk Firebeard.
Sorex asks the player to deliver Stros M'Kai Rum to Falk Firebeard. Starts the quest at .
Upon delivering the rum, he will thank you and reward you with a leveled amount of gold to complete the quest.

Talking to Sorex after the execution will open up discussion about the leaders of Solitude; continuing the conversation will end with him asking you to bring a delivery of Stros M'Kai Rum to one of those leaders, Falk.

base_facts: I serve as steward in the Blue Palace.
I am usually found by Elisif the Fair's side in the main room.

DELIVER_RUM_TO_FALK: The player delivered the Stros M'Kai Rum from Sorex Vinius.

beats.comment: Player asks Sorex about who is in charge of Solitude after Roggvir's execution.
Sorex asks the player to deliver Stros M'Kai Rum to Falk Firebeard. Starts the quest at stage 10.
Player delivers the Stros M'Kai Rum to Falk Firebeard at the Blue Palace, completing the quest.

title: Elisif's Tribute
description: Elisif the Fair asks the player to place her late husband High King Torygg's War Horn at a Shrine of Talos, as she could not make offerings to Talos at his funeral due to the Empire's ban on Talos worship.

base_facts: I am the Jarl of Solitude and widow of High King Torygg.
I could not make offerings to Talos at my husband's funeral because Talos worship is outlawed in the Empire.
I wish someone would take Torygg's War Horn to a Shrine of Talos for a proper Nordic burial.

ELISIFS_TRIBUTE_LEARN: I have asked the player to take Torygg's War Horn to the Shrine of Talos in Whiterun Hold.
ELISIFS_TRIBUTE_ACCEPT: The player has agreed to take Torygg's War Horn to the Shrine of Talos.
ELISIFS_TRIBUTE_COMPLETE: The player placed Torygg's War Horn at the Shrine of Talos. I am grateful and have allowed them to purchase Proudspire Manor.
Player returns to Elisif after placing the horn. Quest completes and Proudspire Manor becomes available for purchase.

The Jarl's Good Grace [ edit ] Return to Elisif at the Blue Palace in Solitude where she will reaffirm her belief in you and allow you to purchase Proudspire Manor as well as take the next step to becoming a thane .
Follow the path near Shimmermist Cave , along the northern bank of the river, and you can find the shrine behind some trees.

beats.comment: Elisif shares her personal request about placing Torygg's War Horn at a Shrine of Talos.
Player accepts Elisif's request and the quest begins.
Player has placed Torygg's War Horn at the Shrine of Talos. Thalmor agents may attack at the shrine.
Player returns to Elisif after placing the horn. Quest completes and Proudspire Manor becomes available for purchase.

title: The Heart of Dibella
description: After being caught in the Inner Sanctum of the Temple of Dibella, the Dragonborn agrees to find the next SybilÃ¢â‚¬â€a young girl named Fjotra who has been kidnapped by the Forsworn at Broken Tower RedoubtÃ¢â‚¬â€and return her to the priestesses in Markarth.

base_facts: I am the Mother of the Inner Sanctum at the Temple of Dibella in Markarth.
We have been without a Sybil and seek the next girl chosen by Dibella.

FIND_SYBIL_TASK: An outsider has agreed to find our new Sybil. I directed them to Karthwasten.
PRAY_AT_ALTAR: Fjotra has been returned safely. I invited the outsider to pray at Dibella's altar to receive her blessing.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The outsider has received the Blessing of Dibella and is now an Agent of Dibella.
Quest completes after the player prays and receives the Agent of Dibella ability.

Please, lead on." A final farewell You must now return Fjotra to the Temple to become the new Sybil of Dibella, but you also can take a detour to Karthwasten, so Fjotra can say goodbye to her parents, Enmon and Mena .
(Optional) Start the Speak to Degaine quest.

base_facts: I work at the smelter in Karthwasten.
My daughter Fjotra was taken by the Forsworn from Broken Tower Redoubt.

RESCUE_FJOTRA: Someone has come to help rescue Fjotra from the Forsworn.

base_facts: I am the chosen Sybil of Dibella.
I was kidnapped by the Forsworn and held captive at Broken Tower Redoubt.

ESCORT_FJOTRA: I have been rescued. I am honored to serve as the new Sybil and will go to the Temple in Markarth.

beats.comment: Player agrees to find the new Sybil and is directed to Karthwasten.
Player learns Fjotra was kidnapped by Forsworn and must rescue her from Broken Tower Redoubt.
Fjotra is freed and must be escorted back to the Temple of Dibella.
Fjotra is returned; Hamal directs the player to pray at Dibella's altar for the blessing.
Quest completes after the player prays and receives the Agent of Dibella ability.

title: The Book of Love
description: Help the Temple of Mara spread love throughout Skyrim by aiding Fastred in Ivarstead, Calcelmo in Markarth, and reuniting the ghostly lovers Ruki and Fenrig.

base_facts: I am a priestess of Mara at the Temple of Mara in Riften.
Mara has given me visions of those who need help with love.
I ask travelers to act in Mara's name to aid troubled lovers.

IVARSTEAD_COMPLETE: The traveler helped Fastred find love in Ivarstead.
MARKARTH_COMPLETE: The traveler helped Calcelmo and Faleen find each other in Markarth.
GHOSTS_COMPLETE: The traveler reunited the ghostly lovers Ruki and Fenrig beyond death itself.
QUEST_COMPLETE: Mara's blessing has been bestowed upon the traveler for their service to love.
Quest finished. Dinya bestows Mara's blessing and the Agent of Mara reward.
Speak to Ruki then when you talk to Fenrig simply allow him to finish his lines.
The man you speak with will then proceed to meet with Fastred; they'll have a brief conversation which you must observe to advance the quest and ensure Mara's work is done.

base_facts: I live in Ivarstead with my parents Boti and Jofthor.
I am in love with Bassianus Axius but my father disapproves.

IVARSTEAD_COMPLETE: I have found love and left Ivarstead with Bassianus.

base_facts: I am a scholar and Dwemer researcher in Markarth.
I am hopelessly undone by Faleen but cannot bring myself to speak to her.

MARKARTH_COMPLETE: Faleen and I have confessed our love for each other.

base_facts: I am a Redguard warrior and housecarl in Markarth.
Yngvar the Singer is my friend.

MARKARTH_COMPLETE: Calcelmo and I have confessed our love for each other.

base_facts: I am a ghost searching for my love Fenrig at Gjukar's Monument.
I believe I am still alive and looking for Fenrig after a battle.

GHOSTS_COMPLETE: Fenrig and I have been reunited and ascended into the sky together.

base_facts: I am a ghost near Fort Greymoor, believing I am still alive and camping with Gjukar's army.
I was killed in an enemy raid the night before a battle.

GHOSTS_COMPLETE: Ruki and I have been reunited and ascended into the sky together.

beats.comment: Player agrees to help Dinya Balu spread Mara's love across Skyrim.
Player resolved Fastred's love situation in Ivarstead and returned to Dinya.
Player helped Calcelmo and Faleen confess their love and returned to Dinya.
Player reunited the ghostly lovers Ruki and Fenrig at Gjukar's Monument and returned to Dinya.
Quest finished. Dinya bestows Mara's blessing and the Agent of Mara reward.

title: The Blessings of Nature
description: Help Danica Pure-Spring restore the Gildergreen tree in Whiterun by retrieving Nettlebane from hagravens at Orphan Rock and obtaining sap from the Eldergleam, or a sapling through Maurice Jondrelle's peaceful intervention.

base_facts: I am the priestess of the Temple of Kynareth in Whiterun.
The Gildergreen tree outside the temple was struck by lightning and is dying.
Sap from the parent tree, the Eldergleam, can restore the Gildergreen.
A special dagger called Nettlebane is needed to cut the Eldergleam, held by hagravens at Orphan Rock.

GILDERGREEN_PROBLEM: Someone has asked about the Gildergreen's condition.
AGREE_TO_HELP: An adventurer has agreed to help restore the Gildergreen.
NETTLEBANE_RETURNED: The adventurer returned with Nettlebane from the hagravens.
ELDERGLEAM_MISSION: The adventurer has gone to the Eldergleam Sanctuary to retrieve sap.
SAPLING_CHOICE: The adventurer chose Maurice's peaceful path and took a sapling instead of cutting the Eldergleam.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The Gildergreen has been restored thanks to the adventurer's help.

base_facts: I am a pilgrim who traveled far to worship beneath the Gildergreen.
I am distressed that the sacred tree has withered.
I wish to visit the Eldergleam, the parent tree of the Gildergreen.

NETTLEBANE_RETURNED: I asked to accompany the adventurer to the Eldergleam Sanctuary.
ELDERGLEAM_MISSION: I am traveling with the adventurer to see the Eldergleam.
SAPLING_CHOICE: I prayed to the Eldergleam and a sapling appeared, sparing the ancient tree.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The Gildergreen will be renewed through a new sapling.

beats.comment: Player learns about the dying Gildergreen tree and Danica's need for help.
Player agrees to help Danica restore the Gildergreen by retrieving Nettlebane.
Player retrieved Nettlebane from the hagravens and brought it to Danica.
Danica sends player to the Eldergleam Sanctuary to retrieve sap.
Player chose Maurice's peaceful path and took a sapling instead of cutting the Eldergleam.
Quest complete - player returned with sap or sapling to restore the Gildergreen.

title: A Chance Arrangement
description: Brynjolf in Riften proposes a scheme to frame the vendor Brand-Shei by stealing Madesi's silver ring and planting it on him, offering gold and a chance to join the Thieves Guild in return.

base_facts: A member of the Thieves Guild operating in Riften's marketplace.
Sells a supposed Falmer Blood Elixir as a front for his schemes.
Can be found at the Riften bazaar during the day or at The Bee and Barb at night.

BRYNJOLF_SCHEME: Wants to frame Brand-Shei by planting a stolen ring on him to get him arrested.
Will create a distraction in the bazaar while the player steals the ring.
ACCEPT_STEAL_RING: The player agreed to steal Madesi's Silver Ring during my distraction.
The player should steal Madesi's Silver Ring from the strongbox under Madesi's stall.
SPEAK_TO_BRYNJOLF: Satisfied with the outcome of the scheme and pays 100 septims.
Offers the player a chance to join the Thieves Guild.
QUEST_COMPLETE: Considers this the beginning of a profitable friendship with the player.
Quest completes; Brynjolf rewards the player with 100 gold and offers Thieves Guild membership.
Speak to Brynjolf to receive a reward of 100 septims and a chance to join the Thieves Guild .

If you speak to Maul after speaking to Brynjolf and pick the conversational option "Know anything about the Thieves Guild?" , the miscellaneous quest "Talk to Brynjolf about joining the Thieves Guild" may become stuck.

base_facts: An Argonian jeweler with a stall in Riften's marketplace.
Keeps his silver ring in a locked strongbox inside the cabinet under his counter.
A Dunmer merchant selling wares in Riften's marketplace.
Someone wants him in jail where he cannot interfere with their activities.

PLANT_RING_ON_BRAND_SHEI: Has been framed for theft and will be arrested by the Riften guards.

beats.comment: Brynjolf approaches the player with his scheme to frame Brand-Shei.
Player explicitly agrees to help Brynjolf by stealing Madesi's Silver Ring.
beats.intent_summary: Player commits to stealing Madesi's Silver Ring for Brynjolf's scheme.

triggers.intent: Player explicitly agrees to steal Madesi's Silver Ring for Brynjolf.
examples_yes: Okay, I will steal the ring.
I'll get Madesi's ring for you.
I will take the ring and plant it.
Fine, I'll steal the ring during your distraction.
examples_no: Why do you want Brand-Shei framed?
I don't want to steal anything.

beats.comment: Player must steal Madesi's Silver Ring from his strongbox during Brynjolf's distraction.
Player plants Madesi's stolen ring on Brand-Shei via reverse pickpocket, or drops the ring and reports failure.
Player reports back to Brynjolf after the scheme, whether the pickpocket succeeded, failed, or the player took too long.
Quest completes; Brynjolf rewards the player with 100 gold and offers Thieves Guild membership.

title: Taking Care of Business
description: Brynjolf directs the player to the Ragged Flagon beneath Riften, then assigns them to collect overdue debts from three stubborn business owners: Keerava, Bersi Honey-Hand, and Haelga. Success earns membership in the Thieves Guild.

base_facts: I am a member of the Thieves Guild operating out of the Ragged Flagon beneath Riften.
I recruited the player after their performance in A Chance Arrangement.
Three business owners in Riften owe the Guild serious coin and refuse to pay: Keerava, Bersi Honey-Hand, and Haelga.

RECEIVE_DEBT_ASSIGNMENT: I have given the player the names of the three debtors and hinted at their weaknesses: Keerava cares for family, Bersi prizes his Dwemer urn, and Haelga is devoted to Dibella.
RETURN_TO_BRYNJOLF: The player has collected all three debts. I am impressed and ready to offer them a permanent place in the Guild.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I have welcomed the player as a permanent member of the Thieves Guild â€” they collected every debt from Keerava, Bersi, and Haelga as I instructed.
I rewarded the player with three leveled potions from the collected coin as their cut of the job.
The player has proven themselves capable and reliable; I will have more lucrative work for them soon.
This new recruit gives me hope for the Guild's future at a time when Vekel and the others claim we are a dying breed.

base_facts: I run the Bee and Barb inn in Riften with my partner Talen-Jei.
I owe the Thieves Guild money but I have refused to pay them.
I have family at a farm just inside Morrowind that I worry about.

COLLECT_KEERAVA_DEBT: I have paid my debt to the Thieves Guild, whether through intimidation, a brawl, or fear for my family in Morrowind.

base_facts: I own the Pawned Prawn general store in Riften.
I owe the Thieves Guild money and I refuse to be extorted.
I have a priceless Dwemer urn displayed in my shop that I treasure greatly.

COLLECT_BERSI_DEBT: I have paid my debt to the Thieves Guild, either after a brawl or after my precious Dwemer urn was destroyed.

base_facts: I run Haelga's Bunkhouse in Riften.
I owe the Thieves Guild money but I will not be bullied.
I am a devoted follower of Dibella, the goddess of beauty.

COLLECT_HAELGA_DEBT: I have paid my debt to the Thieves Guild, whether through coercion involving my Dibella devotion, a brawl, or after hearing the others caved.

beats.comment: Player locates Brynjolf at the Ragged Flagon after traversing the Ratway.
Brynjolf assigns the player to collect debts from Keerava, Bersi, and Haelga.
Player collects Keerava's debt via brawl, intimidation about her family, or being the last debtor.
Player collects Bersi's debt via brawl or by smashing his Dwemer urn, or being the last debtor.
Player collects Haelga's debt via coercion about Dibella, brawl, or being the last debtor.
All three debts collected; player returns to Brynjolf in the Ragged Flagon.
Quest finishes; player is welcomed into the Thieves Guild.

title: Loud and Clear
description: Brynjolf introduces the player to the Thieves Guild. Guild Master Mercer Frey assigns a job at Goldenglow Estate: burn three beehives and clear out Aringoth's safe to punish the owner for cutting off honey shipments to Maven Black-Briar.

base_facts: I am a member of the Thieves Guild and recruit new blood.
I vouched for the new recruit before Mercer Frey.
Maven Black-Briar is one of the Guild's most important clients.

MERCER_BRIEFING: I brought the recruit to meet Mercer Frey, the Guild Master.
GET_JOB_DETAILS: I gave the recruit the Goldenglow job: burn three hives and clear Aringoth's safe.
RETURN_TO_BRYNJOLF: The recruit finished the Goldenglow job. I paid them their cut.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The Goldenglow matter is settled. Maven has another job lined up.
Quest finishes. Player is rewarded and pointed to Maven Black-Briar for the next job.
