The secret sewer entrance leading into the estate To set the beehives on fire you can use a torch , the Fire Breath Shout, or a fire-based spell ; simply standing next to a hive with a torch or spell equipped will.
As long as you've completed the job to the letter, he'll be very pleased and reward you with a leveled amount of gold, as detailed below.

base_facts: I am the Guild Master of the Thieves Guild.
I decide who joins and what jobs they take.

MERCER_BRIEFING: I welcomed the new recruit and told Brynjolf to give them the Goldenglow assignment.

base_facts: I am a senior member of the Thieves Guild.
I was sent to investigate Goldenglow Estate and found it crawling with mercenaries.

OPTIONAL_VEX_INFO: I told the recruit about the sewer entrance on the northwest side of Goldenglow Estate.

base_facts: I own Goldenglow Estate.
I have been pressured by the Thieves Guild for years.
An anonymous buyer recently purchased Goldenglow and told me to stop cooperating with the Guild.

beats.comment: Player follows Brynjolf to meet the Guild Master.
Player listens to Mercer Frey's welcome and receives the job assignment.
Brynjolf explains the Goldenglow job: burn three hives and clear Aringoth's safe.
Optional: Vex reveals the sewer entrance on the northwest side of Goldenglow.
Player burns three beehives and retrieves the Goldenglow Bill of Sale from Aringoth's safe.
Player returns to Brynjolf after completing the Goldenglow job.
Quest finishes. Player is rewarded and pointed to Maven Black-Briar for the next job.

title: Meet the Family
description: After being accepted into the Thieves Guild, Brynjolf instructs you to speak with Vex and Delvin Mallory to learn about the Guild and to Tonilia to receive your Guild Armor.

base_facts: Brynjolf is your sponsor in the Thieves Guild.
He told you to speak with Vex, Delvin Mallory, and Tonilia to get acquainted with the Guild.

QUEST_COMPLETE: Brynjolf's introduction task is complete; you have met Vex, Delvin, and received armor from Tonilia.
He expects you to check in with the guild members and undertake extra jobs to help get the Guild back on its feet.

base_facts: Vex is a senior member of the Thieves Guild who handles heist jobs.
She is not friendly and expects obedience from new recruits.

VEX_CONVERSATION: Vex believes the Guild's decline is due to simple bad luck and mocks Delvin's curse theory.
QUEST_COMPLETE: You have spoken with Vex and learned she attributes the Guild's decline to simple bad luck.
She is now available to offer extra jobs to help put coin in your pocket and restore the Guild.

base_facts: Delvin Mallory is a senior member of the Thieves Guild who handles numbers jobs.
He admits the Guild isn't what it used to be.

DELVIN_CONVERSATION: Delvin believes someone has cursed the Guild with misfortune and is determined to turn things around.
QUEST_COMPLETE: You have spoken with Delvin and learned he believes the Guild has been cursed with misfortune.
He is now available to offer extra jobs to help turn the Guild's fortunes around.

base_facts: Tonilia is Delvin Mallory's personal lookout in the Thieves Guild.
She provides new members with Thieves Guild Armor.

TONILIA_ARMOR: Tonilia gave you a full set of Thieves Guild Armor to get you equipped.
QUEST_COMPLETE: Tonilia has provided you with a full set of Thieves Guild Armor as your official equipment.
You are now properly equipped as a new member of the Thieves Guild.

beats.comment: Quest starts at stage 10. Brynjolf directs the player to meet the Guild members.
Player speaks with Vex and learns about the Guild's decline from her perspective.
Player speaks with Delvin and learns about the Guild's decline and his curse theory.
Player receives Thieves Guild Armor from Tonilia.
Quest finishes at stage 200 after speaking with Vex, Delvin, and receiving armor.

title: Dampened Spirits
description: Brynjolf sends the player to Maven Black-Briar, who tasks them with sabotaging the Honningbrew Meadery to eliminate a competitor. Working with Mallus Maccius, the player must poison Sabjorn's mead during a tasting ceremony, get him arrested, and uncover his silent partner to protect the Thieves Guild.

base_facts: I sent the new Guild member to Maven Black-Briar for an important job.
The symbol on the promissory note matches the one from Goldenglow Estate Ã¢â‚¬â€ someone is trying to drive a wedge between Maven and the Guild.

RETURN_TO_BRYNJOLF: The same symbol links Honningbrew and Goldenglow Ã¢â‚¬â€ someone is trying to destroy the Guild economically. I sent them to Mercer.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The silent partner behind Honningbrew and Goldenglow is trying to destroy the Guild. I've sent the recruit to Mercer Frey to continue the investigation.
Quest completes Ã¢â‚¬â€ the silent partner's plot against the Guild is revealed.
Right after the persuasion check, you can exit out of the conversation, allowing you to restart the conversation and it offers a chance to repeat the check indefinitely and train Speech .

Remaining out of sight and talking to Sabjorn is virtually impossible, so it's advised to bring the captain to his knees and quickly talk to Sabjorn, then remain undetected until the winetasting scene starts.

base_facts: I am the head of the Black-Briar family and the most influential person in Riften.
I want Honningbrew Meadery put out of business Ã¢â‚¬â€ they are my competitor.
I need to know how Sabjorn funded his operation so quickly.

MEET_MAVEN: I've sent this Guild member to Whiterun to meet Mallus Maccius and sabotage Honningbrew Meadery.
REPORT_TO_MAVEN: The promissory note's author uses the same symbol as the Goldenglow bill of sale. I paid the Guild member with an enchanted weapon for their work.

base_facts: I work at Honningbrew Meadery but I'm trapped in debt to Sabjorn.
Maven promised me control of the meadery once Sabjorn is out of the way.

MEET_MALLUS: I explained the plan: approach Sabjorn about the pest problem, use his own poison to taint the mead for the tasting ceremony.
SABJORN_ARRESTED: Sabjorn is gone and I'm in charge of Honningbrew now. I gave the Guild member the key to Sabjorn's dresser to find the proof Maven needs.
SILENT_PARTNER: The promissory note from Sabjorn's dresser reveals who funded the meadery operation.

base_facts: I own Honningbrew Meadery.
I have a pest problem in the tunnels beneath the meadery.
I trapped Mallus Maccius in debt to get free labor from him.

SABOTAGE_PLAN: I gave the pest poison and the meadery key to someone offering to help with the infestation.

beats.comment: Brynjolf sends the player to Maven, who explains the job to sabotage Honningbrew Meadery.
Maven directs the player to Mallus Maccius at The Bannered Mare in Whiterun.
Player speaks to Sabjorn, gets poison and key, then poisons the nest and the mead vat.
Tasting ceremony occurs, the captain is poisoned, Sabjorn is arrested, Mallus takes over.
Player finds the promissory note in Sabjorn's dresser identifying the silent partner.
Player returns to Maven with the promissory note; she notes the matching symbol.
Player reports to Brynjolf, who connects the symbol to the Goldenglow plot and sends them to Mercer.
Quest completes Ã¢â‚¬â€ the silent partner's plot against the Guild is revealed.

title: Scoundrel's Folly
description: After discovering connections between Goldenglow Estate and Honningbrew Meadery, Mercer Frey sends you to Solitude to interrogate Gulum-Ei, an Argonian dockworker and former Guild contact, about the Thieves Guild's anonymous adversary.

base_facts: A senior member of the Thieves Guild who can provide advice on Guild operations.
Aware of the Guild's recent troubles and the investigation into their anonymous adversary.

SPEAK_TO_MERCER_FREY: Brynjolf can offer optional advice before you head to Solitude to find Gulum-Ei.

base_facts: Guild Master of the Thieves Guild.
Discovered the connection between the Goldenglow Bill of Sale and the Promissory Note from Honningbrew Meadery.

SPEAK_TO_MERCER_FREY: Mercer identified Gulum-Ei as a former Guild contact who may know who is targeting the Guild.
Mercer believes the Guild is being deliberately undermined, not cursed.
RETURN_TO_MERCER: Mercer is upset to learn Karliah is behind the attacks on the Guild.
Mercer deduces Karliah will be at Snow Veil Sanctum and insists on coming along on the next job.
QUEST_COMPLETE: Mercer plans to confront Karliah at Snow Veil Sanctum and insists on accompanying you personally.
Quest completes. Karliah identified as the adversary who murdered Gallus and is targeting Mercer. One piece of Thieves Guild armor is upgraded.

Detailed Walkthrough [ edit ] The Plot Thickens [ edit ] When you next speak to Mercer, he will remark that the symbol found on the Goldenglow Bill of Sale from Goldenglow Estate is the same as the one on the Promissory.
This makes this mission significantly easier to complete for a non-stealthy character, but you will forfeit the payment and you will not have Gulum-Ei as a fence later on.

base_facts: An Argonian dockworker for the East Empire Company in Solitude.
A former contact of the Thieves Guild who used to steal goods for them.
Frequents the Winking Skeever tavern.

CONFRONT_GULUM_EI: Gulum-Ei is stubborn and refuses to reveal information easily out of fear for his own safety.
Gulum-Ei can be persuaded with high Speech skill, bribed with Firebrand Wine from the Blue Palace, or shadowed.
OBTAIN_INFORMATION: Gulum-Ei was approached by a mysterious angry woman who gave him gold to buy Goldenglow Estate.
The woman's anger was directed specifically at Mercer Frey.
Gulum-Ei gave you Soul Gems as compensation for your effort.
SHADOW_AND_CONFRONT: Gulum-Ei was not fully forthcoming about what he knows.
Gulum-Ei leads through the East Empire Company Warehouse to Brinewater Grotto.
CONFRONT_IN_GROTTO: Gulum-Ei reveals the mysterious woman is Karliah, who murdered the previous Guildmaster Gallus.
If spared, Gulum-Ei offers to act as a fence for stolen goods as repayment.

beats.comment: Player speaks to Mercer Frey and learns about Gulum-Ei and the connection between the two documents.
Player travels to the Winking Skeever and confronts Gulum-Ei, who may require persuasion, bribery via Firebrand Wine, or shadowing.
Player obtains partial information from Gulum-Ei after persuading, bribing with wine, or threatening. Gulum-Ei mentions a mysterious angry woman targeting Mercer.
Player shadows Gulum-Ei through the East Empire Company Warehouse to Brinewater Grotto and confronts him there.
Player returns to Mercer Frey with the confession and learns Karliah is the adversary. Mercer deduces she is at Snow Veil Sanctum.
Quest completes. Karliah identified as the adversary who murdered Gallus and is targeting Mercer. One piece of Thieves Guild armor is upgraded.

title: Speaking With Silence
description: Mercer Frey leads the player to Snow Veil Sanctum to hunt down Karliah, accused of murdering Gallus. Inside, Karliah shoots the player with a paralytic arrow, revealing Mercer as Gallus's true killer before he abandons the player to die. Karliah nurses the player back to health and introduces the Nightingales.

base_facts: I lead the Thieves Guild and want Karliah dead for murdering Gallus.
I have scouted Snow Veil Sanctum and found Karliah's horse outside.
I expect the player to follow my lead without question.

MEET_MERCER_OUTSIDE: I have taken care of Karliah's horse so she cannot escape.
I want to catch Karliah inside while she is distracted.
ENTER_SANCTUM: I can unlock ancient Nordic locks with ease.
I warn the player about traps Karliah has reset.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I killed Gallus and framed Karliah for his murder.
I betrayed the player and left them to die in Snow Veil Sanctum.
I told Brynjolf I would give him the player's regards.

base_facts: I am a Dunmer and former Nightingale, accused of murdering Gallus.
I have been hiding from Mercer Frey for over twenty years.

SPEAK_TO_KARLIAH: I shot the player with a paralytic poison arrow to save their life, not kill them.
I never had a clear shot at Mercer with the poisoned arrow.
I made a split-second decision to get the player out of harm's way.
QUEST_COMPLETE: Mercer Frey is the true killer of Gallus, not me.
Gallus, Mercer, and I were Nightingales, guardians in service to Nocturnal.
I tended to the player's wounds outside Snow Veil Sanctum after Mercer's betrayal.

beats.comment: Player meets Mercer Frey outside Snow Veil Sanctum to begin the hunt for Karliah.
Player enters Snow Veil Sanctum with Mercer as a temporary follower, facing draugr and traps.
After Karliah's paralytic arrow and Mercer's betrayal, the player wakes outside and speaks with Karliah.
Quest ends with Mercer revealed as Gallus's killer and the Nightingale secret uncovered.

title: Hard Answers
description: Karliah needs Gallus's encoded journal translated to expose Mercer Frey's treachery. Enthir identifies the language as Falmer and directs the player to Calcelmo in Markarth, who refuses to help. The player must infiltrate Calcelmo's Dwemer Museum, reach the stone Falmer Translation Guide in his tower, and create a rubbing to bring back to Enthir for translation.

base_facts: Gallus's journal is written in a code that must be deciphered to prove Mercer's betrayal.
She recovered the journal from Snow Veil Sanctum.

SPEAK_ENTHIR: Enthir may be able to help translate Gallus's journal.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The journal confirms Mercer desecrated the Twilight Sepulcher and stole from Nocturnal.
Karliah gave the Nightingale Blade as thanks and wants to confront Brynjolf at the Ragged Flagon.

base_facts: Enthir is a wizard at the College of Winterhold and was an old acquaintance of Gallus.

SPEAK_ENTHIR: Gallus's journal is written in the Falmer language.
Calcelmo in Markarth is the foremost authority on the Falmer.
RETURN_TO_ENTHIR: The rubbing of Calcelmo's stone provides enough to translate the journal.
Mercer defiled the Twilight Sepulcher, Nocturnal's temple the Nightingales are sworn to protect.

base_facts: Calcelmo is the Court Wizard of Markarth and the foremost expert on the Falmer.
He is stubborn and protective of his research.

SPEAK_CALCELMO: Calcelmo refuses to help translate the journal or share his Falmer research.
His Dwemer Museum may contain the translation materials needed.

beats.comment: Player speaks with Enthir about translating Gallus's journal. He identifies it as Falmer and points to Calcelmo.
Player speaks with Calcelmo in Understone Keep. He refuses to help directly.
Player gains entry to Calcelmo's Dwemer Museum by key, lockpicking, or persuasion.
Player reaches the Falmer Translation Guide stone tablet in Calcelmo's Tower and creates a rubbing.
Player returns to Enthir at the Frozen Hearth cellar with the rubbing. Enthir translates the journal.
Player speaks to Karliah after the translation. She reveals Mercer defiled the Twilight Sepulcher and gives the Nightingale Blade. Quest ends, The Pursuit begins.

title: The Pursuit
description: Karliah seeks to prove her innocence and expose Mercer Frey's betrayal of the Thieves Guild. After the Guild's vault is found empty, the player must infiltrate Mercer's home at Riftweald Manor to find evidence of his whereabouts.

base_facts: A former Thieves Guild member framed by Mercer Frey for Gallus's murder.
Carries the translated journal as proof of her innocence.

MEET_KARLIAH: Presented Gallus's translated journal to the Guild as proof of her innocence.
CONVINCE_BRYNJOLF: Led the Guild to the empty vault, proving Mercer drained it.
QUEST_COMPLETE: Her innocence has been accepted by the Guild; she is no longer treated as Gallus's murderer.
Stands vindicated and ready to assist in the next phase against Mercer.

base_facts: Second-in-command of the Thieves Guild.
Initially loyal to Mercer Frey as Guildmaster.

CONVINCE_BRYNJOLF: Convinced of Mercer's betrayal after finding the vault empty.
Instructed the player to infiltrate Mercer's home for clues.
RETURN_PLANS: Believes Mercer intends to steal the Eyes of the Falmer before fleeing Skyrim.
QUEST_COMPLETE: Received Mercer's plans from the player confirming Mercer intends to steal the Eyes of the Falmer before fleeing Skyrim for good.
Convinced the Guild must proceed to the gems' location immediately to intercept Mercer.
Disposition toward the player has increased from 0 to 1.
The pursuit of Mercer continues; Trinity Restored follows.

base_facts: A Nord guarding Riftweald Manor for Mercer Frey.
Owes a debt to Maven Black-Briar that keeps him bound to the job.
Thieves Guild member once acquainted with Vald.
Suggests erasing Vald's debt with Maven or killing him to gain entry.

beats.comment: Player meets Karliah at the Ragged Flagon and follows her to the Cistern.
Brynjolf is convinced of Mercer's betrayal after the empty vault is discovered.
Player infiltrates Riftweald Manor, optionally dealing with Vald at the gate.
Player discovers Mercer's plans in the hidden cellar beneath the manor.
Player returns Mercer's plans to Brynjolf at the Ragged Flagon.
Quest complete. Mercer is after the Eyes of the Falmer and must be intercepted.

title: Trinity Restored
description: Karliah reveals that Mercer Frey was a Nightingale and proposes that the player and Brynjolf join the Nightingales to reform the trinity. After traveling to Nightingale Hall, donning the Nightingale Armor, and taking the Oath before Nocturnal, the player learns that Mercer stole the Skeleton Key from the Twilight Sepulcher and must recover it.

base_facts: I am a Nightingale, an agent of Nocturnal.
Mercer Frey murdered my mentor Gallus and framed me for it over twenty-five years ago.
The Nightingale trinity must be restored to stand against Mercer.
I asked Brynjolf and the player to meet me at the Shadow Stone outside Riften.

LISTEN_TO_KARLIAH: I have explained to Brynjolf and the player that Mercer was a Nightingale and we must be at full strength to face him.
MEET_AT_SHADOW_STONE: I led them to the entrance of Nightingale Hall, our old base of operations.
OBTAIN_NIGHTINGALE_ARMOR: I instructed them to activate the Armor Stone and equip the Nightingale Armor before we proceed.
TAKE_THE_OATH: I summoned Nocturnal and asked her to resume my role and induct Brynjolf and the player into the Nightingales.
SPEAK_TO_KARLIAH_AFTER_OATH: I explained that Mercer stole the Skeleton Key from the Twilight Sepulcher, threatening the very foundations of the Nightingales and the Thieves Guild's luck.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The duty to recover the Skeleton Key and return it to the Twilight Sepulcher falls upon the player as a Nightingale.

base_facts: I am a senior member of the Thieves Guild in Riften.
Mercer Frey has betrayed the Guild and must be stopped.
Karliah has asked to speak with both of us about facing Mercer.

LISTEN_TO_KARLIAH: I now know Mercer was a Nightingale. We need to be on equal footing with him.
OBTAIN_NIGHTINGALE_ARMOR: I have donned my Nightingale Armor alongside Karliah and the player.
TAKE_THE_OATH: I have sworn service to Nocturnal as a Nightingale.
SPEAK_TO_BRYNJOLF: With Mercer disgraced, I believe the player should lead the Thieves Guild once they have dealt with Mercer and proven themselves.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The player is the right person to lead the Guild after Mercer is dealt with.

base_facts: I am the Daedric Prince of Darkness and Shadow, patron of the Nightingales.
The Nightingales serve as my agents and guardians of the Twilight Sepulcher.

TAKE_THE_OATH: I have agreed to resume Karliah's role and induct Brynjolf and the player into the Nightingales.

beats.comment: Karliah reveals Mercer was a Nightingale and asks the player and Brynjolf to meet her at the Shadow Stone.
Player meets Karliah at the Shadow Stone and enters Nightingale Hall.
Player activates the Armor Stone and equips the Nightingale Armor.
Player stands on the floor glyph and swears the Nightingale Oath before Nocturnal.
Karliah explains that Mercer stole the Skeleton Key from the Twilight Sepulcher.
Brynjolf discusses Guild leadership and suggests the player should lead after Mercer is dealt with.
Quest completes. The player must recover the Skeleton Key from Mercer Frey.

title: Blindsighted
description: The Nightingales pursue Mercer Frey to Irkngthand to stop him from stealing the Eyes of the Falmer and escaping Skyrim with the Skeleton Key of Nocturnal.

base_facts: I told the new Nightingale to meet Karliah and me at Irkngthand.
Mercer Frey betrayed the Thieves Guild and murdered Gallus.
We must stop Mercer before he escapes with the Skeleton Key.

JOIN_WITH_NIGHTINGALES: Karliah and I have joined the new Nightingale inside Irkngthand.
CONFRONT_MERCER: Mercer knew we were coming. He led us into a trap.
QUEST_COMPLETE: Mercer Frey is dead. The Nightingales have survived.

base_facts: Mercer Frey murdered Gallus and framed me for his crimes.
We must recover the Skeleton Key and return it to Nocturnal.
Mercer is heading to Irkngthand to steal the Eyes of the Falmer.

JOIN_WITH_NIGHTINGALES: I believe Mercer knows we are following. He may be planning an ambush.
RECOVER_KEY: The Skeleton Key must be returned to the Twilight Sepulcher.
ESCAPE_AND_REPORT: We survived. The Skeleton Key must be returned to the Twilight Sepulcher.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I gave my Nightingale Bow to our newest Nightingale. The journey to return the Key must be undertaken alone.

base_facts: I possess the Skeleton Key of Nocturnal.
I murdered Gallus and used the Guild for my own gain.
The Eyes of the Falmer will make me wealthy enough to disappear forever.

CONFRONT_MERCER: I knew you would come. Now the Nightingales will die.

beats.comment: Player travels to Irkngthand to confront Mercer Frey.
Karliah and Brynjolf join the player inside Irkngthand to pursue Mercer.
Player locates and fights Mercer Frey in the Irkngthand Sanctuary.
Mercer is slain; player retrieves the Skeleton Key as the chamber floods.
Player escapes the flooding Irkngthand and speaks with Karliah at Bronze Water Cave.
Quest completes; Karliah gives the Nightingale Bow and instructs the player to return the Skeleton Key to the Twilight Sepulcher.

title: Darkness Returns
description: Return the Skeleton Key to the Twilight Sepulcher, follow the Pilgrim's Path through its five tests, and restore the Ebonmere to earn Nocturnal's blessing as a true Nightingale Agent.

base_facts: I am a Nightingale bound to serve Nocturnal.
Mercer Frey betrayed the Nightingales and murdered Gallus.
I helped the new recruit retrieve the Skeleton Key from Mercer.

LISTEN_TO_NOCTURNAL: Nocturnal has emerged from the Ebonmere and is addressing us.
CHOOSE_NIGHTINGALE_ROLE: The new recruit must choose which Nightingale ability to receive from Nocturnal.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The Ebonmere has been restored and Nocturnal's conduit to Evergloam flows once more.
The new recruit has become a true Nightingale Agent imbued with Nocturnal's blessing.
Mercer Frey is dead and Gallus's murder has been avenged at last.
With Nocturnal's favor restored, the Thieves Guild's fortunes will improve.

base_facts: I am the spirit of Gallus, the last Nightingale Sentinel.
I have guarded the Sepulcher alone for over twenty-five years.
Mercer Frey lured me to my death and stole the Skeleton Key.
Without the Key, the Ebonmere is closed and I am fading away.

SPEAK_TO_SENTINEL: A new Nightingale has come with the Skeleton Key. My death was not in vain.
FOLLOW_PILGRIMS_PATH: The recruit must follow the Pilgrim's Path alone to restore the Key to the Ebonmere.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The Key has been returned to the Ebonmere â€” my long vigil can finally end.
Mercer Frey is dead and my murder has been avenged.
The Sepulcher is no longer vulnerable and Nocturnal's conduit is restored.
Karliah still lives and continues to serve as a Nightingale.

base_facts: I am Nocturnal, the Daedric Prince of Darkness and Shadow.
The Ebonmere is my conduit to Evergloam.
The Nightingales serve me in exchange for their abilities.

LISTEN_TO_NOCTURNAL: The Key has been returned and the Ebonmere restored. I have emerged to address my agents.
CHOOSE_NIGHTINGALE_ROLE: I will grant this Nightingale a blessing befitting their chosen role.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The Skeleton Key has been returned and the Ebonmere restored as my conduit to Evergloam.
I have granted this Nightingale a blessing befitting their chosen station.
The Nightingales have fulfilled their agreement as expected; their actions were nothing more than duty.
My presence in this world flows freely through the Ebonmere once more.

beats.comment: Player enters the Twilight Sepulcher with the Skeleton Key.
Player speaks to Gallus's spirit and learns about the Pilgrim's Path and the Ebonmere.
Player navigates the five tests of the Pilgrim's Path through the Sepulcher.

keywords: I need to speak with them

triggers.intent: Player explicitly agrees to proceed with this quest handoff: Player navigates the five tests of the Pilgrim's Path through the Sepulcher.
examples_yes: Tell me what needs to happen next.
examples_no: What are you asking me to do?
No, I do not want to do that.

beats.intent_summary: Player agrees to proceed with this quest handoff: Player navigates the five tests of the Pilgrim's Path through the Sepulcher.

beats.comment: Player unlocks the Ebonmere with the Skeleton Key.
Nocturnal emerges from the Ebonmere and addresses the player about their service.
Player speaks to Karliah and chooses a Nightingale blessing: Agent of Shadow, Subterfuge, or Strife.
Quest complete. Player has become a true Nightingale Agent with Nocturnal's blessing.

title: Reparations
description: After breaking a cardinal rule of the Thieves Guild, you must speak to Vex in the Ragged Flagon and pay 1,000 gold in reparations to regain your membership.

base_facts: Vex is a senior member of the Thieves Guild who operates out of the Ragged Flagon.
Vex handles disciplinary matters within the guild, including reparation payments.

BANNED_FROM_GUILD: A guild member has broken the cardinal rules and been expelled. They need to pay reparations to rejoin.
SPEAK_TO_VEX: This member owes 1,000 gold in reparations before they can be reinstated into the Thieves Guild.
REPARATIONS_PAID: The former guild member has paid their reparations and been reinstated into the Thieves Guild.
Player has paid 1,000 gold in reparations and been reinstated into the Thieves Guild.
Talk to Vex and pay 1,000 gold.
To rejoin the guild, speak to Vex in The Ragged Flagon , who will reprimand you and demand 1,000 gold as reparations.

beats.comment: Player has been banned from the Thieves Guild for breaking a cardinal rule such as assaulting a member or stealing from the guild.
Player speaks to Vex about making reparations after being banned from the guild.
Player needs to bring 1,000 gold to Vex as reparations for rejoining the guild.
Player has paid 1,000 gold in reparations and been reinstated into the Thieves Guild.

title: No Stone Unturned
description: Find all twenty-four Stones of Barenziah scattered across Skyrim, have them appraised by Vex of the Thieves Guild, recover the Crown of Barenziah from Tolvald's Cave, and return it to earn the Prowler's Profit ability.

base_facts: I am a member of the Thieves Guild in Riften.
I appraise unusual gems and other valuables.

GEM_APPRAISED: I told the player the Unusual Gem is one of twenty-four Stones of Barenziah pried from Queen Barenziah's crown by a thief.
The stones are worthless individually but valuable as a complete set.
ALL_STONES_COLLECTED: The player has gathered all twenty-four Stones of Barenziah.
I revealed the Crown of Barenziah is in Tolvald's Cave and serves as a paragon for the Thieves Guild.
CROWN_RETURNED: The player returned the Crown of Barenziah to me.
I restored the crown to its original condition as a paragon for the Guild.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I have restored the Crown of Barenziah to its original condition with all twenty-four stones returned to their rightful places.
The restored crown now serves as a paragon for the Thieves Guild, as it was always meant to.
The player has been granted Prowler's Profit, a permanent effect that significantly increases the chance of finding gems in randomized containers throughout Skyrim.
The long task of recovering the Stones of Barenziah and the Crown from Tolvald's Cave is finally complete.

base_facts: I am a Nord in Riften with connections to the Thieves Guild.
I know about appraising unusual goods.

FOUND_UNUSUAL_GEM: I told the player to show the Unusual Gem to Vex of the Thieves Guild.
I explained the player must become a full member of the Guild to speak with Vex.
I directed the player to find Brynjolf in Riften's marketplace to join the Guild.

beats.comment: Player finds an Unusual Gem and seeks an appraiser. Stage 5/10 triggers.
Vex identifies the gem as a Stone of Barenziah and explains the set of 24. Stage 20 trigger.
Player collects all 24 Stones and speaks to Vex, who reveals the crown location. Stage 30 trigger.
Player retrieves the Crown of Barenziah from Tolvald's Cave. Stage 40 trigger.
Player returns the Crown to Vex. Stage 50 trigger.
Quest finishes. Vex restores the crown, player receives Prowler's Profit. Stage 200 trigger.

title: Thieves Guild Caravan Fence Quest
description: Tonilia asks the player to deliver moon sugar to Ri'saad, leader of the Khajiit caravans, to secure an alliance between the caravans and the Thieves Guild. Upon returning to Tonilia, the player receives leveled gold and three Khajiit become available as fences.

base_facts: I am the Thieves Guild's fence operating out of the Ragged Flagon.
I want to establish an alliance with the Khajiit caravans to transport Guild goods across Skyrim.

QUEST_STARTED: I have asked the player to deliver moon sugar to Ri'saad as a gift and to propose a partnership between the caravans and the Guild.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The player secured the alliance with the Khajiit caravans. I rewarded them with gold.
Player returns to Tonilia and completes the quest, receiving gold and fence access.
The Khajiit do not become available as fences until after you have returned to Tonilia and finished the quest.
She requests that you speak to the leader of the caravans, a Khajiit peddler named Ri'saad about securing an alliance between the caravans and the Guild.

base_facts: I am the leader of the Khajiit caravans that travel between Whiterun and Markarth.
My caravan trades goods across Skyrim.

MOON_SUGAR_DELIVERED: I accepted the moon sugar and agreed to a partnership with the Thieves Guild.
My fellow Khajiit caravans will now buy stolen goods from Guild members.

beats.comment: Tonilia asks the player to deliver moon sugar to Ri'saad to secure a caravan alliance.
Player delivers moon sugar to Ri'saad and he agrees to the partnership.
Player returns to Tonilia and completes the quest, receiving gold and fence access.

title: The Litany of Larceny
description: A Thieves Guild side quest to find and return seven unique larceny items to Delvin Mallory at the Ragged Flagon for leveled gold rewards. Each item is discovered during the main Guild questline.

base_facts: I am a member of the Thieves Guild operating out of the Ragged Flagon.
I purchase special items of interest to the Guild for a fair price.
I value unique trinkets connected to the Guild's history and operations.

DISCOVER_QUEEN_BEE_STATUE: The Queen Bee Statue from Goldenglow Estate is one of the larceny items I want.
DISCOVER_HONNINGBREW_DECANTER: The Honningbrew Decanter from Honningbrew Meadery is one of the larceny items I want.
DISCOVER_EAST_EMPIRE_MAP: The East Empire Shipping Map from the Warehouse is one of the larceny items I want.
DISCOVER_MODEL_SHIP: The Model Ship from Snow Veil Sanctum is one of the larceny items I want.
DISCOVER_DWEMER_PUZZLE_CUBE: The Dwemer Puzzle Cube from Calcelmo's Laboratory is one of the larceny items I want.
DISCOVER_BUST_OF_GRAY_FOX: The Bust of the Gray Fox from Riftweald Manor is one of the larceny items I want.
DISCOVER_LEFT_EYE_OF_FALMER: The Left Eye of the Falmer from Irkngthand is one of the larceny items I want.
Player finds the Left Eye of the Falmer at Irkngthand Sanctuary during Blindsighted.
Reward [ edit ] This is the amount of gold you get each time you turn in an item, except the eye with four times higher reward.
Picking them up will add a miscellaneous task to take it to Delvin Mallory , who will pay a leveled amount of money for the item.

beats.comment: Player finds the Queen Bee Statue at Goldenglow Estate during Loud and Clear.
Player finds the Honningbrew Decanter at Honningbrew Meadery during Dampened Spirits.
Player finds the East Empire Shipping Map at the East Empire Company Warehouse during Scoundrel's Folly.
Player finds the Model Ship at Snow Veil Sanctum during Speaking with Silence.
Player finds the Dwemer Puzzle Cube in Calcelmo's Laboratory during Hard Answers.
Player finds the Bust of the Gray Fox at Riftweald Manor during The Pursuit.
Player finds the Left Eye of the Falmer at Irkngthand Sanctuary during Blindsighted.

title: Under New Management
description: After restoring the Thieves Guild to its former glory by completing all four reputation jobs and Darkness Returns, the player is invited to become Guild Master. A ceremony is held in the Ragged Flagon cistern where Brynjolf, Delvin, Vex, and Karliah confirm the appointment. The player receives the Guild Master's Armor, the Amulet of Articulation, and the Tribute Chest Key.

base_facts: I am a senior member of the Thieves Guild and help run its day-to-day operations.
The Guild Master is chosen by consensus among the guild's leadership.
The Tribute Chest in the cistern is reserved for the Guild Master's share of guild earnings.

SPEAK_BRYNJOLF: The player has earned the right to be named Guild Master and I have told them so.
SPEAK_BRYNJOLF_POST_CEREMONY: I have given the new Guild Master the Tribute Chest Key and the Amulet of Articulation.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I have presided over the ceremony confirming the player as the new Guild Master of the Thieves Guild, with the agreement of Delvin, Vex, and Karliah.
I have given the new Guild Master the Tribute Chest Key and the Amulet of Articulation as symbols of their new position.
The Tribute Chest near the Guild Master's desk will be periodically stocked with loot as the guild's tribute to its master.
I have directed the new Guild Master to speak with Tonilia to receive their Guild Master's Armor set.

base_facts: I am the Thieves Guild's primary fence operating out of the Ragged Flagon.
I provide armor and equipment upgrades to guild members.

RETRIEVE_ARMOR: I have given the new Guild Master their Guild Master's Armor set.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I have given the new Guild Master their Guild Master's Armor set, a superior recolored variant of the standard Thieves Guild Armor.
The Guild Master's Armor is similar in appearance to the set Mercer Frey once wore.

beats.comment: Player speaks to Brynjolf about becoming Guild Master after completing all prerequisites.
Player proceeds to the center of the cistern for the installation ceremony.
Ceremony concludes with Brynjolf, Delvin, Vex, and Karliah confirming the player as Guild Master.
Player speaks to Brynjolf after the ceremony and receives the Tribute Chest Key and Amulet of Articulation.
Player retrieves the Guild Master's Armor set from Tonilia.
Quest complete. Player is now Guild Master with all rewards received.

title: Silver Lining
description: Delvin Mallory sends the player to assist Endon, a silversmith in Markarth, whose silver mold was stolen by bandits led by Rigel Strong-Arm and taken to Pinewatch. The player must infiltrate Pinewatch, recover the mold, and return it to Endon.

base_facts: I am a member of the Thieves Guild and handle special jobs.
I received word from Endon in Markarth requesting the Guild's assistance.
After a successful job I compliment my operatives and share news of new merchants in the Ragged Flagon.

RECEIVE_QUEST: I have assigned the player to help Endon recover his stolen silver mold.
COMPLETE_QUEST: Endon is pleased to have his merchandise back and is now a powerful ally for the Guild in Markarth.

base_facts: I am a silversmith residing in Markarth and can be found at the Silver-Blood Inn.
I had a silver mold stolen while it was en route to me.
The mold was taken by bandits led by Rigel Strong-Arm to a hideout called Pinewatch.

SPEAK_TO_ENDON: I have explained that my silver mold was stolen by bandits and taken to Pinewatch.
RETURN_MOLD: I am grateful for the return of my silver mold and will serve as a fence for the Thieves Guild in Markarth.
Player returns the silver mold to Endon, completing the quest. Endon becomes a fence for the Guild.
The button opens a hidden entrance that leads down to some caves.
At the start of the next tunnel is another pressure plate that activates blades in front of you, and another plate at the far end that activates a battering ram from the right.

base_facts: I am the bandit leader at Pinewatch.
I carry the Pinewatch Treasure Room Key.
I have set up traps to protect my treasure room.

beats.comment: Player accepts the special job from Delvin to help Endon in Markarth.
Player speaks to Endon at the Silver-Blood Inn and learns about the stolen silver mold.
Player enters Pinewatch to find the bandit hideout and the silver mold.
Player recovers the silver mold from the Pinewatch treasure room, dealing with Rigel Strong-Arm and her traps.
Player returns the silver mold to Endon, completing the quest. Endon becomes a fence for the Guild.

title: The Dainty Sload
description: Delvin Mallory assigns a special job from Solitude. Erikur, a wealthy thane, wants the Thieves Guild to frame Captain Volf of the Dainty Sload by planting the illegal substance Balmora Blue in his footlocker.

base_facts: Delvin Mallory assigns special jobs for the Thieves Guild from the Ragged Flagon.
He received word from Solitude about an opportunity involving Erikur.
Completing special jobs helps the Guild regain influence in cities.

QUEST_COMPLETE: Delvin is pleased that Captain Volf will be imprisoned and Erikur has pledged support for the Guild in Solitude.

base_facts: Erikur is a wealthy thane and businessman in Solitude, found at the Blue Palace during the day.
He has requested the Thieves Guild's assistance with a matter of revenge.

LEARN_THE_PLAN: Captain Volf of the Dainty Sload broke a trade agreement with Erikur.
Erikur wants to frame Captain Volf by planting Balmora Blue in his footlocker aboard the Dainty Sload.
QUEST_COMPLETE: Erikur is pleased with the framing of Captain Volf.
He has pledged to open doors for the Thieves Guild in Solitude.

base_facts: Sabine Nytte is a crew member aboard the pirate ship Red Wave docked outside the East Empire Company Warehouse.
She deals in rare contraband including Balmora Blue.

ACQUIRE_BALMORA_BLUE: Sabine sells Balmora Blue for 1500 gold.
The Balmora Blue is hidden in a locked chest under the docks near the Red Wave.

beats.comment: Player speaks to Erikur in Solitude about the special job.
Erikur explains Captain Volf broke their agreement and wants him framed with Balmora Blue.
Player acquires Balmora Blue from Sabine Nytte aboard the Red Wave.
Player plants Balmora Blue in Captain Volf's footlocker aboard the Dainty Sload.
Player returns to Erikur after planting Balmora Blue, then reports to Delvin.

title: Imitation Amnesty
description: Delvin Mallory sends the player to Whiterun to help Olfrid Battle-Born free his friend Arn from execution by stealing an incriminating letter from the Jarl's quarters and forging the prison registry in Dragonsreach.

base_facts: I handle special jobs for the Thieves Guild from the Ragged Flagon in Riften.
Olfrid Battle-Born, a wealthy Nord in Whiterun, has requested the Guild's help with a delicate matter.

RECEIVE_QUEST: I have given the player a special job to assist Olfrid Battle-Born in Whiterun.
QUEST_COMPLETE: Olfrid Battle-Born has pledged the full support of the Battle-Born clan to the Thieves Guild. A new merchant has set up shop in the Flagon.

base_facts: I am a wealthy Nord living in Whiterun, head of the Battle-Born clan.
My old war buddy Arn has been arrested for drunkenness in Whiterun, but he is really wanted for murder in Solitude.

SPEAK_OLFRID: I have asked the Thieves Guild to steal the letter warning of Arn's true crime from the Jarl's quarters and forge the prison registry on the steward's desk in Dragonsreach.
QUEST_COMPLETE: My friend Arn will only serve a few days for drunkenness instead of facing the executioner's axe. The Battle-Born clan stands with the Thieves Guild.

beats.comment: Player receives the special job from Delvin to help Olfrid Battle-Born in Whiterun.
Player speaks to Olfrid and learns about Arn and the two tasks needed to save him.
Player has stolen the incriminating letter and forged the prison registry. Return objective appears.
Quest complete. Arn is free and the Thieves Guild gains the Battle-Born clan as an ally in Whiterun.

title: Summerset Shadows
description: Delvin Mallory assigns a special job in Windhelm. Torsten Cruel-Sea's daughter was killed and her silver locket stolen by a rival thieves guild called the Summerset Shadows. Track them down, recover the locket, and eliminate the competition.

base_facts: A high-ranking member of the Thieves Guild who assigns special jobs from the Ragged Flagon in Riften.

ACCEPT_QUEST: Has a special job in Windhelm regarding a rival thieves faction called the Summerset Shadows.

base_facts: A wealthy Nord merchant living in Windhelm.

TALK_TO_TORSTEN: His daughter Fjotli was killed and her silver locket stolen. He wants the locket returned and revenge on the Summerset Shadows.
RETURN_LOCKET: Has received Fjotli's silver locket back from the player.
Rewarded the player with a leveled item for returning the locket.
Pledged his influential support to the Thieves Guild in Windhelm.

base_facts: An Altmer merchant in Windhelm with connections to the Summerset Shadows.

TALK_TO_NIRANYE: Revealed that the Summerset Shadows only looted Fjotli's body and did not kill her. Their hideout is in Uttering Hills Cave.
RETURN_LOCKET: Now serves as a fence for the Thieves Guild in Windhelm, provided she was spared during the investigation.
Her ties to the Summerset Shadows are effectively severed following the elimination of their leadership.

base_facts: Leader of the Summerset Shadows, a rival thieves guild from Summerset Isle operating out of Uttering Hills Cave.

beats.comment: Player accepts the special job from Delvin to investigate the Summerset Shadows.
Player speaks to Torsten and learns about his daughter's murder and stolen locket.
Player confronts Niranye and learns the Summerset Shadows' hideout location.
Player recovers Fjotli's Silver Locket from Linwe at Uttering Hills Cave.
Player returns the locket to Torsten, completing the quest.

title: Enchanting Tutorial
description: Farengar Secret-Fire in Dragonsreach teaches the basics of enchanting. Learn enchantments by disenchanting items, use filled soul gems, and enchant at the Arcane Enchanter to complete the tutorial.

base_facts: I am the court wizard of Whiterun, stationed at my research quarters in Dragonsreach.
I sell soul gems, enchanted items, and other supplies needed for enchanting.

ASK_ABOUT_ENCHANTING: I explained the basics of enchanting: learn enchantments by disenchanting enchanted items at the Arcane Enchanter, then use a filled soul gem and the enchanter to apply the enchantment to another item.
Disenchanting destroys the source item, so I warned the student to be careful.
I have soul gems and other supplies for sale if the student needs them.
TUTORIAL_COMPLETED: The student has used the Arcane Enchanter in my quarters, taking their first step into the craft of enchanting.
I have fulfilled my role as their guide to the basics; it is now up to them to practice disenchanting items and applying enchantments with filled soul gems.
I remain available to sell soul gems and other supplies if the student has the coin to continue their studies.

beats.comment: Player asks Farengar how to enchant weapons and armor; he explains the basics and the quest objective is set.
Quest completes when the player activates the Arcane Enchanter in Dragonsreach. No enchanting or disenchanting is required.

title: Rising at Dawn
description: Falion in Morthal can cure vampirism through a ritual requiring a filled black soul gem, performed at his summoning circle at dawn.

base_facts: I am Falion, a mage in Morthal who studies vampires and the undead.
I can cure vampirism through a ritual at the summoning circle north of town.
I require a filled black soul gem to perform the cure ritual.
I perform the ritual at dawn and will not help if the vampire is Blood-Starved.

HEAR_ABOUT_CURE: Someone has been asking about a cure for vampirism.
SPEAK_TO_FALION: I have agreed to cure this vampire. They must bring me a filled black soul gem.
DELIVER_SOUL_GEM: The vampire has brought me a filled black soul gem. They must meet me at the summoning circle at dawn.
PERFORM_RITUAL: I am performing the ritual to cure vampirism at the summoning circle.
CURE_COMPLETE: I have successfully cured the vampire of their vampirism.
Falion completes the ritual and cures the player of vampirism.
Go to Morthal and talk to Falion .
Meet Falion at Dawn [ edit ] At 3am, Falion will start making his way to the circle and remains there until 7am.

beats.comment: Player learns about Falion as a potential cure for vampirism from innkeepers or Dawnguard members.
Player speaks to Falion and agrees to the cure process.
Player brings a filled black soul gem to Falion.
Player meets Falion at the summoning circle at dawn and the ritual sequence begins.
Falion completes the ritual and cures the player of vampirism.
